18:60.t: Futhi khumbula mhla uMusa ethi kunceku yakhe: “Angeke ngiphumule kuze kube ngifika lapho kuhlangana khona izilwandle ezimbili noma ngihambe ibanga elide”.

18:61.t: Kuthe lapho bobabili befika lapho kuhlangana khona izilwandle ezimbili bakhohlwa inhlanzi yabo, yona eyavele yangena olwandle kwaqhekeka indlela yayo.

18:62.t: Kuthe sebendlulile [kuleyondawo] wathi [uMusa] kunceku yakhe: [Ake usiphe idlamini [isidlo sasemini] yethu, impela uhambo lwethu lolu lusikhathazile”.

18:63.t: Yathi: “Uyakhumbula ngenkathi siphula edwaleni, ngikhohliwe ukukwazisa ngenhlanzi futhi nguShayitani kuphela ongenze ngiyikhohlwe ukuyibalula. Ingene olwandle kwavuleka indlela yayo ngesimanga.

18:64.t: Wathi: “Yilokho ebesikufuna”. Babuyela emuva lapho abahambe khona.

18:65.t: Bazithela phezu kwesigqila sezinye izigqila zeThu esasinika umusa ovela kithi saphinde sasifundisa ulwazi luvela kithi.

18:66.t: Wathi uMusa: “Ngingahamba nawe yini ukuze ungifundise okunye kwalokho ofundiswe kona okuholela eqinisweni na?”

18:67.t: Sathi [isigqila sika Allah]: “Impela angeke wena ukhone ukungibekezelela”.

18:68.t: Belu ungakubekezelela kanjani lokho ongenalwazi lwakho na?

18:69.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “Uzongifumanisa - ngemvumo ka Allah – ngingobekezelayo futhi angeke ngephule umyalelo wakho”.

18:70.t: Sathi [isigqila sika Allah]: “Uma uzohamba nami, ungangibuzi ngalutho kuze kube yimi engiphawulayo ngakho”.

18:71.t: Bahambake bobabili baze bayogibela emkhunjini, sawubhoboza. Wathi [uMusa]: “Uyawubhoboza ukuze ucwilise abakuwo na? Impela wenze into embi”.

18:72.t: Sathi: “Angishongo yini ukuthi impela angeke wena ukhone ukungibekezelela”.

18:73.t: Wathi: “Ungangijezisi ngosebengikukhohliwe futhi ungangenzeli izinto zami zibe nzima”.

18:74.t: Bahambake bobabili baze bahlangana nomfana, sambulala. Wathi [uMusa]: “Ubulala umphefumulo omsulwa ongabulalanga muntu? Impela wenze into eshaqisayo.

18:75.t: Sathi: “ Angishongo yini kuwe ukuthi impela angeke wena ukhone ukungibekezelela”.

18:76.t: Wathi: “Uma ngiphinde ngakubuza noma yini emuva kwalokhu ungabe usahamba nami, impela sekuphele wona amazaba lapha kimi”.

18:77.t: Baqhubeka bahamba bobabili baze bazithela phezu komuzi. Base becela ukudla kubantu bakhona kepha benqaba ukubamukela njengezihambi. Base bethola kuwo [lomuzi] uthango obeselutshekile lufuna ukuwa, saluvusa salumisa. Wathi [uMusa]: “Uma uthanda ungabakhokhisa ngalo inzuzo”.

18:78.t: Sathi [isigqila sika Allah]: “Yikhona ke la mina nawe esihlukana khona. Ngizokwazisa ngencazelo yakho konke lokhu ohluleke ukukubekezelela”.

18:79.t: Mayelana nomkhumbi, ubungowezichaka ezazisebenza olwandle, bengifuna ukuwufaka isici ngamabomu, ngokuba ngaphambi kwabo bekunenkosi ehlwitha imikhumbi [engenacisi] ngodli.

18:80.t: Mayelana nomfana, abazali bakhe bebengabakholwayo sase sisaba ukuthi uyobahlukumeza [lapho esemdala] ngokungezwa nokungakholwa.

18:81.t: Besifuna ukuthi iNkosi yabo ibaphe ongcono esikhundle sakhe noyobaphatha kahle.

18:82.t: Mayelana nothango, belungelezintandane zabafana ababili khona emzini, kanti ngaphansi kwalo bekunomcebo wabo bobabili futhi abazali babo babeqotho, ngakhoke iNkosi yakho beyifuna ukuba bakhule babe badala bese bekhipha memba umcebo wabo; isihawu esivela eNkosini yakho. Angikwenzanga ngokwentando yami. Leyo iyona incazelo yakho konke lokhu ongakhonanga ukukubekezelela.

18:83.t: Futhi bakubuza ngo Dulikarinani [umpondombili]. Yithi: “Ngizonilandisa ngendaba yakhe”.

18:84.t: Impela sambeka emhlabeni samnika indlela yokufinyelela kuyo yonke into [ulwazi lokuyenza].

18:86.t: Waze wafika entshonalanga, walithola lishonela esiyalweni esimnyama, wathola kunabantu lapho [entshonalanga]. Sathi: “We Dulikarinani, ungabajezisa noma ube nesihle kubo”.

18:87.t: Wathi: “Lowo ophambukile sizomjezisa bese ebuyela eNkosini yakhe iphinde imjezise isijeziso esishaqisayo”.

18:88.t: Kuthi lowo okholwayo owenza nezenzo eziqotho, uyothola umvuzo weJana, futhi siyokhuluma kahle naye.

18:90.t: Waze wafika empumalanga, walithola liphumela phezu kwabantu esingezange sibenzele isisithezo esibavikela kulo.

18:93.t: Waze wafika phakathi kwezintaba ezimbili ezazihonqile, wathola emuva kwazo zombili kunabantu abangaqondi lwimi [olunye].

18:94.t: Bathi: “Dulikarinani, impela isizwe sakwa Ya’ajuju nakwaMa’ajuju benza umonakalo ezweni. Kunganjani sikukhokhele ukuba usakhele uthango phakathi kwethu nabo.

18:95.t: Wathi: “Lokhu engikunikwe iNkosi yami kungcono, ngakhoke ngisizeni ningilethe abantu abanamandla ukuze ngakhe phakathi kwenu nabo uthango.

18:96.t: Ngipheni ingqukuqa yensimbi. Kuthe lapho esezivale zombili izinhlangothi zentaba [ngezisimbi], wathi: “Vuthelani [...basani umlilo ushise izinsimbi]”. Kuthe lapho eselenze lawumlilo luvutha [uthango], wathi: “Ngiletheleni ithusi ngiligalele ngaphezu kwalo [uthango lovuthayo].

18:97.t: Abazange bakhone [abakwaYa’ajuju nakwaMa’ajuju] ukuleqa [uthango] futhi abakhonanga ulibhoboza imbobo.

18:98.t: Wathi: “Lona umusa ovela ku Allah. Kepha uma sekufike isethembiso seNkosi yami uyolenza [uthango] lube uthuli. Ngokuba isithembiso seNkosi yami siyiqiniso.

18:99.t: Ngalolosuku siyobadedela abanye babo balakanyelane nabanye. Kuyothi lapho sekushaywa icilongo [okwesibili] sibabuthanise bonke ndawonye.

18:100.t: NgaloloSuku siyovezela obala iJahanamu kulabo abangakholwa.

18:101.t: Labo amehlo abo ayemboziwe engayiboni imibiko yaMi futhi bengakwazi ukuzwa lutho.

18:102.t: Ingabe laba abangakholwa bacabanga ukuthi bangenza izingqila zaMi abahlengi [babo] ngaphandle kwaMi na? Impela iJahanamu siyilungiselele labo abangakholwa ukuba bahlale kuyo.

18:103.t: Yithi: “Kunganjani nginitshele ngalabo ozenzo zabo azinanzuzo”.

18:104.t: Yilabo imisebenzi yabo empilweni yasemhlabeni yayisekudukeni kulapho bona becabanga ukuthi benza kahle.

18:105.t: Labo, yibona kanye abangayikholwanga imibiko yeNkosi yabo nokuthi bayohlangana naYo. Ngakhoke imivuzo yezenzo zabo yashabalala nangoSuku lokwahlulela asikuba nandaba nabo.

18:106.t: Labo umvuzo wabo iJahanamu ngenxa yokungakholwa kwabo nokwenza imibiko yaMi neZithunywa zaMi inhlekisa.

18:107.t: Nebala labo abakholwayo baphinde benze izenzo eziqotho, bayothola izivande zeFiridosi njengendawo yokuhlala.

18:108.t: Bayohlala kuzo unaphakade, abayikufuna ukususwa kuzo.

18:109.t: Yithi: “Ukube ulwandle beluwuketshezi lokuloba Amazwi eNkosi yami; beluphela ulwandle engakapheli Amazwi eNkosi yami, noma singaletha olunye [ulwandle] ukugcwalisela”.

18:110.t: Yithi: “Mina ngingumuntu nje kuphela, kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi lowo okumele nimkhonze uyedwa vo kuphela. Ngakhoke lowo ofisa ukuhlangana neNkosi yakhe makenze izenzo eziqotho [ezinhle] angabhangqi noyedwa ekukhonzeni iNkosi yakhe”.

19:2.t: Lokho ukulandisa ngomusa weNkosi yakho esigqileni saYo uZakariya.

19:4.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami, amathambo ami asebuthaka nekhanda lami seliqhakazile futhi angikaze ngibuye neze lapho ngikhuleka kuWe Nkosi yami”.

19:5.t: Nebala ngesaba izihlobo emuva kokuba ngingasekho kunjalo nje umkami akazele, ngakhoke ngiphe umsizi ovela kuWe”.

19:6.t: Oyoba indlalifa yami neyomndeni kaYakubu, futhi Nkosi yami, umenze athandeke.

19:7.t: Zakariya, impela sikuhalalisela ngomfana ogama lakhe kuzoba ngu Yahiya, akekho esike samqamba lona phambilini.

19:8.t: Wathi:”Nkosi yami, ngizomthola kanjani umfana ebe umfazi wami eyinumba kulapho nami ngizigugele ngingumxhiliba na?”

19:9.t: Yathi [ingelosi]: “Isho njalo iNkosi yakho, yathi: kulula kimi [ukudala umfana], belu ngakudala nawe phambilini ube wawukade ungelutho”.

19:10.t: Wathi [uZakariya]: “Nkosi yami, ngiphe uphawu”. Yathi: “Yathi uphawu lwakho ukuthi ungakwazi ukukhulumisa abantu izinsuku ezintathu”.

19:11.t: Waphuma egunjini lokuthandaza waya ebandleni lakhe, wabayalela ukuba badumise ekusenu nakusihlwa.

19:12.t: Yahiya, thatha iNcwadi [iTora] ngokuzimisela futhi samunika ukuqonda esasemncane.

19:13.t: Samupha futhi ububele obuvela kithi kanye nobumsulwa, futhi wayemthobela u Allah.

19:14.t: Futhi wayehlonipha abazali bakhe engewona umdlwembe oweyisayo.

19:15.t: Ukuthula makube kuye ngosuku azalwa ngalo nangosuku afa ngalo nangosuku ayovuswa ngalo [ekufeni] aphile.

19:16.t: Landisa [wena Muhamadi] lapha eNcwadini [iKurani] ngoMariyamu, mhla eqhela ngasemndenini wakhe wayohlala endaweni engasempumalanga.

19:17.t: Wazibekela isisithezo ezisitha kubo [abantu bakubo]. Sabe sesithumela kuye ingelosi yeThu [uJibhirili] eyathatha isimo somuntu oqotho phambi kwakhe.

19:18.t: Wathi [uMariyamu]: “Ngizivikela ngoNomusa kuwe uma ngempela umthobela u Allah”.

19:19.t: Yathi [ingelosi]: “Ngiyisithunywa nje seNkosi yakho, esithunywe ukukulethela umfana omsulwa”.

19:20.t: Wathi: “Ngingamthola kanjani umfana ngingakaze ngithintwe muntu [wesilisa] futhi ngingakaze ngibe unondindwa”.

19:21.t: Yathi: “Isho kanjalo iNkosi yakho: kulula kiMi, futhi siyomenza isibonakaliso ebantwini nomusa ovela kithi. Futhi yinto vele esinqunyiwe.

19:22.t: Wamthwala [ekhulelwe] waya naye endaweni esekudeni eqhelile.

19:23.t: Wahlaselwa umhelo ehleli ngaphansi kwesihlahla samasundu, wathi: “Ngifisa ukube ngafa kudala ngaphambi kwalokhu ngakhohlwa ngangaziwa nhlobo”.

19:24.t: Wammemeza [umfana wakhe] ngenzansi kwakhe wathi: “Ungakhathazeki ngokuba iNkosi yakho wenze umfundlana ezansi kwakho”.

19:25.t: Nyakazisela ngakuwe isiqu sesihlahla sizokuwisela amasundu amasha avunwe ngaleso sikhathi.

19:26.t: Yidla uphuze uthokoze. Uma ubona noma yimuphi umuntu, ubothi: “Ngizibophezele ku Allah ukuba ngizile, ngakhoke akukho muntu engiyomkhulumisa namhlanje”.

19:27.t: Wafika naye [umfana wakhe] kubantu bakubo emphethe. Bathi: “We Mariyamu, impela ufike nento eyinsumansumane”.

19:28.t: Dadewabo ka Haruna, uyihlo wayengeyena umuntu omubi futhi nonyoko wayengeyena unondindwa.

19:29.t: Wavele wabakhomba kuye [umfana wakhe]. Bathi: “Sizokhuluma kanjani noswana olusembelekweni na?”

19:30.t: Wathi [umfana kaMariyamu]: “Mina ngiyisigqila sika Allah, unginike iNcwadi wangenza iSithunywa”.

19:31.t: Futhi wangenza ngaba obusisekile noma yikuphi langikhona, wangiyalela ngeswala nezakati uma nje lokhu ngisaphila.

19:32.t: Futhi wangenza ngaba ohlonipha umama wami, akazange angenze umdlwembe ongezwa.

19:33.t: Ukuthula makube kimi ngosuku lapho ngizalwa nangosuku lapho ngifa nangosuku lapho ngivuswa ngiphile.

19:34.t: Loyo ngu Isa indodana ka Mariyamu. Amazwi eqiniso leli abalingabazayo.

19:35.t: Akumfaneli u Allah ukuba abe nengane; makangcweliswe. Uma efuna ukwenza noma yini, uvane kuyo: “Yenzeka”, bese iyenzeka.

19:36.t: Nebala u Allah iNkosi yami neNkosi yenu, ngakhoke mkhonzeni, iyona lena indlela eqondile.

19:37.t: Aphikisana wodwa amaqembu, imbubhiso ikulabo abangakholelwa ekubuthaneni koSuku olukhulu.

19:38.t: Yeka abayokubona nabayokuzwa ngosuku abayofika ngalo kithi. Kepha labo abangakholwa basekudukeni okusobala namhlanje.

19:39.t: Baxwayise ngosuku lokuzisola lapho okuyokwehlulelwa khona. Kulapho bona abanendaba futhi abakholwa.

19:40.t: Nembala yithina esiyoba yizindlalifa zomhlaba nakho konke okukuwo futhi bonke bayobuyela kithi.

19:41.t: Futhi landisa ngo Ibhirahimu eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayeneqiniso eyiSithunywa.

19:42.t: Mhla ethi kuyise: “Baba wami othandekayo, kungani ukhonza lokho okungezwa nokungaboni okungakusizi ngalutho”.

19:43.t: Baba wami othandekayo, impela senginolwazi olungakafiki kuwe, ngakhoke landela mina ngikuholele endleleni eqondile.

19:44.t: Baba wami othandekayo ungamkhonzi uShayitani ngokuba uShayitani weyisa wangamlalela Onomusa [uAllah].

19:45.t: Baba wami othandekayo, impela ngisaba ukuthi uyothola isijeziso esivela koNomusa bese uphenduka umlandeli ka Shayitani.

19:46.t: Wathi [uyise]: “Awunandaba nezikhonzwa zami na, we Ibhirahimu?” Uma ungaphezi ngizokukhanda ngamatshe mina uqobo futhi awungiyeke [ungangikhulumisi]isikhathi eside.

19:47.t: Wathi [u Ibhirahimu]: “Ukuthula makube kuwe. Ngizokucelela intethelelo eNkosini yami ngokuba yona inesihawu kimi”.

19:48.t: Futhi ngizonishiya nina kanye nalokho enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah, bese ngikhuleka eNkosini yami, hleze ngingehluleki lapho sengikhulekile eNkosini yami.

19:49.t: Kuthe lapho esebahlubukile kanye nalokho ababekukhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah, samupha u Isihaki noYakubu. Bobabili sabenza iZithunywa.

19:50.t: Sabapha nabo emseni weThu sabenzela ukutuswa kweqiniso okungapheli.

19:51.t: Landisa futhi ngoMusa eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayekhethekile futhi wabe eyiSithunywa esinguMembulelwa.

19:52.t: Sammemeza ngasohlangothini lwesokudla lwentaba iTuri, samsondeza sakhuluma naye.

19:53.t: Samupha emseni weThu umfowabo uHaruna owaba yiSithunywa.

19:54.t: Landisa futhi ngo Isima’ili eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayesigcina isithembiso futhi wabe eyiSithunywa esinguMembulelwa.

19:55.t: Wayehlala najlo eluleka umndeni wakhe ngeswala nezakati futhi wayethandeka eNkosini yakhe.

19:56.t: Landisa futhi ngo Idirisi eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayeneqiniso futhi eyiSithunywa.

19:58.t: Yibona ke labo u Allah ababusisile eZithunyweni nakuzalo luka Adamu nakulabo esabathwala kanye noNuhu nakuzalo luka Ibhirahimu nakulabo esabahola sabakhetha. Uma befundelwa imibiko yoNomusa, bawa phansi ngobuso bakhothame futhi bekhala.

19:59.t: Kepha balandelwa emuva kwabo yisizukulwane esasingenandaba neswala futhi silandela izinkanuko. Siyohlangabezana nokubi [eJahanamu].

19:60.t: Ngaphandle kwalowo ozisolayo akholwe bese enza izenzo ezinhle, yilaboke abayongena eJana futhi akukho noncane okungebona ubulungiswa okuyokwenziwa kubo.

19:61.t: Izivande zaphakade lezi Onomusa azithembise izigqila zaKhe zingazibonanga. Impela isithembiso saKhe nakanjani siyofika.

19:62.t: Abayikuzwa kuzo umbhedo ngaphandle nje kokuthi “ukuthula” [bebingelelana]. Bayothola ukudla kwabo kuzo ekuseni nakusihlwa.

19:63.t: Iyonake leyo iJana esiyoyenza ifa lalabo abangithobelayo kuzigqila zaMi.

19:64.t: [Yithi wena Jibhirili kuMuhamadi]: “Asehlingaphandle komyayelo kaAllah. Konke okungaphambi kwethu [okuzayo] nokusemuva kwethu [okwendlule] nokumaphakathi kwalokho kungokuka Allah. Futhi iNkosi yakho ayikhohlwa”.

19:65.t: UyiNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwakho. Ngakhoke khonzani Yena nibambelele ekukhonzeni Yena [Yedwa]. Ingabe ukhona yini omunye omaziyo ofana naYe na?

19:66.t: Umuntu uthi: “Ingabe uma sengifile ngiyophinde ngivuswe ngiphile na?”

19:67.t: Ingabe umuntu akasakhumbuli yini ukuthi samdala phambilini ebengelutho.

19:68.t: Ngiyifunge iNkosi yakho, siyobabuthanisa bonke kanye noShayitani ndawonye bese sibaletha baphahle iJahanamu beguqile.

19:69.t: Emuva kwalokho siyobe sesihlunga kuwo wonke amaqembu [aphambukile] lowo obeyisa u Allah kakhulu.

19:70.t: Futhi esibazikahle labo abanelwe ukungena kuyo [iJahanamu].

19:71.t: Futhi akekho kini nonke ongeke angena kuyo. Leso isinqumo seNkosi yakho esingeguqulwe.

19:72.t: Siyobahlenga labo abathobela uAllah kuthi labo abaphambukile sibayeke kanjalo phakathi kuyo beguqile.

19:73.t: Uma befundelwa imibiko yeThu ecacile, laba abangakholwa bathi kulabo abakholwayo: “Yilona liphi iqembu kwamabili [thina nani] elinemizi engcono nenkundla [yokuhlangana] engcono [ngobuningi] na?”

19:74.t: Ziningi izizwe ngaphambi kwabo esazibhubhisa, ababenempahla yasendlini enhle futhi bebukeka kahle.

19:75.t: Yithi: “Lowo odukile, Onomusa uyomengezela isikhathi, kuze kube yilapho bebona lokho abathenjiswe kona. Isijeziso noma iSikhathi [sokwahlulelwa]. Bayokwazike [ngalowo mzuzu] ukuthi ubani kahle empeleni ononendawo yokuhlala embi nonebutho elingatheni.

19:76.t: Labo abasendleleni eqondile u Allah uyobengezela ukuqonda. Futhi izenzo ezinhle yizona ezingcono eNkosini yakho ngomvuzo nangesiphetho.

19:77.t: Uyambona lona ongakholwa imibiko yeThu kepha athi: “Ngizophiwa umcebo nezingane”.

19:78.t: Ingabe wazi ikusasa [elingabonwa] noma wenze isivemelwano Allah na?

19:79.t: Phinde! Sizokuqopha lokhu akushoyo bese simengezela isijeziso ngaphezulu.

19:80.t: Futhi yithina esiyosala nalokhu akushoyo [umcebo nezingane zakhe] bese eza kithi eyedwa qwaba.

19:81.t: Baqoka izikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah ukuze zibe usizo kubo.

19:82.t: Phinde! Ziyokuphika ukukhonzwa yibo [emhlabeni] bese ziba izitha kubo.

19:83.t: Ubonile yini ukuthi sithumele oShayitani kulabo abangakholwa belokhu bebakuthazisisa [ekwenzeni okubi].

19:85.t: Mhla siyobuthanisela koNomusa labo abathobela u Allah njengezicukuthwane.

19:86.t: Siqhubele izigilamkhuba eJahanamu beshaya ngobhadu bonyiwe.

19:87.t: Abakwazi ukushweleza ngaphandle kwalowo owenze isivumelwano no Allah.

19:90.t: Kangangokuthi amazulu acishe asakazela aqhephuka ngakho kanjalo nomhlaba ucishe waqhekeka nezintaba zadilika.

19:93.t: Ngokuba konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kuyofika kuNomusa njengezigqila.

19:94.t: Impela ubazi bonke futhi ubabale bonke.

19:95.t: Futhi bonke bayofika kuYe ngoSuku lokwahlulela ngamunye vo.

19:96.t: Nebala labo abakholwayo benze nezenzo ezinhle, Onomusa uyobenzela uthando.

19:97.t: Impela siyenze lula [iKurani] ngolwimi lwakho ukuze wethule ngayo izindaba ezinhle kwabakholwayo uphinde uxwayise ngayo abantu abathanda ukuphikisa kakhulu.

19:98.t: Futhi ziningi izizwe ezibandelelayo esazibhubhisa. Ingabe ukhona noyedwa wabo ombonayo noma uzwe nje umsinjwana wabo na?

20:2.t: Asiyembulelanga iKurani kuwe [Muhamadi] ukuze uthole ubunzima.

20:3.t: Ngaphandle nje kokuthi ibe isikhumbuzo kulowo owesabayo [u Allah].

20:4.t: Yehle kancane kancane ivela kulowo odale umhlaba namazulu aphakeme.

20:6.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni nokumaphakathi kwawo nokungaphansi komhlaba kungokuka Allah.

20:7.t: Noma ungakhulumela phezulu, nembala u Allah wazi okuyimfihlo nokusithele.

20:8.t: U Allah akekho omunye ofanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe, unaMagama amahle.

20:10.t: Mhla ebona umlilo wathi kumndeni wakhe: “Hlalani la, ngibona umlilo hleze nginiphathele isikhuni esivuthayo noma ngithole ongangilayela indlela emlilweni”.

20:11.t: Kuthe lapho efika kuwo wamenyezwa; “We Musa”.

20:12.t: Nebala Yimina Lona iNkosi yakho. Ngakhoke khumula izimbadada zakho ngokuba usesigodini saseTuwa esihlanzekile.

20:13.t: Futhi sengikuhlonzile ngakhoke lalela lokho okwembulwayo.

20:14.t: Impela Yimina lona u Allah, akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaMi. Ngakhoke khonza Mina [kuphela] wenze neswala ukuze ungikhumbule.

20:15.t: Nembala iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] siyeza, ngithi angingasigaguli ukuze wonke umphefumulo uzuziswe ngalokho okwenzile.

20:16.t: Ngakhoke akungabi bikho muntu ongakholwa yiso nolandela izinkanuko ozokugudlula [ekukholweni] kuso, funa ubhubhe.

20:17.t: Yini lokhu okusesandleni sakho sokudla we Musa?

20:18.t: Wathi: “Induku yami, ngidondoloza ngayo ngiphinde ngephulele imfuyo yami amagatsha ngayo kantike ziningi ezinye izinto engisiza ngazo”.

20:20.t: Wayijikijela phansi, maqede yaba inyoka ihuhuluza.

20:21.t: Wathi: “Ithathe ungesabi, sizoyibuyisela esimeni sayo sasekuqaleni”.

20:22.t: Futhi faka isandla sakho ohlangothini lwakho [ngaphansi kwengalo], sizophuma sesimhlophe okungekona okokugula; isibonakaliso nje esinye.

20:23.t: Ukuze sikubonise ezinye zezibonakaliso zeThu ezinkulu.

20:24.t: Hamba uye kuFirawuni ngokuba impela usephule umthetho.

20:36.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Usukunikiwe lokhu okucelile we Musa”.

20:38.t: Khumbula mhla siyalela unyoko lokho okwayalelwa.

20:39.t: Ukuthi: “Mfake ebhokisini ulitshingele emfuleni. Umfula uyomkhafulela osebeni, athathwe yisitha saMi naye [uFirawuni]”. Futhi ngakuthela ngothando oluvela kiMi nokuthi wakhuliswa ngaphambi kwaMehlo Ami.

20:40.t: Mhla udadewenu ehamba [eya kuFirawuni] wathi: “Kunganjani nginitshengise ongakhona ukumnakekela na?”. Sakubuyisela kunyoko ukuze athokoze angakhathazeki. Futhi wabulala umuntu, sakuhlenga osizini saphinde sakuvivinya ngezivivinyo eziningi. Wabe usuhlala esizweni saseMadiyana iminyaka wase usufikela lapho onqunyelwe ukuba ube khona we Musa.

20:42.t: Hambake wena nomfowenu nezibonakaliso zami ningaphezi ukungikhumbula.

20:43.t: Hambani nobabili niye kuFirawuni, impela usephule umthetho ngokwedlulele.

20:44.t: Nobabili nikhulume naye amazwi amnene hleze alalele noma esabe [u Allah].

20:45.t: Bobabili bathi: “Nkosi yethu, impela sesaba ukuthi uyosijezisa noma adaze inkani”.

20:46.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Ningesabi ngokuba Mina nginani nobabili, ngilalele futhi ngiyabona”.

20:47.t: Iyani kuye nobabili nifike nithi: “Thina siyiZithunywa zeNkosi yakho. Ngakhoke dedela isizwe sakwa Isirayelikithi futhi ungasijezisi. Futhi size nesibonakaliso esivela eNkosini yakho. Ukuthula makube kulowo olandelela indlela yeqiniso”.

20:48.t: Nembala kwembulelwe kithi ukuthi isijeziso siyotholwa yilowo ongakholwa aphinde anganaki.

20:49.t: Wathi [uFirawuni]: “Ubani iNkosi yenu nobabili na, we Musa?”.

20:50.t: Wathi: “iNkosi yethu yilena eyepha yonke into umlingani wayo wase eyihola [kulokho ekudingayo]”.

20:52.t: Wathi: “iNkosi yami enolwazi ngabo lulotshiwe eNcwadini, phela iNkosi yami ayilenzi iphutha futhi ayikhohlwa”.

20:53.t: Lena eyenze umhlaba waba wandlaleka wanidabulela kuwo izindlela. Waphinda wehlisa amanzi emvula wanikhiqizela ngawo izitshalo ezahlukene ngambili.

20:54.t: Dlanini nidlise nemfuyo yenu. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulabo abanogebhezi olubhandlile.

20:55.t: Sinidale ngawo [ngenhlabathi umhlaba] futhi siyonibuyisela kuwo [mhla ningcwatshwa] siphinde sinikhiphe kuwo futhi okwesibili [mhla sinivuswa].

20:56.t: Sambonisa [uFirawuni] izibonakaliso zeThu zonke kepha wangakholwa futhi wenqaba.

20:57.t: Wathi [uFirawuni]: “We Musa, ingabe uze kithi ukuze usikhiphe endaweni yethu ngobuthakathi bakho na?”

20:58.t: Ngakhoke nathi sizokuhlangabeza ngomlingo ofanayo. Beka-ke isikhathi sokuhlangana phakathi kwethu esisosigcina thina nawe, indawo ephakathi nendawo.

20:59.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “Isikhathi senu sokuhlangana, usuku lwemvunulo futhi kumele abantu bathuniswe emini yasekuseni”.

20:60.t: Kepha uFirawuni wakushaya indiva [umlayezo ka Musa]. Wamane wahlanganisa itulo lakhe weza.

20:61.t: Wathi kubo uMusa: “Qaphelani, ningalinge niqambele u Allah amanga funa anibhubhise ngesijeziso. Futhi akazuzi lutho lowo oqamba amanga.

20:62.t: Baphikisana bodwa ngodaba lwabo futhi babhunga ngasese.

20:63.t: Bathi: “Nembala, laba bobabili abalumbi; bafuna ukunikhipha endaweni yenu ngemilingo yabo baphinde baniphuce usiko lwenu olusezingeni.

20:64.t: Ngakhoke, hlanganisani isu lenu bese nima imigqa. Uyohlabana namhlanje lowo oyodla ubhedu.

20:65.t: Bathi: “Musa, ungajikijela noma kube yithi esijikijela kuqala”.

20:66.t: Wathi: “Cha jikijelani nina”. Kwaba usebona izintambo zabo nezinduku zabo ongathi ziyahamba ngenxa yomlingo wabo.

20:69.t: Jikijela lokho okusesandleni sakho sokudla, kuyogwinya konke lokhu abakwenzile. Phela lokhu abakwkenzile itulo nje lomlumbi; futhi akukho lapho umlumbi aphumelela khona.

20:70.t: Abalumbi bawa ngobuso bekhothama, bathi: “Siyakholelwa eNkosini kaHaruni noMusa”.

20:71.t: Wathi [uFirawuni]: “Nimkholwa kanjani ngingakaniphi imvumo na? Okusho ukuthi nguyena impela ubongoza wenu onifundise umlingo. Ngizonigenca izandla nemilenze ngokuphambana bese nginibethelela eziqwini zamasundu; niyokwazi-ke ukuthi ngubani phakathi kwethu onesijeziso esinzima nesiyohlala sikhona”.

20:72.t: Bathi [abalumbi]: “Asisoze sakhetha wena kuna lezibonakaliso ezifike kithi naloyo osidalile. Yehlulela okwehlulelayo; phela wehlulela kuphela empilweni yasemhlabeni”.

20:73.t: Thina sikholelwe eNkosini yethu ukuze isithethelele izimpambuko zethu kanye nalokho kwemilingo osiphoqelele kukho. Futhi u Allah nguyena ongcono noyohlala ekhona.

20:74.t: Nebala, loyo oyofika eNkosini yakhe enecala [lokungakholwa]; uyothola iJahanamu, akayikufa kuyo noma aphile.

20:75.t: Kepha loyo oyofika kuYo engokholwayo enze nezenzo ezinhle; labo bayothola izigaba eziphezulu.

20:76.t: Izivande zaphakade okugeleza ezansi kwazo imifula, bahlale kuzo unaphakade. Lowo umvuzo walowo oziphathe kahle.

20:77.t: Futhi sembulela kuMusa ukuthi: “Hamba nezigqila zami ubasheyele indlela eyomile olwandle, ungesabi ukuficwa [uFirawuni] futhi ungabi novalo [lokuminza].

20:78.t: uFirawuni nebutho lakhe babalandela, kepha bambozwa amanzi lawo amamboza.

20:79.t: uFirawuni wabadukisa abantu bakhe, futhi akabaholelanga endleleni eqondile.

20:80.t: Sizwe sakwa Isirayeli, nebala sanihlenga esitheni senu futhi sanibekela isikhathi sokuhlangana ngasohlangothi lwesokudla entabeni iTuri. Futhi sanehlisela imana nezigwaca.

20:81.t: Dlanini kokumsulwa [okuhlanzekile] esinabele kona futhi ningabe seniphula imithetho kukho, funa nehlelwe ulaka lwaMi. Kantike lowo owehlelwa ulaka lwaMi, impela usuke esebhubhile.

20:82.t: Futhi impela Ngingothethelelayo kulowo ozisolayo bese ekholwa enze izenzo ezinhle azimelele endleleni eqondile.

20:83.t: Musa, yini lena ekwenze usheshe ufike ngaphambi kwabantu bakho na?

20:84.t: Wathi: “Labo basezithendeni zami; ngisheshe ukufika kuWe Nkosi yami ukuze uthokoze”.

20:85.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Impela sibalingile abantu bakho emuva kokuba usuhambile futhi uSamiri ubadukisile”.

20:86.t: Wabuyela ebantwini bakhe uMusa ecasukile elusizi. Wathi: [Bantu bakithi, ingabe iNkosi yenu ayizange yini inithembise isithembiso esihle na? Ingabe sibe side isikhathi kini [nadineka] noma nifune ukuba nehlelwe ulaka oluvela eNkosini yenu, kungakho ningasigcinanga isivumelwano sami na?

20:87.t: Bathi: “Asisiphulanga isivumelwano sakho ngokwethu. Kepha sithweswe imigodla bobucwebe babantu [bakaFirawuni] sayintshinga [emlilweni]. Kanjalo noSamiri waphonsela phakathi [ayekuphethe]”.

20:88.t: Wabakhiqizela umzimba wethole owawubhongisa okwenkomo, base bethi: “Nguye lona okumele nimkhonza nina noMusa kepha wakhohlwa”.

20:89.t: Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi alikwazi ukubaphendula futhi alikwazi ukubalimaza noma ukubazuzisa ngalutho.

20:90.t: Futhi uHaruni wayekade ethe kubo phambilini: “Bantu bakithi, niyalingwa ngalo [ithole]. Impela iNkosi yenu ngoNomusa. Ngakhoke landelani mina futhi nilalele imiyalelo yami”.

20:91.t: Bathi: “Siyolokhu sihleli kulo silindile kuze uyabuya kithi uMusa”.

20:92.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “Haruni, lapho ubabona beduka, yini ekuvimbile...?”

20:93.t: Ekutheni ungilandele, ingabe nawe wephule umyalelo wami na?

20:94.t: Wathi [uHaruni]: “Mtakamama, musa ungidonsa ngetshebe yami nangekhanda lami. Ngisabe ukuthi uzothi: - uhlakaze isizwe sakwa Isirayeli futhi wangawagcina amazwi ami”.

20:96.t: Wathi: “Ngibone abangakubonanga, ngase ngicaphuna ezinyathelweni zeSithunywa ngakuthela [ebucwebeni obebushiswa]. Ungiyenge kanjalo umphefumulo wami”.

20:97.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “Hamba, ngokuba empilweni yakho kuyomele uthi – ‘ningangithinti’ – futhi unesikhathi sakho ongeke waphuthiswa sona [kwelizayo]. Futhi buka lesi sikhonzwa sakho obuzinze kuso, sizosishisa bese sisifaza emanzini”.

20:98.t: Impela okunguyena enimele nimkhonze ngu Allah kuphela, Lona okungafanele kukhonzwe okunye ngaphandle kwaKhe. Ulwazi lwaKhe lwengamele yonke into.

20:99.t: Sikulandisela kanjalo izindaba zalokho osekwandlula. Futhi sikuphe isikhumbuzo esivela kithi [iKurani].

20:100.t: Lowo oyishaya indiva, uyothwala icala ngoSuku lokwahlulela.

20:101.t: Uyohlala kuso [isijeziso] unaphakade. Waze wamubi umthwalo wabo ngoSuku lokwahlulela.

20:102.t: Ngosuku lapho kuyoshaywa icilongo; siyobuthanisa abanamacala ngalolo suku beluhlaza [isibhakabhaka].

20:103.t: Bayokhulumela phansi phakathi kwabo [bathi]: “Nihlale [izinsuku] eziyishumi kuphela”.

20:104.t: Thina sikwazi kahle lokho abakushoyo lapho ethi lowo ongathi ukhaliphile kubo: “Cha, nihlale nje usuku kuphela”.

20:105.t: Futhi bakubuza ngezintaba. Yithi: “iNkosi yami iyoziphushula zibe impuqumpuqu”.

20:107.t: Angeke ubone kugwemba noma ukuba magwici kuwo.

20:108.t: Ngalolo suku bayolandela isigijimi esingenakugwemba. Futhi amazwi ayomthulela Onomusa, ngeke uzwe lutho ngaphandle nje kokuhlebezela.

20:109.t: Ngalolo suku akukho kushweleza okuyoba usizo, ngaphandle okwalowo oyovunyelwa Onomusa aphinde akuthakasele ukuba akhulume.

20:110.t: Wazi konke okungaphambi kwabo [okuzayo] nokusemuva kwabo [okwendlule], kepha bona abasoze bazi konke ngaYe.

20:111.t: Ubuso nobuso buyomthobela Ophilayo Ongumnakekeli. Futhi lowo oyobe ethwele impambuko [ukungakholwa] akasoze aphumelela.

20:112.t: Futhi lowo owenza izenze ezinhle ebe engokholwayo, akayikuwesaba okungekona ubulungiswa noma ukuncishiselwa [umvuzo].

20:113.t: Siyembulele kanjalo iyiKurani yesi Arabhu sacacisa kuyo ezinye zezijeziso, hlele bapheze noma ibakhumbuze ngandlela thize.

20:114.t: Makaphakanyiswe uAllah, iNkosi yeQiniso. Ungajahi ukufunda iKurani kungaphothulwa ukuyembulela kuwe [Muhamadi]. Futhi yithi:”Nkosi yami ngandisele ulwazi”.

20:115.t: Impela senza isivumelwano no Adamu phambilini. Kepha wakhohlwa futhi asimtholanga enokuzimisela.

20:116.t: Khumbula mhla sithi kuzingelosi: “Khothamelani u Adamu niwe ngobuso; zakhothama ngaphandle kuka Ibilisi, yena wala”.

20:117.t: Sathi: “Adamu, nebala lona isitha sakho nomkakho; makanganikhiphi-ke eJana funa nisokole”.

20:118.t: Ngokuba awusoze walamba noma uhambaze kuyo.

20:119.t: Futhi awusoze wonywa noma ushiswe yilanga kuyo.

20:120.t: uShayitani wamhlebela wathi: “Adamu, kunganjani ngikukhombise isihlahla saphakade nobukhosi obungapheli na?”

20:121.t: Badla kuso [isihlahla] babanqunu, baqala ukuzimboza ngamacembe aseJana. U Adamu wawuphula umyalelo weNkosi yakhe waphambuka.

20:122.t: Emuva kwalokho yamqoka iNkosi yakhe yamthethelela yamholela endleleni eqondile.

20:123.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Yehlani kuyo nonke; abanye benu bayoba izitha kwabanye. Ngakhoke uma kufika kini ukukhanya okuvela kiMi; lowo oyolandela ukukhanya kwaMi angeke aduka futhi angeke abe nesiphetho esibi.

20:124.t: Kepha lowo ofulathela isikhumbuzo saMi; uyoba nempilo enzima. Futhi siyomvusa ngoSuku lokwahlulela eyimpumputhe.

20:125.t: Uyothi: “Kungani ungivuse ngingaboni na, ngibe bengibona [phambilini] na?”

20:126.t: Uyothi [u Allah]: “Kanjalo yafika kuwe imibiko yeThu kepha wayingayinaka. Kanjalo-ke nawe namhlanje awuyikunakwa”.

20:127.t: Simjezisa kanjalo lowo ophula umthetho ebe engakholwa imibiko yeNkosi yakhe. Futhi isijeziso sakwelizayo sinzima futhi sihlala sikhona.

20:128.t: Ingabe ababonanga yini ukuthi maningi kanjani abezinye izizwe abahamba ezindaweni zabo esababhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulabo abakhaliphile.

20:129.t: Ukube bekungesiso isinqumo esibekiwe esivela eNkosini yakho [sokudondisa isijeziso] nesikhathi esibekiwe, besizobehlela [isijeziso besasemhlabeni].

20:130.t: Ngakho-ke kubekezelele lokho abakushoyo ubabaze udumo lweNkosi yakho ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga nangaphambi kokuba lishone. Nangezikhathi zakusihlwa, mbabaze. Nasemaphethelweni emini hleze uthokoze.

20:131.t: Futhi amehlo mawangalangezeleli lokho esikwabele labo abafana nabo [abangakholwa], okungubukhazikhazi bempilo yasemhlabeni ukuze sibavivinye ngakho. Futhi isabelo seNkosi yakho singcono futhi sihlala sikhona.

20:132.t: Yalela umndeni wakho ngeswala ubambelele kuyo. Asikuceli sondlo; yithina esikondlayo. Futhi isiphetho esalabo abathobela u Allah.

20:133.t: Bathi: “Kungani engasiletheli isibonakaliso esivela eNkosi yakhe na?” Abuzange yini bufike kubo ubufakazi obabuqukethwe iMibhalo yasendulo na?

20:134.t: Ukube sababhubhisa ngesijeziso ngaphambi kwaso [iSithunywa], bebezothi: “Nkosi yethu, okungenani ngabe uthumele iSithunywa kithi ukuze silandele imibiko yaKho anduba siphoxeke noma sihlazeke”.

20:135.t: Yithi: “Bonke balindele, ngakhoke nani lindani, kungekudala niyokwazi ukuthi ngobani abasendleleni eqondile nalabala abasekukhanyeni”.

21:1.t: Ukuhlulelwa kwabantu sekusondele kulapho bona benganakile bengenandaba.

21:2.t: Konke okuvela eNkosini yabo okuyimvuselelo yesikhumbuzo, bakulalela bedlala.

21:3.t: Izinhliziyo zabo zinganakile. Futhi labo abaphambukile babhunga ngasese [bathi]: “Lona ngumuntu ofana nje nani. Pho niya kanjani kumlimgo nibe nibhekile na?”

21:4.t: Wathi: “iNkosi yami ikwazikonke okushiwoyo ezulwini nasemhlabeni. Nguyena Ongozwayo Owaziyo”.

21:5.t: Kepha bathi: “ [iKurani] imbudane nje yamaphupho; empeleni [uMuhamadi] uziqambele yona kokunye uyimbongi [eqamba izinkondlo]. Makasilethele isibonakaliso njengoba kwenza iZithunywa zaphambilini”.

21:6.t: Ezinye zezizwe ezingakholwanga ngaphambi kwabo, sazibhubhisa. Ingabe bona bazokholwa na?

21:7.t: Futhi sathumela ngaphambi kwakho amadoda [ayiZithunywa] ebesembulela kuwo. Ngakhoke buzani labo abanolwazi uma ningazi.

21:8.t: Futhi asibenzanga izidumbu nje ezingadli ukudla futhi abaphilanga ubaphakade.

21:9.t: Futhi sasigcina isithembiso sabo sabahlenga nalabo esibathandayo sabhubhisa labo abephula umthetho.

21:10.t: Nebala sinilethele iNcwadi enodumo lwenu, kungani ningaqondi na?

21:11.t: Ziningi izizwe ezaziphambukile esazibhubhisa sazishabalalisa. Sadala abanye abantu emuva kwazo.

21:12.t: Kuthe lapho bebona isijeziso seThu esinzima, bateta izithende emhlane [babaleka].

21:13.t: Ningabaleki, buyelani kulokho ebeninetheze kukho nasemizini yenu ukuze nibuzwe.

21:15.t: Lokhu kwaba ukukhala kwabo saze sabenza okwesivuno bedindilizile befile.

21:16.t: Futhi asidalanga izulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi ngoba sidlala.

21:17.t: Ukube besifuna ukuchitha isizungu [ngokuba nengane noma umfazi] besiyomqoka kithi uqobo, kepha asisoze sakwenza.

21:18.t: Sijikijela amanga ngeqiniso liwahlakaze avane ashabalala. Futhi niyothola isijeziso ngenxa yalokho enikushoyo.

21:19.t: Bonke abasemazulwini nasemhlabeni bangabaka Allah. Futhi labo abakuYe abazigqaji ekumkhonzeni futhi abadineki.

21:21.t: Ingabe baziqokele izikhonzwa zasemhlabeni ezikwazi ukuvusa abafileyo na?

21:22.t: Ukube kwakukhona ezinye izikhonzwa ezulwini nasemhlabeni ngaphandle kuka Allah, kwakuyoxubana ubendle impela. Makangcweliswe u Allah iNkosi yeSihlalo kulokho amakushoyo.

21:23.t: Akabuzwa ngalokho akwenzayo, kepha bona bayobuzwa.

21:24.t: Ingabe baqoke izikhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe [u Allah] na? Yithi: “Lethani ubufakazi benu. Nali ulwazi ngalabo abanami [iKurani] nolwazi ngalabo abangandulelayo [iziNcwadi zaphambilini]. Empeleni abaningi kubo abalazi iqiniso, yingakho nje beshaya indiva.

21:25.t: Asikho iSithunywa esasithumela ngaphambi kwakho esingembulelanga kuso ukuthi: “Akekho okumele akhonze ngaphandle kwaMi, ngakhoke khonzani Mina [ngedwa]”.

21:26.t: Futhi bathi, Onomusa unengane. Makangcweliswe! Empeleni yizigqila ezihloniphekile [izingelosi].

21:27.t: Azikhulumi engakaziphi imvumo. Futhi zenza ngokomyalelo waKhe.

21:28.t: Wazi konke okungaphambi kwazo [okuzayo] nokusemuva kwazo [okwendlule]. Futhi aziyukushwelezela muntu ngaphandle kwalowo amvumele. Futhi ngenxa yokumesaba zihlala zithukile.

21:29.t: Uma omunye wazo engathi: “Yimina okumele ningikhonze ngaphandle kwaKhe [u Allah]”. Loyo siyomjezisa ngeJahanamu. Sibajezisa kanjalo abaphambukayo.

21:30.t: Ingabe laba abangakholwa ababonanga yini ukuthi amazulu nomhlaba kwakuhlangene, sakuhlukanisa. Futhi senza yonke into yaphila ngamanzi. Abakholwa ngani na?

21:31.t: Sagxumeka izikhonkwane [izintaba] emhlabeni ukuze ungazamazami nabo. Saphinde safaka izindlela ezibanzi ukuze baholeleke.

21:32.t: Senza isibhakabhaka uphahla oluqinile. Kepha bona abazinakile izibonakaliso zaso.

21:33.t: Futhi nguYena lona owadala ubusuku nemini nelanga nenyanga. Konke kuhamba emzileni [wayo].

21:34.t: Akekho umuntu esamunika impilo yaphakade ngaphambi kwakho. Ngakhoke, uma wena [Muhamadi] uzofa; ingabe bona bazophila unaphakade na?

21:35.t: Wonke umphefumulo uyowunambitha ukufa. Futhi siyonivivinya ngokubi nangokuhle bese niphindiselwa kithi.

21:36.t: Labo abangakholwa uma bekubona bakwenza inhlekisa [bathi]: “Ingabe nguyena lona okhuluma ngezikhonzwa zenu na?”. Kulapho bona bengakholwa okukhulunywa ngoNomusa.

21:37.t: Umuntu udalwe enokujaha. Sizonibonisa izibonakaliso zeThu, ngakhoke ningajahi.

21:38.t: Futhi bathi: “Siyofika nini lesi sithembiso uma ngempela niqinisile”.

21:39.t: Ukube labo abangakholwa bebazi ngesikhathi lapho bengeke bakwazi ukuvikela ubuso babo nemihlane yabo eMlilweni futhi bengeke basizakala.

21:40.t: Empeleni siyofika bengazelele, sibasanganise. Belu ngeke bakwazi ukusibusela emuva futhi abayikunikwa thuba.

21:41.t: Nebala iZithunywa ezingaphambi kwakho zenziwa inhlekisa. Kepha labo ababehlekisa ngabo bahaqwa yilokho ababehlekisa ngakho.

21:42.t: Yithi: “Ngubani oyonivikela koNomusa ebusuku nasemini na?” Empeleni abanendaba ngokushiwo iNkosi yabo.

21:43.t: Mhlawumbe banezikhonzwa ezizobavikela ngaphandle kweThu. Kepha abakwazi ukuzisiza bona uqobo futhi akekho oyabavikela kithi.

21:44.t: Siphe laba nokhokho babo ukunethezeka isikhathi eside. Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi silokhu siza siwudla kancane umhlaba ezinhlangothini zawo na? Ingabe bayonqoba na?

21:45.t: Yithi: “Nginisabisa ngalokho okwembulelwe”. Futhi isimumu asisoze sakwazi ukuzwa isimemezelo lapho sixwayiswa.

21:46.t: Uma betholwa isabelo nje esincane sesijeziso seNkosi yakho, bathi: “Kuphelile ngathi, impela siphambukile”.

21:47.t: Siyobeka izikali zobulungiswa ngoSuku lokwahlulela. Akukho mphefumulo oyokwenziwa okungebulungiswa nakancane nje. Noma kungaba into elingana nesisindo sohlamvu oluncane, siyokuletha. Futhi Thina sanele njengaba Hluleli.

21:48.t: Futhi sanika uMusa noHaruni umhlahlandlela [iTora] nokukhanya kanye nesikhumbuzo kulabo abathobela u Allah.

21:49.t: Labo abesaba iNkosi yabo bengayibonanga futhi besaba neSikhathi [sokwahlulela].

21:50.t: Futhi lesi isikhumbuzo esibusisekile esisambulele. Ingabe niyosiphika na?

21:51.t: Sanika u Ibhirahimu ukukhalipha kwakhe phambilini futhi besazi ngaye.

21:52.t: Mhla ethi kuyise nakubantu bakubo: “Yini lezithixo enilokhu nizinze kuzo na?”.

21:54.t: Wathi: “Impela nina nokhokho benu benisephutheni elisobala”.

21:55.t: Bathi: “Ingabe usilethele iqiniso noma nje uyadlala?”

21:56.t: Wathi: “Empeleni iNkosi yenu, iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba lena eyawadala futhi ngingomunye wabafakazela lokho”.

21:57.t: Ngimfunge u Allah, ngizokwakhela izithixo zenu itulo lapho senihambile ningekho.

21:58.t: Wazenza izicucu zonke ngaphandle kwesikhulu kunazo zonke ukuze mabuyele kuso.

21:59.t: Bathi: “Ubani owenze lokhu kuzikhonzwa zethu, impela akanabulungiswa”.

21:60.t: Bathi: “Sizwe lelibhungu okuthiwa ngu Ibhirahimu likhuluma ngazo”.

21:61.t: Bathi: “Mletheni phambi kwabantu ukuze babe ngofakazi”.

21:62.t: Bathi: “Ibhirahimu, ingabe nguwe owenze lokhu kuzikhonzwa zethu na?”

21:63.t: Wathi: “Empeleni yilesi esikhulu esikwenzile; ngakhoke buzani sona uma zikwazi ukukhuluma”.

21:64.t: Bathi ukuzidla bahlaziya base bethi: “Nebala yinina eniphambukile”.

21:65.t: Kepha babuyela enkanini yabo [bathi]: “Wazi kahle ukuthi lezinto azikwazi ukukhuluma”.

21:66.t: Wathi: “Nikukhonza kanjani ngaphandle kuka Allah lokho okungakwazi ukunizuzisa utho futhi kungakwazi nokunilimaza na?”.

21:67.t: Hhayi suka! Kungani pho nilokhu nikhonza okunye ngaphandle kuka Allah; anisile yini emakhanda na?

21:68.t: Bathi: “Mshiseni, nilekelele izikhonzwa zenu uma ngempela nizimisele”.

21:70.t: Babefuna ukuqeda ngaye kepha sabenza kwaba yibona abalahlekelwayo.

21:71.t: Yena [u Ibhirahimu] noLuti sabahlengela ezweni [laseShamu] leli esalibusisela izizwe zonke.

21:72.t: Sabe sesimupha u Isihaki samengezelango Yakubu. Bobabili sabenza baba qotho.

21:73.t: Saphinde sabenza abaholi ababehola ngokomyalelo weThu sembulela futhi kubo ukuba benze izenzo ezinhle neswala nokunika izakati futhi babekhonza Thina.

21:74.t: uLuti naye samunika ubuhlakani nolwazi saphinde samhlenga endaweni [yaseSodoma] lapho ababenza khona amanyala. Nembala babengabantu abagcolile abayiziphula mthetho.

21:75.t: Samfaka emseni weThu, impela wayengowabanye abaqotho [abenzibokuhle].

21:76.t: Khumbula futhi mhla uNuhu ekhuleka phambilini. Sawuphendula umkhuleko wakhe, naye samhlenga kanye nomndeni wakhe osizini olunzima.

21:77.t: Saphinde samsiza kubantu, laba abathatha imibiko yeThu njengamanga. Impela, babengabantu abonakele. Ngakhoke, sabaminzisa bonke ngothi lwabo.

21:78.t: Khumbula futhi uDawudi noSulayimani mhla behlulela odabeni lwezitshalo okwafohlela kuzo izimvu zabantu [ebusuku zingalusiwe]. Futhi Besikhona ekwahluleleni kwabo.

21:79.t: Senza uSulayimani kwaba nguye oluqondayo. Kepha bobabili [yena noyise] sabapha ubuhlakani [ubuthunywa] nolwazi. Futhi sajubela uDawudi izintaba nezinye zidumisa naye; futhi yithina ebesikwenza [lokho].

21:80.t: Saphinde samfundisa ukwenza izembatho zokuzivikela ukuze zinivikele ezimpini zenu. Akenibongeke.

21:81.t: Futhi sanika uSulayimani umoya oyisivunguvungu ohamba ngomyalelo wakhe uye ezweni esafaka kulo izibusiso. Futhi besazi ngayo yonke into.

21:82.t: Futhi bekuno Shayitani ababemtshuzela [olwandle] baphinde benze eminye imisebenzi. Futhi besibaqaphile.

21:83.t: Khumbula futhi u Ayubu mhla ekhuleka eNkosini yakhe [ethi]: “Ngehlelwe ubunzima futhi Wena unomusa ukudlula bonke abanomusa”.

21:84.t: Sawuphendula umkhuleko wakhe, sabususa ubunzima ayenabo, samnika umndeni wakhe usuphindwe kabili njengomusa ovela kithi nesikhumbuzo kulabo abakhonzayo.

21:85.t: Khumbula futhi u Isimai’ili no Idirisi noDulikifili; bonke babengababekezelayo.

21:87.t: Khumbula futhi uDun-nuni mhla ehamba ecasukile, wacaba ukuthi asisoze samthola. Wakhuleka emajukujukwini obumnyama wathi: “Akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKho. Ungcwele, impela ngiphambukile”.

21:88.t: Sawuphendula umkhuleko wakhe samhlenga osizini. Futhi sibahlenga kanjalo abakholwayo.

21:89.t: Khumbula futhi uZakariya, mhla ekhuleka eNkosini yakhe [ethi]: “Nkosi yami, ungangiyeki ngingedwa [ngingenandlalifa] ube Wena ungongcono kulabo abayizindlalifa”.

21:90.t: Sawuphendula umkhuleko wakhe, samupha uYahiya samlungisela umkakhe. Impela babehlala njalo beziphuthuma izinto ezinhle baphinde bakhuleke kithi ngokulangezelela nangokwesaba. Futhi babezithoba benesizotho kithi.

21:91.t: Khumbula futhi nalowo owavikela ubuntombi bakhe. Saphefumulela kuye ngomoya weThu. Samenza yena nendodana yakhe isibonakaliso kundalo yonke.

21:92.t: Iyonake lena inkolo yenu – inkolo eyodwa; futhi Mina ngiyiNkosi yenu ngakhoke ngikhonzeni.

21:93.t: Kepha bahlakazeka phakathi kwabo, kodwa bonke bayobuyela kithi.

21:94.t: Lowo owenza izenzo ezinhle ebe engokholwayo; izithukuthuku zakhe angeke zicekelwe phansi; futhi Thina sizilobile.

21:95.t: Kunqatshelwe kunasiphi isizwe esasibhubhisa ukuba babuyele emuva [emhlabeni].

21:96.t: Kuze kube mhla kuvulelwa abakwa Ya’juju noMa’juju, lapho beyophuma kuzo zonke izindunduma begijima.

21:97.t: Siyosondela isethembiso seqiniso [uSuku lokwahlulela]; amehlo alabo abangakholwa ayobe endwazile [bethi]: “Kwaze kwaphela ngathi, impela besingenendaba ngalolu suku, eqinisweni besiphambukile”.

21:98.t: Nina kanye nalokho enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah niyoba izithungelo zaseJahanamu imbala, niyongena kuyo.

21:99.t: Ukube laba bebeyizikhonzwa ezifanelwe ukukhonzwa ngabe bebengeke bangene kuyo; futhi bonke bayobhadla kuyo unaphakade.

21:100.t: Bayobephefumulela phezulu [okomuntu onephika] kuyo kepha bengezwa.

21:101.t: Impela labo abavele sebenqunyelwe kithi iJana ngaphambilini; labo-ke bayoqheliselwa kude nayo [iJahanamu].

21:102.t: Abayikuzwa ngisho umsindo wayo [iJahanamu]. Futhi bayohlala unaphakade lapho abayothala konke abakufisayo.

21:103.t: Ukwesaba Okukhulu angeke kubakhathaze. Futhi izingelosi ziyobahlangabeza [zithi]: “Yilona lolo uSuku lwenu enanithenjiswe lona”.

21:104.t: Mhla siyosonga izulu njengokusongwa kwemibhalo esemiqulwini. Njengeba sayisungala indalo okokuqala siyophinda siyivuse. Kuyibophezelo kithi; impela siyokwenza.

21:105.t: Futhi saloba eziNcwadini zasendulo emuva kokuloba Oqwembeni, ukuthi, izwe ifa eliyotholwa yizigqila zaMi eziqotho.

21:106.t: Nebala lokhu [okuqukethwe iKurani] kwanele kubantu abakhonzayo.

21:108.t: Yithi: “Impela, kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi, okumele nimkhonze uyedwa nje vo; ngakhoke nani zinikeleni ke [nibe amaMusilimu]”.

21:109.t: Kepha uma bekushaya indiva, yithi: “Nginazisile ngokwanele. Futhi nami angazi ukuthi sekuseduze kumbe kusasekude lokhu enithenjiswe kona”.

21:110.t: Nebala nguYena [u Allah] owazi inkulumo esobala esidlangalaleni futhi wazi nalokho enikufihlayo [ngasese].

21:111.t: Futhi mina angazi ukuthi [ukudondiswa kwesijeziso] hleze kube yisivivinyo kini nokuthi nincebeleke okwesikhashana.

21:112.t: Wathi [uMuhamadi]: “Nkosi yami yehlulela ngeqiniso! Futhi iNkosi yethu Onomusa, iYona eyosinceda ngalokho abakushoyo”.

22:1.t: Nina bantu, thobelani iNkosi yenu, ngokuba ukuzamazama ngeSikhathi [sokwahlela] into enzima impela.

22:2.t: Mhla lapho niyobona umame oncelisayo ekhohlwa [uswana] aluncelisayo nozethwele uyozalela khona lapho. Futhi uyobona abantu engathi badakiwe kulapho bengadakiwe kepha isijeziso sika Allah sinzima.

22:3.t: Futhi kunalabo bantu abaphikisa ngo Allah bengenalwazi futhi ebe elandela wonke uShayitane oyihlongandlebe.

22:4.t: Unqunyelwe ukuthi lowo oyomlandela, uzomdukisa aphinde amholele esijezisweni somlilo.

22:5.t: Nina bantu, uma ninokungabaza ngokuvuswa [kwelizayo emuva kokofa]; bhekani ngoba sanidala ngobumba kwaba yisidoda kwaba ihlulu kwaba umbungu ophelele nongaphelele ukuze sinicacisele; futhi sigcina esikuthandayo ezibelethweni kuze kufike isikhathi esibekiwe; bese sinikhipha niyizingane, bese niyakhula nibe badala. Phakathi kwenu kunalabo abafayo [besebasha] kuthi abanye baze baguge baphenduke izintothoviyane ezingasazi lutho. Futhi uzobona umhlaba womile, kuthi lapho sesehlisele amanzi [emvula] kuwo uvele uqhakaze wande uphinde ukhiqhize lonke uhlobo oluhle lwezitshalo.

22:6.t: Lokho ngungenxa yokuthi u Allah uyiQiniso nokuthi nguYena ovusa abafileyo nongehlulwa yilutho.

22:7.t: Nokuthi iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] siyeza, akunakungabaza ngaso; nanokuthi u Allah uyobavusa labo abasemathuneni.

22:8.t: Phakathi kwabantu kunalowo ophikisana ngo Allah engenalwazi noma incazelo noma incwadi ecacisayo.

22:9.t: Uvele abheke le [ezigqaja], ukuze adukise [abantu] endleleni ka Allah [i-isilamu]. Uyothola ukuhlazeka lapha emhlabeni, kuthi ngoSuku lokwahlulela simzwise isijeziso somlilo.

22:10.t: Lokho, kungenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zakho nokuthi u Allah akasoze enze okungebulungiswa esigqileni.

22:11.t: Phakathi kwabantu, kunalowo okhonza u Allah enongabazane. Uma kumhambela kahle uyaqhubeka [ngokukhonza u Allah]. Kepha uma ehlelwa ubunzima uyajika [abe yimbuka]; akazuzanga lutho emhlabeni nakwelizayo. Lokho ukulahlekelwa okusobala.

22:12.t: Ukhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah lokho okungeke kwamlimaza [uma engakulaleli] futhi okungeke kwamzuzisa [uma ekulalela]. Lokho ukuduka okujulile.

22:13.t: Ukhonza lowo ubungozi bakhe buseduze kunosizo kwakhe. Waze wamubi umsizi nomhlanganyeli bo.

22:14.t: Nebala labo abakholwayo abenza nezenzo ezinhle u Allah uyobangenisa ezivandeni okugeleza ezansikwazo imifula. Impela u Allah wenza akufunayo.

22:15.t: Lowo ocabanga ukuthi u Allah akasoze amsiza [uMuhammadi] emhlabeni nakwelizayo; makabophele intambo ophahleni azikhunge ngalo bese ebheka-ke ukuthi lomzamo wakhe uyoyiqeda yini lenzondo anayo na?

22:16.t: Futhi sayembulela kanjalo [iKurani] iyimibiko ecacile nokuthi u Allah uhola amfunayo.

22:17.t: Impela labo abakholwayo, nalabo abangamaJuda, namaNasarina namaSabiya kanye noMajusi nalabo ababhangqayo; u Allah uyokwahlulela phakathi kwabo ngoSuku lokuKwahlulela. Phela u Allah uyiqhaphe yonke into impela.

22:18.t: Awuboni yini ukuthi bonke abasemazulwini nasemhlabeni kanye nelanga nenyanga nezinkanyezi nezintaba nezihlahla nezilwane neningi labantu, konke kuwa ngobuso kukhothamela u Allah. Kanti futhi baningi abafanelwe isijeziso. Futhi lowo u Allah amhlazile akekho oyombuyisa isithunzi. Impela u Allah wenza akufunayo.

22:19.t: Laba ababili abaphikisanayo baphikisana ngeNkosi yabo. Labo abangakholwa bayosikelwa izembatho emlilweni, bathelwe ngamanzi ashisayo ekhanda.

22:20.t: Kuyoncibikaliswa ngawo lokho okuseziswini zabo kanjalo nezikhumba.

22:22.t: Kuyothi njalo uma befuna ukuphuma kuwo [umlilo] ngenxa yosizi; bayobuyiselwa kuwo [kuthiwe]: “Yizwani-ke isijeziso somlilo”.

22:23.t: Labo abakholwayo benze nezenzo ezinhle, impela u Allah uyobafaka ezivandeni okugeleza enzansi kwazo imifula, bayohlotshiswa kuzo ngeziqhizo zegolide nangamalulu, futhi izembatho zabo kuzo kuyoba isilika [emnene].

22:24.t: Futhi bayoholelwa emazwini amahle baphinde baholelwe endleleni encomekayo [i-Isilamu].

22:25.t: Impela labo abangakholwa nabayisihibe endleleni ka Allah naseMasijidiHaramu, lena esayenzela isintu ngokulinganayo, kungaba ozonzile kuyo noma oyisihambi. Futhi lowo ohlosa ukwenza kuyo [iMasijidiHaramu] impambuko ngokungebulungiswa siyomzwisa isijeziso esibuhlungu.

22:26.t: Khumbula futhi mhla sikhombisa u Ibhirahimu indawo yeNdlu [iKaba], [sathi kuye]: “Ungabhangqi lutho naMi. Futhi uhlanze iNdlu yami, [uyihlanzele] labo abayizungezayo nalabo abathandazayo [bemile, bekhotheme bewa nangobuso].

22:27.t: Memezela ngeHaji kusintu sonkana. Bayoza kuwe ngezinyawo nangamakameli bewagibele; beza ngazo zonke izindlela eziqhamuka ekudeni.

22:28.t: Ukuze bazibonele lokho okuyinsizakalo kubo baphinde babalule igama lika Allah ezinsukwini ezaziwayo ngalokho ababele kona ezilwaneni zemfuyo [ezizohlatshwa]. Ngakhoke, dlanini kuzo niphe nalowo abaphuyile [abadla imbuya ngothi].

22:29.t: Bese beqedelela ukususa izinsila zabo [ngokuqeda zonke izinkambiso ezisele], bagcine nezibopho zabo bese benza iTawafu [ukuzungeza] yeNdlu ekhululiwe [iKaba].

22:30.t: Lokho, nalowo ohlonipha izinkambiso zika Allah ezihloniphekile, yikona okongcono kuye eNkosini yakhe. Futhi nivunyelwe izilwane ezidliwayo ngaphandle kwalezi enilandiswe ngaso. Ngakhoke ziqhelelaniseni nokungcola kwezithixo niphinde niziqhelelanise namanga.

22:31.t: Nibe msulwa ku Allah ningambhangqi nalutho. Futhi lowo obhangqa u Allah, kungathi uwe emkhathini wahlwithwa yinyoni noma wahamba nomoya wamusa endaweni esekudeni.

22:32.t: Lokho, nalowo ohlonipha Izimpawu zika Allah, impela kusuka ekuthobeni kwezinhliziyo.

22:33.t: Ninezinsizakalo kuzo [izilwane zomhlatshelo] kuze kufike isikhathi esibekiwe emuva kwalokho ziyohlatshwa eNdlini ekhululiwe.

22:34.t: Futhi zonke izizwe [zabakholwayo zaphambilini] sababekela izinkambiso [zokuhlaba] ukuze babalule igama lika Allah kulokho ababele kona ezilwaneni ezidliwayo. Belu okumele nimkhonze uyedwa vo, ngakhoke zinikeleni kuYe. Futhi thula izindaba ezimnandi kulabo abazithobayo.

22:35.t: Laba okuthi uma kuphathwa igama lika Allah, izinhliziyo zabo zigcwala ukwesaba futhi banga babekezelayo kulokho okubehlelayo baphinde benze neswala nakulokho esibabele kona bayanikela.

22:36.t: Amakameli anonile nawo siwenze aba ezinye zezimpawu zika Allah, ninokuhle kuzo. Ngakhoke phimisani igama lika Allah kuwo lapho limile [nilihlaba]. Uma seliwile ngohlangothi, dlanini kuwo niphe ohluphekayo ongaceli nocelayo. Sinijubele wona kanjalo ukuze nibonge.

22:37.t: Inyama yawo ayisoze yafika ku Allah kanjalo negazi lawo kepha iTakuwa [ukuthobela intando ka Allah nokuzinikela kuYe] evela kini efika kuye. Unijubele wona kanjalo ukuze niqhakambise ubukhulu buka Allah ngalokho aniholele kukho. Futhi yethula izindaba ezinhle kulabo abenza okuhle.

22:38.t: Impela u Allah uyabavikela labo abakholwayo; ngokuba u Allah akamthandi impela wonke lowo oyiqili ongabongi.

22:39.t: Labo abahlaselwa ngokungebulungiswa bavunyelwe [ukuba baziphindiselele], futhi impela u Allah unamandla okubasiza [abakholwayo bengalwanga].

22:40.t: Labo abakhishwa emizini yabo ngokungemthetho, ngenxa nje yokuthi bathi: “u Allah iNkosi yethu”. Ukube u Allah akavikelanga abanye abantu ngabanye, ngabe kade abhindlizwa amaTempeli nama Sonto nama Sinagogi nama Masijidi okuphathwa igama lika Allah kakhukulu. Futhi u Allah nakanjani uyomsiza lowo omsizayo [ngokuvikela intando]. Impela u Allah Ungumninimandla onguSomandla.

22:41.t: Labo uma sibamisa emhlabeni baqikelele ukwenza iswala bakhiphe nezakati bagqugquzele okuhle banqande okubi. Futhi isiphetho zezinto [zonke] ngesika Allah.

22:42.t: Uma bekuphika, kanjalo nalabo ababandulelayo baphika; isizwe sikaNuhu no Adi kanye noTamudi.

22:44.t: Nabantu base Madiyana. No Musa waphikwa; ngabayeka okwesikhashana laba abangakholwa ngase ngibajezisa. Bheka nje ukuthi saba njani isijeziso saMi.

22:45.t: Ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa mhla ziphambuka; zawa bhu phansi nophahla lwazo. Futhi miningi nemithombo eyekelelwe nezinqaba eziphakeme.

22:46.t: Ingabe abahambanga yini ezweni babe nezinhliziyo abaqonda ngazo noma izindlebe abezwa ngazo. Empeleni, akuwona amehlo angaboni, kepha yizinhliziyo lezi ezisezifubeni okuzona ezingaboni.

22:47.t: Futhi bakujaha ngesijeziso; bheka ngoba u Allah akasoze asiphula isethembiso saKhe. Futhi usuku olulodwa eNkosini yakho lulingana neninyaka eyinkulungwane kulokhu enikubalayo.

22:48.t: Futhi ziningi izizwe esazipha isikhathi nakuba zaziphambukile. Sabe sesizijezisa belu isiphetho sikiMi.

22:50.t: Ngakhoke, labo abakholwayo baphinde benze okulungileyo, bayothola intethelelo nesondlo esihle.

22:51.t: Kuthi labo abazikhandla ukuphikisana nemibiko yeThu, yibona kanye abayongena emlilweni.

22:52.t: Futhi yileso naleso Sithunywa noMembulelwa [uMphorofeti] esamthumela ngaphambilini kwakho [Muhamadi]; kwakhuthi lapho uma efunda, uShayitani azame ukwengeza ekufundeni kwaso. Kepha u Allah uyakwesula lokho okwengezwa uShayitane bese ehlunga ngobuchule imibiko yaKhe. U Allah Unolwazi Ukhaliphile.

22:53.t: Ukuze enze lokho okwengezwe uShayitani kube isivivinyo kulabo abanokufa [ukuzenzisa] ezinhliziyweni zabo nalabo ozinhliziyo zabo zilukhuni.

22:54.t: Nokuthi labo abaphiwe ulwazi bazi ukuthi iyiqiniso [iKurani] elivela eNkosini yakho, ukuze bakholwe yiyo nezinhliziyo zabo ziyithobele. Impela u Allah unguMholeli walabo abakholwayo endleleni eqondile.

22:55.t: Futhi labo abangakholwa bayohlala beyingabaza kuze kube mhla kufika iSikhathi bengazelele noma bafikelwe isijeziso soSuku olomile [uSuku lokwahlulela].

22:56.t: Bonke ubukhosi ngalolo Suku bungobuka Allah, uyokwahlulela phakathi kwabo. Ngakhoke, labo abakholwayo baphinde benze okulungileyo bayongena ezivandeni zengcebeleko.

22:57.t: Kuthi labo abangakholwa baphinde bathatha imibiko yeThu njengamanga, labo, yibona kanye abathola isijeziso esithunazayo.

22:58.t: Futhi labo abafudukela endleleni ka Allah bese bebulawa noma bazifele, u Allah uyobondla ngesondlo esihle. Impela u Allah unguMondli ongcono.

22:59.t: Uyobangenisa endaweni abayoyithakasela. Impela u Allah Unolwazi Unesineke.

22:60.t: Lokho; lowo ophindisela ngokulingene lokho ahlukunyezwe ngakho kepha bese ehlukunyezwa ngokungemthetho, u Allah uyomsiza nakanjani. Impela u Allah Umnene Ungumthetheleli.

22:61.t: Lokho, yingoba u Allah ufaka ubusuku emini afake imini ebusuku nokuthi impela u Allah Ungozwayo Obonayo.

22:62.t: Lokho; yingoba u Allah nguYena Oyiqiniso kanti lokhu abakukhonzayo ngaphandle kwaKhe kuwumbhedo, nokuthi u Allah nguYena Ophakeme Omkhulu.

22:63.t: Awuboni yini ukuthi u Allah wehlisa amazi emvula bese umhlaba uguquke ube luhlaza. Impela u Allah Ungonakayo Onolwazi.

22:64.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokwaKhe. Belu impela u Allah Ungozimele Odunyiswayo.

22:65.t: Awuboni yini ukuthi u Allah unijubele konke okusemhlabeni kanjalo nomkhumbi ohamba olwandle ngomyalelo waKhe. Futhi ubambe isibhakabhaka ukuba singaweli phezu komhlaba, ngaphandleke uma ekuvumela [lokho]. Impela u Allah Unobubele Unesihe kusintu.

22:66.t: Futhi nguYena onipha ukuphila aphinde akuthathe aphinde anivuse. Impela umuntu akakholwa.

22:67.t: Isizwe nesizwe sisibekele inkambiso abahambisa ngayo. Ngakhoke mabangaqophisani nawe kuloludaba. Futhi memela eNkosini yakho; impela usekukhanyeni okuqondile.

22:68.t: Kepha uma bephikisana nawe, yithi: “u Allah ukwazi kahle lokho enikwenzayo”.

22:69.t: U Allah uyokwehlulela phakathi kwenu ngoSuku lokwahlulela kulokho eniphikisana ngakho.

22:70.t: Awazi yini ukuthi u Allah wazi konke okusezulwini nasemhlabeni. Impela lokho kulotshiwe [oqwembeni olulondiwe]. Impela lokho kuwubala ku Allah.

22:71.t: Futhi bakhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah lokho okungenabufakazi ngakho nalokho abangenalwazi ngakho. Futhi labo abaphambukile akekho oyobahlenga.

22:72.t: Uma befundelwa imibiko yeThu ecacile, ubona ukunyukubala ebusweni balabo abangakholwa. Kusala nje kancane ukuba babagxavule labo ababafundela imibiko yeThu. Yithi: “Kunganjani nginazise ngokubi kakhulu kunalokho na? Umlilo u Allah awuthembise labo abangakholwa, futhi saze sasibi isiphetho”.

22:73.t: Nina bantu, kwenziwe umzekelo ngakhoke wulaleleni. Impela labo enibakhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah abasoze badala ngisho impukane noma bengayihlanganela. Futhi uma impukane ibahlwitha utho abasoze bakhona ukuyiphuca kona. Akanamandla umthungathi [izikhonzwa] nothungathwayo [impukane].

22:74.t: Abamhloniphanga u Allah ngendlela efanele Yena. Impela u Allah Ungonamandla OnguSomandla.

22:75.t: U Allah uqoke izithunywa ezingelosini nasebantwini. Impela u Allah Ungozwayo Obonayo.

22:76.t: Ukwazi konke okungaphambi kwabo [okwendlula] nokusemuva kwabo [ikusasa]. Futhi zonke izinto ziyobuyela ku Allah.

22:77.t: Nina enikholwayo khothamani futhi niwe ngobuso nikhonze iNkosi yenu nenze okuhle ukuze niphumelele.

22:78.t: Futhi zikhandleni ku Allah, ukuzikhandla okufanele Yena. NguYena oniqokile futhi akanenzelanga ubunzima enkolweni; okuyinkolo kababa wenu u Ibhirahimu. NguYena oniqambe ukuthi ningamaMusilimu ngaphambilini [eZincwadini] nakulokhu [kwiKurani]. [Uniqokile] ukuze iSithunywa sibe ufakazi ngani, nani nibe ngofakazi ngesintu sonkana. Ngakhoke qikelelani ukwenza iswala nikhiphe nezakati nibambelele ku Allah, ngokuba nguYena uMhlengi wenu; yeka uMhlengi omuhle noMsekeli omuhle.

23:6.t: Ngaphandle kubafazi babo noma amabibi abo ezigqila, ngokuba abayikusolwa.

23:7.t: Ngakhoke lowo oyofuna [ukwanelisa izinkanuko] ngale kwalokho; labo bayiziphula mthetho.

23:12.t: Futhi impela samdala umuntu ngobumba oluthathwe ndawo zonke.

23:13.t: Sabe sesimenza isidoda endaweni eyinqaba [esibelethweni sikanina].

23:14.t: Sabe sesenza isidoda saba ihlulu; senza ihlulu umbungu; senza umbungu waba namathambo; samboza amathambo ngenyama; samenza isidalwa esehlukile [kunalokho ebesiyikho ekuqaleni]. Ungcwele u Allah onguMdali oyingcweti kunano bonke.

23:17.t: Futhi impela sadala ngaphezu kwenu izigaba eziyisikhombisa [amazulu] futhi akukho ndalo esingayinakile.

23:18.t: Saphinde sehlisa amanzi emvula ngenani elibaliwe sawazinzisa emhlabeni. Futhi siyakwazi ukuphinde siwashabalalise.

23:19.t: Sanikhulisela ngawo [amanzi] izivande zamasundu nemivini, enithola kuzo [izivande] izithelo eziyinala niphinde nidle nakuzo.

23:20.t: Kanjalo nesihlahla esimila ngasentabeni iTuri esikhiqiza amafutha nesishebo kwabadlayo.

23:21.t: Impela ninesifundo kwimpahla efuywayo. Sinipha okuphazwayo okuphuma eziswini zayo kanti futhi ninezinsizakalo eziningi kuyo kunjalo nje niyadla kuyo.

23:23.t: Sathumela uNuhu esizweni sakhe, wathi: “Bantu bakithi, khonzani u Allah ngokuba akekho omunye okufanele nimkhonze ngaphandle kwaKhe, ake nizithobe”.

23:24.t: Zathi izikhulu lezi ezingakholwa esizweni sakhe: “Lona umuntu nje ofana nathi, ufuna ukuzenza ngcono kini. Ukube u Allah ubefuna, ngabe ulethe izingelosi. Yilokho kwathi nhlo, asikaze sizwe ngalokho ngisho nakokhokho bethu imbala”.

23:25.t: Akayilutho ngaphandle nje kwendoda ewuhlanya; myekeleni nilinde okwesikhashana.

23:26.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami ngisize kulokho abangiphikisa ngakho”.

23:27.t: Sabe sesembulela kuye ukuthi: “Yakha umkhumbi ngaphambi kwaMehlo eThu nangokwembulela kweThu. Kuyothi lapho sekufika umyalele weThu [wesijeziso] kwagobhoza amanzi eziko; layisha kuyo yonke [inhlobo] yendalo ngakubili [izinsika neduna] kanye nomndeni wakho, ngaphandle nje kwalabo kubo isinqumo esiphothuliwe ngabo. Futhi ungangikhulumisi mayelana nalabo abaphambukile ngokuba impela bayominza”.

23:28.t: Uma wena [Nuhu] usugibelile emkhunjini kanye nalabo abanawe, yithi: “Udumo lungo luka Allah lona osihlengile kubantu abaphambukile”.

23:29.t: Futhi yithi: “Nkosi yami ngihlalise endaweni ebusisekile ngokuba Wena ungumhlalisi okumpetha kwabahlalisayo.

23:31.t: Sabe sesidala esinye isizwe emuva kwabo.

23:32.t: Sathumela kubo iSithunywa esivela kubo, [ukuba sithi]: “Khonzani u Allah ngokuba akekho omunye okufanele nimkhonze ngaphandle kwaKhe, ake nizithobe”.

23:33.t: Izikhulu lezi ezingakholwa esizweni sakhe neziphika ukuhlangana kwelizayo, nesasizinjingisile empilweni yasemhlabeni, yithi: “Lona umuntu nje ofana nani, udla lokhu enikudlayo aphinde aphuze lokhu enikuphuzayo”.

23:34.t: Uma nje nike nalalela umuntu ofana nani impela niyoba ngabalahlekelwe.

23:35.t: Ingabe unithembisa ukuthi lapho senifile naphenduka umhlabathi namathambo, niyophinda nivuswe na?

23:37.t: Akulutho nje ngaphandle kwempilo yethu yasemhlabeni, siyafa siphile kepha asisoze savuswa.

23:38.t: Lona indoda nje eqambela u Allah amanga futhi thina angake simkholwe.

23:39.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami ngisize kulokho abangiphikisa ngakho”.

23:41.t: Bahlaselwa umsindo ngokweqiniso sabenza badindiliza [okwezibi ezikhafulwa umfula]. Baqalekisiwe abantu abaphambikile.

23:42.t: Sabe sesiletha ezinye izizwe emuva kwabo.

23:43.t: Futhi akukho sizwe esiyophutha isikhathi saso esibekiwe noma sisigeje.

23:44.t: Sabe sesithumela iZithunywa zethu zilandelana. Kepha njalo nje uma iSithunywa sifika esizweni, bayasiphikisa. Ngakhoke sabalandelanisa [ngezijeziso] futhi sabenza undabuzekwayo.

23:45.t: Saphinda sathumela uMusa nomfowabo uHaruna nezibonakaliso zeThu nobufakazi obusobala.

23:46.t: KuFirawuni nezikhulu zakhe, kepha bazigqaja futhi babengabantu abaziqhakambisayo.

23:47.t: Bathi: “Singabakholwa kanjani abantu ababili abafana nathi, kulapho nje nesizwe sabo sikhonza thina”.

23:48.t: Babaphikisa bobabili; ngakhoke baba ngabanye ababhujiswayo.

23:49.t: Futhi sanika uMusa iNcwadi impela ukuze balandele indlela eqondile.

23:50.t: Futhi senza indodana kaMariyamu nonina isibonakaliso sabakhoselisa endaweni ephakeme eyisicaba futhi egeleza amanzi.

23:51.t: Nina Zithunywa, dlanini lokho okumsulwa futhi nenze okulungileyo; impela Minangikwazi konke enikwenzayo.

23:52.t: Futhi lenkolo yenu inkolo eyodwa futhi Mina ngiyiNkosi yenu, ngakhoke ngithobeleni.

23:53.t: Kepha udaba lwabo lwaqhekeka phakathi kwabo baba ngamaqembu; ilelo nalelo qembu lajabula ngalokho elinakho.

23:54.t: Bayekele kanje ekudukeni kwabo kuze kufike isikhathi [esibekiwe].

23:55.t: Ingabe bacabanga ukuthi lokhu esibandisela kona kumceso nezingane;

23:57.t: Impela labo ngenxa yokwesaba iNkosi yabo bahlala bethukile.

23:60.t: Nalabo abanikela ngalokho abanikela ngakho izinhliziyo zabo zesaba ukuthi bayobuyela eNkosini yabo.

23:61.t: Yibo ke labo abaphuthuma okulungileyo futhi bayancintisana ngakho.

23:62.t: Futhi akekho umuntu esimthweza umthwalo ongaphezu kwakhe. Futhi sineNcwadi ekhuluma iqiniso. Futhi abasoze benziwa okungebulungiswa.

23:63.t: Empeleni izinhliziyo zabo zidukile mayelana nalokhu [iKurani] futhi banezinye izenzo ngaphandle kwalokho [ukubhangqa u Allah] abazenzayo.

23:64.t: Kuyothi lapho sesigasela labo abaziqhakambisayo kubo ngesijeziso; kuyoba yibo labaya sebehayiza.

23:65.t: Ningahayizi namhlanje ngokuba akukho sizo eniyolithola lapha kithi.

23:66.t: Impela nanifundelwa imibiko yaMi, kepha nina nahlehla nyovana nibaleka.

23:68.t: Ingabe abayihlaziyanga yini inkulumo [yeKurani] kumbe bafikelwe yilokho okungakaze kufike kokhokho babo basendulo na?

23:69.t: Noma abasiboni kahleiSithunywa sabo yingakho nje besiphika?

23:70.t: Kumbe bathi siyahlanya. Empeleni ulethe iqiniso kepha iningi labo alilifuni iqiniso.

23:71.t: Uma iqiniso lingalandela izinkanuko zabo, amazulu nomhlaba nokuqukethe yikho bekuyonakala. Empeleni sibalethele lokho okuyobaphakamisa kepha bona bakushaya indiva ukuphakanyiswa kwabo.

23:72.t: Kumbe ubacela inzuzo; inzuzo yeNkosi yakho iyona engcono, belu Yiyo enguMondli obandlula bonke.

23:74.t: Impela laba abangakholelwa kwelizayo baphambukile endleleni eqondile.

23:75.t: Noma singaba nomusa kubo siphinde sisuse ubunzima abakubo, bazobuyela bagxile banhlanhlathe empambukweni yabo.

23:76.t: Futhi sabahlasela ngesijeziso, kepha abazange bazithobe eNkosini yabo noma bazincengele.

23:77.t: Kuze kuthi mhla sibavulela umnyango onesijeziso esinzima kube yibona asebedidekile kuso.

23:78.t: Futhi nguYena lona onidalele ukuzwa nokubona nezinhliziyo, kepha anivamanga ukubonga.

23:79.t: Futhi nguYena lona onidalile emhlabeni futhi niyobuthaniselwa kuye.

23:80.t: NguYena futhi lona oletha ukuphila nokufa futhi ukuphambana kobusuku nemini kungokwaKhe, ake nicabange.

23:82.t: Bathi: “Kuyothi sesifile saba umhlabathi namathambo, siphinde sivuswe na?”

23:83.t: Kudala sathenjiswa lokhu thina kanye nokhokho bethu phambilini. Lokhu izinganekwane nje zasendulo.

23:84.t: Yithi: “Umhlaba nokuhlala kuwo kungokukabani uma ngempela nazi na?”

23:86.t: Yithi: “Ngubani umnikazi wamazulu ayisikhombisa nomnikazi weSihlalo esikhulu na?”

23:88.t: Yithi: “Ngubani lona ubukhosi bazo zonke izinto buseZandleni zaKhe futhi uyavikela akavikelwa uma nazi na?”

23:90.t: Impela sibalethele iqiniso futhi yibona impela abanamanga.

23:91.t: U Allah akaziqokelanga ngane futhi akukho esinye isikhonzwa esinaYe. Ukube bekunjalo, ngabe ileso naleso sikhonzwa besizogqoza nalokho esikudalile futhi bezizozama ukulawulana. Makangcweliswe u Allah kulokho abakushoyo.

23:92.t: Isazi sokungabonwa nokubonwayo, uphakeme kulokho abakubhangqayo.

23:93.t: Yithi: “Nkosi yami, uma ungibonisa lokho abathenjiswe kona [isijeziso]...”

23:95.t: Impela Thina siyakwazi ukukubonisa lokho esibathembise kona.

23:96.t: Wena [Muhamadi] phindisela ngalokho okuhle ukudlula okubi. Thina siyakwazi kahle lokhu abakushoyo.

23:97.t: Futhi yithi: “Nkosi yami ngizivikela ngaWe kuzilingo zoShayitani”.

23:98.t: Futhi ngizivikela ngaWe Nkosi yami ekutheni bafike kimi.

23:99.t: Kuyothi mhla kufika ukufa komunye wabo athi: “Nkosi yami ngibuyisele emuva [emhlabeni]”.

23:100.t: Ukuze ngenze okulungileyo kulokho engakushiya emuva. Phinde!; impela amazwi nje awashoyo [angazimisele ngawo]. Futhi ngaphambi kwakhe iBarizakhi kuze kube usuku lapho beyovuswa.

23:101.t: Mhla kushaywa icilongo, buyophela ubuhlobo phakathi kwabo ngalolo suku futhi abayi kubuzana.

23:102.t: Lowo oyoba nezisindo ezisindayo; yilabo abayophumelela.

23:103.t: Kepha lowo oyoba nezisindo ezilula; yilaboke abazilahlekele eJahanamu bayohlala kuyo unaphakade.

23:104.t: Umlilo uyoshiya ubuso babo futhi bayohlala behlinile [izindebe zishile amazinyo eqhethile] kuyo.

23:105.t: Ingabe anizange yini nifundelwe imibiko yami kepha nina nayiphika.

23:106.t: Bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, sehlulwe ukulahlekelwa kwethu [ngokulandela izinkanuko] kanjalo saba ngabantu abadukile”.

23:107.t: Nkosi sikhiphe kuyo [iJahanamu], uma nje sike sabuyela kuyo siyobe impela siphambukile.

23:108.t: Uyothi: “Sukani la, hlalani kuso futhi ningangikhulumisi”.

23:109.t: Impela bekuneqembu lezigqila zaMi [ezikholwayo] ezithi: “Nkosi yethu, siyakholwa; ngakhoke sithethelele usihawukele futhi Wena unomusa ukudlula bonke abanomusa.

23:110.t: Kepha nina nabathathisa okwenhlekisa baze banenza nakhohlwa ukukhumbula Mina naphinde nabahleka.

23:111.t: Impela namhlanje ngibahlomulisile ukuthi bangabaphumelele ngenxa yokubekezela kwabo.

23:113.t: Bayothi: “Sihlale usuku noma ingxenye yosuku, buza ababali.”

23:114.t: Uyothi: “Nihlale isikhathi esincane impela, ukube nje benazi.”

23:115.t: Ingabe nicabanga ukuthi sinidalele ize nokuthi ngeke nisabuyela kithi na?

23:116.t: Uphakeme u Allah iNkosi yeqiniso; akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe, umnikazi weSihlalo Esihloniphekile.

23:117.t: Lowo obhangqa no Allah esinye isikhonzwa engenabufakazi ngaso; ukwehlulela kwaKhe kuseNkosini yakhe. Impela abangakholwa abasoze baphumelela.

23:118.t: Futhi yithi: “Nkosi yami thethelela uphinde uhawukele ngokuba Wena unomusa ukwedlula bonke abanomusa”.

24:1.t: Lena isura [isahluko] esiyambulele futhi sayiphoqelela ukuba ilandelwe sembulela futhi kuyo imibiko ecacile ukuze nilalele.

24:2.t: Umphingi wesimame nowesilisa babhaxabuleni ngamunye amahlandla ayikhulu, futhi ningabazweli ekugcineni inkambiso ka Allah uma ngempela nikholelwa ku Allah nasoSukwini lokugcina. Futhi isijeziso sabo kumele sithanyelwe ibandla lalabo abakholwayo.

24:3.t: Umphingi wesilisa ushada kuphela umphingi wesimame noma umkhonzi zithixo wesimame. Kanjalo nomphingi wesimame ushadwa kuphela umphingi wesilisa noma umkhonzi zithixo wesilisa. Kepha lokho kunqantshelwe kwabakholwayo.

24:4.t: Futhi labo abasola ngecala abesimame abaziphethe kahle bese bengalethi ofakazi abane; babhaxabuleni amahlandla angamashumi ayisishagalombili bese ningaphinde namukele ubufazi babo. Futhi labo bayizeqa mthetho.

24:5.t: Ngaphandle ke kwalabo abazisolayo bacele intethelelo emuva kwalokho baphinde benze okulungileyo; impela u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

24:6.t: Labo abesilisa abasola abafazi babo ngecala [lokungathembeki emshadweni] kepha bengenabo ofakazi ngaphandle kwabo uqobo. Ubufakazi boyedwa kubo ukuba afunge kane ngo Allah ukuthi uqinisile.

24:7.t: Kobesihlanu [afunge] ngokuthi isiqalekiso sika Allah sibe kuye uma eqamba amanga.

24:8.t: Kuyomele bakumise ukumjezisa owesimame uma efunga kane ngo Allah ukuthi [umyeni wakhe] uqamba amanga.

24:9.t: Kobesihlanu [afunge] ngokuthi ulaka luka Allah lube kuye [owesimame] uma [umyeni wakhe] eqinisile.

24:10.t: Ukube bekungesiwo umusa ka Allah kini nesihe sakhe nokuthi u Allah Uyathethelela Ukhaliphile [bekazobhubha lapho lona oqamba amanga].

24:11.t: Impela labo abeza namanga aluhlaza, iquqaba ngaphakathi kini. Ningacabangi ukuthi ayinto embi kini kepha ayinto enhle kini. Wonke umuntu kini uyothola isijeziso salokho akuzizile empambukweni. Kuthi lowo obe kunguyena obe nendima enkulu kuwo [lamanga] ngaphakathi kwenu, yena uyothola isijeziso esikhulu.

24:12.t: Ukube nje nathi lapho niwezwa, abakholwayo besilisa nesifazane bavane bacabanga okuhle ngabanye babo bese bathi: “Lana ngamanga aluhlaza”.

24:13.t: Kungani bengalethanga ofakazi abane na? Uma bengabalethanga ofakazi, laboke ku Allah bangabaqambi manga.

24:14.t: Ukube bekungewona umussa ka Allah kini nesihe saKhe emhlabeni nakwelizayo, beniyotholwa isijeziso esikhulu kulokhu enigaxele kukho.

24:15.t: Mhla niwathutha ngamalimi enu futhi nikhuluma ngemilomo yenu lokho ebeningenalwazi ngakho, nicabanga ukuthi kuyinto encane kulapho kuyinto enkulu ku Allah.

24:16.t: Ukube nje mhla niwezwa navane nathi: “Asinalo igunya lokhuphawula ngalokhu, mawungcweliswe Wena, lokhu ukuthunaza okukhulu”.

24:17.t: U Allah uyaxwayisa ukuba ningaphinde nenze okufanayo uma ngempela ningabakholwayo.

24:18.t: Futhi u Allah unicacisele imibiko. U Allah Ungowaziyo Okhaliphile.

24:19.t: Impela labo abathanda ukuba amanyala asabalale ngalabo abakholwayo, bayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu emhlabeni nakwelizayo. U Allah uyazi kepha nina anazi.

24:20.t: Ukube bekungesiwo umusa ka Allah kini nesihawu saKhe nokuthi u Allah Unobubele Unesihawu [ngabe unijezisile].

24:21.t: Nina enikholwayo, ningalandeli ezinyathelweni zika Shayitani; ngokuba lowo oyolandela ezinyathelweni zika Shayitani, impela ugqugquzela amanyala nempambuko. Ukube bengesiwo umusa ka Allah kini nesihe saKhe bukungasoze kube khona noyedwa kini obeyohlanzeka [ezimpambukweni zakhe]. Kepha u Allah uhlanza amthandayo futhi Ungozwayo Owaziyo.

24:22.t: Labo abaqotho kini nabanjingile mabangafungeli ukuyeka ukupha izihlobo nabampofu nabafuduka endleleni ka Allah. Mabaxolele bandlulise. Anifuni yini ukuba u Allah anithethelele na? Ngokuba u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

24:23.t: Impela, labo abasola ngecala labo abesimame abakholwayo abaziphethe kahle abangazibandakanyi namanyala; baqalekisiwe emhlabeni nakwelizayo, futhi bayothola isijeziso esikhulu.

24:24.t: Ngosuku lapho ulimi lwabo nezandla zabo kanye nemilenze yabo iyofakaza ngabo mayelana nalokho ababekwenza.

24:25.t: Ngalolo suku u Allah uyobanika ngokugcwele isabelo sabo seqiniso futhi bayokwazi ukuthi u Allah nguYena Oyiqiniso Elisobala.

24:26.t: Abesifazane ababolile bathola abesilisa ababolile, nabesilisa ababolile bayothola abesifazane ababolile. Kuthi abesifazane abahlanzekile bathole abesilisa abahlanzekile nabesilisa abahlanzekile bayothola abesifazane abahlanzekile. Labo abahlangene nalokho abakukhulumayo. Bayothola intethelelo nesondlo esihle.

24:27.t: Nina enikholwayo, ningangeni ezindlini okungezona ezenu ningakakhuleki futhi nibingelele abanikazi bazo. Lokho yikona okugcono kini ukuze nilalele.

24:28.t: Uma ningatholi muntu kuzo, ningangeni kuze kube nithola imvumo. Uma nitshelwa ukuthi buyelani emuva, buyelani emuva, ngokuba yokona okuhlanzekile kini. Futhi u Allah Uyakwazi enikwenzayo.

24:29.t: Aninacala uma ningena ezindlini okungasahlali muntu kuzo okunensizakalo yenu kuzo. Futhi u Allah uyakwazi konke enibeka obala nenikufihlayo.

24:30.t: Tshela abakholwayo besilisa ukuba babhekise phansi amehlo abo [kokunqatshelwe] bavikele nezitho zabo zangasese. Lokho yikona okuhlanzekile kubo. Impela u Allah Unolwazi ngalokho abakwenzayo.

24:31.t: Uphinde utshele abakholwayo besimame ukuba babhekise phansi amehlo abo [kokunqatshelwe] bavikele nezitho zabo zangasese. Futhi bangavezi ubuhle babo ngaphandle kwalokho okuzivelelayo. Futhi mabavale ngamakhimari [indwangu evala ikhanda kuya phansi] abo izifuba zabo. Futhi bangavezeli muntu ubuhle babo ngaphandle kwabayeni babo noma oyise noma abakhwe babo noma amadodana abo [abawazalayo] noma amadodana wabayeni babo noma abafowabo noma amadodana abafowabo noma amadodana wodadewabo noma abanye abafazi [abakholwayo] noma izigqila zabo noma amadoda ayizisebenzi angasenayo imizwa [ngezansi] noma izingane ezingakazi lutho ngengasese labesimame. Futhi mabangashayi phansi imilenze yabo ukuze kwaziwe lokho abakufihlile okuwubuhle babo. Celani intethelelo ku Allah nina nonke enikholwayo ukuze niphumelele.

24:32.t: Futhi shadisani labo abangashadile kini nalabo abaqotho kuzigqila zenu zesilisa nesifazane. Uma beswele u Allah uyobanjingisa ngomusa waKhe. U Allah wengamele konke Uyazi.

24:33.t: Labo abangenawo amandla okushada mabaziphathe kahle kuze kube u Allah uyamnjingisa ngomusa waKhe. Futhi labo kuzigqila zenu abafuna ukusebenzela inkululeko yabo, bavumuleni uma kunobuqotho enibaziyo ngabo. Futhi nibaphe kumcebo ka Allah lona aniphe wona. Futhi ningaphoqeleli izigqila zenu zesifazane ekubeni onondindwa, ukuze nizuze iznto zempilo yasemhlabeni, uma zona zizifunela isimilo. Lowo ozoziphoqa, impela u Allah emuva kokuziphoqa Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu [kuzo].

24:34.t: Impela sembulela kuwe [Muhamadi] imibiko ecacisayo nesibonelo salabo asebandlula ngaphambi kwenu kanjalo neseluleko kulabo abathobela intando ka Allah.

24:35.t: U Allah Uwukukhanya kwamazulu nomhlaba. Ukukhanya kwaKhe kufana nengosi enesibani kuyo; isibani esisengilazini. Ingilazi yona ngathi inkanyezi ekhazimulayo eyokhelwe ngamafutha esihlahla esibusisiwe, esingekho ngase mpumalanga noma ngase ntshonalanga. Amafutha kuthi awakhanye wona ngokwawo noma engakokhelwa ngomlilo. Ukukhanya phezu kokunye ukukhanya. U Allah uholela amthandayo ekukhanyeni kwaKhe. Futhi wenzela abantu imizekelo. Futhi u Allah wazi ngayo yonke into.

24:36.t: Ezindlini [emaMasjidi] u Allah ukuvumele ukuba zakhiwe zimiswe bese kukhunjulwa iGama lika Allah kuzo. Ababaza ubungcwele baKhe kuzo ekuseni nantambama..;

24:37.t: Amadoda angayengwa uhwebo nokuhweba ekukhumbuleni u Allah nokwenza iswala nokukhipha iZakati; besaba usuku lapho izinhliziyo namehlo kuyophenduka.

24:38.t: Ukuze u Allah abahlomulise ngokuhle ukudlula lokho ababekwenza aphinde abengezele ngomusa waKhe. U Allah wondla amthandayo ngokungemkhawulo.

24:39.t: Futhi labo abangakholwa, izenzo zabo zifana notalagu olosethafeni eliwugwadule, lowo owonyiwe acabanga ukuthi amanzi, kuthi lapho efika kulo angatholi lutho kepha athole u Allah kulo amehlulele ngokuphelele. Futhi u Allah uyashesha lapho ehlulela.

24:40.t: Noma zifana nobumnyama ekujuleni kolwandle olumbozwe igagasi okunegagasi elinye ngaphezu kwalo kube nefu ngaphezu kwalo. Ubumnyama phezu kobunye ubumnyama. Kuthi lapho ekhipha isandla sakhe acishe angasiboni. Futhi lowo u Allah angamnikanga ukukhanya akasoze abe nakho ukukhanya.

24:41.t: Awuboni ukuthi konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kudumisa u Allah ngisho izinyoni ezindizayo; konke kuyayazi indlela okumthandaza ngayo [u Allah] neyokumdumisa. Futhi u Allah ukwazi konke abakwenzayo.

24:42.t: Ubukhosi basemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokuka Allah futhi isiphetho siyokuba ku Allah.

24:43.t: Awazi ukuthi u Allah uqhuba amafu bese ewahlanganisa abe yimbumba, bese ubona imvula iphuma phakathi kwabo. Aphinde ehlise imvula ezintabeni ebandayo ahlasele ngayo amthandayo ayiqhelise kulowo amthandayo. Ukubanika kwayo kucishe kuvale amehlo.

24:44.t: U Allah uguqula ubusuku nemini. Impela kulokho kunesifundo kulabo abahlaziyayo.

24:45.t: Futhi u Allah udale zonke izidalwa ngamanzi [uketshezi lwesidoda]. Kunalezo ezihamaba ngesisu kube nalezo ezihamba ngemilenze emibili kube nalezo ezihamba ngemine. Udala akuthandayo; impela u Allah akahlulwa yilutho.

24:46.t: Impela sambulele imibiko ecacisayo. Futhi u Allah uholela amthandayo endleleni eqondile.

24:47.t: Futhi bathi siyakholelwa ku Allah nakuSithunywa futhi siyazithoba. Kepha emuva kwalokho olunye uquqaba kubo lubuyela emuva. Laboke abasibo abakholwayo.

24:48.t: Uma bebizelwa ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe ukuze sehlulele phakathi kwabo; uyobona ngeqembu elithile kubo lifulathela.

24:49.t: Kepha uma kuyibona abamangali beza kuye bezithoba.

24:50.t: Ingabe kunesifo ezinhlizweni noma banongabazane kumbe basaba ukuthi u Allah neSithunywa saKhe bazobacindezela ngokungebulungiswa na? Empeleni yibona kanye abangenabo ubulungiswa.

24:51.t: Izwi lalabo abakholwayo lapho bebizelwa ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe ukuze sehlulele phakathi kwabo, bavele bathi: “Siyezwa futhi siyazithoba”. Yibo kanye ke labo abayophumelela.

24:52.t: Lowo olalela u Allah neSithunywa saKhe aphinde asabe u Allah athobele intando yaKhe, yibonake labo abayophumelela.

24:53.t: Futhi [abazenzisi] bafunga bagomele ngo Allah ukuthi uma ubayalela nakanjani bayophuma [ukuya empini]. Yithi: “Ningafungi; ukulalela okwaziwayo [lokhu okwenu]. Impela u Allah Unolwazi ngakho konke enikwenzayo”.

24:54.t: Yithi: “Lalelani u Allah nilalele neSithunywa. Kepha uma nikushaya indiva; okwakhe yilokhu athweswe kona nani okwenu yilokhu enithweswe kona. Kepha uma nimlalela niyoba sendleleni eqondile. Futhi okusemahlombe eSithunywa ukwethula umlayezo ocacile.

24:55.t: U Allah uthembise labo abakholwayo kini nabenza okulungileyo ukuba uyobabeka emhlabeni njengoba abeka labo ababandulelayo futhi uyobamisela inkolo yabo lena abakethele yona aphinde aguqulele ukwesaba kwabo kube nokuphepha. “Uma bekhonza Mina bengangibhangqi ngalutho. Lowo oyoba ongakholwa emuva kwalokho, labo bayobe beyizi phula mthetho”.

24:56.t: Futhi qikelelani ukwenza iswala nikhiphe nezakati nolalele isithunywa ukuze nihawukelwe.

24:57.t: Ningacabangi ukuthi laba abangakholwa baphunyukile emhlabeni. Indawo yabo yokugcina umlilo, saze sasibi isiphetho.

24:58.t: Nina enikholwayo, labo abayizigqila zenu nalabo abangakathombi kini, mabanicele imvume [yokungena egunjini lenu] ezikhathini ezintathu. Ngaphambi kweswala yeFajari nalapho nihlubula khona izembatho zenu emini nasemuva kweswala ye Isha. Lezi izikhathi zenu ezintathu zangasese. Akucala kini nakubo emuva kwazo; ngokuba abanye benu bangena bephuma kini. U Allah uyihlalusa kanjalo imibiko, futhi u Allah Ungowaziyo Okhaliphile.

24:59.t: Uma abantwana benu sebefike esigabeni sokuthomba, mabacele imvumo [yokungena] njengoba labo baphambilini nabo babecela imvumo. U Allah unihlalusela kanjalo imibiko yaKhe; futhi u Allah Ungowaziyo Okhaliphile.

24:60.t: Futhi izalukazi zabafazi lezi ezingesenandaba nokushada; azinacala uma zihlubula izembatho zazo kepha zingavezi ubuhle bazo. Uma zizithiba yikona okungcono kuzo. Futhi u Allah Ungozwayo Owaziyo.

24:61.t: Akunacala kulowo oyimpumputhe nalowo oyinquge nalowo ogulayo.
