Futhi nani aninacala uma nidla ezindlini zenu noma ezoyihlo noma ezonyoko noma ezabafowenu noma ezodadewenu noma ezabafowabo boyihlo noma ezobabekazi benu noma ezomalume benu noma ezoninalume benu noma lezo eniphatha izihluthulelo zazo noma ezomngani wenu. Futhi aninacala uma nidla ndawonye noma ngokuhlukana. Uma ningena ezindlini, zibingeleleni nina uqobo, isibingelelo esivela ku Allah esibusisiwe esimsulwa. U Alla unihlalusela kanjalo imibiko ukuze niqonde.

24:62.t: Labo okuyibona abakholwayo, yilabo abakholelwa ku Allah neSthunywa saKhe futhi uma benaso ndawonye abahambi bengasicelanga imvumo. Impela labo abakucela imvumo yibona kanye labo abakholelwa ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe. Uma bekucela imvumo mayelana nezinye zezinto zabo, vumela omthandayo kubo uphinde ubacelele intethelelo. Impela u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

24:63.t: Musani ukubiza iSithunywa phakathi kwenu njengoba uma nibizana nodwa. Impela u Allah uyabazi laba ababaleka isinyelele kini. Labo abaphambana nomyalelo waso [iSithunywa] mabaqaphele bengehlelwa ukungakholwa noma behlelwe isijeziso esibuhlungu.

24:64.t: Bheka ngoba konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungo kuka Allah; wazi lokhu enikukho manje nangosuku abayobuyela kuYe, ukuze abazise ngalokho ababekwenza. Futhi u Allah wazi yonke into.

25:1.t: Uyingcwele Lona owembulela iFurikani [iKurani] kusigqila saKhe ukuze sibe umexwayisi kumhlaba wonke jikelele.

25:2.t: Lona ubukhosi basemazulwini nasemhlabeni bungo baKhe. Akanangane futhi akakaze abe nomlingani ebukhosini. Futhi nguYena odale yonke into wayabela ngokuyilingene.

25:3.t: Baqoke ngaphandle kwaKhe izikhonzwa ezingakwazi ukudala lutho; kunalokho zona zidaliwe futhi abakulawuli ukulimala noma ukuzuza kwabo uqobo futhi abakulawuli ukufa noma ukuphila noma ukuvuswa [emuva kokufa].

25:4.t: Laba abangakholwa bathi: “Impela lokhu [iKurani] ngamanga aluhlaza aziqambele wona balekelelwa ngabanye abantu”. Impela abanabulungiswa futhi banamanga aluhlaza.

25:5.t: Baphinde bathi: “Izinganekwane nje zabasendulo uzilobele zona, ubizelwa zona ekuseni nantambama”.

25:6.t: Yithi: “Yembulelwe nguLoyo owazi imfihlo emazulwini nasemhlabeni; impela Yena Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu”.

25:7.t: Futhi bathi: “Yini ngalesi Sithunywa, sidla ukudla sihambe nasezindaweni zokuhweba. Kungani kungathunyelwanga naye ingelosi ukuze kube nomunye umexwayisi naye.

25:8.t: Noma anikwe umcebo noma abe nesivande adla kuso. Bese labo abaphambukile bathi: “Nilandela nje indoda eloyiwe”.

25:9.t: Awubheke nje ukuthi bakwenzela kanjani imizekelo; base baduka abasakwazi ukuthola indlela eqondile.

25:10.t: Uyingcwele Lona uma ethanda angakunikeza [Muhamadi] okungcono okudlula lokho, izivande okugeleza imifula ngenzansi kwazo aphinde akwenzele izinqaba.

25:11.t: Kepha baphika iSikhathi [sokwahlulela]. Kulapho Thina silungiselele lowo ophika iSikhathi umlilo.

25:12.t: Uma ubabona beza le kude, bayowuzwa ubhavumula ububula.

25:13.t: Kuyothi lapho sebetshingelwe endaweni engcinyanayo phakathi kuwo beboshwe izandla nezinyawo; bayokhulekela ukuba imbubhiso.

25:14.t: Ningakhulekeli neyodwa imbubhiso namhlanje kepha khulekelani eziningi.

25:15.t: Yithi: “Yikona lokho okuhle noma isivande saphakade lesi esithenjiswe abakholwayo na? Siyoba umvuzo nesiphetho sabo”.

25:16.t: Bayothola konke abakulangezelelayo kuso unaphakade; isithembiso iNkosi yakho eyosigcina.

25:17.t: Futhi mhla ebabuthanisa bona kanye nalokho abakukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah, uyothi [u Allah kuzikhonzwa]: “Ingabe yinina laba enidukise izigqila zami lezi noma zizidukele zona ngokwazo na?”

25:18.t: Bayothi: “Mawungcweliswe Wena, asinalo igunya lokuziqokela abahlengi ngaphandle kwaKho, kepha nguWe obenze banethezeka nokhokho babo baze bakhohlwa imiyalelo base baba ngabantu ababhubhile”.

25:19.t: Impela bayaniphikisa kulokho enikushoyo futhi anikwazi ukuzihlenga noma ukuzisiza. Futhi lowo kini ongeke enze ubulungiswa [ngokubhangqa u Allah], sizomzwisa isijeziso esinzima.

25:20.t: Futhi asikho iSithunywa esasithumela ngaphambi kwakho ebesingadli noma esingayi ezindaweni zokuhweba. Futhi senze abanye benu baba isiviviyo kwabanye, ngakhoke bekezelani.

25:21.t: Labo abangalangazeleli ukuhlangana naThi bathi: “Kungani kunga thunyelwangwa ingelosi kithi noma nje sibone iNkosi yeThu mathupha na?” Impela bayazazisa futhi sebendlulele kakhulu ekupheleni umthetho.

25:22.t: Mhla beyobona izingelosi, ngalolo suku akunakuba nezindaba ezinhle kulabo abayizephula mthetho futhi bayothi:”Kunqatshelwe akuvunyelwe”.

25:23.t: Futhi siyobheka izenzo zabo abazenzile bese sizenza uthuli olusakazeke yonke indawo [aziyukuba namvuzo].

25:24.t: Labo abayongena eJana, ngalolo suku bayobe besendaweni engcono yokuhlala nendawo enhle impela yokuphumula.

25:25.t: Futhi landisa ngosuku lapho isibhakabhaka siyoqhekeka kuvele amafu bese kwehliswa izingelosi kancane kancane.

25:26.t: Bonke ubukhosi bangempela ngalolo suku buyokuba ngobuka loyo Onomusa [u Allah]. Impela kuyoba usuku olunzima kwabangakholwa.

25:27.t: Futhi landisa ngosuku lapho ophambukile ayoluma khona izandla zakhe athi: “Ngaze ngafisa ukuba ngalandela iSithunywa endleleni eqondile”.

25:28.t: Kwaze kwaphela ngami, ngaze ngafisa ukuba angizange ngaba umngani kazibanibani.

25:29.t: Impela ungidukisile kumyalelo emuva kokuba usufikile kimi. Impela uShayitani uyohlala njalo emkhaphela umuntu.

25:30.t: Futhi iSithunywa sithi: “Nkosi yami impela abantu bami abasayinaki leKurani”.

25:31.t: Kanjalo, senzela wonke uMembulelwa isitha kulabo abayiziphula mthetho. Kepha iNosi yakho yanele njengoMholi noMhlengi.

25:32.t: Laba abangakholwa bathi: “Kungani iKurani ingembulelwanga kuye [uMuhamadi] yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa”. Siyenze kanjalo ukuze siqinise inhliziyo yakho futhi sayihlalusa kancane kancane.

25:33.t: Futhi njalo uma beza nomzekelo othize; Thina sizokulethela iqiniso nencazelo engcono.

25:34.t: Labo abayosiwa eJahanamu behudulwa ngobuso; yiboke labo abasesimeni esibi nabasendleleni edukile.

25:35.t: Futhi sanika uMusa iNcwadi [iTora] saphinda senza umfowabo uHaruna waba iphini lakhe.

25:36.t: Sase sithi kubo: “Hambani nobabili niye kulaba bantu abaphika imibiko yeThu”. Sabe sesibabhubhisa [abangakholwa].

25:37.t: Kanjalo [sababhubhisa] nabantu baka Nuhu, mhla bephikisa iZithunywa. Sabacwilisa sabenza baba isibonelo ebantwini. Futhi labo abaphambukile sibalungiselele isijeziso esibuhlungu.

25:38.t: Kanjalo nesizwe sakwa Adi noTamudi nabase Rasi [umthombo] nezinye izizwe eziphakathi kwalokho eziningi.

25:39.t: Bonke sabenzela imizekelo [sibacacisela] futhi bonke sababhubhisa kanzima.

25:40.t: Futhi babendlula emanxiweni esizwe [eSodoma] esalethelwa imvula embi. Ingabe babengawaboni na? Empeleni abakholelwa ekuvusweni [kwelizayo].

25:41.t: Uma bekubona, bakwenza inhlekisa [bathi], “ingabe nguye lo u Allah amthumele njengeSithunywa na?”

25:42.t: “Ucishe wasidukisa ngezikhonzwa zethu, ukube nje asibambelelanga kuzo”. Khona maduze lapho bebona isijeziso bayokwazi ukuthi ubani ngempela odukile.

25:43.t: Bheka lowo owenze izinkanuko zakhe isikhonzwa sakhe; ingabe uyokhona yini ukumhlenga na?

25:44.t: Kumbe ucabanga ukuthi iningi labo liyezwa noma liyaqonda. Bazifanela nje nemfuyo; empeleni bona baduke kakhulu.

25:45.t: Uke wabona ukuthi iNkosi yakho iwundlala kanjani umthunzi na? Uma ithanda ibingawenza ume [ungasuswa yilanganga] futhi senze ilanga laba yinkomba yokuba khona komthunzi.

25:47.t: Futhi nguYena onenzela ubusuku baba yingubo yokwembatha nobuthongo kwaba ukuphumula futhi wenza imini yaba isikhathi sokuvuka.

25:48.t: Futhi nguYena lona othumela imimoya njengezethuli zezindaba ezinhle ngaphambi komusa waKhe [imvula]. Sase sesehlisela amanzi emvula ahlanzekile.

25:49.t: Ukuze zivuselele ngaso indawo ebesifile nokuthi siphe amanzi kulokho esikudalile, imfuyo nabantu abaningi.

25:50.t: Futhi siyayisabalalisa [imvula] phakathi kwabo ukuze banake. Kepha iningi labo lanqaba laqoma ukungabongi.

25:51.t: Ukuba besithanda besizothumela kuyo yonke imizi [indawo] umexwayisi [kepha siqoke wena Muhamadi].

25:52.t: Ngakhoke ungabalaleli laba abangakholwa futhi ubazabalazele kanzima ngayo [iKurani].

25:53.t: Futhi nguYena lona ohlanganise izilwandle ezimbili, lolu lumnandi lumtoti kuthi lolu lunosawoti luyababa. Futhi wenze kwaba nesithiyo nothango oluvimbile.

25:54.t: Futhi nguYena lona odale ngamanzi umuntu, wamenza waba nobuhlobo ngokwegazi nangokushada. Futhi iNkosi yakho Inamandla.

25:55.t: Bakhonza lokho okungeke kwabasiza nokungeke kwakhona ukubalimaza ngaphandle kuka Allah. Impela ongakholwa uyohlala njalo ephikisa neNkosi yakhe.

25:56.t: Futhi sikuthumele ukuba ube umethuli wezindaba ezinhle nomexwayisi.

25:57.t: Yithi: “Anginiceli mvuzo ngayo ngaphandle kwalowo ofuna ukuthatha indlela [yokusondela] eya eNkosini yakhe”.

25:58.t: Thembela kulowo Ongophilayo ongafi futhi ubabaze udumo lwaKhe. Futhi Unolwazi ngezimpambuko zezigqila zaKhe.

25:59.t: Nguyena odale amazulu nomhlaba nokungaphakathi kwawo ezinsukwini eziyisithupha wabe esenyukela phezu kweSihlalo, lona Onomusa, ngakhoke buza ngaYe loyo Onolwazi [u Allah].

25:60.t: Uma kuthiwa kubo, “khothamelani Onomusa niwe ngobuso”, bathi: “Ngubani Onomusa, ufuna sikhothamele lowo esiyalelwa nguwe [Muhamadi] siwe ngobuso na?” Kwavele kwabandisela ukubalekela iqiniso.

25:61.t: Ungcwele lona odale izinkanyezi [nemigudu yazo] esibhakabhakeni wadala nesibani [ilanga] kuso kanye nenyanga ekhanyisayo.

25:62.t: Futhi nguYena owenze ubusuku nemini kwalandelana enzela lowo ofuna ukuthatha isifundo noma ofuna ukubonga.

25:63.t: Izigqila zika Allah yilezo ezihamba emhlabeni ngokuzithoba; kuthi lapho uma isiwula sikhuluma nabo [seyisa] bathi, “ukuthula”.

25:64.t: Nalabo abachitha ubusuku bekhothamile bewe ngobuso baphinde bawe [kuswala] benzela iNkosi yabo.

25:65.t: Nalabo abathi: “Nkosi yethu, qhelisa isijeziso seJahanamu [kwalasha] kithi ngokuba isijeziso sayo siyanamathelana impela.

25:67.t: Nalabo uma benikela ababi budedengu futhi ababi ngongoqo, benza nje okuphakathi nalokho.

25:68.t: Nalabo abakhonzi ezinye izikhonzwa bazibhangqe no Allah. Futhi abawukhiphi ngokungemthetho umphefumulo oqatshelwe ngu Allah futhi abaphingi. Lowo oyokwenza lokho uyothola isijeziso.

25:69.t: Isijeziso sakhe siyophindwa phindwa ngoSuku lokwahlulela ahlale kuso [isijeziso] unaphakade ehlazekile.

25:70.t: Ngaphandleke kwalowo ocela intethelelo ngokuzisola akholwe, enze nezenzo ezilungileyo; labo, u Allah uyoguqula izimpambuko zabo zibe izenzo ezinhle. Futhi u Allah Ungothethelelayo Onesihawu.

25:71.t: Futhi lowo ocela intethelelo ngokuzisola enze nezenzo ezilungileyo; impela usuke esezisola ngokweqiniso ku Allah.

25:72.t: Nalabo abangazibandakanyi namanga futhi uma bendlula lapho kunombedo khona, bandlula kuwo ngokuzihlonipha [bangazibandakanyi].

25:73.t: Nalabo uma belulekwa ngemibiko yeNkosi yabo, abaziphathisi okwezimumu nezimpumputhe [benze ngathi ebezwa noma ababoni].

25:74.t: Nalabo abathi: “Nkosi yethu siphe abalingani nezingane ezisithokozisayo futhi usenze sibe ngabaholi balabo abathobela Wena”.

25:75.t: Labo, bayohlonyuliswa ngegumbi ngenxa yokubekezela kwabo futhi bayothola kulo ukubingelelwa nokuthula.

25:76.t: Bayohlala kulo unaphakade; yeka indawo enhle yokuhlala nokuzinza.

25:77.t: Yithi: “iNkosi yami ayinandaba nani ukube bekungekho ngenxa yomkhuleko wenu. Impela niyaphika [nina eningakholwa], ngakhoke sizoninamathela [isijeziso]”.

26:3.t: Hleze uzikhandla kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi kabasibo abakholwayo.

26:4.t: Ukube siyathanda besizobehlisela isibonakaliso esivela ezulwini, lesi imiqala yabo iyohlale isithobele.

26:5.t: Futhi njalo uma sibalethela iseluleko esisha esivela koNomusa bavele basishaye indiva.

26:6.t: Impela baphika iqiniso, ngakho ziyofika kubo izindaba zalokho abahlekisa ngakho.

26:7.t: Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi ziningi kanjani izinhlobo [zezitshalo] esihlumise emhlabeni na?

26:8.t: Impela kulokho kunesibonakaliso kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:9.t: Futhi impela iNkosi yakho inguSomandla Onesihawu.

26:10.t: Landisa ngamhla iNkosi yakho imemeza uMusa [yathi], “hamba uye kulabantu abaphambukile”.

26:11.t: Isizwe sika Firawuni. Kungani bengathobeli u Allah na?

26:12.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “Nkosi yami, impela ngesaba ukuthi bayothi nginamanga”.

26:13.t: Futhi nenhliziyo yami ithwele kanzima nolimi lwami aluqaqekile; ngakhoke thumela kuHaruna.

26:14.t: Futhi basase nempindiselo yegazi kimi; ngakhoke ngesaba ukuthi bangahle bangibulale.

26:15.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Phinde, hambani nina nobabili nemibiko yeThu, Thina sikanye nani silalele”.

26:16.t: Ngakhoke iyani kuFirawuni nifike nithi: “siyiZithunywa zeNkosi yendalo yonke”.

26:17.t: Ukuze udedele kithi isizwe sakwa Isirayeli.

26:18.t: Wathi [uFirawuni]: “Asizange yini sikukhulise kusukela umncane waphinde wahlala iminyaka eminingi yempilo nathi na?”

26:19.t: Wase wenza lento yakho owayenza kulapho ungakhombisi ukubonga.

26:21.t: Ngase nganibalekela ngenxa yokunesaba. Kepha iNkosi yami yangipha ubuhlakani [ukwembulelwa] wangenza omunye weZithunywa.

26:22.t: Futhi nje lomusa ongikhumbuza wona – ukuthi wenza isizwe sakwa Isirayeli izigqila.

26:23.t: Wathi uFirawuni: “Yini leNkosi yendalo yonke na?”

26:24.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokuphathi kwakho, uma ngempela ninesiqiniseko [ningena kungabaza]”.

26:26.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “iNkosi yenu neNkosi yokhokho benu basendulo”.

26:27.t: Wathi: “Impela leSithunywa senu esithunyelwe kini uyahlanya”.

26:28.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “iNkosi yempumalanga nentshonalanga nalokho okumaphakathi kwazo, uma ngempela ninokuqonda”.

26:29.t: Wathi: “Uma uziqokela esinye isikhonzwa ngaphandle kwami, impela ngizokugquma ejele”.

26:32.t: Wajikijela induku yakhe gubhu yaphenduka inyoka esobala.

26:33.t: Wakhipha isandla sakhe gubhu saphenduka saba mhlophe kwababukayo.

26:34.t: Wathi [uFirawuni] kuzikhulu ezimhaqile: “Impela lona umlumbi ogogodile”.

26:35.t: Ufuna ukunikhipha ezweni lenu ngobulumbi bakhe; ngakhoke nithi akwenziwe njani na?

26:36.t: Bathi: “Awumyeke nje benomfowabo bese uthumela ababuthanisi kuzo izifunda”.

26:40.t: Mhlawumbe sizolandela abalumbi uma kuyibona abanqobayo.

26:41.t: Kuthe lapho abalumbi befika bathi kuFirawuni: “Ingabe ukhona umvuzo esizowuthola uma kuba yithina abanqobayo”.

26:44.t: Baphonsa izintambo zabo nezinduku zabo base bathi: “Ngobukhulu buka Firawuni impela yithina esiyonqoba”.

26:45.t: NoMusa wabe esephonsa induku yakhe, gubhu yiyo leya isidla konke lokhu ababekhohlisa ngakho.

26:49.t: Wathi [uFirawuni]: “Nikholwa nguye ngingakanivumeli mina; impela ungugosa wenu lona owanifundisa ubulumbi, nizokwazi kahle. Ngizonqamula izandla zenu nemilenze yenu ngokuphambana bese nginibethela nonke”.

26:51.t: Impela sifisa ukuthi iNkosi yethu isithethelele izimpambuko zethu ngokuba sibe ngabakoqala ukukholwa.

26:52.t: Sabe sesembulela kuMusa sathi: “Hamba nezigqila zami ebusuku, impela niyolandelwa”.

26:54.t: [wathi uFirawuni], Impela laba bawuquqaba oluwubala nje.

26:61.t: Kuthe lapho esebonana womabili amaqembu, laba ababe noMusa bathi: “impela sesibanjiwe”.

26:63.t: Sabe sesambulela kuMusa sathi, “shaya ulwandle ngenduku yakho”, lwaqhekeka, yonke ingxenye yaba ngathi intaba enkulukazi.

26:65.t: Sahlenga uMusa nabo bonke labo ababe kanye naye.

26:67.t: Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:70.t: Mhla ethi kuyise nesizwe sakhe: “Yini lokhu enikukhonzayo na?”

26:73.t: Kumbe kukhona ezinizuzisa kona noma zinilimaze ngakho na?

26:74.t: Bathi: “Phela safumanisa okhokho bethu benza kanjalo”.

26:77.t: Kuyisitha sami ngaphandle kweNkosi yendalo yonke.

26:81.t: Lena eyothatha umphefumulo wami iphinde ingivuse.

26:82.t: Lena engifisa ukuba ingithethelele izimpambuko zami ngoSuku lokwahlulela.

26:83.t: Nkosi yami ngiphe ubuhlakani ungihlanganise nabaqotho.

26:85.t: Futhi ungenze ngibe omunye wezindlalifa zeJana yentokomalo.

26:88.t: Ngosuku lapho umcebo nezingane zingekuba nasizo.

26:89.t: Ngaphandle kwaloyo ofike ku Allah nenhliziyo emsulwa.

26:90.t: Futhi iJana iyobe isisondezelwa labo abathobela u Allah.

26:93.t: Ngaphandle kuka Allah; ingabe kuyonisiza noma kuzisize kona na?

26:97.t: Simfunge u Allah, impela besisekudukeni okusobala.

26:99.t: Futhi akekho osidukisile ngaphandle kweziphula mthetho.

26:102.t: Uma nje singathola ithuba lokubuyela emuva, siyoba ngabakholwayo.

26:103.t: Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:104.t: Futhi impela iNkosi yakho inguSomandla Onesihawu.

26:106.t: Mhla umfowabo uNuhu ethi kubo, “ake nithobele u Allah”.

26:108.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:109.t: Futhi anginiceli mvuzo ngokuba umvuzo wami useNkosini yendalo yonke.

26:110.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:112.t: Wathi: “Akusiwo umsebenzi wami ukwazi ngalokho abakwenzayo”.

26:113.t: Impela iNkosi yabo kuphela eyobahlulela ukube nje benazi.

26:116.t: Bathi: “Uma ungaphezi we Nuhu, impela uzokhandwa ngamatshe”.

26:117.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami, impela isizwe sami asingikholwa”.

26:118.t: Yehlulela kahle phakathi kwami nabo futhi ungihlenge mina nalabo abakholwayo abakanye nami.

26:119.t: Samhlenga yena kanye nalabo ababekanye naye emfuleni.

26:120.t: Sabe sesiminzisa emuva kwalokho labo abasala.

26:121.t: Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:122.t: Futhi impela iNkosi yakho inguSomandla Onesihawu.

26:124.t: Mhla umfowabo uHudi ethi kubo, “Kungani ningathobeli u Allah na?”

26:126.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:127.t: Futhi anginiceli ngakho umvu ngokuba umvuzo wami useNkosini yendalo yonke kuphela.

26:128.t: Ingabe nakha kuyo yonke indawo ephakeme izakhiwo eziphakeme nichitha isikhathi na?

26:129.t: Futhi nakha izakhiwo ezinkulu okungathi nizohlala unaphakade.

26:131.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:136.t: Bathi: “Kuyefana nje kithi uyeluleka noma aweluleki”.

26:139.t: Abamkholwanga, sababhubhisa. Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:140.t: Futhi impela iNkosi yakho inguSomandla Onesihawu.

26:142.t: Mhla umfowabo uSwalihi ethi kubo, “Kungani ningathobeli u Allah”.

26:144.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:145.t: Futhi angiceli mvuzo ngakho ngokuba umvuzo wami useNkosini yendalo yonke.

26:146.t: Ingabe niyekwa kanje lana niphephile na?

26:148.t: Nezitshalo namasundu ozithelo zayo zivuthwe kahle.

26:150.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:151.t: Futhi ningalaleli umyalelo walabo abayizephula mthetho.

26:152.t: Labo abenza ukuphambuka ezweni futhi abangalungisi.

26:154.t: Awuyilutho ngaphandle nje komuntu ofana nathi; ngakhoke silethele isibonakaliso uma ngempela uqinisile.

26:155.t: Wathi: “Nali ikameli lika Allah. Linosuku lalo lokuphuza nani ninosuku lwenu lokuphuza olunqunyiwe.

26:156.t: Ningalenzi okubi funa nehlelwe isijeziso sosuku olukhulu.

26:158.t: Behlelwa isijeziso. Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:159.t: Futhi impela iNkosi yakho inguSomandla Onesihawu.

26:161.t: Mhla umfowabo uLuti ethi kubo, “kungani ningathobeli u Allah na?”

26:163.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:164.t: Futhi anginiceli mvuzo ngakho ngokuba umvuzo wami useNkosini yendalo yonke.

26:165.t: Ingabe nikhanuka amadoda endalweni yonke na?

26:166.t: Niyekele lokho u Allah anidalele kona kubafazi benu. Impela nina ningabantu abayiziphula mthetho.

26:169.t: Nkosi yami ngihlenge mina nomndeni wami kulokho abakwenzayo.

26:173.t: Sabathela ngemvula, yaze yayimbi imvula yalabo abaxwayisiwe.

26:174.t: Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:175.t: Futh impela iNkosi yakho inguSomandla Onesihawu.

26:177.t: Mhla uShu’ayibu ethi kubo, “kungani ningathobeli u Allah na?”

26:179.t: Ngakhoke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami.

26:180.t: Futhi anginiceli mvuzo ngakho ngokuba umvuzo wami useNkosini yendalo yonke.

26:183.t: Futhi ningaqili abantu izinto zabo noma nenze impambuko ezweni nenkohlakalo.

26:184.t: Futhi thobelani lona odale nina nezizwe zasendulo.

26:186.t: Futhi awuyilutho ngaphandle nje komuntu ofana nathi futhi sicabanga ukuthi unamanga.

26:187.t: Ngakoke sehlisele ingxenye yesijeziso esivela ezulwini uma ngempela uqinisile.

26:188.t: Wathi: “iNkosi yami ikwazi kahle lokhu enikwenzayo”.

26:189.t: Kepha abamukholwanga; base behlelwa isijeziso sosuku lwefu. Impela kwabe kuyisijeziso sosoku olukhulu.

26:190.t: Impela kulokho kunesifundo, kepha iningi labo alikholwa.

26:194.t: Eyehlisela enhlizweni yakho ukuze ube ngumxwayisi.

26:197.t: Ingabe akubanga isibonakaliso esanele kubo ukuthi izazi zesizwe sakwa Isirayeli ziyayazi [iKurani] na?

26:198.t: Ukube sayembulela kwabanye abangewona ama Arabhu.

26:200.t: Sakufaka kanjalo [ukuphika iqiniso] ezinhlizweni zeziphula mthetho.

26:201.t: Abasoze bakholwa yiyo kuze babona isijeziso esibuhlungu.

26:207.t: Konke lokhu abanethezeka ngakho akuyikuba siza ngalutho.

26:208.t: Futhi asikaze sibhubhise isizwe ngaphandle sithole umexwayisi.

26:209.t: Njengesikhumbuzo. Futhi asibona labo abenza okungebulungiswa.

26:213.t: Ngakhoke ungakhonzi esinye isikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah funa ube ngomunye wabajeziswayo.

26:216.t: Uma bengakulaleli, yithi: “Mina angihlangene nalokho enikwenzayo”.

26:221.t: Ake nginazise ukuthi oShayitani behlela kubani.

26:222.t: Behlela kuwo wonke lowo onamanga oyisonakali.

26:223.t: Bayazama ukulalela kepha iningi labo linamanga.

26:225.t: Awuboni yini ukuthi bayahema kuzo zonke izigodi.

26:227.t: Ngaphandle kwalabo abakholwayo abenza okulungileyo, nabakhumbula u Allah kakhulu abaziphindiselayo uma kuno kungebulungiswa okwenziwe kubo. Futhi labo abaphambukile bazokwazi maduze nje ukuthi yisiphi isiphetho abayophelela kuso.

27:1.t: Twa-Sin; lena imibiko yeKurani neNcwadi ecacisayo.

27:2.t: Ukuze ibe umhlahla ndlela nezindaba ezinhle kulabo abakholwayo.

27:3.t: Labo abaqikelela ukwenza iswala bakhiphe nezakati futhi benesiqiniseko ngelizayo.

27:4.t: Impela labo abangakholelwa kwelizayo; sibakhangisele izenzo zabo ingakho benhlanhlatha.

27:5.t: Yibona labo abayothola isijeziso futhi nakwelizayo bangabalahlekelwe.

27:6.t: Futhi impela wena [Muhamadi] wembulelwa iKurani ivela koKhaliphile Onolwazi.

27:7.t: Landisa ngamhla uMusa ethi kumndeni wakhe: “Ngibone umlilo, ngizonilethela ulwazi noma nginilethele isikhuni esivuthayo ukuze nani nothe”.

27:8.t: Kuthe lapho efika kuwo kwamenyezwa, kwathiwa: “Ubusisiwe osemlilweni nalowo oseduze nawo futhi makangcweliswe u Allah iNkosi yendalo yonke”.

27:9.t: Musa, impela Mina ngingu Allah onguSomandla Okhaliphile.

27:10.t: Phonsa phansi induku yakho. Kuthe lapho eyibona inyakaza okwenyoka, wateta izithende wangabheki emuva. Musa ungesabi, ngokuba izithunywa azesabi Kimi.

27:11.t: Ngaphandle kwalowo owenza impambuko bese enza okuhle emuva kokubi; impela Mina nginguMthetheleli Onesihawu.

27:12.t: Faka isandla sakho ohlangothini lwakho, siyophuma simhlophe singenasifo. Esinye sezibonakaliso eziyisishagalolunye kuFirawuni nesizwe sakhe. Impela bangabantu abayiziphula mthetho.

27:13.t: Kuthe labo izibonakaliso zeThu zifika kubo zibakhanyisela bathi: “lobu ubulumbi obusobala”.

27:14.t: Baziphika ngokungekho ubulungiswa nokuzigqaja, kepha izinhliziyo zabo zazinesiqiniseko ngazo. Awubheke ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salabo abaphula umthetho.

27:15.t: Futhi sanika uDawudi noSulayimani ulwazi, base bathi: “Lonke udumo ngoluka Allah lona osibusisile kuneningi lezigqila zaKhe ezikholwayo”.

27:16.t: uSulayimani walandela uDawudi [ngobuthunywa nangolwazi nobukhosi]; wathi: “Bakwethu, thina sifundiswe ulwimi lwezinyoni futhi saphiwa kuyo yonke into. Impela lokhu umusa osobala”.

27:17.t: uSulayimani wanuthelwa ibutho lakhe elifaka phakathi amajini nabantu nezinyoni futhi lalinabakhuzi.

27:18.t: Kuthe lapho befika esigodini sezintuthwane, yathi intuthwane: “Zintuthwane ngenani ezindlini zenu ningaze ninyathelwe nguSulayimani nebutho lakhe kulapho bengaboni”.

27:19.t: Wamamatheka ehleka [uSulayimani] inkulumo yayo [intuthwane], wabe esethi: “Nkosi yami ngiphe amandla okubonga isibusiso saKho lesi ongibusiswe ngaso mina nabazali bami nokuthi ngenze okulungileyo okukujabulisayo bese ngomusa waKho ungihlanganise [kwelizayo] nezigqila zaKho eziqotho.

27:20.t: Wahlola izinyoni wabe esethi: “Kungani ngingamboni uzinengweni kumbe akekho”.

27:21.t: Impela ngizomjezisa ngesijeziso esinzima noma ngimnqume nomake angilethele ubufakazi obucacile.

27:22.t: Akupholanga maseko [watheleka uzinengweni], wathi: “Ngithole lokhu ongakakutholi, ngifika kuwe nje ngiphuma eSaba’ ngiphethe ulwazi oluqiniseki”.

27:23.t: Ngithole umfazi ebabusa futhi uphiwe kukho konke [ucenile] belu unesihlalo esikhulu.

27:24.t: Ngimthole yena nesiswe sakhe bekhothamela ilanga ngaphandle kuka Allah futhi uShayitani ubenzele zinhle izenzo zabo, ngalokho wabavimba ekubeni sendleleni eqondile ukuze bangaphinde babe sendleleni eqondile.

27:25.t: Ukuze bangakhothameli u Allah bawe ngobu, Lona okhipha isundu emazulwini nasemhlabeni futhi wazi konke enikufihlayo nalokho enikuvela obala.

27:26.t: U Allah, akekho omunye okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe; iNkosi yeSihlalo Esikhulu.

27:27.t: Wathi [uSulayimani]: “Sizobona ukuthi uqinisile yini noma unamanga”.

27:28.t: Hamba nalencwadi yami ufike ubaphonsele yona bese usuka kubo, ubheke ukuthi baphuma naliphi.

27:30.t: Ivela kuSulayimani, yithi: “Egameni lika Allah Onomusa Onesihawu...”

27:31.t: Ungaziqhakambisi kimi, futhi wozani kimi seningamaMusilimu [abazinikele entandweni ka Mdali].

27:32.t: Wathi [umfazi obusayo]: “Nina zikhulu, ngelulekeni kulolu daba lwami, belu angikaze ngithathe isinqumo ningakangibonisi.

27:33.t: Zathi: “Thina sihlome ngokuphelele futhi nempi siyilwa kanzima, kepha sinqumo ngesakho, ngakhoke bona ukuthi uyalela ngani”.

27:34.t: Wathi: “Impela amakhosi uma engena [ehlasela] isizwe bayasonakalisa; bahlaze izikhulu zaso; into ahla eyenza”.

27:35.t: Mina ngizothumela kubo isipho, bese ngibona ukuthi zibuya naliphi izigijimi.

27:36.t: Kuthe uma sesifikile [isigijimi] kuSulayimani wathi: “Nifuna ukungandisela umcebo na? Lokhu engikunikwe ngu Allah kungcono kakhulu ukudlula lokhu aniphe kona; empeleni nin nijatshuliswa yilezipho zenu”.

27:37.t: Buyela emuva kubo. Impela sizogasela kubo ngebutho abangasoze balimela bese sibakhipha kuyo [iSaba’] behlazekile bedicilelekile.

27:38.t: Wathi [uSulayimani]: “Bandla, ngubani kini ongangilethela isihlalo sakhe ngaphambi kokuthi bafike kimi sebengama Musilimu”.

27:39.t: Sathi isigwebedla sejini: “Mina ngingakulethela sona ungakasukumi endaweni yakho, futhi nginamandla alokho ngithembekile”.

27:40.t: Lona onolwazi lweNcwadi wathi: “Mina ngingakulethele sona ungakacwayizi”. Kuthe uma esibona sihleli phambi kwakhe wathi: “Lokhu umusa weNkosi yami; ufuna ukungivivinya ukuba ngizobonga noma ngeke ngibonge. Belu lowo obongayo, uzibongela yena uqobo futhi lowo ongabongi; impela iNkosi yami Ingezimele Ephayo”.

27:41.t: Wathi: “Yenzani izinguquko esihlalweni sakhe, sibheke ukuthi uzokhanyelwa yini noma uyoba ngomunye walabo abangeke bakhanyelwa.

27:42.t: Kuthe lapho efika kwathiwa: “ingabe sinje isihlalo sakho na?” Wathi: “Ngathi yiso”. [uSulayimani wathi]:”Sanikwa ulwazi ngaphambi kwakhe futhi besi ngamaMusilimu”.

27:43.t: Lokhu ayekukhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah yikona okwamvimba [ekukholweni]. Impela wabe engomunye wabantu abangakholwa.

27:44.t: Kwathiwa kuye: “Ngena enqabeni ewumbhoshongo”. Kethu uma eyibona wacabanga ukuthi indawo enamanzi wase wakhwica kwavele imilenze yakhe. Wathi [uSulayimani]: “Lena inqaba eyakhiwe ngengilazi [okungathi inamanzi]”. Wathi: “Nkosi yami impela bengiphambukile, manje ngiyazinikela Kanye noSulayimani eNkosini yendalo yonke”.

27:45.t: Futhi sathumela esizweni sakwa Tamudi umfowabo uSwalihi, ukuba athi: “Khonzani u Allah”; kepha baba ngamaqembu amabili bephikisana.

27:46.t: Wathi [uSwalihi]: “Bantu bakithi, kungani nijahela okubi ngaphambi kokuhle na? Kungani ningaceli intethelelo ku Allah ukuze nihawukelwe na?”

27:47.t: Bathi: “Sikubona usilethela amashwa wena nalabo abanawe”. Wathi: “Amashwa enu aku Allah; kepha nina ningabantu abavivinywayo”.

27:48.t: Futhi kwakunabantu abayisishagalolunye endaweni abonakele futhi abengenzi okulungileyo.

27:49.t: Bathi: “Fungani ngo Allah ukuthi sizomhlasela ebusuku nomndeni wakhe, bese sithi kwabakubo asikubona ukufa komndeni wakhe futhi siqinisile”.

27:50.t: Bakha itulo Nathi sahlela esikuhlelayo kulapho bona bengazi.

27:51.t: Awubheke nje ukuthi sabanjani isiphetho setulo labo; sababhubhisa bonke bona kanye nesizwe sabo.

27:52.t: Naziya izindlu zabo zidilikile ngenxa yokuphambuka kwabo. Impela kulokho kunesifundo kubantu abanolwazi.

27:53.t: Sabahlenga labo ababekholwa futhi bethobela u Allah.

27:54.t: Futhi balandise ngoLuti, mhla ethi kubantu bakhe: “Nenza amanyala nibhekile na?”

27:55.t: Nikhanuka amadoda niyeke abafazi! Impela ningabantu abayiziwula.

27:56.t: Impendulo yabantu bakhe kwavana ukuthi bathi: “Baxosheni abakwa Luti endaweni yenu; impela bangabantu abazenza ngcono”.

27:57.t: Kepha samhlenga yena nomndeni wakhe ngaphandle komkakhe, sanquma ukuthi uyokubo omunye wababhubhayo.

27:58.t: Sabehlisela imvula [yamatshe]; yaze yayimbi imvula yalabo abaxwayiswa.

27:59.t: Yithi: “Lonke udumo ngoluka Allah, futhi ukuthula makube ezigqileni zaKhe lezi aziqokile. Ingabe ngu Allah ongcono noma lokho abakubhangqayo na?”

27:60.t: Kumbe lowo owadala amazulu nomhlaba wanehlisela amanzi emvula, wabe esenihlumisela izivande ezinhle, nina ebeningeke nikwazi ngisho ukuhlumisa esisodwa isihlahla sayo. Ingabe-ke kukhona yini esinye isikhonzwa esikanye no Allah na? Empeleni nina ningabantu abafanisayo.

27:61.t: Kumbe lowo owenze umhlaba wazinza wadala phakathi kwawo imifula, wawufakela nezikhonkwane [izintaba] futhi bafaka nesisitho phakathi kwezilwandle.Ingabe-ke kukhona yini esinye isikhonzwa esikanye no Allah na? Empeleni iningi labo alinalwazi.

27:62.t: Kumbe lowo ophendula lowo osebunzimeni lapho ekhuleka kuYe asuse ubunzima futhi onenze naba ngabalandeli emhlabeni [balabo abanandulelayo]. Ingabe-ke kukhona yini esinye isikhonzwa esikanye no Allah na? Kuncane enikulalelayo.

27:63.t: Kumbe lowo oniholayo ebumnyameni basezweni nasolwandle, lowo ophinde athumele imimoya eyethula izindaba ezinhle ngaphambi kokufika komusa waKhe [imvula]. Ingabe-ke kukhona yini esinye isikhonzwa esikanye no Allah na? Uphakeme u Allah kunalokho abakubhangqayo.

27:64.t: Kumbe lowo okususa phansi ukudala aphinde futhi akuvuse, lowo ophinde anondle ngokuvela ezulwini nasemhlabeni. Ingabe-ke kukhona yini esinye isikhonzwa esikanye no Allah na? Yithi: “Lethani ubufakazi benu uma ngempela niqinisile”.

27:65.t: Yithi: “Akekho osemazulwini nasemhlabeni owazi okungabonwayo ngaphandle kuka Allah, futhi abazi ukuthi bayovuswa nini”.

27:66.t: Kepha ulwazi lwabo luyophelela kwelizayo. Kepha [manje] bayalingabaza. Empeleni abaliboni [ikwelizayo].

27:67.t: Laba abangakholwa bathi: “Kuyothi lapho sesiyinhlabathi kanye nokhokho bethu bese siphinda sivuswa?”

27:68.t: Impela kade sasithenjiswa lokhu thina nokhokho bethu ngaphambi kwalokhu; impela lokhu izinganekwane zasendulo kuphela.

27:69.t: Yithi: “Hambani emhlabeni, bese nibheka ukuthi saba njani isiphetho seziphula mthetho”.

27:70.t: Ungakhathazeki ngabo futhi ungaphatheki kabi ngamatulo abawakhayo.

27:71.t: Futhi bathi: “Kanti siyofika nini lesi sithembiso uma ngempela niqinisile”.

27:73.t: Futhi iNkosi yakho inomusa kusintu impela, kepha iningi labo alibongi.

27:74.t: Futhi iNkosi yakho ikwazi kahle impela okufihlwe izinhliziyo zabo nalokho abakukhipha obala.

27:75.t: Akukho nokukodwa okungabonwayo ezulwini nasemhlabeni okungaqoshiwe eNcwadini Ecacisayo [Uqwembe Olulondiwe].

27:76.t: Impela leKurani ilandisela abakwa Isirayeli okuningi kwalokho abaphikisana ngakho.

27:78.t: Impela iNKosi yakho iyokwehlulela phakathi kwabo ngomthetho waKhe. Futhi unguSomandla Owaziyo.

27:79.t: Ngakhoke thembela ku Allah, ngokuba useqinisweni elisobala.

27:80.t: Impela wena [Muhamadi] awusoze wenza abafileyo bakwazi ukuzwa futhi angeke wakwazi ukwenza isimumu sizwe isimemo lapho sefulathela sishaya indiva.

27:81.t: Futhi angeke uhole izimpumputhe uzikhiphe ebumnyameni bazo. Uyokhona kuphela ukwenza bakuzwe labo abakholwa yimibiko yeThu bebe bengaMamusilimu.

27:82.t: Uma isinqumo sesehlela kubo, siyobakhiphela isilwane emhlabeni esiyobatshela ukuthi abantu babe ngenasiqiniseko ngemibiko yeThu.

27:83.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho siyobabuthanisa amaqembu ngamaqembu kuzo zonke izizwe, alabo ababephika imibiko yeThu bese bayaqhutshwa.

27:84.t: Kuthi lapho sebefika, athi [u Allah]: “Niphike imibiko yaMi ningenalwazi ngayo na, kanti yini lokhu ebenikwenza na?”

27:85.t: Isinqumo [sesijeziso] siyobe sesehlela phezu kwabo ngenxa yempambuko yabo futhi abayikukhuluma.

27:86.t: Ababonanga yini ukuthi senze ubusuku ukuba baphumule kubo nemini ukuba babone. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abakholwayo.

27:87.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho kuyoshaywa icilongo; bonke abasemazulwini nasemhlabeni bayokwethuka ngaphandle kwalabo abathandwa ngu Allah. Futhi bonke bayoza kuYe [u Allah] bedixilelekile.

27:88.t: Uyothi uma ubona izintaba ucabange ukuthi zimile kanti sesihambisa okwamafu. Lokhu ukwenza kuka Allah Lona oyingcweti kuyo yonke into. Impela Yena Unolwazi ngalokho enikwenzayo.

27:89.t: Lowo owenza okuhle uyothola okungcono ukudlula lokho futhi bayophepha ekwesabeni kalolo Suku.

27:90.t: Futhi lowo owenza okubi, ubuso babo buyontshingelwa emlilweni. Niyojeziswela lokho enikwenzile kuphela.

27:91.t: Mina ngiyalelwe ukuba ngikhonze iNkosi yalomuzi [waseMakha], yona lena ewenze wahlonipheka futhi yonke into ngeyaYo. Futhi ngiyalelwe ukuba ngibe owokuqala ukuba yiMusilimu.

27:92.t: Nokuthi ngifunde iKurani. Ngakhoke lowo olandela indlela eqondile uzenzela yena. Futhi lowo odukayo, yithi: “Mina ngingumexwayisi nje kuphela”.

27:93.t: Futhi yithi: “Lonke udumo ngoluka Allah, uzonibonisa izibonakaliso zaKhe nani nizozazi. Futhi akusikho ukuthi iNkosi yakho ayikwazi enikwenzayo.

28:3.t: Sikulandisela indaba ka Musa noFirawuni ngeqiniso kubantu abakholwayo.

28:4.t: Impela uFirawuni waziqhayisa ezweni wenza abantu balo amaqembu. Elinye lamaqembu wayelicindezela ebulala amadoda abo ayeke abafazi babo. Impela wayengomunye abonakele.

28:5.t: Futhi besifuna ukubusisa labo abacindezelwe emhlabeni futhi sibenze abaholi siphinde sibenze izindlalifa.

28:6.t: Bese sibazinzisa emhlabeni, futhi sibonise uFirawuni noHamani nebutho labo ngabo [abacindezelwe] lokho ababekwesaba.

28:7.t: Safaka kunina kaMusa ukuthi, “mncelise, kanti uma umesabela, mphonsele emfuleni futhi ungasabi ungakhathazeki; ngokuba thina sizombuyisela kuwe futhi simenze omunye weZithunywa”.

28:8.t: Wabe esecoshwa umndeni ka Firawuni ukuze abe isitha nenkathazo kubo. Impela uFirawuni noHamani nebutho labo babesephutheni.

28:9.t: Wathi umfazi kaFirawuni: “Uyoba injabulo kimi nakuwe, ungambulali hleze abe usuzo kithi noma nje simenze ingane yethu kulapho bengazi”.

28:10.t: Inhliziyo kanina kaMusa yaba igobongo [ngenxa yokwesaba, wacishe wamdalula ukube nje asizange sizinzise inhliziyo yakhe ukuze abe okholwayo [kusithembiso sika Allah].

28:11.t: Wathi [unina kaMusa] kudadewabo [kaMusa]: “Mthungathe”. Wambona ngaseceleni benganakile.

28:12.t: Besikade sesimnqabela ukuba anceliswe ngabanye ngaphambilini. Ngakhoke wathi [udadewabo]: “Nginganibonisa umndeni onganinakekelela yena futhi bamphathe kahle”.

28:13.t: Sambuyisela kunina ukuze ajabule angakhathazeki futhi azi ukuthi impela isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso; kepha iningi labo alazi.

28:14.t: Kuthe lapho esekhulile ngokugcwele, samnika ubuhlakani nolwazi. Futhi sibahlomulisa kanjalo abenza okuhle.

28:15.t: Wangena emzini abantu bakhona benganakile, wafica amadoda amabili elwa; lona oweqembu lakhe kuthi lona isitha sakhe. Lona weqembu lakhe wamcela ukuba amelekelele esitheni sakhe; uMusa wamwakaza ngenqindi wambulala, wathi: “impela lokhu umsebenzi kaShayitani, impela yena ungumdukisi oyisitha esisobala”.

28:16.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami, impela ngiphambukile, ngakhoke ngithelele”; wamthethelela, impela Yena Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

28:17.t: Wathi: “Nkosiyami ngalokho ongibusise ngakho ungangenzi umsekeli weziphula mthetho”.

28:18.t: Waqala ukwesaba eqalaza emzini, kwathi memfu lona obekade ecela usizo ngayizolo efuna futhi amlekelele. Wathi [uMusa] kuye: “Impela wena uyihlongandlebe langempela”.

28:19.t: Kuthe lapho efuna ukugxavula lona oyisitha sabo, wathi [uzakwabo]: “We Musa, ufuna ukungibulala njengoba ubulale umuntu izolo na? Wena ufuna ukuba undlovu kayiphikiswa ezweni afune kuba umlungisi”.

28:20.t: Kweza indoda igijima iphuma ekugcineni nomuzi yathi: “We Musa impela izikhulu zibhunga ngawe ukuze zikubulale, ngakhoke phuma uphele, impela mina ngiyakweluleka”.

28:21.t: Waphuma kuwo esaba eqalaza, wathi: “Nkosi yami ngihlenge kubantu abaphambukileyo”.

28:22.t: Kuthe lapho esebhekise amabombo eMadiyana, wathi: “Hleze iNkosi yami ingiholele endleleni eqondile”.

28:23.t: Kuthe uma efika emanzini aseMadiyana, wafica kunoquqaba lwabantu luphuzisa [impahla], wathola futhi kunabesimame ababili bemele buqama. Wathi: “Kwenzenjani nganina?”. Bathi: “Asiyiphuzisi impahla kuze kube sebehambe bonke abelusi, futhi ubaba wethu ikhehla elidala”.

28:24.t: Wabaphizisela wase ehamba eya emthunzini, wathi: “Nkosi yami ngidinga konke okuhle ongangipha kona”.

28:25.t: Omunye wabesimame ababili weza kuye ehamba ngesizotha wathi: “Ubaba wami uyakubiza ukuze akunike umvuzo wokusiphuzisela”. Kuthe uma esifikile kuye [ubaba wamadodakazi] wamlandisela udaba wathi: “Ungesabi; ususindile kubantu abaphambukile”.

28:26.t: Wathi omunye [wamadodakazi]: “Baba, mqashe; impela lowo okunguyena okungcono umqashe yilowo onamandla othembekile”.

28:27.t: Wathi: “Ngifuna ukushadisa enye yamadodakazi wami lawa, ngokuthi wena ungisebenzele iminyaka esiyishagalombili. Uma uqeda eyishumi, kuyophma kuwe, phela angifuni ukukwenzela nzima. Uzongifumanisa ngingoqotho ngentando ka Allah”.

28:28.t: Wathi [uMusa]: “Lokho kuphakathi kwami nawe; noma yisiphi kwezimbili izikhathi engiziphothulayo akuyikuba nenzondo kimi, futhi u Allah kulokho esikushoyo ukuqaphile”.

28:29.t: Kuthe lapho uMusa esesiqedi isikhathi, wahamba nomndeni wakhe; wabona eceleni kwentaba umlilo. Wathi kumndeni wakhe: “Hlalani la, impela ngibona umlilo, mhlawumbe nginganilethela ulwazi kuwo noma isikhuni esivuthayo ukuze nothe”.

28:30.t: Kuthelapho efika kuwo, kwamemezwa eceleni kwesigodi sangakwesokudla endaweni ebusisiwe esihlahleni, kwathiwa: “We Musa, impela Mina ngingu Allah iNkosi yendalo yonke”.

28:31.t: “Phonsa phansi induku yakho”. Kuthe uma eyibona inyakaza okwenyoka wabeletha izithende wangabheka emuva. [Wabizwa]: “We Musa buya ungesabi, impela uphephile”

28:32.t: Faka isandla sakho esikwameni sakho, siziphuma simhlophe kungesifo bese usondeza ingalo yakho kuwe ngenxa yokwesaba. Lokho ubufakazi obubili obuvela eNkosini yakho buya kuFirawuni nezikhulu zakhe, impela bona bangabantu abayiziphula mthetho”.

28:33.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami, impela ngabulala umuntu kubo, ngakhoke ngiyesaba ukuthi bangahle bangibulale”.

28:34.t: Futhi umfowethu uHaruna uliciko ngolimi ukudlula mina, ngakhoke mthumele kanye nami njengosekela azongifakazela, impela ngiyesaba ukuthi bazongiphikisa.

28:35.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Sizokuqinisa ngomfowenu futhi sizonenzela ubufakazi, ngakhoke ngeke banenze lutho [olubi]. Nobabili kanye nalabo abanilandelayo niyonqoba ngezibonkaliso zeThu”.

28:36.t: Kuthe lapho uMusa efika kubo nezibonakaliso Zethu ezicacile, bathi: “Lokhu ubulumbi aziqambele bona futhi asikaze sezwa ngalokho ngisho nakokhokho bethu emandulo”.

28:37.t: Wathi uMusa: “iNkosi yami imazi kahle lowo oze nokuholelwa okuvela kuYe nalowo okunguyena oyothola isiphetho; impela abaphambuki abaphumeleli”.

28:38.t: Wathi uFirawuni: “Nina zikhulu, akukho sikhonzwa enginazela sona. We Hamani ake ungenzele izitini ngenhlabathi ungakhele inqaba ewumbhoshongo ukuze kengilunguze lesikhonzwa sika Musa ngona ngicabanga ukuthi unamanga”.

28:39.t: Waziqhayisa yena nebutho lakhe ezweni ngokungemthetho futhi bacabanga ukuthi abasoze babuyela kithi.

28:40.t: Samjezisa yena nebutho lakhe sabatshinga emanzini. Awubheke nje ukuthi sabanjani isiphetho sabaphambukile.

28:41.t: Futhi sabenza baba ngabaholi abamemela emlilweni kanti nangosuku lokwahlulela angeke basizwa.

28:42.t: Sabalandelisa ngesiqalekiso kulomhlaba kanti futhi ngoSuku lokwahlulela bayoba ngababi.

28:43.t: Futhi sanika uMusa Incwadi emuva kokuba sesibhubhise izizwe zasekuqaleni, ukuze ikhanyisele abantu ibe umhlahlandlela futhi ibe umusa ukuze balalele.

28:44.t: Futhi bewungekho ohlangothini [lwentaba] lwasentshonalanga mhla sethula umyalelo kuMusa [simjuba] futhi bewungathamelanga.

28:45.t: Kepha Thina sadala izizwe [emuva kaMusa] zaphila isikhathi eside. Futhi ubungahlali nabantu baseMadiyana ubafundela imibiko yeThu, kepha yithina esathumela.

28:46.t: Futhi bewungekho eceleni [kwentaba] iTuri mhla simemeza; kepha [sikuthumele ukuba ube] umusa ovela eNkosini yakho ukuze wexwayise abantu abangamtholanga umexwayisi ngaphambi kwakho hleze balalele.

28:47.t: Uma bengehlelwa umshophi [isijeziso] ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo, bazothi: “Nkosi yethu, kungani ungathumelanga isithunywa kithi ukuze silandele imibiko yakho futhi sibe ngabakholwayo”.

28:48.t: Kuthe iqiniso lifika kubo livela kithi bathi: “Kungani angenikwanga okufana nalokhu okwanikwa uMusa na?” Abazange yini bakuphike lokho okwanikwa uMusa phambilini na? Bathi: “Ubulumbi obubili buyasekelana [beqonde iTora neKurani]”. Baphinde bathi: “Thina konke asikukholwa”.

28:49.t: Yithi: “Lethani incwadi evela ku Allah ewumhlahlandlela ongcono ukudla lezi ezimbili, ukuze ngiyilandele uma ngempela niqinisile”.

28:50.t: Uma bengakuphenduli, yazike ukuthi bazilandelela izinkanuko zabo nje kuphela. Futhi ingabe ubani oduke ukudlula lowo olandela izinkanuko zakhe ngaphandle kokuhola okuvela ku Allah. Impela u Allah akabaholi abantu abaphambukile.

28:51.t: Futhi impela sibahlalusele inkulumo [yeKurani] ukuze balalele.

28:52.t: Labo esabanika iNcwadi ngaphambi kwayo [iKurani], babekholwa yiyo.

28:53.t: Uma befundelwa yona bathi: “Siyayikholwa, impela iyiqiniso elivela eNkosini yethu futhi besivele singamaMusilimu ngaphambi kwayo”.

28:54.t: Labo bayonikwa umvuzo wabo kabili ngenxa yokubekezela kwabo futhi basusa okubi ngokuhle baphinde baphisane ngalokho esibabele kona.

28:55.t: Uma bezwa umbhedo bayaziqhelelanisa nawo, bathi: “Thina sinokwethu esikwenzayo, nani ninokwenu enikwenzayo; ukuthula makube kini asinaso isikhathi seziwula”.

28:56.t: Impela akunguwe ohola omthandayo, kepha ngu Allah ohola amthandayo futhi ubazi kahle abasendleni eqondile.

28:57.t: Futhi bathi: “Uma silandela ukuholwa kanye nawe sizohlwithwa ezweni lethu”. Asizange yini sibazinzise endaweni ehloniphekile ephephile, zonke izithelo zayo yonke into zilethwa kuyo njengesondlo esivela kithi, kepha iningi labo alazi”.

28:58.t: Futhi ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa ezaphula umthetho ngempilo yazo. Nansiya imizi yabo ayisahlali muntu emuva kwabo ngaphandle nje okwesikhashana. Futhi yithina esasala siyithatha.

28:59.t: Futhi iNkosi yakho ayikaze ibhubhise isizwe ingakathumeli kwelomkhulu laso iSithunywa esibafundela imibiko yeThu. Futhi asikaze sibhubhise isizwe abantu bakhona bengebona abaphambuki.

28:60.t: Yonke into eniphiwe yona, eyokuzijabulisa empilweni yasemhlabeni nobuhle bayo. Kepha lokho okuku Allah kungcono futhi akupheli. Ake niqonde.

28:61.t: Lowo esimthembise isethembiso esihle futhi eyosithola, ingabe uyafana yini nalowo esimjabulise ngezinto zempilo yasemhlabeni bese eyoba ngabayolethwa [ukuze ahlulelwe] ngoSuku lokwahlelela na?

28:62.t: Ngosuku lapho [u Allah] ayobabiza khona athi: “Baphi abalingani baMi laba ebenibaqokile na?”

28:63.t: Laba abayokwehlelwa yisinqumo [sesijeziso] bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, yibo kanye laba esabadukisa, sabadukisa njengoba nathi sasidukile; futhi babengakhonzi thina nhlobo”.

28:64.t: Kuyobe sekuthiwa: “Khulekani kuzikhonzwa zenu; bayokhuleka kepha zingabaphenduli, bese bebona isijeziso; ukube nje bahamba endleleni eqondile [ngabe abasibonanga isijeziso].

28:65.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho [u Allah] ayobabiza khona athi: “Niziphendule nathini iZithunywa na?”

28:66.t: Kuyophela izizaba kubo ngalolo suku; angeke babuzane lutho.

28:67.t: Kepha lowo ozozisola acele intethelelo akholwe enze nokulungileyo, hleze abe ngophumelelayo.

28:68.t: Futhi iNkosi yakho idala ekuthandayo; bona abanakho ukuzikhethela. U Allah ungcwele futhi uphakeme kunalokho abakubhangqayo.

28:69.t: Futhi iNkosi yakho iyakwazi lokho okufihlwa izinhliziyo zabo nalokho abakuveza obala.

28:70.t: Futhi ungu Allah, akekho omunye ofanele akhonze ngaphandle kwaKhe; lonke udumo lungo lwaKhe ekuqaleni nasekugcineni; futhi nguYena owehlulelayo kanti futhi niyibuyela kuYe.

28:71.t: Yithi: “Akenisho, uma u Allah engenza ubusuku bube unaphakade kini, yisiphi isikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah esiyonilethela ukukhanya na? Ingabe anizwa yini na?”

28:72.t: Yithi: “Ake nisho, uma uAllah engeza imini ibe unaphakade kini, yisiphi isikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah esiyonilethela ubusuku eniyophumula kubo na? Ingabe anizwa yini na?

28:73.t: Futhi ngomusa waKhe unenzele ubusuku nemini ukuze niphumule kubo futhi nithungathe nezibusiso zaKhe nokuthi nibonge.

28:74.t: Ngosuku lapho [u Allah] ayobabiza khona athi: “Baphi abalingani baMi laba ebenibaqokile na?”

28:75.t: Siyokhipha kusizwe nesizwe ufakazi bese sithi: “Lethani ubufakzi benu”. Lapha bayokwazi ukuthi iqiniso ngelika Allah futhi konke lokhu ababekuqamba kuyobalahlekela”.

28:76.t: Impela uKaruna waye ngowesizwe sika Musa kepha bawajikela – samnika umcebo ozihluthulelo zawo zisinda amadoda amaningi anamandla – mhla abantu bakubo bethi kuye: “Ungazindondonyi ngokweqile, ngokuba u Allah akabathandi abazindondonyayo”.

28:77.t: Futhi sebenzisa lokho u Allah akuphe kona ukuthola umuzi wakwelizayo [iJana]; kepha ungakhohlwa isabelo sakho sasemhlabeni. Wenze okuhle [kwabanye] njengoba enze okuhle kuwe. Futhi ungabhebhetheli ukonakala ezweni, impela u Allah akabathandi abonakele.

28:78.t: Wathi: “Ngiwunikwe [umcebo] ngenxa yolwazi enginalo [ubuhlakani bami]”. Ingabe akazi yini ukuthi impela u Allah wababhubhisa ngaphambi kwakhe izizwe ezazinamandla ukudlula yena nezazicebe ukudlula yena. Futhi angeke iziphula mthetho zibuzwe zezimpambuko zabo [abasendulo]”.

28:79.t: Waphumela kubantu bakubo evunulile, bathi laba abalangazelela impilo yasemhlabeni: “Sifisa engathi nathi besinokufana nalokhu okunikwe uKaruna, impela uphiwe lukhulu”.

28:80.t: Bathi laba abanikwa ulwazi: “Kahleni bo, umvuzo ka Allah yiwona ongcono kulowo okholwayo nowenza okulungileyo. Futhi akekho oyowuthola ngaphandle kwalabo ababekezelayo”.

28:81.t: Samgqiba ngomhlaba yena nomuzi wakhe; kwakungekho nelilodwa iqembu ebengamsiza ngaphandle kuka Allah futhi wayengeke aphunyuke.

28:82.t: Laba ababekade befisa ukuba nguye ngayizolo kwabayibo futhi abathi: “Yeheni, impela u Allah upha aphinde amswinye isondlo lowo amthandayo ezigqileni zaKhe. Ukube nje u Allah akasibusisanga ngabe nathi usugqibile; yeheni, impela abangakholwa abaphumeleli”.

28:83.t: Lowo umuzi wakwelizayo esiwudalele labo abangalangezeleli ukuphakama emhlabeni noma ukonakala. Futhi isiphetho esalabo abathobela u Allah.

28:84.t: Lowo owenza okuhle, uyothola okungcono kunakho [umvuzo]. Kuthi lowo owenza okubi; labo abenza okubi abayikujeziselwa okunye ngaphandle kwalokho abakwenzile.

28:85.t: Impela lona owembulele iKurani kuwe, uyokubuyisela lapho uphuma khona. Yithi: “iNkosi yami imazi kahle lowo oza nokuholwa nalowo osekudukeni okusobala”

28:86.t: Futhi wawungalangezeleli ukuthi ulethelwe iNcwadi [iKurani] ngaphandle nje komusa ovela eNkosini yakho. Ngakhoke ungabi umesekeli wabangakholwa.

28:87.t: Futhi ungavinjwa muntu emibikweni ka Allah uma seyembulelwe kuwe. Umemele eNkosini yakho, ungabi mdibi munye nabakhonza izithixo.

28:88.t: Futhi ungakhonzi esinye isikhonzwa usibhangqe no Allah; akekho ofanele ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe. Yonke into iyoshabalala ngaphandle kobuso baKhe. Ukwehlulela ngokwaKhe futhi niyobuyela kuYe.

29:2.t: Ingabe abantu bacabanga ukuthi kuyothi uma sebethe: “Siyakholwa”, bese bengavivinywa na?

29:3.t: Sabavivinya impela labo ababandulelayo; ukuze phela u Allah azi labo abaqinisile [ukuthi baykholwa] nalabo abanamanga.

29:4.t: Kumbe labo abenza izimpambuko bacabanga ukuthi bayosiphunyuka na? Yaze yayimbi indlela abehlulela ngayo.

29:5.t: Lowo olangezelela ukuhlangana no Allah; impela isikhathi [esibekiwe] sika Allah siyeza, futhi Ungozwayo Owaziyo.

29:6.t: Futhi lowo ozikhandlayo, uzenzela yena uqobo, ngokuba u Allah akayidingi indalo yonke.

29:7.t: Futhi laba abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo, sizobasulela izimpambuko zabo siphinde sibahlomulise ngomvuzo odlula lokhu ababekwenza.

29:8.t: Seluleke umuntu ukuba aphathe kahle abazali bakhe. Uma bekuphoqelela ukuba uNgibhangqe nalokho ongenalwazi ngakho, ungabalaleli. Nonke niyobuyela kiMi bese nginazisa ngalokho ebenikwenza.

29:9.t: Futhi labo abakholwayo abenza nokulungileyo, nakanjani siyobangenisa kanye nabaqotho.

29:10.t: Futhi ebantwini kunalowo othi: “Ngiyakholelwa kuka Allah”, kepha uma eselinyazwa ngenxa ka Allah, wenza incindezelo yabantu kube ngathi isijeziso esivela ku Allah. Kodwa uma sekufika usizo oluvela eNkosini yakho, nakanjani uzothi: “Impela besikanye nani”. Kanti u Allah akakwazi kahle yini lokhu okusezifubeni zendalo yonke na?

29:11.t: U Allah ubazi kahle impela laba abakholwayo futhi ubazi kahle impela nalabo abangabazenzisi.

29:12.t: Laba abangakholwa bathi kulabo abakholwayo: “Landelani eyethu indlela, sizonithwalela izimpambuko zenu”, abasoze babathwalela lutho ezimpambukweni zabo, impela banamanga.

29:13.t: Bayothwala imithwalo yabo [yezimpambuko] neminye imithwalo phezu kwemithwalo yabo. Futhi bayobuzwa ngoSuku lokwahlulela ngalokho ngamanga ababewaqamba.

29:14.t: Futhi sathumela uNuhu esizweni sakhe, wahlala phakathi kwabo iminyaka eyinkulungwane ususe engamashumi ayisihlanu. Wahlaselwa izikhukhula bengabaphambukile.

29:15.t: Samhelanga yena nalabo ababesemkhunjini sabenza isibonakaliso endalweni yonke.

29:16.t: Landisa ngo Ibhirahimu mhla ethi esizweni sakhe: “Khonzani u Allah nithobele Yena [kuphela], yikona lokho okungcono kakhulu kini ukube nje benazi”.

29:17.t: Lokhu enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah izithixo futhi niqamba amanga aluhlaza. Impela lokhu enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah akunasondlosenu abanaso, ngakhoke celani isondlo ku Allah futhi nikhonze yena nimbonge, ngokuba niyobuyela kuYe.

29:18.t: Uma niphika, nezizwe ezinandulelayo nazo zaphika, futhi-ke umsebenzi weSithunywa ukuba sethule umlayezo ocacile.

29:19.t: Ababoni yini ukuthi u Allah uyisusa phansi kanjani indalo bese eyiphinda futhi. Impela lokho kulula ku Allah.

29:20.t: Yithi: “Hambani emhlabeni, nibheke ukuthi yaqala kanjani indalo yaqala kanjani. Futhi u Allah uyophinda ayivuse futhi. Impela u Allah akahlulwa yilutho.

29:21.t: Ujezisa amthandayo aphinde ahawukele amthandayo futhi niyobuyela kuYe.

29:22.t: Futhi nina anisoze naphunyuka emhlabeni nasezulwini, futhi akekho oyonihlenga noyonisiza ngaphandle kuka Allah.

29:23.t: Futhi labo abangakholwa imibiko ka Allah nokuhlangana naYe; yilabo asebelahlekelwe yithemba emseni waMi, futhi yibo kanye labo abayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu.

29:24.t: Impendulo yesizwe sakhe kwavele kwaba ukuthi bathi: “Mbulaleni noma nimshise”. Kepha u Allah wamhlenga emlilweni. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abakholwayo.

29:25.t: Wathi: “Nivele naziqokela izithixo ngaphandle kuka Allah ukuze kube nozwano phakathi kwenu empilweni yasemhlabeni; ngoSuku lokwahlulela niyophikana nodwa futhi niqalekisane nodwa, bese isiphetho senu kube umlilo futhi akekho oyonisiza”.

29:26.t: u Luti yena wamkholwa [u Ibhirahimu]. Wabe esethi [u Ibhirahimu]: “Ngifudukela eNkosini yami, impela Yona inguSomandla Okhaliphile”.

29:27.t: Samupha u Isihaki no Yakubu sabeka ubuthunywa neNcwadi ozalweni lwakhe, samnika nomvuzo wakhe emhlabeni futhi nakwelizayo ukanye nabaqotho.

29:28.t: Futhi landisa ngoLuti mhla ethi kubantu bakhe: “Impela nina nenza amanyala; akukho noyedwa endalweni yonke owake wawenza ngaphambi kwenu”.

29:29.t: Nikhanuka amanye amadoda, nibamba nenkuzi futhi nenza izimpambuko ezigungwini zenu. Impendulo yesizwe sakhe kwaba ukuba bathi: “Wena nje silethele isijeziso sika Allah uma uqinisile”.

29:31.t: Kuthe lapho zifika izithunywa zeThu ku Ibhirahimu nezindaba ezinhle, zathi: “Thina siyobhubhisa abantu bakulandawo, impela abantu bakhona baphambukile”.

29:32.t: Wathi: “Kuno Luti kuyo”. Bathi: “Sazi kahle ukuthi ubani okuyo. Sizomhlenga yena nomndeni wakhe ngaphandle komkakhe, ngoba uyobhujiswa”.

29:33.t: Kuthe lapho izithunywa zethu zifika ku Luti, wazixwaya wangakhululeka ngazo; zathi: “Ungesabi futhi ungakhathazeki. Thina sizokuhlenga wena nomndeni wakho ngaphandle komkakho ngokuba yena uyobhujiswa”.

29:34.t: Sizokwehlisela ebantwini balendawo isijeziso esivela phezulu ngenxa yokuphula kwabo umthetho.

29:35.t: Impela sashiya kuyo isibonakaliso esicacile kubantu abaqondayo.

29:36.t: Nabase Madiyana, [sathumela] umfowabo uShu’ayibu, wathi: “Bantu bakithi, khonzani u Allah niphokephelele oSukwini lokugcina ningaphambuki ezweni nenza ukonakala”.

29:37.t: Bamphikisa, bahlaselwa ukuzamazama, kwasa bedindilizile emizini yabo.

29:38.t: Futhi sababhubhisa abakwa Adi noTamudi. Impela imizi yabo niyazi kahle. uShayitani wabenzela zinhle izenze zabo [ezimbi] ngaleyo ndlela wabavimba endleleni eqondile futhi babezibona besengekho ephutheni.

29:39.t: NoKaruna noFirawuna noHamani sababhubhisa. Impela uMusa wafika kubo nezibonakaliso, kunalokho baziqhayisa ezweni kepha abaphunyukanga.

29:40.t: Yilowo nalowo sambhubhisa ngempambuko yakhe. Kunalowo kubo esamthumelela ngesiphepho, kube nalowo owahlaselwa umsindo omkhulu, kube nalowo esamgqiba ngomhlaba bese kuba nalowo esamcwilisa. Futhi akusiye u Allah owenza okungebulungiswa kubo kepha yibona abangenzanga ubulungiswa kubo uqobo.

29:41.t: Umzekelo walabo abaziqokele abahlengi ngaphandle kuka Allah, bafana nesicabucabu esakha indlu. Impela indlu entekenteke, indlu yesicabucabu; ukube nje bebazi.

29:42.t: Impela u Allah ukwazi konke lokhu abakukhonzayo ngaphandle kwaKhe futhi unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

29:43.t: Leyo imizekelo esiyenzela abantu futhi akekho oyiqondayo ngaphandle kwalaba abanolwazi.

29:44.t: U Allah udale amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso. Impela kulokho kunesibonakaliso kulabo abakholwayo.

29:45.t: Funda lokhu okwembulelwe kuwe eNcwadini futhi uqikelele ukwenza iswala. Impela iswala ivikela emanyaleni nasezimpambukweni. Futhi ukukhumbula u Allah yikona okukhulu. Belu u Allah ukwazi konke enikwenzayo.

29:46.t: Futhi ungaqophisani nabeMibhalo ngaphandle uma kungendlela enhle. Ngaphandle ke kwalabo abangenabulungiswa kubo. Nithi: “Siyakholelwa kulokho okwembulelwe kithi nokwembulelwe kini futhi lona esimkhonzayo nenimkhonzayo uyedwa futhi sizinikele kuYe”.

29:47.t: Kanjalo sembulela nakuwe iNcwadi. Futhi labo esembulela kubo iNcwadi bayakholelwa kuyo, nakulaba kunalabo abakholelwa kuyo. Futhi akekho ophika imibiko yeThu ngaphandle kwabangakholwa.

29:48.t: Futhi bewungakaze ufunde ncwadi ngaphambi kwayo [iKurani] noma ke ubhale ngesandla sakhe sokudla. Phela bebezoba nokungabaza laba abaphikayo.

29:49.t: Empeleni [iKurani] iyimibiko ecacile esezinhlizweni zalabo abanikwe ulwazi, futhi akekho ophika imibiko yeThu ngaphandle kwaba ngenabulungiswa.

29:50.t: Futhi bathi: “Kungani engehliselwa izibonakaliso esivela eNkosini yakhe na?” Yithi: “Izibonakaliso ziku Allah, mina nje ngingumexwayisi ocacisayo”.

29:51.t: Ingabe abaneli ukuthi sembulele kuwe iNcwadi abafundelwa yona na?. Impela kulokho kunomusa nesikhumbuzo kubantu abakholwayo.

29:52.t: Yithi: “u Allah wanele njengofakazi phakathi kwami nani, ngoba wazi konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni. Futhi labo abakholelwa kumbhedo bese bengakholelwa ku Allah, yibona abalahlekelwe”.

29:53.t: Futhi bayajaha ngesijeziso. Ukube bengekho ngenxa yesikhathi esibekiwe ngabe kade safika kubo isijeziso. Futhi siyofika kubo bengazelele kulapho benganakile.

29:54.t: Bakujaha ngesijeziso, kulapho impela iJahanamu iyobahaqa bonke abangakholwa.

29:55.t: Ngosuku lapho isijeziso sibamboza ngaphezulu nangaphansi kwemilenze yabo, bese ethi [u Allah]: “Zwanini lokho ebenikwenza”.

29:56.t: Zigqila zaMi ezikholwayo, impela umhlaba waMi ubanzi ngakhoke khonzani Mina kuphela.

29:57.t: Wonke umphefumulo uyokuzwa ukufa, bese nibuyela kithi.

29:58.t: Labo abakholwayo benze nokulungileyo sizobabeka eJana emagunjini [aphakeme], okugeleza ngaphansi kwawo imifula bahlale kuwo unaphakade. Waze wamuhle umvuzo wabasebenzayo.

29:59.t: Labo ababekezelayo futhi bathembele eNkosini yabo.

29:60.t: Zingakhi izilwane ezingakubeki ukudla kwazo, kepha u Allah uyazondla Kanye nani; futhi Ungozwayo Owaziyo.

29:61.t: Uma ungababuza ukuthi, ngubani owadala amazulu nomhlaba waphinda wajuba ilanga nenyanga na? Bayothi: “Ngu Allah”. Pho bayengwa kanjani ngamanga na?

29:62.t: U Allah upha ngenala isondlo kulowo amthandayo aphinde futhi amswinye. Impela u Allah wazi yonke into.

29:63.t: Uma ungababuza ukuthi, ngubani oletha amanzi emvula wavusa ngawo umhlaba emuva kokuba ubusufile na? Bayothi: “Ngu Allah” Yithi “Lonke udumo ngoluka Allah, kepha iningi labo aliqondi”.

29:64.t: Lempilo yasemhlabeni iwukuchitha isikhathi nomdlalo nje. Futhi umuzi wakwelizayo yiwona impela impilo, ukube nje bebazi.

29:65.t: Uma sebegibele emkhunjini, bakhuleka ku Allah kuphela ngobumsulwa; kepha uma esebehlengele emhlabeni, yibo labaya sebeyabhangqa.

29:66.t: Baze bangabongi lokhu esibaphe kona futhi bazijabulise, kepha bazokwazi.

29:67.t: Ingabe ababoni ukuthi senze iHaramu [iMakha] kwaba indawo ephephile kulapho abantu behlwitha eceleni kwabo. Ingabe bakholelwa kumbhedo bangabongi isibusiso sika Allah na?

29:68.t: Ngubani ongenabulungiswa ukudlula lowo oqambela u Allah amanga noma ophika iqiniso lapho lifika kuye na? Kanti iJahanamu akusikho yini lapho okuyokhesela khona abangakholwa na?

29:69.t: Labo abazikhandlayo ngaThi, sizobaholela ezindleleni zeThu. Futhi impela u Allah unalabo abenza okuhle.

30:3.t: Ezanzi nezwe futhi bayophinde banqobe emuva kokunqotshwa kwabo.

30:4.t: Eminyakeni emithathu kuya kweyishumi. Ukulawula ngokuka Allah ekuqaleni nasemuva. Futhi ngalolo suku abakholwayo bayothokoza...

30:5.t: Ngosizo luka Allah. Usiza amthandayo futhi unguSomandla Onesihawu.

30:6.t: Isethembiso sika Allah, u Allah akasephuli isethembiso saKhe kepha iningi labantu abazi.

30:7.t: Bazi lokhu okosobala empilweni yasemhlabeni kulapho bengenandaba nekwelizayo.

30:8.t: Ingabe abajulanga bona ngokwabo na?. U Allah udale amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso nesukhathi esibekiwe. Impela iningi labantu abakholwa ukuthi bayohlangana neNkosi yabo.

30:9.t: Abazenge yini bahambe emhlabeni babheke ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salabo ababandulelayo. Babenamandla ukudlula bona futhi babephendula umhlaba futhi bawuphucula ukudlula bona. Zafika kubo iZithunywa zabo nezibonakaliso; akusiyena u Allah ongenzanga ubulungiswa kubo kepha yibona abangenzanga ubulungiswa kubona uqobo.

30:10.t: Isiphetho salabo abenza okubi kwaba esibi ngoba baphika imibiko yeThu futhi babehlekisa ngayo.

30:11.t: U Allah udala indalo eyisusa phansi bese eyiphinda, futhi niyobuyela kuYe.

30:12.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] sesifika, izephula mthetho ziyodideka.

30:13.t: Bayobe bengesenaye oyobashwelezela kuzikhonzwa zabo, futhi bayoziphika izikhonzwa zabo.

30:14.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] sifika; ngalolo suku bayohlukana.

30:15.t: Labo abakholwayo benza nokulingileyo, bayobe besesivandeni bejatshuliswa.

30:16.t: Kuthi labo abangakholwa baphika nemibiko yeThu nokuhlangana kwelizayo, laboke bayosiwa esijezisweni.

30:17.t: Ungcwele u Allah lapho kuhwalala nalapho kusa.

30:18.t: Futhi udumo lonke ngolwaKhe emazulwini nasemhlabeni, nasebusuku nasemini.

30:19.t: Ukhiqiza okuphilayo kokufile, aphinde akhiqize okufile kokuphilayo. Futhi uvuselela umhlaba emuva kokuba bewufile. Futhi nani niyokhishwa kanjalo [mhla nivuswa emathuneni].

30:20.t: Ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukuthi unidale ngenhlabathi nase naba ngabantu nasabalala.

30:21.t: Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukuthi wanidalela abalingani bohlobo lwenu ukuze nithole ukuthula kubo futhi wenza kwaba nothando nomusa phakathi kwenu. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abahlaziyayo.

30:22.t: Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukudalwa kwamazulu nomhlaba nokuhluka kwezilimi zenu nemibala yenu [yesikhumba]. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulabo abanolwazi.

30:23.t: Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukulala kwenu ebusuku nasemini nokuthungatha kwenu umusa waKhe. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abezwayo.

30:24.t: Futhi kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe unibonisa umbani nesabe [ukushaywa yiwo] futhi nibe nethemba [lemvula]. Futhi wehlisa amanzi emvula avuselele ngawo umhlaba emuva kokuba ubusufile. Impela kulokho kunezibinakaliso kubantu abaqondayo.

30:25.t: Futhi kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukuthi isibhakabhaka nomhlaba kume ngomyalelo waKhe. Futhi kuyothi lapho enibiza kanye emhlabeni niyovele niphume.

30:26.t: Wonke osemazulwini nasemhlabeni ungowaKhe; bonke bathobela Yena.

30:27.t: Futhi nguYena owaqala indalo futhi uyophinda ayivuse [emuva kokufa kwayo], futhi kulula kakhulu kuYe. Kunjalo nje Yena unomfanekiso ophezulu emazulwini nasemhlabeni; futhi unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

30:28.t: Unenzele umzekelo ngani uqobo. Ingabe nina nezigqila zenu ningabalingani kulokho esinabele kona [kumcebo], ngokulingana, nibasaba njengoba nisaba nina uqobo [eningezigqila] na?. Siyicacisa kanjalo imibiko kubantu abaqondayo.

30:29.t: Empeleni laba abangenabulungiswa balandela izinkanuko zabo ngokungeqiniso. Ingabe-ke ubani oyohola lowo odukiswe ngu Allah na? Futhi akekho oyobasiza.

30:30.t: Bambelela enkolweni ngobumsulwa; ubambelele esimeni sobumsulwa sika Allah lesi adalela kuso abantu. Akekho oyoguqula indalo ka Allah. Leyo iyona ndlela eqondile kepha iningi labantu alazi.

30:31.t: Ngokuzinikela kuYe futhi nimuthobele. Niqikelele ukwenza iswala futhi ningabi ngababhangqi [abakhonza izyithixo].

30:32.t: Labo abahlakaza inkolo yabo babe ngamaqembu; lonke iqembu lijabule ngalokho elinakho.

30:33.t: Uma abantu behlelwa ubunzima bakhuleka ku Allah ngokuzinikela kuYe. Kepha uma esebazwise umusa ovela kuYe, ubona ngabanye babo sebebhangqa iNkosi yabo.

30:34.t: Ngaleyo ndlela bangakubongi lokhu esibaphe kona. Zijabuliseni, maduze nje nizokwazi.

30:35.t: Kumbe sibalethele ubufakazi obukhuluma ngalokho abakubhangqa naYe na?

30:36.t: Futhi uma sizwisa abantu umusa, bayajabulela. Kepha uma behlelwa umshophi ngenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zabo, bavele balahle ithemba.

30:37.t: Ababoni yini ukuthi u Allah wandisela futhi answinye amthandayo isondlo. Impela kulokho kuzibonakaliso kubantu abakholwayo.

30:38.t: Nikeza izihlobo okuyilungelo labo kanjalo nompofu nomhambi. Lokho yikona okungcono kakhulu kulabo abafuna Ubuso buka Allah futhi labo yibona abayophumelela.

30:39.t: Futhi konke lokhu okuyinzalo enikwengezayo emcebeni wabantu akusoze kwanda ku Allah. Kuthi lokhu enikhiphayo okuyizakati nilangazelele Ubuso buka Allah; yibona labo abayohlomula ngokuphindiwe.

30:40.t: U Allah nguYena onidalile banondla futhi nguYena othatha impilo yenu aphinde anivuse. Ingabe ukhona yini ongakwenza nakancane okunye kwalokho na? Ungcwele futhi uphakeme u Allah kunalokho abakubhangqayo.

30:41.t: Ukonakala sekudlangile ezweni nasolwandle ngenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zabantu; ukuze abazwise okunye kwalokho abakwenzile hleze bazisole.

30:42.t: Yithi: “Hambani emhlabeni, nibheke ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salaba baphambilini. Iningi labe lingababhagqayo [abakhonza izithixo].

30:43.t: Bambelela enkolweni eqondile lungakafiki usuku lolo ku Allah olungeke lwaphindiselwa emuva; ngalolo suku bayosabalala.

30:44.t: Lowo ongakholwa, ukungakholwa kwakhe makusale naye. Futhi labo owenza okulungileyo, baziphembela bona.

30:45.t: Ukuze ahlomulise emseni waKhe labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo; impela Yena akabathandi abangakholwa.

30:46.t: Kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe, ukuthi uthumela imimoya ethula izindaba ezinhle [zemvula], ukuze anizwise umusa waKhe nokuthi umkhumbi uhambe ngomyalelo waKhe nokuthi nizithungathelele ezibusisweni zaKhe, hleze nibonge.

30:47.t: Futhi sathumela iZithunywa kuzizwe zazo ngaphambi kwakho; zafika kubo nobufakazi. Kepha saziphindiselela kulabo abephula umthetho, futhi kumele sibasize laba abakholwayo.

30:48.t: U Allah uthumela imimoya esabalalisa amafu bese ewandlala esibhakabhakeni ngokuthanda kwaKhe awesenze amacozucozu; bese ubona imvula iphuma ngaphakathi kwawo. Ube eseyinisela loyo amthandayo ezigqileni zaKhe, kube yibo labaya sebejabula.

30:49.t: Nakuba ngaphambi kokuba ine kubo bebe sebengenalo ithemba.

30:50.t: Bheka nje imithethelela yomusa ka Allah, ukuthi uwuvuselela kanjani umhlaba emuva kokufa kwawo. Impela loyo uyakwazi nakanjani ukuvusa abafileyo futhi akehlulwa yilutho.

30:51.t: Futhi noma singathumela umoya, bazibone [izitshalo] ziba luphuzi [zifa]; bayolokhu beqhubeke njalo emuva kwakho lokho bengabongi.

30:52.t: Ngempela wena awukwazi ukwenza abafileyo bezwe futhi awukwazi ukwenza izimumu sizwe isimemo uma bebaleka bengenendaba.

30:53.t: Futhi awukwazi ukuhola izimpumputhe uyikhipe ekudukeni kwazo. Labo okuyibona ongabenza bakulalele yilabo abakholelwa kumibiko yeThu futhi bengaMamusilimu.

30:54.t: U Allah nguYena lona owanidala nibuthaka wase enipha amandla emuva kobuthaka waphinde wanenza emuvakokuba namandla nabuthaka naguga; udala akuthandayo futhi Unolwazi Unamandla.

30:55.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho sifika iSikhathi [sokwahlulela], iziphula mthetho ziyofunga zigomele ukuthi zahlala nje isikhashana [emangcwabeni]. Phela babedukiswa kanjalo.

30:56.t: Laba abanikwa ulwazi nokholo bayothi: “Ngokulotshiwe eNcwadini ka Allah, nihlale kwaze kwaba usuku lokuvuswa. Yilona-ke lolu usuku lokuvuswa kepha beningazi”.

30:57.t: Ngalolo suku, labo abaphambukile izizaba zabo ngeke zibasize ngalutho futhi abayikunikwa thuba lokuzincengela.

30:58.t: Impela zibenzele abantu yonke imizekelo kule Kurani. Kepha uma ubalethela umbiko owodwa laba abangakholwa bathi: “Niyazibhedele nje”.

30:59.t: U Allah uzivala kanjalo izinhliziyo zalaba abangenalwazi.

30:60.t: Ngakhoke, bekezela, ngokuba isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso futhi ungabavumeli bakuqede umoya laba abangenasiqiniseko.

31:4.t: Labo abaqikelela ukwenza iswala bakhiphe nezakati futhi banesiqiniseko ngelakwelizayo.

31:5.t: Laba basekuholweni okuvela eNkosini yabo futhi labo yibona abayophumelela.

31:6.t: Futhi kunalowo kubantu okhetha inkulumo ewubhedo ukuze adukise [abantu] endleleni ka Allah [i-Isilamu] ngokungenalwazi aphinde ayenze inhlekisa.

31:7.t: Futhi uma efundelwa imibiko yeThu, uvele afulathele ngokuzigqaja kube ngathi akayizwanga noma ngathi izindlebe zakhe zivalekile. Ngakhoke mhalalisele ngesijeziso esibuhlungu

31:8.t: Impela labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo, bayothola izivande zentokomalo.

31:9.t: Bayohlala kuzo unaphakade; isethembiso sika Allah esiyiqiniso; futhi unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

31:10.t: Udale amazulu nomhlaba ngaphandle kwezinsika ezinibonayo. Wafaka izikhonkwane [izintaba] emhlabeni ukuze ukuzamazami nani; waphinde wasabalalisa kuwo izilwane zanhlobo zonke. Futhi sehlise amanzi emvula sahlumisa ngawo kuwo [umhlaba] izinhlo zonke ezinhle [zezitshalo].

31:11.t: Iyona ke lena indalo ka Allah; ngakhoke ngiboniseni ukuthi badaleni laba abanye ngaphandle kwaKhe. Empeleni abaphambukile basekudukeni okusobala.

31:12.t: Futhi sanika uLukumani ubuhlakani, [sathi]: “Bonga u Allah; lowo obongayo uzibongela yena uqobo, futhi lowo ongabongi, impela u Allah Uzimele Uyadunyiswa.

31:13.t: Mhla ethi uLukumani kwindodana yakhe eyeluleka: “Ndodana, ungabhangqi [lutho] no Allah, ngokuba impela ukubhangqa u Allah kuyimpambuko enkulu”.

31:14.t: Futhi Thina sayalela umuntu ukuba aphathe kahle abazali bakhe – nina wamthwala kanzima wambeletha kanzima, futhi wayeka ukuncela emuva kweminyaka emibili – sathi: “Bonga Mina nabazali bakho, futhi isiphetho sikimi”.

31:15.t: Kepha uma bekuphoqelela ukuba ungibhangqe nalokho ongenalwazi ngakho, ungabalaleli, kepha ubaphathe kahle emhlabeni. Futhi ulandele indlela yalowo ozinikela kiMi. Niyobeke senibuyela kiMi bese nginazisa ngalokho ebenikwenza.

31:16.t: Ndodana, uma kunohlavu oluncane olungango lwemastadi, lube sedwaleni noma lube semazulwini noma emhlabeni; u Allah uyoluveza. Impela u Allah Uyanaka Unolwazi.

31:17.t: Ndodana, qikelela ukwenza iswala futhi uyalele lokho okulungile unqande okubi futhi ukubekezelele okukwehlelayo. Impela lokho okunye kwezinto ezisemqoka.

31:18.t: Ungabukeli abantu phansi futhi ungahambi ngokuziqhayisa emhlabeni; impela u Allah akamthandi wonke umuntu ozigqajayo oqhoshayo.

31:19.t: Hamba kahle ngesizotha uma uhamba futhi ubeke izwi phansi [ungakabalasi]; ngokuba impela izwi elibi yilelo lembongolo [yona ukubanga umsindo].

31:20.t: Aniboni yini ukuthi u Allah unijubele konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni futhi wanithela ngezibusiso zaKhe ngaphandle ngaphakathi. Futhi kunalowo kubantu oqagulisana ngo Allah ngaphandle kolwazi noma ukuholwa noma incwadi ecacisayo.

31:21.t: Uma kuthiwa kubo: “Landelani lokho u Allah akwembulele”. Bathi: “Sizolandela lokho esafumanisa okhokho bethu kukho”. Nakuba uShayitani ebamemela esijezisweni somlilo.

31:22.t: Lowo ozinikela ngokuphelele ku Allah ebe enza okuhle; impela ubambelele ensikeni eqinile engasoze yephuka. Futhi isiphetho sezinto siku Allah.

31:23.t: Lowo ongakholwa, ukungakholwa kwakhe makungakukhathazi. Bayobuyela Kithi bese sibazisa ngalokho ababekwenza. Impela u Allah usazi kahle okuqukethwe izinhliziyo.

31:24.t: Sizobajabulisa okwesikhashana, bese sibatshingela esijezisweni esinzima.

31:25.t: Futhi uma ubabuza ukuthi ubani owadala amazulu nomhlaba, bayothi: “ngu Allah”. Yithi: “Lonke udumo ngoluka Allah”. Kepha iningi labo alazi.

31:26.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni ngokuka Allah. Impela u Allah Uzimele Uyadunyiswa.

31:27.t: Uma zonke izihlahla ezisemhlabeni bezingaba usiba lokuloba bese izilwandle zibe uketshezi [lokuloba]; luphindwe lwengeze ngezinye izilwandle eziyisikhombisa emuva kwalokho; Amazwi ka Allah awasoze aphela, impela u Allah unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

31:28.t: Ukudalwa kwenu nokuvuswa kwenu kufana nje nokuphefumula kanye. Impela u Allah Uyezwa Uyabona.

31:29.t: Awuboni ukuthi u Allah ufaka ubusuku emini nemini ebusuku futhi ujube ilanga nenyanga, konke kuyohamba kuze kube isikhathi esibekiwe nokuthi u Allah Unolwazi ngalokho enikwenzayo.

31:30.t: Lokho kungoba, impela u Allah uyiqiniso nokuthi impela lokhu abakhonzayo ngaphandle kwaKhe umbhedo nokuthi u Allah nguYena Ophakeme Omkhulu.

31:31.t: Awuboni yini ukuthi umkhumbi uhamba olwandle ngesibusiso sika Allah ukuze anibonise ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe. Impela kulokho kunezibonakliso kuwo wonke lowo obekezelayo obongayo.

31:32.t: Uma bembozwa amagagasi njengemithunzi, bakhuleka ku Allah kuphela ngobumsulwa. Kepha uma esebahlengele emhlabeni, kunalabo kubo abaqotho. Futhi akekho ophika imibiko yeThu ngaphandle kwalowo oyiqili elingakholwa.

31:33.t: Nina bantu, thobelani iNkosi yenu futhi nesabe usuku lapho umzali angeke ayisiza ngalutho ingane yakhe; kanjalo nengane angeke yamsiza ngalutho umzali. Impela isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso. Ngakhoke ingakuyengi impilo yasemhlabeni futhi nomdukisi angakudukisi ngo Allah.

31:34.t: Impela u Allah nguYena onolwazi lweSikhathi futhi uletha imvula wazi okusezibelethweni [zabakhulelwe]. Futhi akekho umuntu owazi ukuthi uzozuzani kusasa futhi akekho umuntu owaziyo ukuthi uyofela kuyiphi indawo. Impela u Allah Unolwazi Uyazi.

32:2.t: [Lokhu] ukwembulelwa kweNcwadi [iKurani] engenakungabaza kuyo, ivela eNkosini yendalo yonke.

32:3.t: Ingabe bathi: “Uziqambele yona”. Empeleni iyiqiniso elivela eNkosini yakho ukuze uxwayise abantu okungazange kufike kubo ngaphambi kwakho umexwayisi, hleze baholeleke.

32:4.t: U Allah nguYena owadala amazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwakho ezinsukwini eziyisithupha, wase enyukela eSihlalweni.; aninaye ngaphandle kwaKhe umhlengi noyonishwelezela. Ake nithathe isifundo.

32:5.t: Uhlela izinto phezulu ezulwini zize emhlabeni, ziphinde zenyuke zibuyele kuYe ngosuku olulingana neminyaka eyinkulungwane eniyibalayo.

32:6.t: Lowo Ungowazi okungabonwayo nokusobala, onguSomandla Onesihawu.

32:7.t: Lona owenze yonke into ayidalile yaba yinhle. Futhi waqala ukudala umuntu [u Adamu] ngobumba.

32:8.t: Emuva kwalokho wadala uzalo lwakhe ngesidoda esiwuketshezi esilula.

32:9.t: Wase embumba wamphefumulela ngoMoya waKhe. Futhi wanenzela ukuzwa namehlo nezinhliziyo; kepha akuvamanga ukuba nibonge.

32:10.t: Futhi bathi: “Ingabe uma sesibhubhile emhlabeni [sangcwatsha], siyophinde sidalwe kabusha na?”. Empeleni abakholelwa ekuhlanganeni neNkosi yabo.

32:11.t: Yithi: “Ingelosi yokufa lena ejutshwe kini, iyothatha imiphefumulo yenu, bese nibuyela eNkosini yenu”.

32:12.t: Uma ubungazibona izephula mthetho sezigebise amakhanda eNkosini yabo [bethi]: “Nkosi yethu, sesiyabona futhi sesiyezwa; ngakhoke sibuyisele emuva [emhlabeni] ukuze senze okulungileyo, impela sesinesiqiniseko”.

32:13.t: Ukube besithanda, besizohola wonke umuntu. Kodwa isinqumo sesiphumile kiMi ukuthi: “Ngiyogcwalisa iJahanamu ngamajini nangabantu bonkana”.

32:14.t: [Kuyothiwa]: “Zwanini [isijeziso] ngokulibala kwenu umhlangano walolu suku; impela nathi siyonilibala. Futhi zwanini isijeziso saphakade ngenxa yezenzo zenu”.

32:15.t: Labo okuyibona abakholwa imibiko yeThu, yilabo okuthi uma bekhunjuzwa ngayo bavele bawe ngobuso bakhothame, babaze udumo lweNkosi yabo futhi bengaziqhayisi.

32:16.t: Bavuka ebusuku bakhuleke eNkosini yabo benokwesaba nethemba futhi bayaphana ngalokho esibabele kona.

32:17.t: Akekho umuntu owazi lokho abafihlelwe kona kokujabulisayo [kwelizayo], okuwumvuzo wezenzo zabo.

32:18.t: Ingabe lowo ongokholwayo uyefana yini nalowo oyisephula mthetho [ongakholwa]; cha abafani.

32:19.t: Labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo, bayothola izivande zokukhosela, njengendawo yokuhlala ngenxa yezenzo zabo.

32:20.t: Kepha labo abayizephula mthetho [abangakholwa], bayokhosela emlilweni. Kuyothi njalo uma bezama ukuphuma kuwo, babuyiselwe phakathi kuwo bese kuthi kubo: “Zwanini isijeziso somlilo lesi ebenisiphika”.

32:21.t: Futhi siyobazwisa isijeziso esincane ngale kwesikhulu ukuze babuyele endleeni eqondile.

32:22.t: Futhi ngubani ophambuke ukudlula lowo okhunjuzwa ngemibiko ka Allah bese eyishaya indiva ayifulathele na?. Impela siyoziphindisela kuzephula mthetho.

32:23.t: Futhi sanika uMusa iNcwadi, – ngakhoke ungabi nokungabaza mayela nokuhlangana naye – futhi sayenza yaba umhlahlandlela kusizwe sakwa Isirayeli.

32:24.t: Futhi senza kwaba nabaholi phakathi kwabo ababehola ngomyalelo weThu, mhla bekezela futhi babengenakungabaza ngemibiko yeThu.

32:25.t: Impela iNkosi yakho iyokwahlulela phakathi kwabo ngoSuku lokwaHlulela mayelana nalokho ababephikisana ngakho.

32:26.t: Ingabe akukabacaceli ukuthi ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo, abahamba lapho ezazihlala khona. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso; kungani bengalaleli na?

32:27.t: Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi siletha amanzi emhlabeni owomile, bese sikhiqiza ngawo izitshalo okudla kuzo imfuyo yabo nabo uqobo; kungani bengaboni na?

32:28.t: Futhi bathi: “Kanti siyofika nini lesahlulelo uma ngempela nineqiniso na?”

32:29.t: Yithi: “Ngosuku lwesahlulelo, laba abangakholwa, ukukholwa kwabo [ngalolo suku] angeke kubasize futhi abayikunikwa thuba”.

32:30.t: Ngakhoke bashiye kanjalo ulinde, ngoba nabo balindile.

33:1.t: Sithunywa, thobela u Allah futhi ungabalaleli abangakholwa nabazenzisi. Impela u Allah Uyazi Ukhaliphile.

33:2.t: Landela lokho okwembulelwe kuwe kuvela eNkosini yakho. Impela u Allah Unolwazi ngakho konke enikwenzayo.

33:3.t: Futhi thembela ku Allah, futhi u Allah wanele njengoMnakekeli.

33:4.t: U Allah akenzanga indoda yaba nezinhliziyo ezimbili ngaphakathi kuyo. Futhi akenzanga abafazi benu baba ngonyoko. Futhi akenzanga izingane zenu ezitholiwe zaba izingane zenu zegazi. Lokho into eshiwo yini ngemilomo yenu. Kepha u Allah ukukhuluma iqiniso futhi uholela endleleni eqondile.

33:5.t: Babizeni [abantwana abatholiwe] ngoyise, yikona okungubulungiswa ku Allah. Uma ningabazi oyise babo; lapho bangabafowenu enkolweni nezihlobo zenu. Futhi aninacala kulokho enikwenze ngephutha, kodwa kulokho enikwenze ngamabomu. Futhi u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

33:6.t: iSithunywa yisona esimqoka kubakholwayo ukundlula bona uqobo. Futhi amakhozikazi aso, onina babo [abakholwayo]. Futhi izihlobo zegazi zifika kuqala kwezinye kunabakholwayo nabafudiki ngokomthetho ka Allah; ngaphandle-ke uma nifuna ukwenza isihle kuzihlobo zenu. Lokho kulotshiwe eNcwadini [uQwembe olulondoloziwe].

33:7.t: Futhi khumbula mhla senza isibopho neZithunywa kanjalo nawe [Muhamadi] noNuhu no Ibhirahimu no Isa indodana ka Mariyamu; futhi senza isipho esiqinile nabo.

33:8.t: Ukuze abuze abaneqiniso mayelana neqiniso labo; futhi walungiselela abangakholwa isijeziso esibuhlungu.

33:9.t: Nina enikholwayo, khumbulani izibusiso zika Allah kini, mhla kufika amabutho kini; sabe sesithumela kuwo umoya namabutho eningawabonanga. Futhi ukubona kahle konke enikwenzayo.

33:10.t: Mhla befika kini ngenhla [empumalanga] nangenzansi [entshonalanga] kwenu; kwahlahla amehlo novalo lwabasentanyeni naba nemindlinzo emibi ngo Allah.

33:11.t: Khona lapho bavivinywa abakholwayo bashukumiswa kanzima.

33:12.t: Lapho abazenzisi nalabo abanesifo ezinhlizweni zabo bathi: “Ayikho into esiyithenjiswe yiSithunywa ngaphandle nje kwenkohliso”.

33:13.t: Lapho iqembu elithile phakathi kwabo lathi: “Bantu baseYatiribi [eMadina] ayikho into enihlalele [empini], ngakhoke buyelani emumva”. Elinye iqembu lona lacela imvumo [yokubuyela emumva] kuSithunywa, bathi: “Imizi yethu ayiphephile” – akusikho ukuthi yayingaphephanga, babefuna nje ukubaleka kuphela.

33:14.t: Ukube angeniswa kubo [amabutho ezitha] nhlangothi zonke, bese becelwa ukuba babuyele ekubhanqeni u Allah [bashiye i-Isilamu], bebe zokwenza futhi bekungeke kubathathe isikhathi eside.

33:15.t: Futhi bebekade bethembise u Allah ngaphambilini ukuthi ngeke babaleke [empini]. Futhi isithembiso ku Allah kuyobuzwa ngaso.

33:16.t: Yithi: “Ngeke kunisize ngalutho ukubaleka uma nibalekela ukufa noma ukubulawa; manjalo niyoncebeleka okwesikhashana”.

33:17.t: Yithi: “Ngubani lona oyonivikela ku Allah uma kukhona okubi noma okuhle afuna kunehlele na?”

33:18.t: U Allah ubazi kahle labo phakathi kwenu abasalela emuva abathi kubafowabo: “Wozani kithi”, futhi abavamile nokuya empini.

33:19.t: Banomhawu kini. Uma befikelwa ukwesaba [impi], niyobabona bekubheka amehlo abo egenqeza okumuntu oqulekiswa ukusaba ukufa. Uma sekundlulile ukwesaba [impi], bashiya abangalazi kini ngolimi olubukhali, benohawu wokuhle. Labo abakaze bakholwe; ngakhoke u Allah ushabalalise izenzo zabo [ezinhle]. Futhi lokho kulula ku Allah.

33:20.t: Bacabanga ukuthi amabutho ombimbi awakahambi. Uma engabuya; bafisa ukuba bangayohlala emaphandleni belokhu bebuza ngani. Futhi noma bebengaba khona nani, bebengeke bangene nani empini ngaphandle nje kwedlanzana.

33:21.t: Impela ninesibonelo esihle eSithunyweni sika Allah; kulowo okholelwa ku Allah nasoSukwini lokuGcina aphinde akhumbule u Allah kakhulu.

33:22.t: Kuthe lapho abakholwayo bebona amabutho ombimbi bathi: “Yikho lokhu esikuthenjiswe ngu Allah neSithunywa saKhe; u Allah ubeqinisile neSithunywa saKhe”. Futhi kwabandisela ukholo nokuzinikela.

33:23.t: Kunamadoda kubakholwayo akugcina lokho ayekuthembise u Allah. Kunalawo aseyiphothulile indima yabo bese kuba nalawo asalindile, kepha awakaguquki nakancane.

33:24.t: Ukuze u Allah anike abaneqiniso umvuzo weqiniso labo; bese ejezisa abazenzisi uma ethanda noma abaxolele. Impela u Allah unguMthetheleli Onesihawu.
