33:25.t: Futhi u Allah wabaphindisela emumva laba abangakholwa nenzondo yabo bengazuzanga lutho oluhle. Futhi u Allah wabanela impi abakholwayo [abayilwanga] futhi u Allah Unamandla unguSomandla.

33:26.t: Waphinde wabakhipha ezinqabeni zabo laba abeMibhalo abasizana nabo [abangakholwa], wabafaka ingebhe ezinhlizweni zabo; abanye babo nababulala kwathi abanye nababopha.

33:27.t: Futhi wenza nina izindlalifa zendawo yabo nemizi yabo nomcebo wabo nenye futhi indawo eningafiki kuyo. Futhi u Allah akahlulwa yilutho.

33:28.t: Sithunywa, yithi kumakhosikazi akho: “Uma nilangazelela impilo yasemhlabeni nobuhle bawo; wozani nginixoshise bese nginikhulula ngesihle [sihlukane]”.

33:29.t: Kepha uma nilangazelela u Allah neSithunywa saKhe nomuzi wakwelizayo; impela u Allah ulungiselele labo abenza okulungileyo kini umvuzo omkhulu.

33:30.t: Bafazi beSithunywa, lowo oyokwenza amanyala asobala phakathi, uyophinda phindelwa isijeziso kabili. Futhi lokho kulula ku Allah.

33:31.t: Futhi lowo phakathi kwenu ozothobela u Allah neSithunywa saKhe aphinde enze okulungileyo; sizomnika umvuzo wakhe uphindwe kabili futhi silungisele isidlo esihle [kwelizayo].

33:32.t: Bafazi beSithunywa, nina anifani nabanye abafazi. Uma nithobela u Allah, ningehlisi kakhulu izwi lapho nikhuluma, funa lowo onesifo enhlizweni yakhe abe nokukhanuka. Futhi nikhulume inkulumo eqotho.

33:33.t: Futhi nihlale emizini yenu ningalokho niveza ubuhle benu njengasesikhathini sobuwula [ngaphambi kwe Isilamu]. Futhi niqikelele ukwenza iswala nikhiphe nezakati niphinde nilalele u Allah neSithunywa saKhe. U Allah ufuna nje kuphela ukususa impambuko kini bantu basendlini [yeSithunywa] nokuthi anihlanzisise.

33:34.t: Futhi nikhumbule imibiko ka Allah nobuhlakani okufunda ezindlini zenu; impela u Allah Unesineke Unolwazi.

33:35.t: Impela abesilisa abangamaMusilimu nabesifazane, nabesilisa abakholwayo nabesifazane, nabesilisa abazithobayo nabesifazane, nabesilisa abaneqiniso nabesifazane, nabesilisa ababekezelelayo nabesifazane, nabesilisa abasabayo nabesifazane, nabesilisa abanikelayo nabesifazane, nabesilisa abazilayo nabesifazane, nabesilisa abavikela izitho zabo zangasese nabesifazane, nabesilisa abakhumbula u Allah kakhulu nabesifazane; u Allah ubalungiselele intethelelo nomvuzo omkhulu.

33:36.t: Futhi owesilisa okholwayo nowesifazane angeke babe nombono wabo emuva kokuba u Allah esekhiphe umyalelo kanjalo neSithunywa saKhe; lowo ongalaleli u Allah neSithunywa saKhe, impela uduke ukuduka okusobala.

33:37.t: Futhi khumbula mhla uthi kulowo u Allah ambusisile nawe wamenzela umusa: “Gcina umkakho ungamdedeli”. Kulapho ufihle ngaphakathi kuwe lokho u Allah ayezokuveza obala futhi wesaba abantu kepha ngu Allah okumele umesabe. Kuthe lapho uZayidi ehlukanisa naye [umkakhe], samshadisa wena; ukuze abakholwayo banganqeni [besaba icala] ukushada abafazi bezingane zabo abazitholile uma sezahlukanisile nabo. Futhi umyalelo ka Allah uyenzeka.

33:38.t: iSithunywa asinacala kulokho u Allah asinqumele kona; phela inkambiso ka Allah nakulabo asebandlula. Futhi umyalelo ka Allah kunqunyiwe ukuba wenzeke.

33:39.t: Labo abadlulisela imibiko ka Allah futhi mabesabe, bengasabi muntu ngaphandle kuka Allah; futhi u Allah wenele njengomehluleli.

33:40.t: U Muhamadi akasiye ubaba wendoda phakathi kwenu; kepha uyiSithunywa sika Allah noMembulelwa wokugcina. Futhi u Allah wazi yonke into.

33:41.t: Nina enikholwayo, khumbulani u Allah kakhulu.

33:43.t: NguYena lona oningamela ngomusa waKhe nezingelosi zaKhe ziyanikhulekela; ukuze anikhiphe ebumnyameni anise ekukhanyeni; futhi unesihawu kwabakholwayo.

33:44.t: Ukubingelelana kwabo ngosuku lapho beyohlangana naYe, kuyoba “ukuthula”; futhi ubalungiselele umvuzo omkhulu.

33:45.t: Sithunywa, impela sikuthumele ukuba ube ufakazi nomethuli wezindaba ezinhle nomexwayisi.

33:46.t: Nomemela ku Allah ngemvumo yaKhe nokuthi ube isibani esikhanyisayo.

33:47.t: Futhi halalisela abakholwayo ngokuthi bayothola umusa omkhulu ovela ku Allah.

33:48.t: Futhi ungalaleli abangakholwa nabazenzisi futhi ungabi nendaba ngokuhlukumeza kwabo, uthembele ku Allah; futhi u Allah wanele njengoMnakekeli.

33:49.t: Nina enikholwayo, uma nishada abesimame abakholwayo bese niyehlukana nabo ngaphambi kokuthi nibathinte; asikho isidingo sokuba banizindele. Baxoshiseni futhi nibakhulule ngesihle.

33:50.t: Sithunywa, impela sikuvumele [ukuba ushade] amakhosikazi akho lawa owanike izimfanelo zawo kanjalo nezigqila [amabibi] lezo u Allah akulethele zona, namadodakazi kamfowabo nawodadewabo bakayihlo, nakamalume wakho nawodadewabo bakanyoko; lawa afuduke kanye nawe nowesimame okholwayo uma ezethula kuSithunywa uma ukuthi siyafuna ukumshada; kuwe kuphela ngaphandle kwabakholwayo – siyakwazi lokhu esibanqumele kona mayelana namakhosikazi abo – ukuze wena ungabi nokunqena. Futhi u Allah unguMthetheleli Onesihawu.

33:51.t: Uqhelisa omthandayo futhi usondeze kuwe omthandayo. Futhi lowo ofuna ukumsondeza kulowo omqhelisile awunacala. Lokho yikona okungabenza bonke bajabule futhi baneliseke ngalokho obanika kona. U Allah ukwazi kahle okusezinhlizweni zenu; futhi u Allah Uyazi Ubobubele.

33:52.t: Unqatshelwe [ushada abanye] abafazi emuva kwalokho nokuthi uthathe abanye esikhundleni sabo; noma kungakukhanga kangakanani ubuhle babo, ngaphandle uma beyizigqila zakho [amabibi]. Futhi u Allah uziqhaphe zonke izinto.

33:53.t: Nina enikholwayo, ningangeni emizini yeSithunywa; ngaphandle uma nimenyelwe ekudleni, ningalindi kuze kuvuthwe. Kodwa uma nimenyiwe, ngenani; uma seniqedile ukudla niphume futhi ningalibali ukukhuluma. Ngokuba lokho kusiphatha kabi iSithunywa; bese siba namahloni [okunixosha]; kepha u Allah akanamahloni ngeqiniso. Futhi uma niwabuza [amakhosikazi eSithunywa] izinto, wabuzeni ningemuva kwesithiyo. Lokho yikona okuhlanzekile ezinhlizweni zenu nasezinhlizweni zawo. Futhi akumele nihlukumeze iSithunywa sika Allah noma nishade amakhosikazi aso emuva kwaso nhlobo. Ngokuba lokho ku Allah kuyinto enkulu.

33:54.t: Uma niveza obala okuthile noma nikufihla; impela u Allah uyazi yonke into.

33:55.t: Awanacala [amakhosikazi eSithunywa] uma bebonwa oyise noma amadodana awo noma abafowabo noma amadodana abafowabo noma amadodana odadewabo noma abafazi bakubo [ngenkolo] noma izigqila zawo. Futhi nithobele u Allah; impela u Allah uzibheke zonke izinto.

33:56.t: Impela u Allah wengamela iSithunywa ngomusa kanjalo nezingelosi zaKhe [ziyasicelela wona]; nina enikholwayo, siceleleni umusa futhi nisicelele ukuthula.

33:57.t: Impela laba abahlukumeza u Allah neSithunywa saKhe; u Allah uyobaqalekisa emhlabeni nakwelizayo aphinde abalungiselele isijeziso esihlazayo.

33:58.t: Futhi labo abahlukumeza abesilisa nabesimame abakholwayo ngento abangayenzanga, impela basuke beqambe amanga luhlaza benza nempabuko esobala.

33:59.t: Sithunywa, tshela amakhosikazi akho namadodakazi akho namakhosikazi abakholwayo ukuba mabazimboze ngezambatho ezivala umzimba wonke. Lokho kwenza kube lula ukuba baziwe ukuze bangahlukunyezwa; futhi u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

33:60.t: Uma abazenzisi nalabo abanesifo ezinhlizweni zabo nalabo abafafaza amanga eMadina bengaphezi, sizokuyalela ngabo [ukuba ubajezise] bese bengasakhelani nawe ngaphandle nje okwesikhashana.

33:61.t: Baqalekisiwe, yonke indawo lapho abaya khona bayobanjwa babulawe.

33:62.t: Inkambiso ka Allah nalulabo asebandlula. Futhi alikho ilalela oyilitholela inkambiso ka Allah.

33:63.t: Abantu bakubuza ngeSikhathi [sokwahlulela], yithi: “u Allah kuphela onolwazi ngaso”. Wazi ngani, mhlawumbe iSikhathi sesiseduze.

33:64.t: Impela ubaqalekisile laba bangakholwa futhi wabalungiselela umlilo.

33:65.t: Bayobhadla kuwo unaphakade, abayikuthola mhlengi noma oyobasiza.

33:66.t: Ngosuku lapho ubuso babo buyobe buphendulwa emlilweni, belokhu bethi: “Sifisa ngabe salalela u Allah salalela neSithunywa.

33:67.t: Futhi bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, thina salalela abaholi bethu nezikhulu zethu, basidukisa endleleni”.

33:68.t: Nkosi yethu, bajezise ngesijeziso esiphindwe kabili uphinde ubaqalekise ngesiqalekiso esikhulu.

33:69.t: Nina enikholwayo, ningabi njengalaba abaphatha kabi uMusa, futhi u Allah wamkhulula kulokho ababekusho. Futhi wayehloniphekile ku Allah.

33:70.t: Nina enikholwayo, thobelani u Allah nikhulume inkulumo eqotho.

33:71.t: Uyonilungisela izenzo [zibe qotho] aphinde anithethelele izimpambuko zenu. Futhi lowo olalela u Allah neSithunywa saKhe, impela uphumelele impumelelo enkulu.

33:72.t: Impela sathwesa amazulu nomhlaba nezintaba umthwalo [wokugcina intando ka Allah] zenqaba ukuwuthwala zawesaba, kepha umuntu wawuthwala; impela akanabulungiswa uyisiwula.

33:73.t: Ukuze u Allah ajezise abesilisa nabesifazane abangabazenzisi nabesilisa nabesifazane abakhonza izithixo. Nokuthi u Allah athethelele abesilisa nabesifazane abakholwayo; futhi u Allah unguMthetheleli Onesihawu.

34:1.t: Udumo ngoluka Allah, lona konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokwaKhe, futhi udumo ngolwaKhe nakwelizayo; nguYena Okhaliphile Onolwazi.

34:2.t: Wazi okungena emhlabeni nokuphuma kuwo, nokwehla phezulu esibhakabhakeni nokunyukelakuso; futhi nguYena Onesihawu Ongumthetheleli.

34:3.t: Laba abangakholwa bathi: “iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] ngeke sifike kithi”. Yithi: “Nakanjani siyofika kini ngiyifunge iNkosi yami eyazi okungabonwayo; akaphuthwa ngisho okungalingana nohlamvana emazulwini nasemhlabeni nokuncane kunalokho kanjalo nokukhulu; konke kuqoshwe eNcwadini ecacisayo [uQwembe].

34:4.t: Ukuze anike labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo imivuzo yabo. Yilabo abazothola intethelelo nesondlo esihle.

34:5.t: Futhi laba abazikhandla ekuchitheni imibiko yeThu; labo bayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu esinzima impela.

34:6.t: Futhi labo abanikwa ulwazi [osolwazi] bakubona kuyiqiniso lokhu okwembulelwe kuwe kuvela eNkosini yakho futhi kuholela endleleni kaSomandla Odunyiswayo.

34:7.t: Futhi laba abangakholwa bathi: “Ake sinibonise indoda mphini ezonitshela ukuthi uma seniyizicubu, impela niyophinde nidalwe kabusha”.

34:8.t: Ingabe uqambela u Allah amanga kumbe uyahlanya. Empeleni laba abangakholwa kwelizayo bayojezisa futhi badukile impela.

34:9.t: Abakuboni yini lokhu okuphambi kwabo nokusemuva kwabo na? Uma sithanda singabagwinyisa ngomhlaba noma sibehlisele izicucu esivela phezulu. Impela kulokho kunezi bonakaliso kulowo nalowo oyisigqila esizilahlayo.

34:10.t: Sanika uDawudi umusa ovela kithi [sathi: “Zintaba nezinyoni dumisani Kanye naye”; futhi samthambisela insimbi.

34:11.t: [Sathi]: “Yenza izembatho zensimbi ezivulekile futhi ucophelele ukwenza izihlanaganiso ngokulingene [zingabi lula zisheshe zinqamuke nobe zibenkulu zisinde].

34:12.t: Futhi samhlinzeka uSulayimani ngomoya, onqamula ekuseni ibanga elithatha inyanga eyodwa kanjalo nantambama unqamula ibanga elithatha inyanga yonke. Futhi samenzela ithusi [lawuketshezi] lageleza emthonjeni. Futhi bekunamajini asebenza ngaphambi kwakhe ngemvumo yeNkosi yakhe; lowo kuwo ophaphalazayo emyalelweni weThu simzwisa isijeziso somlilo.

34:13.t: Babemenzela noma yini ayifunayo, kungaba amagumbi nezithombe nezitsha [ezinkulu] ezifana nabachibi amanzi namabhoswe amakhulu anganyakazi. Mndeni kaDawudi, sebenzani ngokubonga, futhi bayidlanzana ezigqileni zaMi ababongayo.

34:14.t: Kwathi lapho sesimnqumele ukuba afe [uSulayimani]; akekho owabakhombisa ukuthi usefile ngaphandle kwesidalwa somhlaba esadla induku yakhe; kuthe lapho ewa bhu phansi, kwawacacela amajini ukuthi ukube ayenalo ulwazi lokungabonwayo ngabe awahlala isikhathi esingaka esijezisweni esihlazayo.

34:15.t: Impela isizwe saseSaba’sasine sibonakaliso emizini yaso; izivande ezimbili eziphahlene. Dlanini kusondlo sika Allah futhi nibonge Yena; ninomuzi omuhle neNkosi ethethelelayo.

34:16.t: Kepha abalalelanga; sathumela kubo isikhukhula esinzima, saguqula izivande zabo ezimbili zaba izivande ezinezithelo ezibabayo nezihlahla ezingatheli nedlanzana lezihlahla zameva.

34:17.t: Lokho sabahlomulisa ngakho ngenxa yokungakholwa kwabo; futhi sijezisa [ngaso] kuphela lowo ongakholwa.

34:18.t: Futhi senza phakathi kwabo nemizi lena esayibusisa kwaba nemizi ebonakalayo [ewuchungechunge], esenza kwabalula ukuhamba kuyo; hambani kuyo [lemizi] ubusuku nemini niphephile.

34:19.t: Khepha bathi: “Nkosi yethu, yenza kube nabanga elide phakathi kohambo lwethu [qhelelanisa imizi yethu]”. Baphambuka, sabe sesibenza isifundo sabahlakaza sabahlakazisisa. Impela kulokho kunezifundo kulowo nalowo obekezelayo [ebunzimeni] nobongayo [ebumnandini].

34:20.t: Futhi u Ibilisi wafeza isifiso sakhe kubo [sokudukisa uzalo luka Adamu], bamlandela ngaphandle kwedlanzana lalabo abakholwayo.

34:21.t: Futhi wayenawo amandla phezu kwabo [okubaphoqa]; sasifuna nje ukuhlunga abakholelwa kwelizayo kulabo ababenongabazane ngalo. Futhi iNkosi yakho iziqhaphe zonke izinto.

34:22.t: Yithi: “Bizani laba enibaqokile ngaphandle kuka Allah; abanalutho ngisho okungangohlavana abakulawulayo emazulwini nasemhlabeni. Futhi abanasabelo sokubambisana [njengabalingani] kuzo; futhi Yena [u Allah] akanamlekeleli kubo”.

34:23.t: Futhi ukushweleza kuYe akuyi kusiza ngalutho ngaphandle kwalowo amuphe igunya. Kuyothi lapho izinhliziyo sezigcwele ingebhe bathi: “Itheni iNkosi yenu na?” Bayothi: “Isho iqiniso, futhi iYona Ephakeme Enkulu”.

34:24.t: Yithi: “Ngubani oyonondla emazulwini nasemhlabeni na?” yithi: “Ngu Allah; futhi thina noma nina, sisendleleni eqondile noma sidukile ngokusobala”.

34:25.t: Yithi: “Angeke nabuzwa ngamacala ethu futhi nathi ngeke sibuzwe ngenikwenzile”.

34:26.t: Yithi: “iNkosi yethu iyosibuthanisa bese iyehlulela phakathi kwethu ngeqiniso; phela Yona inguMehluleli Owaziyo”.

34:27.t: Yithi: “Ngiboniseni lokhu enikubhangqe naYe [u Allah] njengabalingani”. Phinde! Empeleni ungu Allah uSomandla Okhaliphile.

34:28.t: Futhi sikuthumele kusintu sonke ukuze ube umethuli wezindaba ezinhle nomexwayisi; kepha iningi labantu alazi.

34:29.t: Futhi bathi: “Kanti siyofika nini lesi sithembiso uma ngempela niqinisile”.

34:30.t: Yithi: “Nibekelwe usuku eningeke naluphutha noma niluhambele phambili nangomzuzu.”

34:31.t: Laba abakholwa bathi: “Asisoze sakholelwa kule Kurani noma lokhu okuyiyandulelayo”. Uma ubungabona lapho abaphambukile sememisiwe ngaphambi kweNkosi yabo belokhu beqagulisana ngamazwi; bayothi laba ababecindezelwe kulabo ababeziqhayisa: “Ukube bekungekho ngenxa yenu ngabe saba ngabakholwayo”.

34:32.t: Bayothi laba ababeziqhayisa kulabo ababecindezelwe: “Ingabe yithi esanivimbela ekuholeni mhla kufika kini na?; empeleni beniyizephula mthetho ngokwenu”.

34:33.t: Bayothi laba ababecindezelwe kulabu ababeziqhayisa: “Kungenxa yamaqhinga obusuku nemini mhla nisiyalela ukuba singakholelwa ku Allah futhi simbhangqe nezimbangi.” Bayokufihla ukudangala lapho sebebona isijeziso; futhi siyofaka amasongo ezintanyeni zalabo abangakholwa. Bathola kuphela umvuzo walokho ababekwenza.

34:34.t: Futhi njalonje uma sithumela umexwayisi esizweni thizeni; iziqumama zakhona zithi: “Impela lokhu enithunywe nakho thina siyakuphika”.

34:35.t: Futhi bathi: “Thina sinomcebo nezingane eziningi futhi angeke thina sijeziswe”.

34:36.t: Yithi: “iNkosi yami yabela ngenala isondlo kulowo emthandayo iphinde imswinye; kepha iningi labantu alazi”.

34:37.t: Umcebo wenu nezingane zenu akusikho okunisondeza eduze naThi; ngaphandle kwalowo okholwayo nowenza okulungileyo. Yiboke labo abayothola umvuzo ophinde kabili ngenxa yalokho ababekwenza futhi bayohlala bephephile emagunjini [aseJana].

34:38.t: Futhi labo abazikhandla ukuchitha imibiko yeThu; yibona labo abafakwa esijezisweni.

34:39.t: Yithi: “u Allah wabela ngenala isondlo lowo amthandayo ezigqileni zaKhe aphinde amswinyele. Futhi noma yini eniyichithayo [yesondlo], Yena uzonibuyisela kona; futhi unguMondli obendlula bonke”.

34:40.t: Futhingosuku lapho ayobabuthanisa bonke ngothi lwabo bese ethi kuzingelosi: “Ingabe yibonake laba ababekhonza nina na?”

34:41.t: Ziyothi: “Ungcwele! Nguwena uMnakekeli wethu ngaphandle kwabo. Empeleni babekhonza amajini futhi iningi labo belikholelwa kuwo”.

34:42.t: Ngakhoke namhlanje akekho onamandla okusiza omunye wenu noma amlimaze. Futhi siyothi kulabo abaphambukile: “Zwanini isijeziso somlilo lesi ebenilokhu nisiphika”.

34:43.t: Uma befundelwa imibiko yeThu acacile bathi: “Lona indoda nje efuna ukunisusa kulokho okwakukhonzwa okhokho benu”. Futhi bathi: “Lokhu [iKurani] amanga aluhlaza aqanjiwe”. Futhi bathi laba abangakholwa ngeqiniso lapho lifika kubo: “Lokhu ilumbo elisobala”.

34:44.t: Asibanikanga zincwadi ukuba bazifunde futhi asithumelanga mxwayisi kubo ngaphambilini kwakho.

34:45.t: Futhi laba abangaphambi kwabo baphika – futhi bona [abaseMakha] abanaso ngisho isigamu seshumi salokho esabanika kona; baphika iZithunywa zeThu; bheka ukuthi sabanjani isijeziso saMi.

34:46.t: Yithi: “Ngineluleka ngento eyodwa, ukuba nibhukule ukujabulisa u Allah ngakubili noma munye ngamunye bese nihlaziya kahle ukuthi, umlingani wenu [uMuhamadi] akahlanyi; ungumexwayisi wenu nje kuphela ngaphambi kkokuba kufike isijeziso esinzima”.

34:47.t: Yithi: “Anginicelanga mvuzo ongowenu; umvuzo wami uku Allah futhi nguYena oqhaphe yonke into”.

34:48.t: Yithi: “iNkosi yami engeYazi okungabonwayo, igadla ngeqiniso”.

34:49.t: Yithi: “Iqiniso selifikile, kepha amanga awakwazi kuletha lutho noma aphinde lutho”.

34:50.t: Yithi: “Uma ngiphambuka, ngiziphambukela mina uqobo futhi uma ngisendleleni eqondile, kungenxa kwalokho iNkosi yami ekwembulela kimi; impela Yona ingoZwayo Oseduze”.

34:51.t: Uma ubungababona sebethukile lapho bengeke besaphunyuka futhi bayothathwa endaweni eseduze.

34:52.t: Futhi bayothi: “Sesiyakholelwa kuYe”. Bayokuthola kanjani besendaweni esekudeni na?

34:53.t: Bakuphika ngaphambilini futhi bebeqagula ngemidlinzo ekude le.

34:54.t: Kuyoba nesithiyo phakathi kwabo nalokho abalangazelelayo njengoba kwenziwa kulabo abafana nabo phambilini; impela babenokungabaza bengenasiqiniseko.

35:1.t: Udumo ngoluka Allah uMdali wamazulu nomhlaba owenza izingelosi zaba izithunywa ezinezimpiko ezimbili nezintathu nezine; wengeza akuthandayo endalweni. Impela u Allah akahlulwa lutho.

35:2.t: Lowo musa u Allah awuvulela abantu akekho ongawuvimba. Futhi lokho akuvimbile akekho ongakukhulula emuva kwaKhe. Futhi nguYena uSomandla Okhaliphile.

35:3.t: Nina bantu, khumbulani umusa ka Allah; ingabe ukhona omunye umdali onondlayo ngokuphezulu nokusemhlabeni na? Akekho omunye ofanelwe ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe; pho nidukiswa yini na?

35:4.t: Uma bekuphika; iZithunywa ezikwandulelayo nazo zaphikwa. Futhi zonke izinto ziyobuyela ku Allah.

35:5.t: Nina bantu, impela isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso; ngakhoke, maningadukiswa impilo yasemhlabeni futhi ningadukiswa umdukisi ngo Allah.

35:6.t: Impela uShayitani uyisitha senu ngakhoke mthatheni njengesitha; umemela abalandeli bakhe ukuze babe ngabayongena emlilweni.

35:7.t: Labo abangakholwa bayothola isijeziso esinzima. Futhi labo abakholwayo abenza okulungileyo bayothola intethelelo nomvuzo omkhulu.

35:8.t: Ingabe lowo owenzelwe kuhle ububi bezenzo zakhe wazibona zizinhle [ingabe uyefana yini nalowo obona okuhle kukuhle nokubi kukubi] na? Impela uAllah udukisa amthandayo ahole amthandayo. Ngakhoke ungalokhu uba lusizi ngabo. Impela uAllah ukwazi kahle abakwenzayo.

35:9.t: Futhi u Allah nguYena lona othumela imimoya esabalalisa amafu, bese siletha ngawo amanzi endaweni ebesifile; bese siyayivuselela ngawo umhlaba emuva kokufa kwawo. Nokuvuswa kuyobanjalo.

35:10.t: Lowo ofuna ukuhlonishwa; ukuhlonishwa konke ngokuka Allah kuphela. Amazwi amahle anyukela kuYe futhi nesenzo esilungileyo siyawaphakamisa. Futhi laba abahlela okuphambukile bayothola isijeziso esinzima; nezinhlelo zalabo ziyobhubha.

35:11.t: Futhi u Allah unidale ngobumba nangesidoda wabe esenenza ukuba niganane. Futhi owesimame akakhulelwa noma abelethe ngaphandle kolwazi lwaKhe. Futhi akekho ophila isikhathi eside noma oncishiselwayo kungalotshiwe eNcwadini. Impela lokho kulula kuAllah.

35:12.t: Futhi izilwandle ezimbili azifani; lolu lumanzi amnandi amtoti ehla esiphundu uma uwaphuza; kuthi lolu lunosawoti luyababa. Kepha kuwo wonke nidla inyama enhle niphinde nikhiphe ubucwebe enibugqokayo, futhi ubona imikhumbi yehla yenyuka kulo nithungatha umusa waKhe futhi ukuze nibonge.

35:13.t: Ufaka ubusuku emini, afake imini ebusuku futhi ujube ilanga nenyanga, konke kuyohamba kuze kufike isikhathi enibekiwe. Loyo [owenza konke lokhu] ngu Allah iNkosi yenu, bonke ubukhosi bungobakhe. Futhi labo enibakhonzayo ngaphandle kwaKhe abanaso ngisho uqweqwe lwendumba [yamasundu].

35:14.t: Uma nikhuleka kubo, abayizwa imikhuleko yenu; futhi ukube bebeyizwa, bebengeke bakwazi ukuyiphendula. Futhi ngoSuku lokwahlulela bayokuphika ukubabhangqa kwenu. Futhi akekho ongakwazisa njengalowo Onolwazi.

35:15.t: Nina bantu, niyizichaka ku Allah. Kepha u Allah ungoZimele Odunyiswayo.

35:16.t: Uma ethanda enganishabalalisa nonke aphinde alethe indalo entsha.

35:17.t: Futhi lokho akukho nzima ku Allah.

35:18.t: Futhi akekho oyothwala umthwalo womunye; noma lona osindelwayo engacela ukuba bamthwalise, akekho oyowuthwala ngisho nabozalo uqobo. Impela wena uxwayisa labo abasaba iNkosi yabo bengayiboni baphinde baqikelele ukwenza iswala. Futhi lowo oziphatha kahle uzenzela yena uqobo. Futhi isiphetho siyoba ku Allah.

35:22.t: Futhi abaphilayo nabafiley abafani nhlobo. Impela u Allah wenza amthandayo ezwe, futhi wena awusoze wakwazi ukwenza abasebathuneni bakwazi ukuzwa.

35:24.t: Impela sikuthumele ngeqiniso ukuze ube umethuli wezindaba ezinhle nomxwayisi. Futhi akukho sizwe okungafikanga kuso umxwayisi.

35:25.t: Uma bekuphika; labo abangaphambi kwabo nabo baphika mhla iZithunywa zabo zifika kubo nezibonakaliso neziNcwadi, iziNcwadi ezicacisayo.

35:26.t: Emuva kwalokho ngabajezisa labo ababengakholwa; bheka nje ukuthi sabanjani isijeziso saMi na?

35:27.t: Awuboni ukuthi u Allah wehlise amanzi emvula phezulu, sakhiqiza ngawo izithelo ezinemibala ehlukahlukene. Nasezintabeni kunezindlela ezimhlophe nezibomvu – imibala ehlukahlukene – nezimnyama bhuqe okwamagwababa].

35:28.t: Kanjalo nakubantu nasezilwaneni nakwimfuyo, imibala ihlukahlukene. Impela labo abesaba uAllah kuzigqila zaKhe osolwazi. Impela u Allah unguSomandla Othethelelayo.

35:29.t: Impela labo abafunda iNcwadi ka Allah benze neswala ngokuqikelela futhi benikela kulokho esibabele kona ngasese nasesidlangalaleni, balangazelele uhwebo olungasoze lwabhubha.

35:30.t: Ukuze abanike umvuzo wabo ngokugcwele aphinde abengezele ngomusa waKhe. Impela Yena unguMthetheleli Onokubonga.

35:31.t: Futhi leNcwadi esiyembulele kuwe iyiqiniso ifakazela lokhu okuyandulelayo. Impela u Allah ngezigqila zaKhe Unolwazi Uyabona.

35:32.t: Emuva kwalokho sanika iNcwadi labo esibaqokile kuzigqila zeThu. Phakathi kwabo kunalowo oyisephula mthetho nalowo oqotho nalowo ophuthuma okuhle ngemvumo ka Allah. Lokho kuwumusa omkhulu.

35:33.t: Izivande zaphakade abazongena kuzo, abayohlotshiswa kuzo ngamabhengele egolide nobuhlalu obumhlophe. Izembatho zabo kuzo ziyobe ziwusilika.

35:34.t: Bayothi: “Udumo ngoluka Allah lona osuse ubinzima kithi; impela iNkosi yethu inguMthetheleli Onokubonga”.

35:35.t: Lona osihlalise endaweni yokuhlala ngomusa waKhe, asihlangabezani nobunzima kuyo futhi asifikelwa wukukhathala.

35:36.t: Labo abangakholwa bayothola umlilo waseJahanamu, angeke bashabalaliswe nokuthi bafe futhi angeke baxegiselwe isijeziso sawo [umlilo]. Siyobahlomulisa kanjalo bonke abangakholwa.

35:37.t: Futhi bayomemeza kuwo bathi: “Nkosi yethu, sikhiphe siyokwenza okulungileyo hhayi lokhu ebesikwenza”. Ingabe asizange yini siniphe isikhathi sempilo esanele ukuthi othatha isifundo athathe isifuno futhi kwafika kini umxwayisi. Ngakhoke zwanini isijeziso ngokuba akekho oyosiza abaphambukile.

35:38.t: Impela u Allah wazi okungabonwayo emazulwini nasemhlabeni; impela Yena ukwazi kahle okuqukethwe izifuba.

35:39.t: NguYena lona onenze naba izizukulwane ezilandelanayo emhlabeni. Ngakhoke lowo ongakholwa, ukungakholwa kwakhe kusala naye. Futhi abangakholwa, ukungakholwa kwabo kubandisela ulaka eNkosini yabo; futhi abangakholwa ukungakholwa kwabo kubandisela ukulahlekelwa.

35:40.t: Yithi: “Ake nibheke lezikhonzwa zenu enizikhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah; ngiboniseni ukuthi zidaleni kumbe zinesabelo emazulwini”. Kumbe sabanika incwadi okuyiyona ebahlaluselayo. Empeleni abaphambukile bathembisana ukuduka.

35:41.t: Impela u Allah ubambe amazulu nomhlaba ukuba kunganyakazi; uma kunganyakaza akekho ongakubamba ngaphandle kwaKhe. Impela Yena Unobubele Uyathethelela.

35:42.t: Futhi bafunga bagomela ngo Allah ukuthi kungafika kubo umxwayisi bayoholeleka ukudlula ezinye zizwe. Kepha kuthe uma esefika umxwayisi babaleka kakhulu.

35:43.t: Beziqhayisa emhlabeni futhi behlela okubi. Futhi itulu elibi lihaqa umnikazi walo [isikhuni sibuya nomkwezeli]. Ingabe balinde okwehlela abasendulo na? Awusoze wathola ilalela lenkambiso ka Allah futhi wathola indlela yokugwema inkambiso ka Allah.

35:44.t: Abakaze bahambe ezweni ukuze babone isiphetho salabo ababengaphambi kwabo ababenamandla ukudlula bona. Futhi akukho okungahlula u Allah emazulwini nasemhlabeni; impela Yena Uyazi Unamandla.

35:45.t: Uma u Allah engajezisa abantu ngemisebenzi yabo; akayikushiya sidalwa phezu kwawo [umhlaba]; kepha ubadondisela isikhathi esibekiwe. Uma sesifika isikhathi sabo; impela u Allah mayelana nezigqila zaKhe Uyabona.

36:6.t: Ukuze uxwayise abantu okhokho babo abangaxwayiswanga kangoba abanendaba.

36:7.t: Impela isijeziso siqinisekiwe kubaningi kubo, kungakho bengakholwa.

36:8.t: Impela Thina sibophe izintamo zabo ngamasongo afika ezilevini bavele babheka phezulu.

36:9.t: Futhi sifake isithiyo ngaphambi kwabo nangasemuva kwabo, sabamboza kangoba abasaboni.

36:10.t: Futhi kuyefana nje kubo, uyabaxwayisa noma awubaxwayisi angeke bakholwe.

36:11.t: Wena uxwayisa nje kuphela lowo olandela iSikhumbuzo [iKurani] futhi osaba Onomusa engamboni; ngakho-ke mhalalisele ngentethelelo nomvuzo omuhle.

36:12.t: Impela Thina sivusa abafileyo siphinde silobe lokho abakwenza nabakushiya emuva.

36:13.t: Benzele umzekelo wabantu bomuzi mhla kufika kuwo iZithunywa.

36:14.t: Mhla sithumela kubo ezimbili, baziphika. Saphinde sathumela esesithathu zathi: Impela thina sithunywe kini”.

36:15.t: Bathi: “Nina ningabantu nje abafana nathi futhi ayikho into eyembulelwe ngoNomusa, nina ninamanga nje”.

36:16.t: Zathi: “iNkosi yethu yazi kahle ukuthi impela thina sithunyelwe kini”.

36:17.t: Futhi umsebenzi wethu ukudlulisa umlayezo ocacile.

36:18.t: Bathi: “Impela thina sinibona nizosilethela amashwa; uma ningaphezi, sizonikhanda ngamatshe niphinde nithole kithi isijeziso esibuhlungu”.

36:19.t: Zathi: “Ukubikelwa kwenu kuyosala nani; ingabe kungenxa yokuthi niyelulekwa na? Impela ningabantu abangenamkhawulo.

36:20.t: Kwaqhamula indoda mphini le kude nomuzi igijima yathi: “Bantu bakithi, landelani iZithunywa”.

36:21.t: Landelani labo abanganiceli mvuzo futhi abasendleleni eqondile.

36:22.t: Ngingavinjwa yini ukuba ngikhonze lowo ongidalile futhi eniyobuyela kuYe na?

36:23.t: Ngingaziqokela kanjani ezinye izikhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe, kulapho uma Onomusa efuna ngehlelwe okubi, ushwele wazo awusoze wangisiza ngalutho futhi angeke bakhone nokungitakula.

36:25.t: Impela ngiyakholelwa eNkosini yenu; ngakho-ke ngilaleleni.

36:26.t: Kwathiwa [kuye]: “Ngena eJana”. Wathi: “Ngifisa engabe abantu bakithi bayazi…”

36:27.t: Ukuthi iNkosi yami ingethethelele kanjani futhi yangenza ngaba womunye wabahlonishwayo.

36:28.t: Asizange sithumele butho elivela phezulu emuva kwakhe [esebulelwe] futhi asilithumeli [ukubhubhisa].

36:29.t: Kwaba nje umsindo [ohlabayo] owodwa kuphela; bavele badindiliza [sebefile].

36:30.t: Yeka ukuzisola kwezigqila [kwelizayo! Njalo nje uma kufika kubo iSithunywa babesenza inhlekisa.

36:31.t: Ababoni yini ukuthi ziningi izizwe esizibhubhisile ngaphambilini kwabo nokuthi aziphindanga zabuya kubo.

36:32.t: Yileso naleso sizwe zonke ziyolethwa kiMi.

36:33.t: Futhi isibonakaliso sabo, umhlaba ofile esiwuvuselele sakhiqiza kuwo izinhlavu abazidlayo.

36:34.t: Senza kuwo kwaba nezivande zamasundu nemivini saphinde saqhekeza sagelezisa kuwo imithombo.

36:35.t: Ukuze badle ezithelweni zawo [amanzi aniselayo] ezingeziwanga izandla zabo; kungani-ke bengabongi na?

36:36.t: Ungcwele lona odale zonke izinhlobo ezikhiqizwa umhlaba nezabo uqobo [umfazi nendoda] nezalokho abangakwazi.

36:37.t: Futhi isibonakaliso sabo ubusuku, sisusa kubo imini ngalokho bazithola sebesebumnyameni.

36:38.t: Futhi ilanga lihamba [kumzila walo] lize lifike la eliphelela khona; lokho kuhlelwe nguSomandla Owaziyo.

36:39.t: Futhi nenyanga sayibekela izimo [ezahlukene] kuze lapho [iyafiphala] njengoswazi [lwesundu] oludala.

36:40.t: Ilanga ngeke liyifice inyanga futhi nobusuku ngeke bundlule imini; konke kubhukuda [kuhamba] emkhathini.

36:41.t: Futhi isibokaliso sabo ukuthi salayisha izizukulwane zabo emkhunjini ogcwele.

36:43.t: Uma sithanda besingabacwilisa bengasizwa muntu futhi bengatakulwa.

36:44.t: Ngaphandle komusa ovela kithi nokuthi baphile kuze kufike isikhathi [sokufa esibekiwe].

36:45.t: Uma betshelwa ukuthi: “Sabani lokhu okuphambi kwenu [elizayo] nokusemuva kwenu [impilo yasemhlabeni] ukuze nihawukelwe.

36:46.t: Futhi noma yisiphi isibonakaliso kuzibonakaliso zeNkosi yabo esifika kubo, bavele basishaye indiva.

36:47.t: Uma betshelwa ukuthi: “Nikelani ngalokho u Allah anabele kona”. Laba abangakholwa bathi kulaba abakholwayo: “Singabondla kanjani laba u Allah uma ethanda engabondla Yena ngokwaKhe, impela nina nidukile ngokusobala”.

36:48.t: Futhi bathi: “Kanti siyofika nini lesi sethembiso uma ngempela niqinisile na?”

36:49.t: Balindele nje kuphela umsindo owodwa oyobahlasela bengazelele bematasa.

36:50.t: Angeke bakhone ngisho ukulayezela futhi angeke bakhone nokubuyela emndenini yabo.

36:51.t: Kuyoshaywa uphondo; bese bephuma emathuneni baye eNkosini yabo.

36:52.t: Bayothi: “Kwaphela ngathi, ubani kodwa lona osivuse la ebesilele khona na?. Yikona lokhu Onomusa akuthembisile futhi neZithunywa beziqinisile”.

36:53.t: Kwaba nje umsindo owodwa, bonke balethwa phambi kweThu.

36:54.t: Namhlanje akukho muntu oyokwenziwa okungebulungiswa futhi niyothola umvuzo walokho ebenikwenza.

36:56.t: Bona nabalingani babo phansi kwemithunzi beqhiyeme emibhedeni.

36:60.t: Nina bantwana baka Adamu, asizange yini sense isibopho nani ukuthi ningakhonzi uShayitani ngokuba impela uyisitha senu esisobala.

36:61.t: Nokuthi nikhonze Mina kuphela; lena iyona ndlela eqondile.

36:62.t: Impela udukise uquqaba olunigi kini; aninakuqonda na?

36:64.t: Ngenani kuyo namhlanje ngenxa yokungakholwa kwenu.

36:65.t: Namhlanje sizovala imilomo yenu, bese sikhulunyiswa izandla zenu futhi nemilenze yenu iyofakaza ngalokho ababekwenza.

36:66.t: Uma sithanda singavala amehlo abo, bese bephuthuma indlela; kepha bayoyibona kanjani na?

36:67.t: Futhi uma sithanda singabaguqula isimo sabo semvelo khona ezindaweni zabo, bahluleke ukunyakaza noma ukubuyela [esimeni].

36:68.t: Futhi lowo eminika impilo ende, simenza abe buthaka emzimbeni; kungani ningaqondi na?

36:69.t: Futhi asimfundisanga ubumbongi futhi akakudingi. Kuyisikhumbuzo nje neKurani ecacisayo.

36:70.t: Ukuze axwayise lowo ophilayo nokuthi isinqumo [sesijeziso] sibafanele labo abangakholwa.

36:71.t: Ababoni yini ukuthi sibadalele kulokho esikwenze ngeZandla zeThu imfuyo baba ngabanikazi bayo.

36:72.t: Sabathambisela yona; kangoba ezinye bayazigibela kuthi ezinye bayazidla.

36:73.t: Futhi kuzo banezinsiza nokuphuzwayo; kungani bengabongi na?

36:74.t: Baziqokele izikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah ukuze basizakale.

36:75.t: Angeke zikwazi ukubasiza kunalokho bona bayibutho elihla liya kuzo [izikhonzwa].

36:76.t: Ngakho-ke makungakukhathazi abakushoyo. Impela Thina siyakwazi lokho abakufihlayo nalokho abakuveza obala.

36:77.t: Akaboni yini umuntu ukuthi simdale ngesidoda; kepha sekawumphikisi oqavile.

36:78.t: Usenzela thina imizekelo akhohlwe ukuthi udalwe kanjani; wathi: “Ubani ongavusa amathambo lapho esebunile na?”.

36:79.t: Yithi: “Ayovuswa ngulowo owadala kwasekuqaleni, futhi wazi ngayo yonke indalo”.

36:80.t: Lona onidalele umlilo ngesihlahla esiluhlaza [cwe]; nakhu nibasa ngaso.

36:81.t: Ingabe lona odale amazulu nomhlaba akakwazi yini ukudala okufana nawo na? Ukwazi impela; phela unguMdali Owaziyo.

36:82.t: Uma efuna ukwenza into ethile, uvele athi: “Yenzeka”, bese iyenzeka.

36:83.t: Ungcwele lona umbuso wezinto zonke useZandleni zaKhe futhi niyobuyela kuYe.

37:5.t: iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwawo; futhi uyiNkosi yezimpumalanga.

37:6.t: Impela zihlobise isibhakabhaka sasemhlabeni ngobukhazikhazi bezinkanyezi.

37:7.t: Futhi savikela kubo bonke oShayitani abangamahlongandlebe.

37:8.t: Abakwazi ukulalela isigungu esiphezulu [sezingelosi] futhi bayikijelwa kuzo zonke izinhlangothi.

37:9.t: Ukuze baqheliswe futhi bathola isijeziso esinganqamuki.

37:10.t: Ngaphandle kalowo okhona ukucosha okuncane bese elandelwa ilangabi elivuthayo.

37:11.t: Awubabuze ukuthi ingabe yibona abadalwe baqina noma yilokho esikudalile na?; impela sibadale ngobumba olunamathelayo.

37:16.t: Ingabe uma sesifile saba inhlabathi namathambo siphinde sivuswe na?

37:19.t: Kuyoba ukuzamazama okukodwa, bese bonke beqalaza.

37:22.t: Buthanisani labo abaphambukile nabafana nabo nalokho ababekukhonza…

37:23.t: Ngaphandle kuka Allah, bese nibaholela endleleni eya emlilweni.

37:28.t: Bathi: “Impela nina benihlala niza kithi nihlasela iqiniso”.

37:30.t: Futhi besingenawo amandla ngaphezu kwenu okuniphoqa; empeleni nina ngokwenu beningabantu abayizephula mthetho.

37:31.t: Isinqumo seNkosi yethu sasifanela; ngakhoke siyozwa [isijeziso].

37:33.t: Impela ngalolo suku bonke bayoba ndawonye esijezisweni.

37:34.t: Impela Thina sizenza njalo izephula mthetho.

37:35.t: Kwakuthi uma betshelwa ukuthi, akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kuka Allah, bavele baziqhayise.

37:36.t: Futhi bathi: “Singayeka izikhonzwa zethu ngenxa yalembongi ewuhlanya”.

37:37.t: Empelani ufike neqiniso futhi wafakazela ezinye iZithunywa.

37:39.t: Futhi niyothola umvuzo walokho ebenikwenza kuphela.

37:48.t: Futhi bayoba namatshitshi akhophozayo anamehlo amahle.

37:53.t: Ukuthi, kuyothi sesifile saba inhlabathi namathambo siphinda sivuswe?

37:57.t: Ukube bekungesiwo umusa weNkosi yami ngabe name ngiphakathi [emlilweni].

37:59.t: Ngaphandle kokufa kwethu kokuqala futhi asijeziswanga na?

37:62.t: Ingabe lokho iyona ndawo yokuhlala engcono noma isihlahla iZakumi [sameva].

37:63.t: Impela sisenze saba isivivinyo kulabo abaphambukile.

37:66.t: Impela bayodla kuso bagcwalise ngaso izisu zabo.

37:67.t: Emuva kwakho bayophuza isiphuzo esixutshiwe esibilayo.

37:69.t: Impela bona bafumanisa okhokho babo bedukile.

37:71.t: Futhi baningi abasendulo abaduka ngaphambi kwabo.

37:73.t: Bheka nje ukuthi sabanjani isiphetho sabaxwayiswa.

37:75.t: Futhi uNuhu wakhuleka kithi; saba abaphenduli abahle kakhulu.

37:76.t: Samhlenga yena nomndeni wakhe ebunzimeni obukhulu.

37:77.t: Senza uzalo lwakhe kwaba yilona olusalayo.

37:78.t: Futhi samenzela isasasa kwabalandela emuva kwakhe.

37:83.t: Futhi impela u Ibhirahimu omunye abalandela ezinyathelweni zakhe.

37:84.t: Mhla befika eNkosini yakhe ngenhliziyo emsulwa.

37:85.t: Mhla ethi kuyise nabantu bakubo: “Yini lokhu enikukhonzayo”.

37:86.t: Ingabe nikhonza izikhonzwa zamanga ngaphandle kuka Allah na.

37:91.t: Waqonda kuzikhonzwa zabo, wafike wathi: “Anidli na?”.

37:96.t: Kube kungu Allah onidalille nina nenikwenzayo.

37:98.t: Babefuna ukumenza okubi kepha senza bona badixileleka phansi.

37:99.t: Wathi: “Impela ngiyahamba ngiya eNkosini yami iyongihola”.

37:102.t: Kuthe lapho esekhulile esekwazi ukuhamba naye, wathi: Ndodana, ngibone nginquma ephusheni; ngakho-ke ubona kanjani na? Wathi: “Baba wami, yenza lokho oyalelwe kona, uzongifumanisa ngingobekezelayo uma u Allah ethanda”.

37:103.t: Kuthe lapho sebezinikele futhi esembhekise phansi.

37:105.t: Usulifezile iphupho. Impela sibahlomulisa kanjalo abenzi bokuhle.

37:108.t: Futhi samenzela isasasa kwabalandela emuva kwakhe.

37:111.t: Impela yena ungomunye wezigqila zeThu ezikholwayo.

37:112.t: Futhi samhalalisela ngo Isihaki ozoba isithunywa esiqotho.

37:113.t: Sambusisa yena no Isihaki; futhi kuzalo labo kunalowo owenza okuhle futhi kunalowo ophambukile ngokusobala.

37:115.t: Futhi sabahlenga nesizwe sabo ebunzimeni obukhlu.

37:119.t: Futhi sabenzela isasasa kwabalandela emuva kwabo.

37:122.t: Impela bona bangabanye bezigqila zeThu ezikholwayo.

37:123.t: Futhi impela no Iliyasi wagengomunye weZithunywa.

37:124.t: Mhla ethi kubantu bakubo: “Kungani ningathobeli u Allah na?”

37:125.t: Nikhonza isithixo u Ba-ali niyeka onguMdali omuhle kakhulu.

37:126.t: U Allah iNkosi yenu neNkosi yokhokho benu basendulo.

37:129.t: Futhi samenzela isasasa kwabalandela emuva kwakhe.

37:132.t: Impela yena ungomunye wezigqila zeThu ezikholwayo.

37:134.t: Mhla simhlenga yena nomndeni wakhe wonke.

37:137.t: Futhi impela nina nindlula kubo ekuseni.

37:144.t: Ngabe wahla esiswini sawo kuze kufike uSuku lokuvuswa.

37:149.t: Babuze ukuthi ingabe iNkosi yakho yona inamadodakazi bona banamadodana na?

37:150.t: Kumbe sadala izingelosi zaba izifazane bona bekhona.

37:151.t: Bheka! Impela bathi ngamanga abo aluhlaza…

37:152.t: U Allah uzele futhi impela banamanga.

37:157.t: Lethani-ke incwadi yenu uma ngempela niqinisile.

37:158.t: Futhi benza kwaba nolibo phakathi kuka Allah namajini; kepha amajini azi kahle ukuthi ayosiwa [esijezisweni].

37:164.t: [Izingelosi zathi]: “Yilowo nalowo kithi unendawo yakhe eyaziwayo”.

37:171.t: Futhi laphuma iZwi leThu mayelana nezigqila zeThu eziyiZithunywa.

37:177.t: Uma sesifika emagcekeni; kwaze kakubi ukusa kwalabo abaxwayisiwe.

37:180.t: Ingcwele iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yamandla kulokho abakushoyo.

37:182.t: Futhi udumo ngoluka Allah, iNkosi yendalo yonke.

38:2.t: Empeleni laba abangakholwa bayaziqhayisa futhi bayaphikisa.

38:3.t: Ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo; zamemeza, kepha kwakungasiso isikhathi sokubaleka.

38:4.t: Futhi bamangazwe ukuthi kufike kubo umexwayisi ongomunye wabo. Bathi abangakholwa: “Lona ngumlumbi onamanga”.

38:5.t: Uzenza kanjani izikhonzwa kube isikhonzwa esisodwa na?; impela lokhu yinto eyisimanga.

38:6.t: Abayizikhulu kobo baphuma [bathi ebantwini]: “Qhubekani futhi nibambelele kuzikhonzwa zenu; impela lokhu yikona okufunekayo”.

38:7.t: Asikaze sizwe ngalokhu nasenkolweni yokugcina imbala; impela lokhu amanga.

38:8.t: Kwembulela kuye isikhumbuzo sikhona thina?. Empeleni bengabaza isikhumbuzo saMi; empeleni abakasizwa isijeziso saMi.

38:9.t: Kumbe banemicebo yomusa weNkosi yakho enguSomandla Ophanayo.

38:10.t: Kumbe umbuso wamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwawo ungowabo; ngakho-ke mabanyuke ngezindlela.

38:12.t: Abantu bakaNuhu nesizwe sakwa Adi noFirawuni wezikhonkwane, baphika ngaphambilini kwabo.

38:13.t: Nesizwe sakwaTamudi nabantu bakaLuti nabantu baseMadiyana. Yiwona-ke lawo amaqembu.

38:14.t: Bonke baphika iZithunywa; base befanelwa isijeziso.

38:15.t: Laba abalinde lutho ngaphandle komsindo owodwa ongabuyeli emuva.

38:16.t: Futhi bathi: “Nkosi yethu shisha usinike imiqulu yethu lungakafiki usuku lokwahlulela”.

38:17.t: Kubekezelele lokho abakushoyo, ukukhumbule isigqila seThu uDawudi owayenamandla; impela wayezikela.

38:18.t: Impela samjubela izintaba zidumisa naye ebusuku nasekuseni.

38:20.t: Samqinisela ubukhosi bakhe samupha nobuhlakani nobuciko benkulumo.

38:21.t: Ingabe usuzwile ngendaba yabaphikisanyo mhla begibela phezu kwegumbi.

38:22.t: Mhla bengena kuDawudi, wabesaba. Bathi: “Ungesabi, singabaphikisanayo, abanye bethu bahlukumeze abanye, ngakho-ke hlulela phakathi ngeqiniso futhi ungenzi okungebulungiswa futhi usiholele endleleni eqondile”.

38:23.t: Impela umnewethu lona unezimbuzi ezingamashumi ayisishagalolunye nesishagalolunye, mina nginembuzi eyodwa vo, ube esethi: “Nginike yona ngiyinakekele, wangihlula ngenkulomo”.

38:24.t: Wathi: “Impela akenzanga ubulungiswa kuwe ngokucela ukuhlanganisa imbuzi yakho nezimbuzi zakhe; futhi iningi labahlanganisayo bayahlukumezana ngaphandle kwalabo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo futhi ave beyidlanzana. uDawudi wacabanga ukuthi besimvivinya, wabe esecela intethelelo eNkosini yakhe waya phansi wakhothama wazilahla.

38:25.t: Samthethelela lokho; futhi impela unendawo eseduze kithi nendawo enhle ayobuyela kuyo.

38:26.t: Wena Dawudi, sikwenze umbusi ezweni, ngakho-ke yehlulela phakathi kwabantu ngeqiniso futhi ungalandeli izinkanuko funa zikuphambukise endleleni ka Allah. Impela laba abaphambuka endleleni ka Allah bayothola isijeziso esinzima ngenxa yokulibala kwabo uSuku lokwahlulela.

38:27.t: Futhi amazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi asikudalelanga ize. Lokho umdlinzo walabo abangakholwa; bayobhubha labo angakholwa emlilweni.

38:28.t: Kumbe kumele sense labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo bafane nalabo abenza ukonakala ezweni noma sense abathobela u Allah bafane nezephula mthetho na?

38:29.t: LeNcwadi esiyembulele kuwe ebusisekile, ukuze bahlaziye imibiko yayo futhi labo abakhaliphile bathathe isifundo.

38:30.t: Futhi sapha uDawudi uSulayimani; wabe eyisigqila esihle; impela wayezinikela.

38:31.t: Mhla ekhonjiswa ntambama izinjomane ezime kahle zomjaho.

38:32.t: Wathi: “Impela sengithande kakhulu izinto ezinhle kunokukhumbula iNkosi yami, laze lasithela [ilanga]”.

38:33.t: Wabuyiseni la; waqala wawagenca imilenze nezintamo.

38:34.t: Futhi samvivinya uSulayimani sajikijela isidumbu phezu kwesihlalo sakhe; emuva kwalokho wazithoba.

38:35.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami ngiphe ubukhosi obungeke butholwe omunye emuva kwami; impela Wena ungoPhayo”.

38:36.t: Samjubela umoya owahamba ngomyalelo wakhe ngesizotha noma kuphi lapho efuna ukuya khona.

38:39.t: Lezi izipho zeThu; iphana omthandayo noma ungaphi omthandayo, ngaphandle kokuba necala.

38:40.t: Futhi impela unendawo eseduze kithi nendawo enhle ayobuyela kuyo.

38:41.t: Futhi khumbula isigqila seThu u Ayubu mhla ekhuleka eNkosini yakhe [ethi]: “Impela uShayitani ungihlasele ngokukhathala nobunzima”.

38:42.t: Shaya phansi ngomlenze wakho; lawa ngamanzi okugeza abandayo nokuphuza.

38:43.t: Samupha umndeni wakhe usuphindwe kabili, kuwumusa ovela kithi nesikhumbuzo kulabo abakhaliphile.

38:44.t: Futhi thatha ngesandla sakho inyanda yezinswazi ukuze ungaphuli isibophezelo sakho. Impela samfumanisa enokubekezela; uyigqila esihle, impela uyazithoba.

38:45.t: Futhi khumbula izigqila zeThu u Ibhirahimu no Isihaki no Yakubu ababenamandla nolwazi olunzulu.

38:46.t: Impela sabaqoka ngesimilo sekhethelo: ukukhumbula elizayo.

38:48.t: Futhi khumbula u Isima-ili no Aliyasa no Dulikifili; bonke bangabekhethelo.

38:49.t: Lesi isikhumbuzo; futhi impela labo abathobela u Allah bayothola indawo enhle abayobuyela kuyo.

38:51.t: Bayohlala baqhiyame kuzo, bafune kuzo izithelo eziningi neziphuzo.

38:53.t: Yikho-ke lokhu enithenjiswe kona ngoSuku lokwahlulela.

38:54.t: Impela lesi isondlo seThu asisoze saphela.

38:55.t: Lokhu [kunjalo]. Kepha amahlongandlebe ayothola indawo embi ayobuyela kuyo.

38:59.t: [Bayothi]: “Nalu uquqaba eniyongena nalo; alwamukelekile, impela luyongena emlilweni”.

38:60.t: Bayothi: “Empeleni yinina eningamukelekile; yinina enisilethele sona [isijeziso], yaze yayimbi indawo”.

38:61.t: Bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, lowo osilethele lokhu, mandisele ngesijeziso esiphindaphindiwe emlilweni”.

38:62.t: Futhi bayothi: “Kungani singawaboni amadoda esiwala kanye nabantu ababi na?”

38:63.t: Ingabe sibenze inhlekisa kumbe amehlo ethu angababoni.

38:64.t: Impela lokho kuphikisana kwabantu abasemlilweni kuyiqiniso.

38:65.t: Yithi: “Mina ngingumexwayisi nje kuphela; futhi akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kuka Allah Oyedwa Ongumlawuli”.

38:66.t: iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwawo enguSomandla enguMthetheleli.

38:69.t: Bengingenalo ulwazi mayelana nezingelosi mhla ziphikisana.

38:70.t: Kuphela kwembulelwa kimi ukuthi ngingumexwayisi ocacisayo.

38:71.t: Landisa ngamhla iNkosi yakho yithi ezingelosini: “Impela ngizodala umuntu ngobumba”.

38:72.t: Uma sengimbumbile ngaphefumulela kuye ngomphefumulo wami; mkhothameleni niwe phansi ngobuso.

38:73.t: Zonke izingelosi ngothi lwazo sawa phansi ngobuso zakhothama.

38:74.t: Ngaphandle kuka Ibilisi, waziqhayisa waba ngomunye wabangakholwa.

38:75.t: Wathi: “We Ibilisi, uvinjwe yini ukuwa phansi ngobuso ukhothamele lokhu engikudale ngeZandla zaMi zombili na?”

38:76.t: Wathi: “Mina ngingcono kunaye; mina ungidale ngomlilo yena wamdala ngobumba”.

38:78.t: Futhi impela wehlelwe isiqalekiso saMi kuyoze kube uSuku lokwahlulela.

38:79.t: Wathi: “Ngiphe impilo ende kuze kube uSuku lokuVuswa”.

38:80.t: Wathi: “Nakanjani ungomunye walaba abanikwe impilo ende”.

38:82.t: Wathi: “Ngifunga ngobukhulu bakho, impela ngizodukisa bonke”.

38:85.t: Ngizogcwalisa iJahanamu ngawe nangalabo kubo abazokulandela ngothi lwabo.

38:86.t: Yithi: “Anginiceli ngakho umvuzo futhi mina azihluphi ngokuqamba amanga”.

38:88.t: Futhi nizolwazi udaba lwayo emuva kwesikhashana.

39:1.t: Ukwembulelwa kweNcwadi okuvela ku Allah uSomandla Okhaliphile.

39:2.t: Impela Thina sembulele kuwe iNcwadi ngeqiniso; ngakhoke, khonza u Allah ngenkolo emsulwa.

39:3.t: Bheka, inkolo emsulwa ngeka Allah. Futhi laba abaqoke izikhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe [bathi]: “Sizikhonzela ukuba zisisondeze eduze ku Allah”; u Allah uyekwehlulela phakathi kwabo ngalokho abaphikisana ngakho. Impela u Allah akamholi lowo onamanga ongakholwa.

39:4.t: Ukube u Allah ubefuna ukuba nengane bekazokhe noma yini akuthandayo kulokho akudalile; ungcwele, ungu Allah Oyedwa Ongumlawuli.

39:5.t: Wadala amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso; umboza imini ngobusuku aphinde amboze ubusuku ngemini, futhi ujube ilanga nenyanga konke kuyohamba kuze kufike isikhathi esibekiwe. Bheka, unguSomandla Othethelelayo.

39:6.t: Wanidala ngomuntu oyedwa waphinde wadala ngaye umlingani wakhe. Futhi unidalele imfuyo eyizinhlobo eziyishagalombili. Unidala eziswini zonyoko isigaba ngesigaba ebumnyameni obuthathu; loyo ngu Allah iNkosi yenu ubukhosi obungobayo; akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe; pho nidukiswa yini na?

39:7.t: Uma ningakholwa, u Allah Uzimele akanidingi; kepha akazithandeli izigqila zaKhe ukungakholwa; futhi uma nibonga yikona anithandela kona. Futhi akukho muntu oyothwala umthwalo womunye. Niyophinda nibuyele eNkosini yenu ukuze inazise ngalokho ebenikwenza; impela Yona ikwazi kahle okuqukethwe izinhliziyo.

39:8.t: Futhi uma umuntu ehlelwa ubunzima, ukukhuleka eNkosini yakhe ngokuzinikela kuYo, kepha uma isimuphe umusa ovela kuYo, uyakukhohlwa lokho ebekukhulekela bese eqokela u Allah izimbangi bese uyaduka endleleni yaKhe. Yithi: “Thokoza ngokungakholwa kwakho okwesikhashana, impela ungomunye wabayongena emlilweni”.

39:9.t: Kumbe [ongcono] yilowo ozithobayo ebusuku ekhotheme ewa ngobuso futhi emile [ethandaza]; usaba elizayo futhi ulangazelele umusa weNkosi yakhe. Ingabe bayafana yini labo abanolwazi nalabo abangenalwazi na? Impela labo abakhaliphile yibona abathatha isifundo.

39:10.t: Yithi: “Zigqila zami ezikholwayo, thobelani iNkosi yenu. Labo abenza okuhle lapha emhlabeni bayothola umvuzo omuhle; futhi umhlaba ka Allah ubanzi. Impela ababekezelayo bayonikwa umvuzo wabo ngokungemkhawulo”.

39:11.t: Yithi: “Ngiyalelwe ukuba ngikhonze u Allah yena kuphela ngobumsulwa”.

39:12.t: Futhi ngiyalelwe ukuba ngibe owokuqala ukuba yiMusilimu.

39:13.t: Yithi: “Ngiyesaba isijeziso sosuku olunzima uma ngingalaleli iNkosi yami”.

39:15.t: Ngakho-ke khonzani enikuthandayo ngaphandle kwaKhe. Yithi: “Impela abalahlekelwa yilabo abazilahlekisele bona nemindeni yabo ngoSuku lokwahlulela; bheka ngoba lokho ukulahlekelwa uqobo”.

39:16.t: Bayothola amathunzi omlilo ngaphezu kwabo nangaphansi kwabo kuyoba namathunzi. Lokho u Allah usabisa ngakho izigqila zaKhe; zigqila zaMi thobelani Mina.

39:17.t: Futhi labo abagwema ukukhonza izikhonzwa zamanga baphinde banikele ku Allah, bayothola izindaba ezinhle; ngakho-ke yethula izindaba ezinhle kuzigqila zaMi.

39:18.t: Lezi ezilalelisisa umyalelo bese bewulandela ngendlela efanele; yibo-ke labo u Allah abaholile futhi yibona kanye abakhaliphile.

39:19.t: Lowo ofanelwe isinqumo sesijeziso; ingabe wena uyakhona yini ukutakula lowo osesemlilweni na?.

39:20.t: Kodwa laba abathobela iNkosi yabo; bayothola amagumbi okunamanye amagumbi akhiwe phezu kwawo, kugeleza imifula ngaphansi kwawo; isithembiso sika Allah, kanti-ke u Allah akasephuli isithembiso.

39:21.t: Awuboni ukuthi u Allah wehlise amanzi phezulu, wawenza imithombo egelezayo emhlabeni, wase ekhiqiza ngawo izitshalo ezinemibala ehlukene; emuva kwalokho ziyoma uzibone sezibunile bese ezenza imvithi. Impela kulokho kunesikhumbuzo kulabo abakhaliphile.

39:22.t: Ingabe lowo u Allah avulela i-Isilamu enhlizweni yakhe waba sekukhanyeni okuvela eNkosini yakhe [uyefana yini nongenjalo] na?Bayobhubha labo abanezinhliziyo eziqinile ekukhumbuleni u Allah; labo basekudukeni uqobo.

39:23.t: U Allah wembulele inkulumo ezindlula zonke, iNcwadi engaziphikisi eziphindaphindayo; izikhumba zalabo abesaba iNkosi yabo ziba nohlevane ngenxa yayo, bese ziphinda zithamba izikhumba zabo kepha izinhliziyo zabo zisagxile ekukhumbuleni u Allah. Lokho ukuhola kuka Allah ahola ngakho amthandayo; futhi lowo u Allah amdukisayo akekho oyomhola.

39:24.t: Ingabe lowo oyovika ububi besijeziso sosuku lokwahlulela ngobuso bakhe [uyefana yini noyophepha kuso na?]; futhi kuyothiwa kulabo abaphambukile: “Zwanini lokho ebenikwenza”.

39:25.t: Labo ababandulelayo baphika [imibiko], isijeziso safika kubo ngalapho ababangenakanga ngakhona.

39:26.t: U Allah wabazwisa ukuhlazeka empilweni yasemhlabeni; futhi isijeziso sakwelizayo sinzima kakhulu, ukube nje bebazi.

39:27.t: Futhi abantu sibenzele yonke imizekelo kuleKurani ukuze bathathe isifundo.

39:28.t: [Esiyenze yaba] iKurani yesi Arabhu engegwembile [engaziphikisi] ukuze bathobele u Allah.

39:29.t: U Allah wenza umzekelo wendoda [eyigqila] ephethwe abalingani abathezisanayo nendoda [eyisigqila] ephethwe umuntu oyedwa; ingabe umzekelo wabo uyefana na?; udumo ngoluka Allah; empeleni iningi labo alazi.

39:30.t: Impela wena uzofa futhi nabo bazofa.

39:31.t: Futhi impela niyophikisa eNkosini yenu ngoSuku lokwahlulela.

39:32.t: Ngubani ophambuke ukundlula lowo oqambela u Allah amanga nophika iqiniso lapho lifika kuye na?; kanti iJahanamu akusiyo yini indawo yalabo abangakholwa na?

39:33.t: Futhi lowo oza neqiniso aphinde alifakazele; labo bangabathobela u Allah.

39:34.t: Bayothola abakufunayo eNkosini yabo; lowo umvuzo wabenza okuhle.

39:35.t: Ukuze u Allah abasulele lokho okubi abakwenzile bese ebanika umvuzo wabo ngokuhle okundlula lokho ababekwenza.

39:36.t: Ingabe u Allah akanele yini kusigqila saKhe na? Futhi bayakuthusa ngalokho okungaphandle kwaKhe; futhi lowo u Allah amdukisile akekho oyomhola.

39:37.t: Futhi lowo u Allah amholile akekho oyomdukisa; ingabe u Allah akasiye yini uSomandla oziphindiselelayo.

39:38.t: Futhi uma ungababuza ukuthi ngubani owadala amazulu nomhlaba, bayothi: “Ngu Allah”. Yithi: “Ake ningitshele ngalokhu enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah, uma efuna ukungipha umusa waKhe, ingabe ziyokwazi yini ukuqanda umusa waKhe na?. Yithi: “U Allah ungenele, abathembelayo bathembela kuYe”.

39:39.t: Yithi: “Bantu bakithi, yenzani enikwenzayo, name ngiyenza; kepha nizokwazi kungekudala”.

39:40.t: Ukuthi ubani oyokwehlelwa isijeziso esihlazanayo futhi ehlelwe isijeziso esingapheli.

39:41.t: Impela sembulele kuwe iNcwadi ngeqiniso ebhekiswe kubantu; lowo ozoholeleka uzisiza yena, kanti nalowo odukayo belu uzilaya yena uqobo; futhi wena awusiye umnakekeli wabo.

39:42.t: U Allah uthatha imiphefumulo uma sekufike isikhathi sayo sokufa naleyo engafanga ebuthongweni bayo; ube esewugodla lowo asewunqumele ukuba ufe kuthi lona omunye [ongezukufa] awukhulule kuze kufike isikhathi esibekiwe. Impela kulokho kuzebonakaliso kubantu abahlaziyayo.

39:43.t: Kumbe baqoke abazobakhulumela ngaphandle kuka Allah; yithi: “Yize zingenalutho futhi zingenangqondo na?”

39:44.t: Yithi: “Ukushweleza ngokuka Allah konke, futhi konke okusemazulwini nomahlaba kungokwakhe. Futhi niyobuyela kuYe”.

39:45.t: Uma u Allah ebalulwa Yedwa, izinhliziyo zalaba abangakholelwa kwelizayo ziyexwaya; kepha uma kubalulwa labo abangaphandle kwaKhe, ubona ngabo sebechichima.

39:46.t: Yithi: “Allah, Mdali wamazulu nomhlaba, Sazi sokungabonwayo nokubonwayo, nguWena ohlulela phakathi kwezigqila zakho kulokho abaphikisana ngakho”.

39:47.t: Uma laba abaphambukile bekungokwabo konke lokhu okusemhlabeni nokunye okufana nakho, bebezozihlawulela ngakho [konke] ebubini besijeziso soSuku lokwahlulela; futhi kuyobavelela obala ku Allah lokho abangakucabangi.

39:48.t: Kuyoba sobala kubo ububi balokho abakwenzile futhi kuyobahaqa lokho ababehlekisa ngakho.

39:49.t: Uma umuntu ehlelwa ubunzima, ukhulekela kithi; kepha sesimuphe umusa ovela kiithi, uvele athi: “Ngikuphiwe ngenxa yolwazi”. Empeleni kuyisivivinyo kodwa iningi labo alazi.

39:50.t: Impela nalabo abangaphambilini kwabo bakusho; kepha lokho ababekwenza akubasizanga ngalutho.

39:51.t: Behlelwa ububi balokho abakuzuzile; futhi nalabo abaphambukile kulaba nabo bayokwehlelwa ububi balokho abakuzuzile futhi ngeke baphunyule.

39:52.t: Ingabe abazi yini ukuthi u Allah upha ngenala aphinde aswinye isondlo kulowo athandayo; impela kulokho kunezibokaliso kubantu abakholwayo.

39:53.t: Yithi: “Zigqila zaMi eziphambukile, ningalahli ithemba ngomusa ka Allah; impela u Allah uthethelela zonke izimpambuko; impela Yena unguMthetheleli Onesihawu.

39:54.t: Futhi zilahleni eNkosini yenu futhi nizinikele kuYo singakafiki kini isijeziso bese ningasizwa.

39:55.t: Futhi nilandele okuhle lokhu okwembulelwe kini kuvela eNkosini yenu singakafiki kini isijeziso ningazelele futhi ninganakile.

39:56.t: Ukuze umuntu angathi: “Ngiyazisola ngokudembesela kwami ngasohlangothini luka Allah futhi bengenza inhlekisa”.

39:57.t: Noma athi: “Ukube u Allah wangihola ngabe ngingomunye wabamthobelayo”.

39:58.t: Noma athi lapho esebona isijeziso: “Uma ngingathola ithuba lokubuyela emuva, ukuze ngibe omunye wabenza okuhle”.

39:59.t: Imbala; imibiko yeThu yafika kuwe kepha wayiphika waziqhayisa futhi waba ongakholwa.

39:60.t: Futhi ngoSuku lokwahlulela uyobona ubuso balabo abaqambele u Allah amanga bumnyama bhuqe; kanti iJahanamu akusiyo yini indawo yalaba abagqajayo na?

39:61.t: Futhi u Allah uyobahlenga laba abamthobelayo ngokuphumelela kwabo; angeke sibathole isijeziso futhi ngeke bakhathazeke.

39:62.t: U Allah unguMdali wezinto zonke futhi nguYena onakekela yonke into.

39:63.t: Unezihluthulelo zasemazulwini nasemhlabeni. Futhi labo abangakholwa yimibiko ka Allah, yibona kanye abalahlekelwe.

39:64.t: Yithi: “Nina ziwula ningiyalela ukuba ngikhonze okunye ngaphandle kuka Allah na?”

39:65.t: Futhi kwembulela kuwe nakulabo abakwandulelayo ukuthi: “Uma nje ungabhangqa; nakanjani zonke izenzo zakho [ezinhle] ziyoshabalala futhi uyoba ngolahlekelwe”.

39:66.t: Empeleni ngu Allah okumele umkhonze uphinde ube ngobongayo.

39:67.t: Futhi abamhloniphanga u Allah ngendlela obekumele ahlonishwe ngayo; futhi umhlaba wonke uyobe ewuxhakathisile ngoSuku lokwahlulela, amazulu ayobe esongwe eSandleni saKhe sokunene. Ungcwele futhi Uphakeme kunalokho abakubhangqayo.

39:68.t: Futhi kuyoshaywa uphondo, bese kuquleka bonke abasemazulwini nabasemhlabeni, ngaphandle kwabathandwa ngu Allah; bese luphindwa lushaywa, bese bonke bayavuka bame baqalaze.

39:69.t: Futhi umhlaba uyokhanya ngenkazimulo yeNkosi yawo; kuyobe sekubekwa incwadi [yezenzo] bese kulethwa iZithunywa nofakazi, kwahlulelwe phakathi kwabo ngeqiniso futhi akukho okungebulungiswa okuyokwenziwa kubo.

39:70.t: Futhi wonke umuntu uyothola umvuzo ogcwele wezenzo zakhe; futhi Yena ukwazi kahle abakwenzayo.

39:71.t: Bayoqhutshelwa eJahanamu labo abangakholwa ngamaqembu ngamaqembu; kuyothi mabefika kuyo, iminyago yayo ivuleke. Abaqhaphi bayo bayothi: “Ingabe azifikanga yini iZithunywa zakini zinifundela imibiko yeNkosi yenu futhi zinixwayisa ngomhlangano walolu suku lwenu na?” Bayothi: “Bafika, kodwa isinqumo sesijeziso sifanele abangakholwa”.

39:72.t: Kuyothiwa: “Ngenani eminyangweni yaseJahanamu nihlale kuyo unaphakade; yaze yayimbi indawo yabazigqajayo”.

39:73.t: Futhi bayoqhutshelwa eJana labo abathobela u Allah ngamaqembu ngamaqembu; kuyothi mabefika kuyo, iminyango yayo iyobe ivulekile. Abaqhaphi bayo bayothi: “Ukuthula makube kini, nimsulwa ngakho-ke ngenani kuyo nihlale unaphakade”.

39:74.t: Futhi bayothi: “Udumo ngoluka Allah, lona osifezele isithembiso saKhe wasinika iJana sihlala noma yikuphi esithanda khona eJana; waze wamuhle umvuzo wabasebenzayo.

39:75.t: Futhi uyobona izingelosi zizungeze iSihlalo zibabaza udumo lweNkosi yazo; futhi kuyokwahlulelwa phakathi kwabo ngeqiniso bese kuthiwa: “Udumo ngoluka Allah iNkosi yendalo yonke”.

40:2.t: Ukwembulelwa kweNcwadi okuvela ku Allah uSomandla Owaziyo.

40:3.t: Othethelela impambuko nowamukela ukuzisola nojezisana kanzima nowenzelana umusa; akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe; isiphetho sikuYe.

40:4.t: Laba abangakholwa yibona kuphela abaphikisana nemibiko ka Allah, ngakho-ke ungayengwa ukwehla nokwenyuka kwabo [bephephile] emazweni.

40:5.t: Ngaphambi kwabo abantu bakaNuhu baphika ngokunjalo amaqembu eza emuva kwabo. Isizwe nesizwe sasifuna ukubulala iSithunywa sabo; futhi babephikisana ngombhedo ukuze bashabalalise iqiniso; ngabe sengiyaba jezisa; bheka ukuthi saba njani isijeziso saMi.

40:6.t: Ngokunjalo isinqumo seNkosi yakho sabafanela laba abangakholwa ukuthi bayongena emlilweni.

40:7.t: Labo abathwala iSihlalo [izingelosi] nalabo abaseduze nabo bababaza udumo lweNkosi yabo futhi baykholelwa kuyo baphinde bacelele labo abakholwayo intethelelo [bathi]: “Nkosi yethu, wengamele yonke into ngomusa nangolwaazi lwaKho, ngakho- ke, thethelela labo abazisolayo nabalandela indlela yakho ubavikele esijezisweni somlilo.

40:8.t: Nkosi yethu, uphinde ubangenise ezivandeni zaphakade lezi obathembise zona bona kanye nalabo abaqotho kubazali babo nabalingani babo nozalo lwabo; impela Wena unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

40:9.t: Futhi ubavikele ezimpambukweni [isijeziso sazo]; ngokuba lowo omvikele ezimpambukweni ngalolo suku usuke impela ube nomusa kuye, futhi leyo impumelelo enkulu.

40:10.t: Impela laba abangakholwa bayomemezwa [kuthiwe]: “Inzondo ka Allah yendlula eyenu inzondo enizizonda ngayo mhla nimenyelwa okholweno kepha nina nangakholwa.

40:11.t: Bathi: “Nkosi yethu, usenze safa kabili waphinde wasivusa kabili; ngakho-ke siyazivuma izimpambuko zethu; ingabe-ke ikhona yini indlela yokuphuma na?”

40:12.t: Lokho kungenxa yokuthi uma u Allah ekhonzwa yedwa, anikholwa, kepha uma ebhangqwa niyakholwa; ukwahlulela ngokuka Allah Ophakeme Omkhulu.

40:13.t: NguYena lona onibonisa izibonakaliso zaKhe aphinde anihlinzeke ngesondlo esivela phezulu [umvula], futhi yilabo abazinikelayo abathatha isifundo.

40:14.t: Ngakho-ke khonzani u Allah Yena yedwa ngobumsulwa noma bangazonda abangakholwa.

40:15.t: Uphakamisa isigaba, uneSihlalo, wembulela ngokunquma kwaKhe kulowo amthandayo ezigqileni zaKhe ukuzwe axwayise ngoSuku lokuHlangana.

40:16.t: Ngosuku lapho bonke bayobe beseshashalazini, akekho oyokwazi ukucashela u Allah. Ngobukabani ubukhosi namhlanje na?; [uyoziphendula]: “Ngobuka Allah Oyedwa Ongumlawuli”.

40:17.t: Namhlanje wonke umuntu uyothola umvuzo walokho abekwenza. Akukho okungebulungiswa namhlanje; impela u Allah wehlulela ngokushesha.

40:18.t: Futhi baxwayise ngosuku oluseduze, lapho izinhliziyo ziyofika emphinjweni belusizi; futhi abaphambukile abanamngani noma oyobakhulumela oyolalelwa.

40:19.t: [u Allah] Wazi inkohliso yamehlo nalokho okufihlwe izifuba.

40:20.t: Futhi u Allah wehlulela ngeqiniso; kepha labo ababakhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah abahluleli ngalutho; impela u Allah ungoZwayo Obonayo.

40:21.t: Ingabe abahambanga yini ezweni babheke ukuthi sabanjani isiphetho salabo ababandulela. Babenamandla ukundlula bona namagugu emhlabeni ukundlula bona. U Allah wabajezisa ngezimpambuko zabo, futhi akekho owayengabavikela ku Allah.

40:22.t: Lokho kungenxa yokuthi, kwakuthi uma kufika iZithunywa zabo nezibonakaliso, babengakholwa; u Allah wase uyabajezisa. Impela Yena unamandla ujezisana kanzima.

40:23.t: Futhi sathumela uMusa nezibonakaliso zeThu nobufakazi obucacisayo.

40:24.t: KuFirawuna noHamani noKaruni, kepha bathi: “Umlumbi onamanga”.

40:25.t: Kuthe lapho efika kubo neqiniso elivela kithi bathi: “Bulalani amadodana alabo abakholwa naye niyeke abafazi babo”. Futhi itulo labangakholwa liyashabalala.

40:26.t: Futhi uFirawuni wathi: “Ngiyekeni ngibulale uMusa, abize iNkosi; impela nesaba ukuthi uzoguqula inkolo yenu noma alethe ukonakala ezweni”.

40:27.t: Wathi uMusa: “Ngizivikela ngeNkosi yami neNkosi yenu kulowo nalowo oziqhayisayo ongakholelwa oSukwini lokwaHlulela”.

40:28.t: Indoda ekholwayo yesizwe sikaFirawuni ebefihla ukholo lwayo yathi: “Nibulala indoda ngoba nje ithe, iNkosi yami ngu Allah yaphinda yanilethela ubufakazi obuvela eNkosini yenu; uma enamanga, amanga ayo ayosala nayo; kepha uma eqinisile, kuyonehlela okunye kwalokhu anithembisa kona; impela u Allah akamholi lowo oyisephula mthetho onamanga”.

40:29.t: Bantu bakithi, namhlanje ubukhosi ngobenu niyabusa ezweni; ngubani-ke oyosiza esijezisweni sika Allah uma sesifika kithi na?. Wathi uFirawuni: “Nginibonisa lokhu engikubonayo futhi nginiholela endleleni eqotho”.

40:30.t: Wathi lona okholwayo: “Bantu bakithi, impela nginesabela lokhu okwenzeka ngezinsuku zamaqembu”.

40:31.t: Njengokwenzeka kubantu baka Nuhu nabakwa AdinabakwaTamudi nalabo abenza emuva kwabo; futhi u Allah akafuni ukwenza okungebulungiswa ezigqileni.

40:32.t: Futhi, bantu bakithi, nginisabela uSuku lokuBizana.

40:33.t: Ngosuku lapho bayobaleka bengabheki emuva, kepha akekho oyonivikela ku Allah; futhi lowo odukiswe ngu Allah akekho oyomhola.

40:34.t: Futhi noYusufu wafika kini phambilini nobufakazi, kepha nanilokhu nikungabaza lokhu anilethele kona; kuthe lapho eseshonile nathi: “u Allah akasoze athumela esinye iSithunywa emuva kwakhe”. U Allah umdukisa kanjalo lowo oyisephulamthetho ongenasiqiniseko.

40:35.t: Labo abaphikisana ngemibiko ka Allah ngaphandle kobufakazi obufike kubo, [lokho] kuzondekile kakhulu ku Allah nakulabo abakholwayo. U Allah uyivala kanjalo inhliziyo yalowo nalowo ozigqajayo oziqhayisayo.

40:36.t: Wathi uFirawuni: “We Hamani, ngakhele umbhoshongo ukuze ngifinyelele emizileni”.

40:37.t: Emizileni yasemazulwini, ngikhone ukulunguza lona okhonzwa nguMusa, belu ngicabanga ukuthi unamanga. Wenzela kuhle kanjalo uFirawuni ububi bezenzo zakhe futhi wavinjwa endleleni eqondile. Futhi iqhinga lika Firawuni liyobhubha.

40:38.t: Wathi lona okholwayo: “Bantu bakithi, landelani mina ngizoniholela endleleni eqotho”.

40:39.t: Bantu bakithi, le mpilo yasemhlabeni iyize kepha elizayo yilona indawo eyisizinda.

40:40.t: Lowo owenza impambuko, uyothola umvuzo olingene yona, kuthi lowo wesilisa noma owesifazane owenza okulungileyo ebe engokholwayo, yilabo abayongena eJana bondliwe kuyo ngokungenamkhawulo.

40:41.t: Futhi bantu bakithi, kungani uma nginibizela empumulelweni kepha nina ningibizela emlilweni.

40:42.t: Ningibizela ekutheni ngingakholelwa ku Allah ngiphinde ngimbhanqe nalokho enginalwazi ngakho kulapho mina nginibizela kuSomandla Ongumthetheleli.

40:43.t: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi lokhu eningibizela kukho akufanele ukumenyelwa [kukho] emhlabeni nakwelizayo nokuthi siyobuyela ku Allah nokuthi izephulamthetho ziyongena emlilweni.

40:44.t: Nizokukhumbula lokhu enitshela kona; futhi ngibeka konke okwami ku Allah, impela u Allah Ukubona konke mayelana nezigqila.

40:45.t: U Allah wamvikela kububi balokho ababekuhlelile; futhi abantu bakaFirawuni bahaqwa isijeziso esibi.

40:46.t: Umlilo bayiswa kuwo njalo ekuseni nantambama; futhi ngosuku lapho kufika iSikhathi [kuyothiwa]: “Fakani abantu bakaFirawuni esijezisweni esinzima kunazo zonke”.

40:47.t: Landisa ngomhla lapho beyophikisana emlilweni, bayothi laba ababecindezelwe kulabo ababeziqhayisa: “Impela thina sasilandela nina, ingabe sikhona yini isabelo somlilo eningasisiza ngaso na?”

40:48.t: Laba ababeziqhayisa bayothi: “Impela sonke sikuwo, impela u Allah usehlulele phakathi kwezigqila”.

40:49.t: Futhi labo abasemlilweni bayothi kubaqhaphi baseJahanamu: “Sikhulekeleni eNkosini yenu isixegisele isijeziso usuku nje olulodwa”.

40:50.t: Ziyothi: “Kanti iZithunywa zenu azifikanga yini kini nobufakazi na”. Bayothi: “Bafika”. Ziyothi: “Zikhulekeleni; futhi umkhuleko wabangakholwa uyize”.

40:51.t: Impela Thina siyosiza iZithunywa zeThu nalabo abakholwayo empilweni yasemhlabeni nangosuku lapho ofakazi beyosukuma [bafakaze].

40:52.t: Ngosuku lapho abaphambukile izizaba zabo zingeke zabasiza ngalutho; futhi bayothola isiqalekiso nendawo embi [umlilo].

40:53.t: Futhi impela sanika uMusa ukuholeka sashiya isizwe sakwa Isirayeli iNcwadi.

40:54.t: Ukuze ibe umholi nesikhumbuzo kulabo abakhaliphile.

40:55.t: Ngakho-ke bekezela; impela isithembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso, futhi ucele intethelelelo yezimpambuko zakho futhi ubababaze udumo lweNkosi yakho ntambama nasekuseni.

40:56.t: Impela laba abaphikisana ngemibiko ka Allah benganabufakazi obafika kubo; ezinhlizweni zabo kunogqabho futhi abasoze balufeza; ngakho- ke zivikele ngo Allah, impela Yena ungoZwayo Obonayo.

40:57.t: Impela ukudalwa kwamazulu nomhlaba kukhulu ukundlula ukudalwa kwabantu, kodwa iningi labantu alazi.

40:58.t: Futhi impumputhe nobonayo abafani ngokunjalo labo abenza okulungiyelo nabenza okubi; kepha anivamile ukulalela.

40:59.t: Impela iSikhathi siyeza akunakungabaza ngaso, kepha iningi labantu abakholwa.

40:60.t: Futhi iNkosi yenu yithi: “Khulekani kiMi ngizoniphendula; impela labo abazigqajayo ukungikhonza, bayongena eJahanamu behlazekile”.

40:61.t: U Allah unenzele ubusuku ukuba niphumule kuwo, imini yakhanya; impela u Allah unomusa kubantu kodwa iningi labantu alibongi.

40:62.t: Loyo ngu Allah iNkosi yenu, uMdali wezinto zonke; akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe; pho nidukiswa yini na?

40:63.t: Badukiswa kanjalo labo abaphika imibiko yeThu.

40:64.t: NguYena u Allah onenzele umhlaba waba yisizinda kwathi isibhakabhaka saba uphahla. Futhi wanibumba, wanenza naba bahle waphinde wanondla ngalokho okumsulwa. Loyo ngu Allah iNkosi yenu; u Allah ungcwele iNkosi yendalo yonke.

40:65.t: UngoPhilayo, akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe, ngakho-ke khonzani Yena yedwa ngobumsulwa; udumo ngoluka Allah iNkosi yendalo yonke.

40:66.t: Yithi: “Nginqatshelwe ukukhonza lokhu enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah emuva kokuba sengithole ubufakazi obuvela eNkosini yami futhi ngiyalelwe ukuba ngizinikele eNkosini yendalo yonke”.

40:67.t: NguYena lona owanidala ngobumba emuva kwalokho ngesidoda nangehlulu wase wanikhipha ningamaswana nase niyakhula naphelela nase naguga – kunalabo phakathi kwenu abashona ngaphambi kwalokho – bese nifika esikhathini esibekiwe ukuze niqondisise.

40:68.t: NguYena oletha ukuphila nokufa; futhi uma enquma ukwenza noma yini uvane athi: “Yenzeka”, bese kuyenzeka.

40:69.t: Ubabonile laba abaphikisana ngemibiko ka Allah; badukiswa kanjani?

40:70.t: Labo abaphika iNcwadi nalokho esikuthumele neZithunywa zeThu; kodwa bayokwazi.

40:71.t: Mhla amasongo esesemiqaleni yabo namaketango bedonswa.

40:72.t: Besiwa emanzini abilayo bese bengqongqiswa emlilweni.

40:74.t: Ngaphandle kuka Allah; bayothi: “Kusidukele, empeleni besinakhonzi lutho phambilini”. Uyobadukisa kanjalo u Allah labo abangakholwa.

40:75.t: Lokho kungenxa yokujabula kwenu ngokungemthetho emhlabeni nangokuziqhayisa kwenu.

40:76.t: Ngenani eminyangweni yaseJahanamu nihlalekuyo unaphakade; yaze yayimbi indawo yabaziqhayisayo.

40:77.t: Ngakho-ke, bekezela, impela isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso. Singakubonisa lokho esibathembise kona noma sithathe impilo, niyobuyela kithi.

40:78.t: Futhi impela sathumela iZithunywa ngaphambi kwakho; kunalezo esikulandisa ngazo kube nalezo esingakulandisanga ngazo. Futhi angeke iSithunywa silethe isibonakaliso ngaphandle kwemvumo ka Allah. Futhi kuyothi uma usufikile umyalelo ka Allah, kuyohlulelwa ngeqiniso, abanamanga bayolahlekelwa khona lapho.

40:79.t: NguYena u Allah lona onidalele imfuyo ukuze niyigibele niphinde nidle kuyo.

40:80.t: Futhi nithola izinsizakalo kuyo – futhi ukuze nifeze isidingo esisezinhlizweni zenu futhi nigitshezwa kuyo nasemkhunjini.

40:81.t: Futhi unibonisa izibonakaliso zaKhe; pho yiziphi izibonakaliso zika Allah enizoziphika.

40:82.t: Ingabe abahambanga yini ezweni babheke ukuthi sabanjani isiphetho salabo ababandulela. Babenamandla ukundlula bona namagugu emhlabeni ukundlula bona. Kepha akubasizanga ngalutho lokho ababekwenza.

40:83.t: Kuthe uma iZithunywa zabo zifika kubo nobufakazi, bajabula ngolwazi ababenalo; kwase kubahaqa lokhu ababehlekisa ngakho.

40:84.t: Kuthe uma bebona isijeziso seThu bathi: “Siyakholelwa ku Allah yena yedwa futhi asisakholelwa kulokho ebesikubhangqa naYe”.

40:85.t: Kepha ukukholwa kwabo lapho bebona isijeziso angeke kubasize; kuyinkambiso ka Allah nakuzigqila zaKhe esezandlula; bayolahlekelwa khona lapho abangakholwa.

41:3.t: iNcwadi omibiko yayo icacisiwe eyiKurani yesi Arabhu kubantu abanolwazi.

41:4.t: Yethula izindaba ezinhle futhi iyexwayisa; kepha iningi labo liyishaye indiva abafuni ukulalela.

41:5.t: Futhi bathi: “Izinhliziyo zethu zivalekile kulokho osimemela kukho futhi izindlebe zethu azizwa futhi phakathi kwethu nawe kunesithiyo; ngakho-ke yenza [okwenzayo] nathi siyenza”.

41:6.t: Yithi: “Mina ngingumuntu nje ofana nani, kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi okumele nimkhonze uyedwa nje vo, ngakho-ke yibani qotho kuYe futhi nicele kuYe intethelelo. Futhi imbubhiso ikulabo ababhangqayo”.

41:7.t: Labo abangayikhiphi izakati futhi abangakholelwa kwelizayo.

41:8.t: Impela labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo bayothola umvuzo ongenamkhawulo.

41:9.t: Yithi: “Ingabe anikholelwa kuLowo odale umhlaba ezinsukwini ezimbili futhi namqokela izimbangi na? Loyo iNkosi yendalo yonke”.

41:10.t: Wafaka phezu kwawo izikhonkwane [izintaba] futhi wafaka izibusiso kuwo waphinde waba kuwo isondlo sawo ezinsukwini ezine – [ukwazisa] labo ababuzayo, kuyefana [akuguquki].

41:11.t: Wabe esephendukela ezulwini lisaseyintuthu, wathi kuwo nomhlaba: “Wozani [nibe khona] ngokuthanda noma ngenkani”. Athi: “Siza ngokuthanda”.

41:12.t: Wabe eselenza amazulu ayisikhombisa ezinsukwini ezimbili, wembulela kulelo nalelo zulu umyalelo walo. Futhi sahlobisa isibhakabhaka ngezibani nokuthi zibe isivikelo. Lokho ukuhlela kukaSomandla Owaziyo.

41:13.t: Uma bengenandaba, yithi: “Nginixwayiswa ngembubhiso [eshaqa konke] efana nembubhiso yabakwa AdinoTamudi.

41:14.t: Mhla iZithunywa zabo zifika kubo ngaphambi nasemuva kwabo [zilandelana], [zithi]: “Ningakhonzi lutho ngaphandle kuka Allah”. Bathi: “Ukube u Allah ubethanda ngabe uthumele izingelosi; impela thina asikholelwa kulokho ezithunywe nakho”.

41:15.t: Mayelana no Adi, bona baziqhayisa ezweni ngokungemthetho futhi bathi: “Ubani onamandla ukudlula thina na?” Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi u Allah lona obadalile nguYena onamandla ukudlula bona; futhi babephika imibiko yeThu.

41:16.t: Sathumela kubo umoya oyisivunguvungu ezinsukwini ezimbi, ukuze sibazwise isijeziso esihlazanayo empilweni yasemhlabeni; futhi isijeziso sakwelizayo sihlazisana kakhulu, futhi abayikusizwa.

41:17.t: Mayelana noTamudi, sabahola kepha bona bathanda ubumpumputhe kunokuholeka base-ke behlaselwa imbubhiso yesijeziso esihlazanayo ngenxa yalokho ababekwenza.

41:18.t: Futhi sabahlenga laba ababekholwa futhi ababethobela u Allah.

41:19.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho izitha zika Allah ziyobuthaniswa emlilweni futhi bayoqhutshwa.

41:20.t: Kuyothi uma sebefike kuwo, izindlebe zabo namehlo abo nezikhumba zabo ziyofakaza ngabo ngalokho ababekwenza.

41:21.t: Bayothi kuzikhumba zabo: “Kungani nifakaze ngathi na?”. Ziyothi: “U Allah lona owenze yonke ikhulume, nguYena osenze sakhuluma”. NguYe owanidala kwasekuqaleni futhi nizobuyela kuYe”.

41:22.t: Futhi beningafihli [izimpambuko] ngoba nakhu izindlebe zenu namehlo enu nezikhumba zenu zizofakaza ngani; kodwa kungoba benicabanga ukuthi u Allah akakwazi okuningi kwenikwenzayo.

41:23.t: Yilokho ebenikucabanga ngeNkosi yenu; unitshingile [emlilweni] naba ngabalahlekelwe.

41:24.t: Noma bengabekezela umlilo uyolokhu uyindawo yabo futhi uma becela elinye ithuba, abasoze banikwa elinye ithuba.

41:25.t: Sabaqokela abalingani ababenzela kuhle lokhu okuphambi kwabo [impilo yasemhlabeni] nokusemuva kwabo [kwelizayo lapho besuka khona], futhi bafanelwa isinqumo esehlela izizwe ezibandulelayo zamajini nabantu; impela balahlekelwa.

41:26.t: Futhi laba abangakholwa bathi: “Ningayilaleli leKurani futhi nibange umsindo ukuze ninqobe”.

41:27.t: Impela sizobazwisa laba abangakholwa isijeziso esibuhlungu futhi sizobanika umvuzo balokhu okubi ababekwenza.

41:28.t: Lowo umvuzo wezitha zika Allah, umlilo; uyoba indawo yabo yaphakade; kuwumvuzo wokuphika kwabo imibiko yeThu.

41:29.t: Futhi laba abangakholwa bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, sitshengise laba abasidukisile kumajini nabantu ukuze sizobafaka phansi kwezinyawo zethu ukuze badicileleke phansi”.

41:30.t: Impela labo abathi: “iNkosi ngu Allah”, bese bezimisela babeqotho, izingelosi ziyokwehlela kubo zithi: “Ningesabi ningakhathazeki, futhi nithakasele iJana lena enithenjiswe yona”.

41:31.t: Thina singabangani benu empilweni yasemhlabeni nakwelizayo; futhi niyothola kuyo noma yini eyihalelayo futhi niyothola kuyo noma yini enikufunayo.

41:33.t: Futhi ngubani ongcono ngenkulumo kunalowo omemela ku Allah futhi owenza okulungileyo bese ethi: “ngiyiMusilimu”.

41:34.t: Futhi okuhle nokubi akufani. Phindisela ngalokho okungcono. Uyobona lowo okunobutha phakathi kwakhe nawe, esengathi umngani omkhulu.

41:35.t: Kutholwa yilabo ababekezelayo futhi kutholwa yilabo abanesabelo esikhulu.

41:36.t: Uma ufikelwa isilingo esivela kuShayitani, zivikele ngo Allah; impela Yena ungoZwayo Owaziyo.

41:37.t: Futhi kwezinye izibonakaliso zaKhe, ubusuku nemini nelanga nenyanga; musanike ukukhothamela ilanga noma inyanga kepha khothamelani u Allah lona okudalile uma ngempela nikhonza Yena kuphela.

41:38.t: Uma beziqhayisa; labo-ke abaseNkosini yakho bayidumisa ubusuku nemini futhi abakhathali.

41:39.t: Futhi kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe, ukuthi ubone umhlaba ufile, kuthi lapho sesithele amanzi kuwo, uqhakaze ukhule. Impela lowo owuvuselele uyovusa abafileyo; impela Yena akehlulwa yilutho.

41:40.t: Impela labo abaphambukayo emibikweni yeThu abafihlekile kithi. Ingabe lowo otshingelwa emlilweni ungcono yini kunalowo oyofika ephephile ngoSuku lokwahlulela na?; yenzani enikuthandayo, impela Yena Uyakubona lokho enikwenzayo.

41:41.t: Impela labo abangakholwa iSikhumbuzo [iKurani] lapho ifika kubo [bayojezisa]. Impela iyiNcwadi enamandla.

41:42.t: Akukho mbhedo ongafika kuyo ngaphambili noma ngemuva kwayo; yembulelwe Okhaliphile Odunyiswayo.

41:43.t: Akukho okushiwo kuwe okungashiwongo kuZithunywa ezikwandulelayo; impela iNkosi yakho inentethelelo futhi inesijeziso esibuhlungu.

41:44.t: Ukube sayenza kwaba iKurani ngolunye ulwimi, bebezothi: “Uma nje imibiko yayo ingacaciswa, olunye ulwimi nesi Arabhu [kanjani]?”. Yithi: “Ingumholi kulabo abakholwayo nekhambi”. Futhi laba abangakholwa, ezindlebenizabo kunehonqo futhi uma kufika kuyo bayizimpumputhe. Yibo labo abayobizwa endaweni esekudeni.

41:45.t: Impela sanika uMusa iNcwadi kepha kwaphikiswana ngayo. Ukube bekungekona ukuthi izwi elivela ku Allah seliphumile [lokunika isikhathi], ngabe sekuhlulelwe phakathi kwabo. Kepha bona banokungabaza abanasiqiniseko ngakho.

41:46.t: Lowo owenza okulungileyo uzisiza yena futhi lowo owenza okubi uzilaya yena; futhi iNkosi yakhe ayisoze yenza okungebulungiswa kusigqila.

41:47.t: Ulwazi lweSikhathi lubuyiselwa kuYe. Futhi lezo zithelo eziphuma emakhasini azo, nalokho okukhulelwa owesifazane nalokho akuzalayo kwenzeka ngoLwazi lwaKhe. Futhi ngokusu lapho eyobamemeza athi: “Baphi abalingani baMi na?”. Bayothi: “Sikutshelile ukuthi akekho kithi ofakazela [lokho]”.

41:48.t: Kwabadukela lokho ababekukhonza phambilini futhi baqinisekiseka ukuthi angeke bakwazi ukubaleka.

41:49.t: Umuntu akadinwa ukukhulekela okuhle, kepha uma ehlelwa okubi, uvele aphelelwe nya ithemba.

41:50.t: Uma sizwisa umuntu umusa ovela kithi emuva kokwehlelwa ubunzima, uvele athi: “Lokhu okwami futhi angicabangi ukuthi iSikhathi [sokwaHlulelwa] siyofika, futhi uma ngibuyela eNkosini yami, impela ngiyothola okuhle”. Sizokwazisa labo abangakholwa ngalokho ababekwenza futhi sizobazwisa isijeziso esibuhlungu.

41:51.t: Futhi uma senzela umuntu umusa uyafulathela ashaye indiva, kepha uma ehlelwa okubi wenza umkhuleko omude.

41:52.t: Yithi: “Ake ningitshele, uma ivela ku Allah kepha nina nangayikholwa; ngubani oduke ukundlula lowo ophambukele kude le?”

41:53.t: Sizobabonisa izibonakaliso zeThu kwimiphelamehlo nakubo uqobo kuze kubacacele ukuthi iyiqiniso. Ingabe akwanele yini ukuthi iNkosi iyibona yonke into na?

41:54.t: Bheka! Impela banokungabaza ngokuhlangana neNkosi yabo. Bheka! Impela yona yengamele yonke into.

42:3.t: Wembulele ngokunjalo kuwe nakulabo abakwandulelayo u Allah onguSomandla Okhaliphile.

42:4.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokwaKhe futhi nguYena Ophakeme Omkhulu.

42:5.t: Amazulu acishe aqhekeka alakanyelana. Futhi izingelosi zibabaza udumo lweNkosi yazo ziphinde zicelele abasemhlabeni intethelelo. Bheka ngoba impela u Allah unguMthetheleli Onesihawu.

42:6.t: Futhi labo abaqoka abahlengi ngaphandle kwaKhe; u Allah nguYena obaqhaphile futhi wena awuyena umnakekeli wabo.

42:7.t: Futhi ngokunjalo sembulele kuwe iKurani yesi Arabhu ukuze uxwayise abaseMakha nalabo abakhelene nabo nokuthi uxwayise ngosuku lukubuthana okungenakungabaza ngalo. Abanye bayongena eJana kuthi abanye bangene emlilweni.

42:8.t: Futhi uma u Allah ethanda ebabenza babe senkolweni eyodwa; kodwa ufaka amthandayo emseni waKhe. Futhi labo abaphambukile abanaye umhlengi noma ongabasiza.

42:9.t: Kumbe baqoke abahlengi ngaphandle kwaKhe; u Allah nguYena uMhlengi futhi nguYena oyovusa abafileyo futhi akehlulwa yilutho.

42:10.t: Futhi noma iyiphi into eniphikisana ngayo, isahlulelo sayo siku Allah. Lowo ngu Allah iNkosi yami, ngethembele kuYe futhi ngizilahla kuYe.

42:11.t: UnguMdali wamazulu nomhlaba; unidalele abalingani bohlobo lwenu nasemfuyweni ngokunjalo; unidala kanjalo. Akukho lutho olufana naYe futhi ungoZwayo Obonayo.

42:12.t: Izihluthulelo zasemazulwini nasemhlabeni ziphethwe nguYe; wabela ngenala amthandayo futhi answinye. Impela Wazi ngayo yonke into.

42:13.t: Unibekele enkolweni lokho ayalela ngakho uNuhu nalokho akwembulele kuwe nalokho esayalela ngakho u Ibhirahimu noMusa no Isa, okuthi: “Dlondlobalisani inkolo futhi ningaqembuki kuyo”. Kunzima kulabo abakhonza izithixo lokhu enibamemela kukho. U Allah uziqokela Yena amthandayo futhi uholela kuYe lowo ozisolayo.

42:14.t: Futhi baqembuka kuphela emuva kokuba bathole ulwazi, ngenxa yenzondo phakathi kwabo. Futhi ukube bekungekho ngenxa yesinqume esiphuma eNkosini yakho sokulinda isikhathi esibekiwe, ngabe kade kwahlulelwa phakathi kwabo. Impela laba abasala neNcwadi emuva kwabo banokungabaza ngayo abanasiqiniseko.

42:15.t: Ngenxa yalokho-ke, mema [abantu ku Isilamu] ube qotho njengoba uyalelwe futhi ungalandeli izinkanuko zabo; futhi uthi: “Ngikholelwa kuleNcwadi u Allah ayembulele kimi futhi ngiyalelwe ukuba ngenze ubulungiswa phakathi kwenu. U Allah iNkosi yethu neNkosi yenu; thina sinezenzo zethu nani ninezenzo zenu, akukho ukuphikisana phakathi kwethu nani; u Allah uyosibuthanisa sonke futhi isiphetho sikuYe”.

42:16.t: Futhi labo abaphikisana no Allah emuva kokuba sekukhona abamlalele [uMuhamadi], ubufakazi babo abuthi shu eNkosini yabo; futhi behlelwe ulaka kanti bayothola nesijeziso esinzima.

42:17.t: NguYena u Allah owembulele iNcwadi ngeqiniso nangobulungiswa. Futhi ungazi ngani, mhlawumbe iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] sesisondele.

42:18.t: Laba abangakholwa basijahile. Kepha alaba abakholwayo bayesesaba futhi bayazi ukuthi siyiqiniso. Bheka ngoba laba abaphikisana ngeSikhathi, impela badukele kude.
