42:19.t: U Allah unesineke ngezigqila zaKhe; wondla amthandayo. Futhi ungoNamadla onguSomandla.

42:20.t: Lowo ofuna umvuzo wakwelizayo sizomandisela umvuzo wakhe, kanti lowo ofuna umvuzo wasemhlabeni sizomnikeza wona kepha kwelizayo akayikuba nasabelo.

42:21.t: Kumbe banezikhonzwa ezibabekele umthetho enkolweni ongagunyazwanga ngu Allah na?. Ukube bengekho ngenxa yesinqumo esiwumnqamulajuqu ngabe kade kwahlulelwa phakathi kwabo. Futhi impela abaphambukile bayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu.

42:22.t: Uyobona abaphambukile bethukile ngenxa yabakwenzile, futhi nakanjani kuyobehlela [abakuvunile]. Labo abakholwayo ababenza okulungileyo bayoba kwizife sasezivandeni; bayothola konke abakulangazelelayo eNkosini yabo. Lokho yikona okuwumusa omkhulu.

42:23.t: Yizona lezo izindaba ezinhle u Allah azethula kuzigqila zakhe lezi ezikholwayo nezenza okulungileyo. Yithi: “Anginceli mvuzo ngakho, ngaphandle nje kokuzwana njengezihlobo”. Futhi lowo owenza okuhle sizomandisela ngokuhle kukho. Impela u Allah unguMthetheleli Obongayo.

42:24.t: Kumbe bathi: “Uqambela u Allah amanga”. Uma u Allah ethanda engavala inhliziyo yakho. Futhi u Allah uyawashabalalisa amanga aqinisekise iqiniso ngaMazwi aKhe; impela Yena ukwazi kahle okuqukethwe izinhliziyo.

42:25.t: Futhi nguYena owamukela ukuzisola nokucela intethelelo ezigqileni zaKhe aphinde axolele izimpambuko futhi uyakwazi enikwenzayo.

42:26.t: Futhi uyabaphendula labo abakholwayo abenza okulungileyo aphinde abandisele umusa waKhe. Abangakholwa bayothola isijeziso esinzima.

42:27.t: Uma u Allah engabela ngenala isondlo kuzigqila zaKhe, zeziyoba ngamahlongandlebe ezweni, kepha uletha akuthandayo ngokulingene; impela Yena mayelana nezigqila zaKhe Unolwazi Uyabona.

42:28.t: Futhi nguYena oletha imvula emuva kokuba sebelahle ithemba aphinde asabalalise umusa waKhe. Futhi nguYena onguMhlengi Odunyiswayo.

42:29.t: Ezinye zezibonakaliso zakhe, ukudalwa kwamazulu nomhlaba nalezo zidalwa azisabalalisile kuwo. Futhi uma ethanda unamandla okubabuthanisa bonke.

42:30.t: Futhi wonke umshophi onehlelayo kungenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zenu, futhi kuningi [u Allah] akuxolelayo.

42:31.t: Futhi nina anisoze naphunyuka emhlabeni, futhi akekho onganihlenga noma anisize ngaphandle kuka Allah.

42:32.t: Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe, imikhumbi eso lwandle njengezintaba.

42:33.t: Uma ethanda angamisa umoya, bese ima nsi [imikhumbi] phezu kwalo. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulowo nalowo obekezelayo obongayo.

42:34.t: Noma avele ayibhubhise ngenxa yezenzo zabo; kepha kuningi akuxolelayo.

42:35.t: Futhi laba abaphikisana ngemibiko yeThu bayazi ukuthi akukho lapho ababalekela khona.

42:36.t: Yonke into enabelwe yona, izinto nje zokuncebeleka emhlabeni; kepha lokhu okuku Allah yikona okungcono nokuyohlala kukhona kulabo abakholwayo abathembela eNkosini yabo.

42:37.t: Nalabo abagwema izimpambuko ezinkulu namanyala nabathi uma becasula bakwazi ukuxolela.

42:38.t: Nalabo abathobela iNkosi yabo baqikelele ukwenza iSwala futhi babonisane phakathi kwabo baphinde baphane kulokho esibabele kona.

42:40.t: Phela umvuzo wempambuko impambuko efana nayo; kepha lowo oxolelayo futhi babuyisane, umvuzo wakhe uku Allah; impela Yena akabathandi labo abangenabulungiswa.

42:41.t: Futhi lowo oziphindiselelayo emuva kokuba ehlukunyeziwe; laboke ngeke basolwe.

42:42.t: Kuphela abasolwayo, yilabo abahlukumeza abantu futhi benze ukonakala emhlabeni ngokungemthetho; yibo-ke labo abayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu.

42:43.t: Futhi lowo obekezelayo aphinde axolele; impela lokho kungokunye kwezinto ezimqoka.

42:44.t: Futhi lowo odukiswe ngu Allah, akekho oyomhlenga ngaphandle kwaKhe. Futhi uyobona abaphambukile mhla bebona isijesizo bayothi: “Ingabe ikhona indlela yokubuyela emuva na?”.

42:45.t: Futhi uyobabona bedangele ngenxa yehlazo lapho besiwa kuwo [umlilo], belokhu bejeqeza. Futhi laba abakholwayo bayothi: “Impela abalahlekelwe yilabo abazilahlekisele bona nemindeni yabo ngosuku lokwahlulela; bheka ngoba abaphambukile bayongena esijezisweni esingapheli”.

42:46.t: Futhi akunabahlengi abayobasiza ngaphandle kuka Allah. Futhi lowo odukiswe ngu Allah kuphelile ngaye.

42:47.t: Thobelani iNkosi yenu kungakafiki usuku olungeke lavinjwa muntu ku Allah; ngalolosuku akukho lapho eniyikhosela khona futhi akekho oyonixwayela [anizwele].

42:48.t: Uma bengenandaba, asikuthumelanga ukuba ube umqaphi wabo, okwakho ukudlulisa umlayezo. Futhi impela uma sizwisa umuntu umusa ovela kithi, uyathokoza ngawo; kepha uma ehlelwa umshopi ngenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zakhe; nangu muntu engasabongi.

42:49.t: Umbuso wamazulu nomhlaba oka Allah; udala akuthandayo; upha amthandayo amantombazane aphe amthandayo abafana.

42:50.t: Noma abaxube kube abafana namantombazane. Futhi wenza amthandayo inyumba; impela Yena Uyazi Unamandla.

42:51.t: Akekho umuntu u Allah akhuluma naye mathupha, kuba kuphela ngokumembulela emuva kwezithiyo noma athumele isithunywa bese embulela ngemvumo yaKhe akufunayo; impela Yena Uphakeme Ukhaliphile.

42:52.t: Ngokunjalo sembulela kuwe umusa ovela kithi; futhi bewungazi ukuthi yini iNcwadi noma yini ukholo; kepha siyenze yaba ukuhkanya esihola ngawo lowo esimthandayo kuzigqila zeThu; futhi impela nawe uholela endleleni eqondile.

42:53.t: Indlela ka Allah, lona okungokwakhe konke okusemazulwini nakho konke okusemhlabeni; bheka! Zonke izinto zobuyela ku Allah.

43:3.t: Impela siyenze yaba iKurani yesi Arabhu ukuze niqonde.

43:4.t: Futhi eNcwadini ewuMsuka [uQwembe] ekithi iphakeme ikhaliphile.

43:5.t: Ingabe kumele sihoxise iSikhumbuzo unomphela kini ngenxa nje yokuthi nina ningabantu abayizephula mthetho na?

43:7.t: Njalonje uma kufika uMembulelwa kubo babevele bahlekise ngaye.

43:8.t: Sabhubhisa abanamandla ukundlula bona futhi sesandlula isibonelo sabasendulo.

43:9.t: Futhi uma ungababuza ukuthi, ngubani owadla amazulu nomhlaba bayothi: “Kudalwe nguSomandla Owaziyo”.

43:10.t: Lona onenzele umhlaba wandlaleka waphinde wanenzela kuwo izindlela ukuze nilayeleke ningaduki.

43:11.t: Lona futhi onehlisele amanzi phezulu ngokulingene; sabe sesivuselela ngawo indawo ebesifile; ngokunjalo niyovuswa.

43:12.t: Lona futhi lona odale zonke izinhlobo wanidalela imikhumbi nezilwane enikugibelayo.

43:13.t: Ukuze nigibele emihlane yakho bese nikhumbula umusa weNkosi yenu lapho seniphezu kwakho bese nithi: “Ungcwele lona osijubele lokhu futhi besingeke thina sikhone…”

43:14.t: Futhi impela thina siyobuyela eNkosini yethu.

43:15.t: Futhi bamqokela isabelo ezigqileni zaKhe; impela umuntu akabongi sidalo.

43:16.t: Kumbe Yena uzikhethele amadodakazi kulokho akudalile, nina wanikhethela amadodana.

43:17.t: Uma omunye ehalaliselwa ngalokho akufanisa noNomusa, ubuso buyagqungqa bubemnyama bhuqe adangale.

43:18.t: Ingabe lowo okhuliswe ngemhlobiso futhi ongakwazi ukuzuchaza lapho kuphikiswa [owesimame] [bamenza ingane ka Allah na]?

43:19.t: Futhi benze izingelosi isifazane zona lezi eziyizigqila zika Allah. Ingabe babekhona yini mhla zidalwa na? Ubufakazi babo buzolotshwa bese bayabuzwa.

43:20.t: Futhi bathi: “Uma u Allah ethanda angeke sabakhonza”. Abanalwazi lwalokho, bavane bayaziqagulela nje.

43:21.t: Kumbe sabanika incwadi ngaphambi kwayo [iKurani]; ngakho-ke babambelele kuyo.

43:22.t: Empeleni bathi: “Safumanisa okhokho bethu belandela inkolo, ngakho-ke nathi sihamba ezinyathelweni zabo”.

43:23.t: Ngokunjalo, kunoma yisiphi isizwe esithumela kuso umexwayisi, izigwili zakhona zazithi: “Impela thina safumanisa okhokho bethu belandela inkolo, ngakho-ke nathi silandela ezinyathelweni zabo”.

43:24.t: Wathi: “Kunganjani nginilethele okuqonde ukundlula lokho enafumanisa kukho okhokho benu na?” Bathi::Impela asikukholwa lokho enithunywe nakho”.

43:25.t: Saziphindisela kubo; ngakho- ke bheka ukuthi saba njani isiphetho sabaphikayo.

43:26.t: Khumbula mhla u Ibhirahimu ethi kuyise nakubantu bakubo: “Impela mina angihlangene nalokho enikukhonzayo”.

43:27.t: Ngaphandle kwalowo owangidala ngokuba Yena uzongihola.

43:28.t: Wawenza kwaba ngamazwi awashiya ngemuva kwakhe ukuze babuye [endleleni eqondile].

43:29.t: Empeleni sijabulise laba nokhokho babo kwaze Fukwafika kubo iqiniso neSithunywa esicacisayo.

43:30.t: Kuthe lapho sekufika iqiniso bathi: “Lokhu ilumbo, futhi asikukholwa impela”.

43:31.t: Futhi bathi: “Kungani leKurani ingembulelwanga endodeni evela kulezizwe ezimbili ezinkulu”.

43:32.t: Ingabe sekuyibona yini ababa umusa weNkosi yakho na? Yithina esibabela ukuziphilisa kwabo empilweni yasemhlabeni futhi siphakamise izigaba zabanye zaba ngaphezulu kwezabanye ukuze abanye basebenzele abanye. Futhi umusa weNkosi yakho yiwona ongcono kunalokho abakuqongelelayo.

43:33.t: Futhi ukube bekungesikho ukuthi abantu bayoba senkolweni eyodwa [yokungakholwa], besiyokwenzela labo abangakholelwa koNomusa uphahla lwesiliva ezindlini zabo nezikwelo abazokhuphuka ngazo.

43:34.t: Futhi izindlu zabo zibe neminyango nemibhede abayohlala abeqhiyame kuyo.

43:35.t: Nobukhakhazi begolide; futhi konke lokho kuyizinto zempilo yasemhlabeni; kepha ikwelizayo eNkosini yakho ngelalabo abayithobelayo.

43:36.t: Futhi lowo ophila ngaphandle kokukhumbula Onomusa, simqokela uShayitani ukuze abe umngani wakhe.

43:37.t: Impela bona [oShayitani] bayavimba endleleni, kepha bona bacabanga ukuthi basendleleni eqondile.

43:38.t: Kuze kuthi lapho esefika kithi, athi: “Ngifisa engathi phakathi kwami nawe bekunebanga lezimpumalanga ezimbili; ungumngani omubi”.

43:39.t: Ngoba seniphambukile nje, angeke kunisize ukuba ndawonye [kwenu] esijezisweni.

43:40.t: Ingabe wena uyakwazi ukukwenza izimumu zizwe noma uhole impumputhe nalowo osekudukeni uqobo na?

43:42.t: Noma sikubonise lokho esibathembise kona; impela Thina angeke basihlula.

43:43.t: Ngakho-ke bambelele kulokho okwembulelwe kuwe; impela usendleleni eqondile.

43:44.t: Futhi [iKurani] iwudumo lwakho nabantu bakini futhi niyobuzwa.

43:45.t: Futhi buza labo esabathumela ngaphambi kwakho kuZithunywa zeThu, ukuthi, ngabe sake saqoka izikhonzwa ezikhonzwayo ngaphandle koNomusa na?

43:46.t: Sathumela uMusa nezibonakaliso zeThu kuFirawuni nezikhulu zakhe, wathi: “Impela ngiyiSithunywa seNkosi yendalo yonke”.

43:47.t: Kuthe lapho ebalethela izibonakaliso zeThu, bavele bazihleka.

43:48.t: Futhi yileso naleso sibonakaliso esibabonisa sona besikhulu kunedlulile. Futhi sabahlasela ngesijeziso ukuze babuye [endleleni eqondile].

43:49.t: Bathi: “Mlumbi, sikhulekele eNkosini yakho, ngesibopho esenze nawe, impela thina sizolandela indlela eqondile”.

43:50.t: Kuthe lapho sesisisusile kubo isijeziso; baphula isethembiso.

43:51.t: Futhi uFirawuni wamemeza kubantu bakhe wathi: “Bantu bami, akusibona yini obami ubukhosi baseMisiri nalemifula egeleza ezansi kwami na? kungani ningaboni na?”

43:52.t: Empeleni yimina ongcono kunalona ongelutho futhi ongakwazi nokukhuluma into ecacile.

43:53.t: Makehlelwe ubuhlalu begolide noma izingelosi zize naye zilandelana.

43:54.t: Wabayenga abantu bakhe, bamlalela; impela babengabantu abayozephula mthetho.

43:55.t: Kuthe lapho sebesicasulile; saziphindisela kubo sabacwilisa bonke.

43:57.t: Futhi uma kwenziwa umzekelo ngendodana ka Mariyamu; abantu bakini babanga umsindo.

43:58.t: Bathi: “Ingabe izikhonzwa zethu ezingcono noma yena na?”, benze umzekelo ngayo ukuze baphikisane nawe; empeleni bangabantu abaphikisanayo.

43:59.t: Uyizigqila nje esisibusisile futhi sasenza isibonelo esizweni sakwa Isirayeli.

43:60.t: Uma sithanda singaletha esikhundleni senu izingelosi emhlabeni izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.

43:61.t: Futhi [u Isa] uyinkomba yokufika kweSikhathi ngakho- ke ungabi nokungabaza ngaso futhi landelani mina lena indlela eqondile.

43:62.t: Futhi uShayitani anganivimbi; impela yena uyisitha esisobala kini.

43:63.t: Kuthe lapho u Isa efika nezibonakaliso wathi: “Ngize kini nobuhlakani futhi ngizonicacisela okunye kwalokho eniphikisana ngakho; ngakho-ke thobelani u Allah nilalele nami”.

43:64.t: Impela u Allah iNkosi yami neNkosi yenu, ngakho-ke khonzani Yena; lena iyona ndlela eqondile.

43:65.t: Amaqembu ngaphakathi kwabo aphikisana. Imbubhiso yesijeziso sosuku olubuhlungu ikulabo abaphambukile.

43:66.t: Ingabe balindele iSikhathi ukuba bengazelele benganakile na?

43:67.t: Abangani ngalolo suku bayoba izitha ngaphandle kwabathobela u Allah.

43:68.t: Zigqila zaMi, namhlanje ningesabi futhi ningakhathazeki.

43:69.t: Labo abakholwa imibiko yeThu futhi babe ngamaMusilimu.

43:71.t: Bayolethelwa ngezitsha zegolide namankomishi; phakathi kuwo kunalokho okulangazelelwa umphefumulo nokujatshulelwa ngamehlo. Futhi niyohla kuyo unaphakade.

43:72.t: Yiyo-ke leyo iJana lena eyithole ngalokho ebenikwenza.

43:73.t: Kuyo niyothola izithelo eziyinala enizodla kuzo.

43:74.t: Impela izephula mthetho ziyongena esijezisweni saseJahanamu unaphakade.

43:76.t: Futhi akukho okungebulungiswa esikwenze kubo; kepha yibona abangenabulungiswa.

43:77.t: Futhi bayomemeza [bathi]: “Maliki, iNkosi mayiqede ngathi”. Uyothi: “Cha, impela nisazohlala”.

43:78.t: Impela sanilethela iqiniso kodwa iningi lenu alilithandi iqiniso.

43:80.t: Kumbe bacabanga ukuthi asikuzwa ukuhleba kwabo nezigungu zabo zangasese. Nebala! Futhi izithunywa zeThu zikanye nabo ziyaloba.

43:81.t: Yithi: “Uma Onomusa enendodana; ngizoba owokuqala ukukhonza”.

43:82.t: Ingcwele iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba, iNkosi yeSihlalo kulokho abakushoyo.

43:83.t: Bayekele kanje bephambuka futhi bedlala baze bafike kusuku lolu abathenjiswe lona.

43:84.t: Futhi nguYena okhonzwayo ezulwini nokhonzwayo emhlabeni; futhi ungoKhaliphile Owaziyo.

43:85.t: Futhi ungcwele lona ubukhosi bamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwawo bungobaKhe futhi nguYena onolwazi lweSikhathi futhi niyobuyela kuYe.

43:86.t: Futhi laba ababakhonzayo ngaphandle kwaKhe abanalo igunya lokushweleza ngaphandle kwalabo abakaza ngeqiniso futhi benolwazi.

43:87.t: Uma ungababuza ukuthi, ngubani obadalile, bayothi: “Ngu Allah”; pho badukiswa kanjani na?

43:88.t: Futhi kuyothiwa: “Nkosi yami, impela laba ngabantu abangakholwa”.

44:3.t: Impela siyembulele ngobusuku obubusisekile; ukuze impela sixwayise.

44:6.t: Kungumusa ovela eNkosini yakho; impela Yona ingiZwayo Owaziyo.

44:7.t: IyiNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwazo, uma ngempela ninganakungabaza.

44:8.t: Akekho omunye ofanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaYo; iYona eletha ukuphila nokufa; iNkosi yenu neNkosi yokhokho benu basendulo.

44:10.t: Lindela usuku lapho isibhakabhaka siyoba nentuthu uqobo.

44:12.t: [Bayothi]: “Nkosi yethu, susa isijeziso kithi ngokuba sesiyakholwa”.

44:13.t: Balalele kanjani ngoba safika iSithunywa esicacisayo kubo…

44:15.t: Impela Thina singasisusa isijeziso kancane; kepha nina niyobuyela emuva [ningakholwa].

44:16.t: Ngosuku lapho siyogxavula khona ukugxavula okunzima, siyobe siziphindiselela.

44:17.t: Futhi savivinya phambilini kwabo abantu bakaFirawuni futhi neSithunywa esihloniphekile safika kubo.

44:18.t: [Sathi]: “Letha kimi izigqila zika Allah; impela mina ngiyiSithunywa esithembekile kini”.

44:19.t: Futhi ungaziqhayisi ku Allah; impela ngizonilethela ubufakazi obucacile.

44:20.t: Futhi ngizivikela ngeNkosi yami neNkosi yenu ekutheni ningikhande kamatshe.

44:22.t: Wakhuleka eNkosini yakhe wathi: “Impela laba ngabantu abayizephula mthetho”.

44:23.t: Wathi [u Allah]: “Hamba nezigqila zami ebusuku; impela niyolandelwa”.

44:24.t: Futhi uyekele ulwandle lunjalo [luvulekile] ngoba bayibutho eliyocwiliswa.

44:28.t: Kanjalo nje; sabe sesizidlulisela kwabanye abantu.

44:29.t: Futhi isibhakabhaka nomhlaba akuzange kubalilele futhi abanikwanga ithuba.

44:30.t: Impela sasihlenga isizwe sakwa Isirayeli esijezisweni esihlazayo.

44:32.t: Futhi sabaqoka sazi kahle endalweni yonke.

44:35.t: Sifa kanye nje kuphela futhi asiphinde sivuswe.

44:36.t: Lethani okhokho bethu uma ngempela niqinisile.

44:37.t: Ingabe bona bangcono yini kunesizwe sika Tuba’ nalabo ababengaphambilini kwaso na?; sababhubhisa, impela babeyizephula mthetho.

44:38.t: Futhi asidalanga amazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi sizidlalela.

44:39.t: Sikudale ngeqiniso, kodwa iningi labo alazi.

44:40.t: Impela uSuku lokwahlulela isikhathi ababekelwe sona bonke.

44:41.t: Usuku lapho isihlobo singeke sasiza esinye isihlobo ngalutho futhi akekho oyobasiza.

44:42.t: Ngaphandle kwaloyo u Allah ayomhawukela; impela Yena unguSomandla Onesihawu.

44:48.t: Bese nimthela ekhanda lakhe ngesijeziso samanzi abilayo.

44:51.t: Impela abathobela u Allah bayoba sendaweni ephephile.

44:53.t: Bayogqoka usilika obushelelezi nosindayo bahlale babhekane.

44:55.t: Bayofuna kuzo yonke inhlobo yesithelo bekhululekile.

44:56.t: Angeke baphinde bezwe ukufa kuzo ngaphandle kokufa kokuqala [emhlabeni] futhi iNkosi yabo iyobavikela esijezisweni somlilo.

44:57.t: Umusa ovela eNkosini yakho; lokho iyona impumelelo enkulu.

44:58.t: Futhi siyenze yabalula ngolwimi lwakho ukuze bathathe isifundo.

45:2.t: [Lesi] isambulelo seNcwadi [iKurani] evela ku Allah onguSomandla Okhaliphile.

45:3.t: Impela emazulwini nasemhlabeni kunezibonakaliso kulabo abakholwayo.

45:4.t: Nasekudalweni kwenu imbala futhi nakuzilwane azisabalalisile kunezibonakaliso kubantu abanesiqiniseko.

45:5.t: Nasekuphambaneni kobusuku nemini futhi nakulokho u Allah akwehlisa phezulu okuyisondlo [imvula] avuselela ngakho umhlaba emuva kokufa kwawo nanekuhambeni kwemimoya, kunezibonakaliso kubantu abaqondayo.

45:6.t: Leyo imibiko ka Allah esikufundela yona ngeqiniso; ngakhoke iyona yiphi inkulumo abazoyikholwa emuva kuka Allah nemibiko yaKhe.

45:7.t: Imbubhiso kuwo wonke umuntu oqamba amanga aluhlaza ophambukile.

45:8.t: Uzwa imibiko ka Allah efundelwa yona bese eqhubeka nokuqhayisa ngathi akazange ayizwe; mhalalisele ngesijeziso esibuhlungu.

45:9.t: Uma kukhona okuthile akwazi ngemibiko yeThu, ukwenza inhlekisa. Labo bayothola isijeziso esihlazayo.

45:10.t: Ngaphambi kwabo [bamelwe] iJahanamu; futhi konke [okuwumcebo] abakuzuzile ngeke kubasize ngalutho, kanjalo nalokho abaziqokele kona njengabahlengi ngaphandle kuka Allah; futhi bayothola isijeziso esinzima.

45:11.t: Lokhu [iKurani] ukuholelwa; futhi labo abangakholwa yimibiko yeNkosi yabo bayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu esibi impela.

45:12.t: U Allah nguYena onijubele ulwandle ukuze umkhumbi uhambe kulo ngokomyalelo waKhe nokuthi nithungathe umusa waKhe ukuze nibonge.

45:13.t: Futhi wanijubela konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni ngokwaKhe; impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abahlaziyayo.

45:14.t: Tshela laba abakholwayo ukuba baxolele labo abangakholelwa ezinsukwini [zezehlakalo] zika Allah, ukuze anikeze abantu umvuzo walokho ababekwenza.

45:15.t: Lowo owenza okuhle, uzenzela yena; futhi lowo owenza okubi uzilaya yena; futhi niyobuyela eNkosini yenu.

45:16.t: Futhi sanika isizwe sakwa Isirayeli iNcwadi nobuhlakani nobuthunywa saphinde sabahlinzeka ngokudla okumsulwa sabaqoka endalweni yonke [ngaleso sikhathi].

45:17.t: Sabanika imiyalelo ecacile; kepha baphikisana emuva kokuba sebethole ulwazi ngenxa yokuzondana phakathi kwabo.

45:18.t: Futhi sakuqokela wena [Muhamadi] inqubo mgomo; ngakhoke landela yona ungalandeli izinkanuko zalabo abangenalwazi.

45:19.t: Impela abasoze abkusiza ngalutho ku Allah. Futhi abaphambukile, abanye bangabangane kubanye; kepha u Allah ungumngani walabo abamthobelayo.

45:20.t: Lokhu [iKurani] kuwumhlahlandlela kubantu nokuholeka nomusa kubantu abanesiqiniseko.

45:21.t: Ingabe laba abenza izimpambuko bacabanga ukuthi siyobenza bafane nalabo abakholwayo abenza okulungileyo, abaphilayo kubo nabangasekho na? Yaze yayiyimbi indlela abahlulela ngayo.

45:22.t: Futhi u Allah udale amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso, nokuthi wonke umuntu athole umvuzo walokho akwenzile ngoku nobulungiswa.

45:23.t: Uyambona yini lona oseqoke izinkanuko zakhe kwaba yizo azikhonzayo, futhi u Allah wamdukisa – esenolwazi – wavala ukuzwa kwakhe nenhliziyo yakhe, wamboza amehlo akhe; ingabe ukhona yini ongamhola emuva kuka Allah na? Kungani ningathathi isifundo na?

45:24.t: Futhi bathi: “Cha, impilo yethu yasemhlabeni, siyafa siphile; isikhathi kuphela esiyosibhubhisa”. Abanalwazi ngalokho, bamane baziqagulela.

45:25.t: Uma befundelwa imibiko yeThu ecacile, elabo abambelela kulo elokuthi bathi: “Siletheleni okhokho bethu uma ngempela niqinisile”.

45:26.t: Yithi: “Ngu Allah onipha impilo aphinde aniphuce yona futhi nguYe oyonibuthanisa ngosuku lokwahlulela olungengatshazwe; kodwa abantu abaningi abazi”.

45:27.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni ngokuka Allah; futhi ngosuku lapho iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] sifika, abaqambimanga bayolahlekelwa ngalolo suku.

45:28.t: Futhi uyobona zonke izizwe ziguqile; isizwe nesizwe siyobizelwa encwadini yaso [yezenzo]; [kuthiwe]: “Namhlanje nizonikezwa umvuzo walokho ebenikwenza”.

45:29.t: Lena incwadi yeThu ikhuluma iqiniso ngani; impela besikuqopha konke ebenikwenza.

45:30.t: Laba abakholwayo abenza nokulungileyo, iNkosi yabo izobangenisa emseni waYo; iyonake leyo impumelelo esobala.

45:31.t: Kuthi laba abangakholwa, [kuthiwe kubo]: “Kanti beningafundelwa yini imibiko Yami, kepha naziqhayisa futhi naningabantu abayizephula mthetho”.

45:32.t: Uma kuthiwa kubo, “impela isithembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso futhi neSikhathi akuna kungabaza ngaso”. Nithi: “Asazi ukuthi yini iSikhathi, siyaziqagelela nje futhi asinasiqiniseko”.

45:33.t: Kuyobacacela obala ububi balokho abakwenzile futhi bayohaqwa yilokho abahlekisa ngakho.

45:34.t: Futhi kuyothiwa: “Namhlanje siyanikhohlwa njengoba nani nakhohlwa umhlangano walolu suku lwenu futhi indawo yenu umlilo futhi akekho oyonisiza”.

45:35.t: Lokho kungoba nenza imibiko ka Allah ihlaya nadukiswa impilo yasemhlabeni. Namhlanje, abayikuphuma kuwo [umlilo] futhi abayikunikwa thuba locela intethelelo.

45:36.t: Ngakhoke, udumo lonke ngoluka Allah iNkosi yamazulu neNkosi yomhlaba iNkosi yendalo yonke.

45:37.t: Ubukhulu ngobakhe emazulwini nasemhlabeni futhi unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

46:2.t: [Lesi] isambulelo seNcwadi [iKurani] evela ku Allah onguSomandla Okhaliphile.

46:3.t: Sadala amazulu nomhlaba nokuphakathi kwakho ngeqiniso futhi kuze kube isikhathi esibekiwe. Kepha laba abangakholwa bakushaya indiva lokho abexwayiswa ngakho.

46:4.t: Yithi: “Ake nibheke lokhu enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah; ngitshengiseni ukuthi kudaleni emhlabeni kumbe kunegalelo emazulwini na? Ngiletheleni incwadi eyafika ngaphambi kwalena [iKurani] noma izinsalela zolwazi uma ngempela niqinisile.

46:5.t: Ngubani oduke ukudlula lowo okhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah lokho okungeke kwamphendula kuze kufike usuku lokwahlulela futhi okungazi lutho ngemikhuleko yabo na?

46:6.t: Futhi mhla abantu bebuthaniswa, ziyoba [izikhozwa] izitha zabo futhi bayophika ukuthi zazikhonzwa yibo.

46:7.t: Uma befundelwa imibiko Yethu ecacile. Laba abangakholwa bathi ngeqiniso lapho lifika kubo: “Leli ilumbo elisobala”.

46:8.t: Kumbe bathi, uziqambele yona na? Yithi: “Uma ngiziqambele yona, akukho-ke eningangisiza ngakho ku Allah; nguYena okwazi kahle konke enikushoyo ngayo [iKurani]; Yena wanele njengofakazi phakathi kwani nani futhi Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

46:9.t: Yithi: “Angiyena owokuqala ukuba yiSithunywa futhi angazi ukuthi kuyokwenziwani ngami nokuthi kuyokwenziwani ngani; ngilandela nja lokho okwembulelwa kimi futhi ngingumexwayisi ocacisayo nje kuphela”.

46:10.t: Yithi: “Ake nisho, uma ivela ku Allah bese nina niyayiphika, futhi ufakazi wesizwe sakwa Isirayeli afakaze ngokufana nayo [iKurani] bese ekholwa, kulapho nina niziqhayisa; impela u Allah akabaholi abantu abangenabulungiswa”.

46:11.t: Futhi laba abangakholwa bathi kulabo abakholwayo: “Ukube bekuyinto enhle, ngabe abasifikelanga kuyo kuqala”. Futhi uma bengaholekanga ngayo bazothi: “Lokhu amanga aluhlaza akudala”.

46:12.t: Futhi ngaphambili kwayo kwakuneNcwadi kaMusaeyabe ingumholi nomusa. Futhi leNcwadi iyaqinisekisa, ingolwimi lwesi Arabhu, ukuze labo abaphambukile baxwayiswe kuthi labo abenza okuhle bahalaliselwe.

46:13.t: Impela labo abathi: “iNkosi yethu ngu Allah”, bese baba qotho; abayikuba nakusaba futhi abayikukhathazeka.

46:14.t: Labo bayongena eJana bahlale kuyo unaphakade njengomvuzo walokho ababekwenza.

46:15.t: Futhi sayalela umuntu ukuba aphathe kahle abazali bakhe; phela unina wamthwala kanzima wambeletha kanzima. Futhi ukumthwala kuze kube uyayeka ukuncela, yizinyanga ezingamashumi amathathu. Kuze kuthi uma esekhululile waqina waba neminyaka engamashumi amane, athi: “Nkosi yami, ngiphe Amandla okubonga izibusiso zaKho lezi ongibusise ngazo mina nabazali bami nawokuthi ngikwazi ukwenza okulungileyo okukuthokozisayo futhi ungenzele uzalo lwami lube qotho, impela ngiyazisola kuWe ngicela intethelelo futhi ngongomunye wabazinikela kuWe [amaMusilimu]”.

46:16.t: Yibona labo esiyokwamukela okuhle abakwenzayo futhi sibaxolele amaphutha abo kanye nabanye abayongena eJana; isethembiso seqiniso lesi ababethenjiswe sona.

46:17.t: Futhi lowo othi kubazali bakhe: “hayi suka, nilokhu ningithembisa ukuthi ngiyophinde ngikhishwe [ethuneni], kulapho ziningi izizwe esezadlula ngaphambi kwami” – kepha bona belokhu becela usizo ku Allah – [bathi kuye]: “Kahle bo, kholwa; impela isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso”. Uvele athi: “Lokhu izinganekwane zasemandulo”.

46:18.t: Yibona ke labo abafanelwe isinqumo [sembubhiso]sezizwe esezandlula ngaphambi kwabo, zamajini nabantu; impela balahlekelwa.

46:19.t: Futhi bonke bayoba nezigaba ngokwezenzo zabo; futhi uyobanika umvuzo wezenzo zabo ngokugcwele futhi akukho okungebulungiswa okuyokwenziwa kubo.

46:20.t: Futhi ngosuku lapho laba abangakholwa beyosiwa emlilweni, [kuyothiwa kubo]: “ Niziqede zonke izinto zenu ezimnandi empilweni yasemhlabeni futhi nazi jabulisa ngazo. Ngakhoke namhlanje nizohlonyuliswa ngesijeziso sehlazo ngenxa yokuziqhayisa kwenu emhlabeni ngokungemthetho nangokuphula kwenu umthetho”.

46:21.t: Futhi landisa ngomfawo wesizwe sakwa Adi, mhla exwayisa isizwe sakhe endaweni yase Ahkafu, futhi ziningi izexwayiso esezandlula ngaphambili kwake, ezinye emuva kwakhe [zithi]: “Ningakhonzi lutho ngaphandle kuka Allah, impela nginisabela isijeziso sosuku olukhulu”.

46:22.t: Bathi: “Uze kithi ukuzosisuza ezikhonzweni zethu na? Silethele lokhu olibe usithembisa kona uma ngempela ungoqinisile”.

46:23.t: Wathi: “Ulwazi luku Allah, mina nginidlulisela lokho engithunywe nakho, kodwa nginibona ningabantu abayiziwula”.

46:24.t: Kuthe lapho bebona ifu liza ngasesigodini sabo, bathi: “Lefu lisilethele imvula”. Empeleni yilokhu ebenikujahile, umoya onesijeziso esibuhlungu.

46:25.t: Ubhubhisa yonke into ngokomyalelo weNkosi yawo. Kwasa bengabona ngaphandle nje kwemizi yabo. Sibahlomulisa kanjalo abantu abayizephula mthetho.

46:26.t: Futhi sabapha lokho esinganiphanga nina futhi sabanika ukuzwa [izindlebe] namehlo nezinhliziyo. Kepha ukuzwa kwabo namehlo abo nezinhliziyo zabo akubasizanga ngalutho mhla bephika imibiko Yethu. Futhi bahaqwa yikho konke lokhu abekwenza inhlekisa.

46:27.t: Futhi sabhubhisa imizi enakhelene nayo saphinde sacacisa imibiko ukuze bapheze.

46:28.t: Kungabi kungabasizanga lokhu abakuqoke ngaphandle kuka Allah njengezikhonzwa abazisondeza ngazo [ku Allah] na; empeleni zabadukele. Futhi lokho ngamanga abo aluhlaza nalokho ababekuqamba.

46:29.t: Futhi khumbula mhla siletha kuwe iqulu lamajini ayezolalela iKurani. Kuthe lapho esefikile kuyo, athi: “Thulani”. Kuthe lapho isiqediwe, abuyela emumva ezizweni zawo eyozixwayisa.

46:30.t: Bathi: “Bantu bakithi, impela sizwe iNcwadi eyembulelwe emuva kwaMusa, efakazela lokho okungaphambi kwayo iholela eqinisweni nasendleleni eqondile”.

46:31.t: Bantu bakithi, lalela uMmemi ka Allah futhi nikholelwe kuYe, uyonithethelela izimpambuko zenu aphinde anivikele esijezisweni esibuhlungu.

46:32.t: Lowo ongezukulalela uMmemi ka Allah, akasoze aphunyuka emhlabeni futhi akukho bahlengi ayobathola ngaphandle kuka Allah; labo babekudukeni okusobala.

46:33.t: Ababoni yini ukuthi u Allah nguYena odale amazulu nomhlaba futhi akazange kumehlule ukukudala kulapho unamandla okuvusa abafileyo. Kunjalo, impela akehlulwa yilutho.

46:34.t: Futhi ngosuku labo abangakholwa bayosiwa emlilweni [kuyothiwa kubo]: “Ingabe lokhu akusilona iqiniso na?” Bayothi: “Yilona Nkosi yethu”. Uyothi [u Allah]: “Zwanini isijeziso ngenxa yalokho ebenikuphika”.

46:35.t: Bekezela njengoba zabekezela iZithunywa zeMpokophelo; futhi ungabajahi. Futhi ngosuku lapho bayobona lokho abathenjiswe kona kuyoba ngathi bahlale isikhashana nje sasemini [emhlabeni]. [Lona] umlayezo. Ingabe ukhona obujiswayo ngaphandle kwabantu abayizephula mthetho na?

47:1.t: Labo abangakholwa baphinde babe yizihibe endleleni ka Allah, izenzo zabo zidukile.

47:2.t: Futhi labo abakholwayo abenza nokulungileyo baphinde bakholelwe kulokho okwembulelwe kuMuhamadi okuyiqiniso elivela eNkosini yabo; uyokwesula izimpambuko zabo futhi uyokwenza ngcono isimo sabo.

47:3.t: Lokho kungoba labo abangakholwa balandela umbhedo kuthi laba abakholwayo bona balandela iqiniso elivela eNkosini yabo. U Allah ubenzela kanjalo abantu imizekelo.

47:4.t: Uma nihlangana nalabo abangakholwa [empini], gencani imiqala, uma senibalimazile [baba buthaka] babopheni; ningabadedela mahala noma nibakhokhise inhlawulo kuze kuba impi iyaphela. Lowo [umyalelo]. Futhi ukube u Allah ubethanda ubezoqeda ngabo; kodwa bekungoba ufuna ukuvivinya abanye benu ngabanye. Futhi labo [abakholwayo] ababulawe endleleni ka Allah, izenzo zabo azisoze zachitheka.

47:5.t: Uzobahola futhi enze ngcono isimo sabo.

47:6.t: Futhi uyobangenisa eJana lena abazobazisa yona kahle.

47:7.t: Nina enikholwayo, uma nisiza u Allah [ngokusiza inkolo yaKhe], naYe uyonisiza futhi aqinise nezinyawo zenu.

47:8.t: Futhi laba abangakholwa bayobhujiswa futhi izenzo zabo [ezinhle] ayozenza ize.

47:9.t: Lokho, kunganxa yokuthi abakuthandanga lokho okwembulelwe ngu Allah, ngakhoke wenza imisebenzi yabo yangaba namvuzo.

47:10.t: Ingabae abahambi yini emhlabeni, babheke ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salabo ababandulelayo; u Allah wababhubhisa, futhi laba abangakholwa bayothola okufanayo.

47:11.t: Lokho ngungenxa yokuthi u Allah unguMnakekeli walabo abakholwayo kanti laba abangakholwa abanaye umnakekeli.

47:12.t: Impela u Allah uyongenisa labo abakholwayo abenza nokulungileyo ezivandeni okugeleza imifula ngaphansi kwazo. Futhi laba abangakholwa bayancebeleka futhi badla njengezilwane; futhi umlilo yilapho beyophelela khona.

47:13.t: Futhi ziningi izizwe ezazinamandla ukudlula isizwe sakho [Muhamadi] lesi esakuxoshsa, esazibhubhisa; akuzange kube khona owayengazisiza.

47:14.t: Ingabe lowo onokucaciseleka okuvela eNkosini yakhe uyefana yini nalowo owenzele muhle ububi bezenzo zakhe futhi olandela izinkanuko zakhe na?

47:15.t: Ukuchaza iJana lena ethenjiswe labo abathobela u Allah: inemifula yamanzi angaguquki nemifula yobisi ukunambitheka kwalo okungaguquki nemifula yotshwala obumnandi kulabo abaphuzayo nemifula yoju olumsulwa; futhi kuyo bayothola yonke inhlobo yezithelo nentethelelo evela eNkosini yabo. Ingabe bayafana yini nalabo abayobhadla emlilweni unaphakade baphinde baphuziswe amanzi abilayo adabula amathumbu abo na?

47:16.t: Futhi kunalabo kubo abakulalelayo, kuthi lapho besuka kuwe bathi kulabo abanikwe ulwazi: “Usetheni mva nje?” Yibona kanye labo u Allah avale izinhliziyo zabo futhi balandela izinkanuko zabo.

47:17.t: Futhi laba abaholelekile uyobandisela ukuholeleka aphinde abanike amandla okuthi bakwazi ukumthobela.

47:18.t: Ingabe balindele iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] ukuba sifike kubo bengazelele na?; impela izinkomba zaso sezifikile; bayokhumbula kanjani lapho sesifikile kubo.

47:19.t: Iba nolwazi lokuthi akekho ofanele ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah, futhi ucele intethelelo yezimpambuko zakho, ucelele nabakholwayo besilisa nesifazane intethelelo. u Allah wazi kahle ukuthi nenzani emini nasebusuku.

47:20.t: Futhi labo abakholwayo bathi: “Kwangathi kungembulelwa isahluko”, kuthi lapho sesambulelwe isahluko esichazwe kahle kwabalulwa kuso ukulwa impi; ubona labo abanesifo ezinhlizweni zabo bekubheka okumuntu oqulekayo esaba ukufa. Obekufanele kubo…

47:21.t: Ukuba balalele futhi basho amagama amukelekile. Uma udaba selunqunyiwe [lokuphaka impi], ukube baba neqiniso ku Allah, kwakuyoba yikona okungcono kubo.

47:22.t: Ingabe emuva kokushaya indiva [imibiko yeKurani nezimfundiso zeSithunywa], nizokwenza ukunokala emhlabeni niqede nobuhlo bemindeni yenu na?

47:23.t: Labo, yibona kanye u Allah abaqalekisile, wabenza izimumu nezimpumputhe.

47:24.t: Kungani bengajuli bayihlaziye iKurani kumbe kunezihluthulelo ezinhlizweni na?

47:25.t: Impela labo abafulathelayo badikile emuva kokuba iqiniso selibacacele, nguShayitani obayengayo nobalayelayo.

47:26.t: Lokho, ngungenxa yokuthi bathi kulabo abazonda lokhu okwembulelwe ngu Allah: “Sizolalela kwezinye izinto”. Futhi u Allah uzazi kahle izimfihlo zabo.

47:27.t: Kuyoba njani mhla izingelosi sezithatha imiphefumulo yabo, zibashaya ebusweni nasemihlane yabo.

47:28.t: Lokho ngungenxa yokuthi balandela lokho okuthukuthelisa u Allah futhi bangakufuna ukumjabulisa, wase wenza izenzo ize.

47:29.t: Ingabe laba abanesifo ezinhlizweni zabo bacabanga ukuthi u Allah akasoze azikhipha ukungcola kwabo na?

47:30.t: Futhi uma sithanda besingakubonisa bona; futhi ubuyobazi ngezimpawu zabo nangendlela yenkulumo. Futhi u Allah uzazi kahle izenzo zabo.

47:31.t: Futhi siyolokhu sinivivnya size sazi labo abazikhandlayo [empini] phakathi kwenu nalabo abababekezelayo futhi sizonivivinya nasezenzweni zenu.

47:32.t: Impela labo abangakholwa abayizihibe endleleni ka Allah nabaphambana neSithunywa emuva kokuba iqiniso selibacacele, abasoze bamlimaza ngalutho u Allah futhi uyozisula izenzo zibe yize.

47:33.t: Nina enikholwayo, lalelani u Allah nolalele neSithunywa ningachithi izenzo zenu.

47:34.t: Impela labo abangakholwa nabayizihibe endleleni ka Allah bese befa besase ngabangakholwa, u Allah akasoze abathethelela.

47:35.t: Ningapheli amandla bese nihlongoza ukubeka phansi izikhali kube kuyinina eningaphezulu kulapho no Allah unani futhi akasoze aniqila ngomvuzo wezenzo zenu.

47:36.t: Impilo yasemhlabeni iwukudlala nokuchitha isikhathi. Uma nikholwa nithobele u Allah; uyoninika umvuzo wenu futhi akaniceli mcebo wenu.

47:37.t: Uma enganicela wona aniphoqelele; niyongoqa bese eveza ukungcola kwenu.

47:38.t: Yini futhi laba uma nibizwa ukuba nozonikela endleleni ka Allah, kunalabo phakathi kwenu abangongoqo. Futhi lowo ongungoqo uzincitsha yena uqobo. U Allah uzimele kepha nina niyichaka. Uma ninganendaba nigazihluphi uyobeka abanye abantu esikhundleni senu bese bengafani nani.

48:2.t: Ukuze u Allah akuthethelele izimpambuko zakho zaphambilini nezakusasa nokuthi aphelelelise izibusiso zaKhe kuwe aphinde akuholele endleleni eqondile.

48:3.t: Nokuthi u Allah akusize ngosizo olunamandla.

48:4.t: Nguyena lona owehlisela uzinzo ezinhlizweni zalabo abakholwayo ukuze bengeze ukholo phezu kokholo abanalo. Futhi u Allah unebutho lasemazulwini nasemhlabeni. Futhi impela u Allah ungoWaziyo Okhaliphile.

48:5.t: Ukuze angenise abakholwayo besilisa nesifazane ezivandeni okugeleza imifula ngezansi kwazo, bayohlala kuzo unaphakade; futhi uyokwesula izimpambuko zabo. Futhi lokho ku Allah iyona mpumelelo enkulu.

48:6.t: Nokuthi ajezise abazenzisi besilisa nabesifazane nabakhonzi bezithixo abesilisa nabesifazane, labo abanemindlizo emibi ngo Allah – ububi buzungeza bona – futhi u Allah ubathukuthelele wabaqalekisa waphinde wabalungiselela iJahanamu; saze sasibi isiphetho.

48:7.t: Futhi u Allah unebutho lasemazulwini nasemhlabeni; futhi impela uAllah unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

48:8.t: Impela sikuthumele ukuba ube ufakazi nomethuli wezindaba ezinhle nomexwayisi.

48:9.t: Ukuze nikholelwe ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe niphinde nimsekele nimhloniphe futhi nimdumise ekuseni nantambama.

48:10.t: Impela labo abenza isibopho sokwethembeka kuwe; empeleni benza isibopho sokwethembeka ku Allah, iSandla sika Allah siphezu kwezandla zabo. Lowo- ke oyesephula uziphulela yena uqobo. Kepha lowo oyogcina lokho azibophezele ngakho ku Allah, uyomnika umvuzo omkhulu.

48:11.t: Labo abasalela emuva [bangaya empini] abasemaphandleni bayothi: “Sixinwe impahla yethu nemindeni yethu, ngakhoke sicelele intethelelo” – basho ngemilomo yabo lokho okungekho ezinhlizweni zabo. Yithi: “Ubani oyonisiza ku Allah uma efuna ukuba nehlelwe ubunzima noma nisizakale na?, empeleni u Allah unolwazi ngalokho enikwenzayo”.

48:12.t: Empeleni benicabanga ukuthi iSithunywa nabakholwayo abasoze baphinde babuyele emindenini yabo futhi lokho kwazinza ezinhlizweni zenu naphinde naba nemindlizo emibi naba ngabantu abangenakho okuhle.

48:13.t: Futhi lowo ongakholelwa ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe; impela thina silungiselele abangakholwa umlilo.

48:14.t: Futhi umbuso wasemazulwini nasemhlabeni ungoka Allah. Uthethelela amthandayo aphinde ajezise amthandayo. Futhi u allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

48:15.t: Uma seniya ukuthotha izimpango zempi, laba absalela emuva bayothi: “Siyekeni sinilandele”. Bafuna ukuguqula Amazwi ka Allah. Yithi: “Anisoze nasilandela, usho njalo u Allah ngaphambilini”. Bayothi: “Empeleni nisidlela umona”. Vele abaqondi lutho ngaphandle nje kokungatheni.

48:16.t: Yithi kulabo abasalela emuva kwabasemaphandleni: “Maduze nje nizobizelwa kubantu abantu abalwa ngamandla ukuze nilwe nabo noma bazinikele [ngaphandle kwempi]. Uma nilalela, u Allah uyoninika umvuzo omuhle; kepha uma nibalela njengoba nabaleka phambilini, uzonijezisa ngesijeziso esibuhlungu”.

48:17.t: Akunacala kulowo oyimpumputhe noyinquge nogulayo [uma besala bengayi empini]. Futhi lowo oyothobela u Allah neSithunywa saKhe, uzomngenisa ezivandeni okugeleza imifula ngezansi kwazo. Kepha lowo oyobaleka [ashaye indiva], uzomjezisa ngesijeziso esibuhlungu.

48:18.t: U Allah wathokoza ngabakholwayo mhla benza isibopho sokuthembeka kuwe ngaphansi kwesihlahla. Futhi wakwazi lokho okusezinhlizweni zabo, wabe esebehlisela uzinzo futhi wabahlomulisa ngokunqoba [iMakha] okwasekuseduze.

48:19.t: Nangezimpango zempi eziningi abazozishaqa. Futhi u Allah impela unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

48:20.t: U Allah unithembise izimpango eziningi enizozishaqa; lezi unisheshisele zona futhi wanivikela ezandleni zabantu [ukuba banihlasela]; ukuze [lokho] kube isibonakaliso kwabakholwayo waphinde waniholela endleleni eqondile.

48:21.t: Kunezinye eningakwazi ukuzithola, ngu Allah ozaziyo; futhi u Allah akahlula yilutho.

48:22.t: Uma laba abangakholwa bengalwa nani, bayobaleka futhi ngeke bathole mhlengi noma umsizi.

48:23.t: Lena inkambiso ka Allah kusukela kudala; futhi awusoze wathola ilalela lenkambiso ka Allah.

48:24.t: Futhi nguYena owabanqanda wanqanda nani [kwangaqubuka impi] maphakathi kwase Makha emuva kokuba enenze nabanqoba; futhi u Allah uyakubona konke enikwenzayo.

48:25.t: Yibona kanye abangakholwa nabaninqabela ukungena eMasijidi Haramu kulapho umhlatshelo ulindele ukufinyelela endaweni yawo. Ukube kwakungekho ngenxa yamadoda nabafazi abakholwayo eningabazi ebeningahle nibanyathele, bese ningena empambukweni nasehlazweni ningazi – [unenze nabanqoba] ukuze angenise amthandayo emseni waKhe – futhi ukube babehlukaniseka, u Allah wayezobajezisa labo abangakholwa phakathi kwabo ngesijeziso esibuhlungu.

48:26.t: Mhla [u Allah] efaka inkani ezinhlizweni zalaba abangakholwa, inkani yobuwula; u Allah wabe esehlisela uzinzo kuSithunywa saKhe nakulabo abakholwayo futhi wabayalela ngamazwi okuthobela u Allah; futhi kwakuyibona okumele bawathole futhi ayefanele bona. Impela u Allah wazi zonke izinto.

48:27.t: Impela u Allah walenza lafezeka ngeqiniso iphupho kuSithunywa saKhe. Nizongena eMasijidi Haramu – uma u Allah evuma – niphephile niphuce amakhanda noma niphungulile ningesabi lutho. Wazi lokhu nina eningakwazi, ngakhoke wahlela ukunqoba okuseduze ngaphambi kwalokho.

48:28.t: NguYena lona owathumela iSithunywa saKhe nobuholi nenkolo yeqiniso ukuze ayidlondlobalise ngaphezu kwazo zoke izinkolo; futhi ungufakazi owenele.

48:29.t: uMuhamadi isithunywa sika Allah. Futhi labo abanaye abanazwelo kulabo abangakholwa kepha banobele ngaphakathi. Ubabona bekhotheme bewe ngobuso phansi belangazelele umusa ovela ku Allah nenjabulo. Izimpawu zabo zisebusweni babo ngenxa yokuwa phansi ngobuso. Leyo indlela abachazwe ngayo kwiTora. Bese kuthi kwi Ininjili bachazwe njengesitshalo esikhipha ihlumela laso silisekele size siqine sime siqonde esiqwini saso, sithokozise abatshali ukuze athukuthelise abangakholwa ngabo. U Allah uthembise laba abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo phakathi kwabo intethelelo nomvuzo omkhulu.

49:1.t: Nina enikholwayo, ningahambeli u Allah neSithunywa saKhe phambili, futhi nithobele u Allah; impela u Allah Ungozwayo Owaziyo.

49:2.t: Nina enikholwayo ningaphakamisi amazwi ngaphezu kwezwi leSithunywa futhi ningakhulumeli phezulu lapho nikhuluma naso njengendlela abanye benu ababanga ngayo umsindo uma bekhuluma nabanye benu; funa izenzo zenu [ezinhle] zishabalale ningaboni.

49:3.t: Impela labo abehlisa amazwi abo ngaphambi kweSithunywa sika Allah, yibona kanye labo u Allah ahlanze izinhliziyo zabo kwangena ukumthobela; bayothola intethelelo nomvuzo omkhulu.

49:4.t: Impela labo abakumemeza bengale kwamagumbi, iningi labo aliphusile.

49:5.t: Ukube babekezelile waze waphuma waya kubo, bekuyoba ngcono kubo lokho. Futhi u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

49:6.t: Nina enikholwayo, uma isephula mthetho sethula kini udaba, kumele nilucubungule niluqinisekise, funa nihlasele abantu ngephutha bese niyazisola ngenikwenzile.

49:7.t: Futhi yazini ukuthi phakathi kwenu kuneSithunywa sika Allah; ukube besinilalela ezintweni eziningi besiyongena empambukweni. Kepha u Allaha unenze nathanda ukholo futhi walenza luhle ezinhlizweni zenu futhi wanenza nakuzonda ukungakholwa nokuphula umthetho nokweyisa. Labo basendleni eqondile.

49:8.t: Umusa ovela ku Allah nezibusiso; futhi u Allah Uyazi Ukhaliphile.

49:9.t: Uma amaqembu amabili amaMusilimu elwa; walamuleni kube nokubuyisana phakathi kwawo. Uma elilodwa lawo lihlasela elinye, yilwani nalaleli elihlaselayo lize libuyele emthethweni ka Allah. Uma libuyela, walamuleni kube nokubuyisana phakathi kwawo ngobulungiswa. Futhi nibe nobulungiswa ngokuba u Allah uyabathanda abanobulungiswa.

49:10.t: Impela abakholwayo bangabozalo; ngakhoke phathanani kahle nabozalo lwenu futhi nithobele u Allah ukuze nihawukelwe.

49:11.t: Nina enikholwayo, amadoda mawangenzi amanye amadoda inhlekisa hleze angcono kunabo. Kanjalo nabafazi mabangenzi abanye abafazi inhlekisa hleze bangcono kunabo. Futhi ningagconani, ningabizani futhi ngamagama amabi; libi kabi igama elihlambalazayo emuva kokholo. Labo abangaphezi bazisole; yibona kanye abaphambukile.

49:12.t: Nina enikholwayo, ziqhelisaneni kakhulu nemindlizo, impela eminye yemindlizo iyimpambuko. Ningahlolani futhi ningahlebani. Ingabe omunye wenu angathanda yini ukudla inyama yesidumbu somnewabo na? – nakanjani ngeke nikuthande – futhi thobelani u Allah; impela u Allah Uyathethelela Unesihawu.

49:13.t: Nina sintu, impela sinidale ngowelisa oyedwa nowesimame oyedwa [uyihlo u Adamu nonyoko uHawa], sase sinenza izizwe nezizwana ukuze nazane. Impela okunguyena ohloniphekile ku Allah phakathi yilowo omthobela ukunidlula nonke. Impela u Allah Uyazi Unolwazi.

49:14.t: Owasemaphandleni wathi: “Siyakholwa”. Yithi: “Anikakakholwa kodwa anibothi, ‘sizinikele’, ngokuba ukholo alukangeni ezinhlizweni zenu. Futhi uma nilalela u Allah neSithunywa saKhe, angeke nilahlekelwe lutho ezenzweni zenu [ezinhle nomvuzo wazo]. Impela u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

49:15.t: Okuyibona impela abakholwayo, yilabo abakholelwa ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe bese bengabi nokungabaza. Baphinde bazikhandle [ngokulwa] endleleni ka Allah ngemicebo yabo nangabo ziqu zabo uqobo; labo yibona abaneqiniso.

49:16.t: Yithi: “Ingabe nifunda u Allah ngenkolo yenu na? kulapho u Allah azi konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni. Futhi u Allah wazi ngayo yonke into”.

49:17.t: Bakushwalela ngokuthi babe ngamaMusilimu. Yithi: “Ningangishabuleli mina ngeIsilamu yenu. Kepha ngu Allah onenzele umusa ngokuholela okholweni, uma ngempela nineqiniso.

49:18.t: Impela u Allah wazi okungabonwayo emazulwini nasemhlabeni; futhi u Allah ukubona konke enikwenzayo.

50:2.t: Empeleni bamangazwe ukuthi kufike kubo umexwayisi ongomunye wabo, bathi laba abangakholwa: “Lesi isimanga sento”.

50:3.t: Ingabe uma sesifile saba inhlabathi [siyophinde sibuyele esimeni]; lokho ukubuya okusekudeni.

50:4.t: Impela sikwaze kahle lokho umhlaba okucuyayo kubo; futhi sineNcwadi elondloziwe.

50:5.t: Empeleni baphike iqiniso selifike kubo; baphithene.

50:6.t: Abasiboni yini isibhakabhaka ngaphezu kwabo ukuthi sisakhe kanjani sasihlobisa futhi asinambobo.

50:7.t: Nomhlaba siwundlalile safaka kuwo izikhonkwane [izintaba] futhi sakhiqiza kuwo yonke inhlobo enhle yesitshalo.

50:8.t: Ukuze kube imvulamehlo nesikhumbuzo kuleso naleso sigqila esizithobayo.

50:9.t: Futhi sehlise amanzi emvula abusisekile, sakhulisa ngawo izivande nezinhlamvu ezivunwayo.

50:11.t: Ukuze kube yisondlo kuzigqila. Saphinde savuselela ngawo [amanzi] indawo efile. Futhi nokuvuswa [kwabafileyo] kuyobanjalo.

50:12.t: Ngaphambi kwabo, isizwe sika Nuhu nabantu base Rasi [umthombo] nabakwa Tamudi zaphika.

50:13.t: Kanjalo nabakwa Adi noFirawuni nabafowabo baka Luti.

50:14.t: Nabantu bezivande [eMadiyana] nesizwe sika Tuba’. Bonke abazikholwanga iZithunywa, bafanelwa isijeziso.

50:15.t: Ingabe sehluleka yini ukudala okokuqala na?; empeleni bona banongabazana mayela nokudalwa kabusha [ukuvukeni kwabafileyo].

50:16.t: Sadala umuntu futhi siyakwazi lokho izinkanuko zakhe ezimhlebela kona; phela siseduze kuye ukudlula umthambo wakhe.

50:17.t: Lapho abaqophi ababili beqopha behleli ngakwesokunene nangakwesonxele.

50:18.t: Noma iyiphi inkulumo ayishoyo kunengqapheli enaye kuyo yonke indawo.

50:19.t: Bafika ubunzima bokufa ngeqiniso. Yilokho obuzama ukukubalekela.

50:20.t: Kuyoshaywa uphondo, lolo kuyobe kuwusuku oluthenjisiwe.

50:21.t: Wonke umuntu uzoza ehamba nomelusi nofakazi.

50:22.t: Ubukade ungakulindele lokhu [usasemhlabeni]; isithiyo sakho sisisusile, ngakhoke namhlanje ukubona kwakho kubukhali.

50:23.t: Ingqapheli yakhe [eqophayo] iyothi: “lokhu okukimi kumi ngomumu”.

50:24.t: [Kuyothiwa kuzingelosi ezimbili]: “Jikijelani eJahanamu lowo nalowo ongakholwa onekhanda eliqinile”.

50:26.t: Lona obhangqe u Allah nesinye isikhonzwa. Mjikijeleni esijezisweni esinzima.

50:27.t: Umngani wakhe [ongumdukisi] uyothi: “Nkosi yethu, akumina engimdukisile kepha nguyena vele obesekudukeni okujulile”.

50:28.t: Uyothi [u Allah]: “Ningalokhu niphikisana la phambi kwaMi, kade nganithumela isexwayiso phambilini”.

50:29.t: Isinqumo asiguquki kiMi futhi angisoze ngenza okungebulungiswa kusigqila.

50:30.t: Ngosuku lapho siyothi kwi Jahanamu: “Ingabe usugcwele na?”. Iyothi: “Bakhona abaseza na?”.

50:31.t: Futhi iJana iyosondezwa eduze kwalabo abathobela u Allah.

50:32.t: Lokhu yikona okuthenjiswe kulowo nalowo ozilahlayo noqaphelayo [imiyalelo ka Allah].

50:33.t: Lowo osaba Onomusa engamboni futhi oyofika nenhliziyo ezisolayo.

50:35.t: Bayothola abakuthandayo kuyo futhi sinokunye okungaphezulu.

50:36.t: Ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo ezazinamandla ukudlula bona, balizulazula izwe; ingabe ukhona owaphunyuka na?

50:37.t: Impela kulokho kunesikhumbuzo kulowo onenhliziyo eqondayo nolalelisayo futhi onakayo.

50:38.t: Futhi sadala amazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwakho ezinsukwini eziyisithupha futhi asizange sikhathale.

50:39.t: Ngakhoke kubekezelele lokho abakushoyo; ubabaze udumo lweNkosi yakho ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga nangaphambi kokuba lishone.

50:41.t: Futhi lalela ngosuku lapho ummemezi eyomemeza endaweni eseduzane.

50:42.t: Ngosuku lapho beyozwa umsindo [wophondo] ngeqiniso. Lolo usuku lokhuphuma [emathuneni].

50:43.t: Impela Thina siletha ukuphila siphinde sikuthathe futhi isiphetho sikithi.

50:44.t: Ngosuku lapho umhlaba uyoqhekeka ubavulekele baphume beshesha; lokho ukubuthanisa okulula kithi.

50:45.t: Thina sikwazi kahle abakushoyo, futhi wena awuphoqi muntu kubo; ngakhoke khumbuza ngeKurani lowo osaba isexwayiso saMi.

51:15.t: Impela abathobela u Allah bayongena ezivandeni nasemithonjeni.

51:16.t: Bayothatha lokho iNkosi yabo ebapha kona. Impela bona ngaphambi kwalokho babenza okuhle.

51:19.t: Futhi nasemicebeni yabo kwakunesabelo socelayo nongaceli.

51:22.t: Naphezulu kunesondlo senu nalokho enithenjiswe kona.

51:23.t: Ngiyifunge iNkosi yezulu nomhlaba, impela iyiqiniso [iKurani] njengoba nani nikwazi ukukhuluma.

51:24.t: Ifikile kuwe yini indaba yezivakashi zika Ibhirahimu ezihloniphekile.

51:25.t: Mhla zingena kuye, zathi, “ukuthula”. Wathi: “Ukuthula [kini] bantu abangaziwa.

51:26.t: Waya emndenini wakhe wabuya nethole elinonile [elosiwe].

51:28.t: Waqala ukubesaba. Zathi: “Cha, ungesabi”, bamhalalisela ngomfana onolwazi.

51:29.t: Umkakhe weza ememeza wazishaya ubuso wathi: “Isalukazi esiyinyumba?”

51:30.t: Zathi: “isho kanjalo iNkosi yakho, impela Yona Ikhaliphile Inolwazi”.

51:31.t: Wathi [u Ibhirahimu]: “Luthini udaba lwenu zithunywa na?”

51:36.t: Futhi asithongala ndlu yamaMusilimu ngaphandle kweyodwa vo.

51:37.t: Sashiya futhi kuyo isibonakaliso kulabo abasaba isijeziso esibuhlungu.

51:38.t: Naku Musa [kunezifundo] mhla simthumela kuFirawuni nobufakazi obucacile.

51:39.t: Wakushaya indiva nebutho lakhe wathi: “Ungumlumbi noma uwuhlanya].

51:40.t: Samjezisa yena Kanye nebutho lakhe, sabantshingela emanzini egxekwa.

51:41.t: Nakwa Adi, mhla sibathumelela ngomoya ongenasibusiso.

51:42.t: Yonke into owayifica wayenza yaba ngathi kade yabuna yoma.

51:43.t: Nakwa Tamudi, mhla kuthiwa kubo: “Nethezekani okwesikhashana”.

51:44.t: Kepha baphula umthetho weNkosi yabo, base behlaselwa umsindo [wembubhiso] bebhekile.

51:46.t: Futhi [sabhubhisa] isizwe sikaNuhu ngaphambilini; impela babengabantu abaphula umthetho.

51:47.t: Futhi isibhakabhaka sisidale ngamandla futhi siyakwazi ukusinweba.

51:49.t: Futhi yonke into siyidale yaba ngakubili ukuze nilalele.

51:50.t: Balekani nibuyele ku Allah; impela mina ngingumexwayisi ocacisayo kini ovela kuYe.

51:51.t: Futhi ningabhangqi esinye isikhonzwa no Allah; impela mina ngingumexwayisi ocacisayo kini ovela kuYe.

51:52.t: Njalo nje uma iSithunywa sifika kulabo abangaphambilini kwabo, babevele bathi: “Ungumlumbi noma uwuhlanya”.

51:53.t: Ingabe bayelulekana ngakho na? Empeleni bangabantu abangamahlongandlebe.

51:55.t: Futhi khumbuza, ngokuba ukukhumbuza kuyabasiza abakholwayo.

51:56.t: Futhi angiwadalelanga lutho amajini kanye nabantu ngaphandle kokuthi bakhonze Mina kuphela.

51:57.t: Angifuni sondlo kubo futhi angifuni ukuthi bangondle.

51:58.t: Impela u Allah nguYena uMondli onamandla Ongenakunyakaziswa.

51:59.t: Impela labo abaphambukile banezimpambuko ezifana nezozakwabo [basendulo], ngakhoke mabangajahi.

51:60.t: Imbubhiso kulabo abangakholwa ngosuku lolu abathenjiswe lona.

52:7.t: Impela isijeziso esivela eNkosini yakho siyofika.

52:13.t: Ngosuku lapho bayodudulelwa kanzima emlilweni waseJahanamu.

52:15.t: Ingabe ilumbo leli kumbe anisaboni kahle na?

52:16.t: Ngenani kuwo; bekezelani noma ningabekezeli kuyefana kini, ngokuba niyothola umvuzo walokho ebenikwenza.

52:17.t: Impela laba abathobela u Allah bayongena ezivandeni nentokomalo.

52:18.t: Bayozitika ngalokho iNkosi yabo abaphe kona, futhi iNkosi yabo iyobahlenga esijezisweni somlilo.

52:19.t: [Kuyothiwa kubo]: “Dlanini niphuze ngokunethezeka ngenxa yalokho ebenikwenza”.

52:20.t: Bayoqhiyama bahlale emibhedeni ebhekene futhi siyobashadisa namaHuru-Ayini.

52:21.t: Futhi labo abakholwayo balandelwa uzalo lwabo kukholo, siyobahlanganisa nozalo lwabo futhi angeke sinciphise lutho kuzenzo zabo. Wonke umuntu uyothwala imisebenzi yakhe.

52:23.t: Bayophuzisana kuzo [izivande] izinkamba zotshwala ezingenambhedo noma impambuko [obungadakani].

52:24.t: Bayosetshenzelwa abafana babo abafana nobuhlalu obumhlophe obufihlihliwe.

52:26.t: Bathi: “Impela phambilini ngenkathi sinemindeni yethu besisaba [isijeziso]”

52:27.t: Kepha u Allah wasibusisa, wasihlenga esijezisweni sokushisa.

52:28.t: Impela besikhuleka kuYe phambilini; impela Yena Unesihle Unesihawu.

52:29.t: Yeluleka ngokuba wena [Muhamadi] ngesibusiso seNkosi yakho awusiso isanusi noma ihlanya.

52:31.t: Yithi: “Lindani; impela nami ngilindile kanye nani”.

52:32.t: Ingabe izingqondo zabo lezi ezibayalela ngalokhu na? Kumbe bangabantu abangamahlongandlebe.

52:34.t: Mabalethe inkulumo efana nayo uma ngempela beqinisile.

52:35.t: Kumbe badalwa ngeze noma yibona uqobo abadali na?

52:36.t: Kumbe badale amazulu nomhlaba na? empeleni abanasiqiniseko.

52:37.t: Kumbe banemicebo yeNkosi yakho noma yibona abaphethe na?

52:38.t: Kumbe banesikhwelo [esifika ezulwini] abalalela ngaso na? Lowo olalelayo kubo makalethe ubufakazi obucacile.

52:39.t: Kumbe Yena [uAllah] unamadodakazi kepha nina ninamadodana na?.

52:40.t: Kumbe ubacela umvuzo, ngenxa yalokho kunzima ukuba bakhokhe.

52:42.t: Kumbe bafuna ukwakha itulo; phela kulabo abangakholwa isikhuni sibuya nomkhwezeli.

52:43.t: Kumbe banomunye abamkhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah na? Ungcwele u Allah kunalokho abakubhangqayo.

52:44.t: Futhi uma bengabona izingcezu ziwa esibhakabhakeni bayovele bathi: “Amafu alakanyene”.

52:45.t: Bayeke kanje baze bafike kulolu suku lapho beyobhijiswa khona.

52:46.t: Ngosuku lapho itulo labo lingeke labasiza ngalutho futhi abayikusizwa muntu.

52:47.t: Futhi labo abaphambukile bayothola esinye isijeziso ngaphambi kwaleso, kepha iningi labo alazi.

52:48.t: Bekezelela isinqumo seNkosi yakho ngokuba wena sikuqaphile ngaMehlo eThu. Futhi ubabaze udumo lweNkosi yakho lapho usukuma [wenza iswala].

53:9.t: Waba ibanga eliyiminsalo emibili noma okothe ukuba seduze.

53:10.t: Wabe [u Allah] esambulela esigqileni saKhe lokho okwambulela.

53:11.t: Futhi inhliziyo ayiqambanga manga ngalokho ekubonile.

53:16.t: Imboza lokhu ekumbozayo iSidirati [ngobubanzi nobukhulu bayo].

53:18.t: Impela wabona izibonakaliso ezinkulu zeNkosi yakhe.

53:21.t: Ingabe nina ninamadodana kepha Yena [u Allah] unamadodakazi na?

53:23.t: Empeleni lana ngamagama eniziqambele wona nina nokhokho benu, akukho bufakazi bawo u Allah abembulele. Bamane balandela imidlinzo nalokho okukhanukwa imiphefumulo. Futhi kade kwafika kubo ukuholwa okuvela eNkosini yabo.

53:24.t: Kumbe umuntu uthola lokho akulangezelelayo na?

53:26.t: Futhi ziningi izingelosi ezisemazulwini ukushweleza kwazo okungeke kwasiza ngalutho ngaphandle uma u Allah evumela owo amthandayo nathokoza ngaye.

53:27.t: Impela laba abangakholelwa kwelizayo babiza izingelosi ngamagama esifazane.

53:28.t: Futhi abanalwazi ngawo, ngaphandle nje kokuthi balendala imidlinzo; futhi imidlinzo ayisizi ngalutho uma kufika eqinisweni.

53:29.t: Myeke kanjalo lowo ofulathela isikhumbuzo seThu futhi olangezelela impilo yasemhlabeni kuphela.

53:30.t: Yilapho ulwazi lwabo luphelela khona. Impela iNkosi yakho iYona eyazi kahle ngalowo odukayo endleleni yaKhe nolowo ohelelekayo.

53:31.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokuka Allah; ukuze anike labo abenze okubi umvuzo wabo ngabakwenzile futhi nalabo abenze okuhle ngokuhle.

53:32.t: Labo abagwema izimpambuko ezinkulu namanyala ngaphandle ke kwamaphutha. Impela iNkosi yakho inentethelelo eyinala. Wazi kahle ngani kusuka lapho enidala emhlabeni nalapho ningamahlwili eziswini zonyoko. Ngakhoke ningazenzi ngcono; nguYena omazi kahle lowo omthobelayo.

53:35.t: Ingabe unolwazi lokungabonwa, wase ekwazi ukubona [ikusasa].

53:36.t: Ingabe akaziswanga ngalokho okusemiqulwini kaMusa na?.

53:45.t: Nokuthi nguYena owadala amabhangqa, isilisa nesifazane.

53:50.t: Nokuthi nguYena owabhubhisa isizwe sakwa Adi sasendulo.

53:52.t: Nesizwe sikaNuhu phambilini; impela babephambukile bengamahlongandlebe.

53:55.t: Yiziphike izibusiso zeNkosi yakho ozoziphika na?

53:62.t: Ngakhoke, khothamelani u Allah niwe ngobuso nimkhonze.

54:2.t: Uma bebona isibonakaliso, bayafulathela bathi: “Ilumbo eliyoshabalala”.

54:3.t: Bayaphika baphinde balandele izinkanuko zabo. Futhi yonke into [enhle nembi] iyokwenzeka.

54:4.t: Futhi lufikile kubo ulwazi obeluqukethe isexwayiso.

54:5.t: Iwubuhlakani obunzulu; kepha izixwayiso azisizanga ngalutho.

54:6.t: Bashiye kanjalo; [kuze kube] usuku lapho isimemezi simemela entweni embi.

54:7.t: Ubuso babo buyobe budangele; bayophuma emathuneni njengesikhonyane esisabalele.

54:8.t: Besheshisa beya kusimemezi. Labo abangakholwa bayothi: “Lolu usuku olunzima”.

54:9.t: Ngaphambi kwabo isizwe sikaNuhu saphika, saphikisa isigqila seThu sathi: “Uhlanya”, basatshiswa.

54:12.t: Saqhekeza imithombo emhlabeni, amanzi [angaphansi naphezulu] ahlanganela kumyalelo onqunyiwe.

54:13.t: Samgibeza entweni eyakhiwe ngezingqembe zokhuni nezikhonkwane [umkhumbi].

54:14.t: Uhamba phambi kwaMehlo eThu njengomvuzo kulabo abangakholwa.

54:15.t: Futhi sawushiya waba isifundo; ingabe ukhona ozothatha isifundo na?

54:17.t: Futhi impela senze iKurani yaba lula; ingabe ukhona oyothatha isifundo na?

54:18.t: Isizwe sakwa Adi baphika [iqiniso]; saba njani ke isijeziso nesixwayiso saMi na?

54:19.t: Impela sathumela kubo umoya oyisivunguvungu obandayo osukwini olubi oluyindeyinde.

54:21.t: Saba njani isijeziso nesixwayiso sami na?

54:22.t: Futhi impela senze iKurani yaba lula; ingebe ukhona oyothatha isifundo na?

54:24.t: Sathi: “Silandele umuntu wakithi oyedwa na? Impela siyobe sesidukile futhi sesihlanya”.

54:25.t: Wembulelwa kanjani isikhumbuzo phakathi kwethu; impela ungumqambi manga ozigqajayo.

54:26.t: Bayokwazi kusasa [kwelizayo] ukuthi ngubani umqambo manga ozigqajayo.

54:27.t: Impela sizothumela ikameli njengisivivinyo kubo; ngakhoke babheke nje futhi ubekezele.

54:28.t: Futhi bazise ukuthi amanzi ayokwabela phakathi kwabo; kuphuza kudedelwana.

54:30.t: Saba njani isijeziso nesixwayiso sami na?

54:31.t: Sathumela kubo umsindo owodwa, boma njengemihlanga ebiyela isibaya.

54:32.t: Futhi impela senze iKurani yaba lula; ingabe ukhona oyothatha isifundo na?

54:34.t: Sathumela kubo imvula yamatshe ngaphandle komndeni kaLuti; sabahlenga entathakusa.

54:35.t: Njengesibusiso esivela kithi; phela sibahlomulisa kanjalo ababongayo.

54:36.t: Futhi wabaxwayisa ngesijeziso seThu kepha baziphika izexwayiso.

54:37.t: Futhi bazama ukuzo yenza amanyala kuzivakashi zakhe; senza amehlo angabona, [kwathiwa kubo]: “Zwanini isijeziso nesixwayiso saMi”.

54:40.t: Futhi impela senze iKurani yaba lula; ingebe ukhona oyothatha isifundo na?

54:42.t: Baziphika zonke izibonakaliso zeThu; sabajezisa isijeziso songuSomandla Onamandla.

54:43.t: Ingabe laba abangakholwa benu bangcono yini kunalabo kumbe ninesiqiseko sokuphepha esilotshwe eZincwadini zaphambilini na?

54:46.t: Empeleni iSikhathi [sokwahlulelwa] yisona ababekelwe sona futhi iSikhathi sinzima kakhulu futhi sibuhlungu kakhulu.

54:47.t: Impela izephula mthetho zidukile futhi ziyongena emlilweni.

54:48.t: Ngosuku lapho beyohudulelwa emlilweni ngobuso babo, [kuthiwe]: “Zwanini ubunzima womlilo”.

54:50.t: Futhi umyalelo weThu uwodwa vo, njengophazima kweso.

54:51.t: Futhi sababhubhisa abafana nani; ingabe ukhona ozothatha isifundo.

54:52.t: Yonke into abayenzile ilotshiwe eZincwadini zaphambilini.

54:53.t: Futhi yonke into encane nenkulu [abayenzayo] iqoshiwe.

54:54.t: Impela laba abathobela u Allah bayongena ezivandeni nasemifuleni.

55:6.t: Futhi inkanyezi nesihlahla kuyakhothama kuwe ngobuso.

55:13.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:14.t: Udale umuntu ngebumba olomile okwezitsha zobumba.

55:16.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:17.t: iNkosi yezimpumalanga ezimbili neNkosi yezintshonalanga ezimbili.

55:18.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:21.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:22.t: Kuphuma kuzo ubuhlalu obumhlophe obukhulu nobuncane.

55:23.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:24.t: Futhi eyaKhe imikhumbi emikhulu esolwandle njengezintaba.

55:25.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:27.t: Kusale Ubuso beNkosi yakho Ehloniphekile nengancishani.

55:28.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:29.t: Bonke abasemazulwini nasemhlabeni bayamcela [izidingo zabo]; nsuku zonke uhlezi kunakwenzayo.

55:30.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:31.t: Sizonibekela esenu isikhathi [sokunihlulela] nina bantu namajini.

55:32.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:33.t: Ninamajini nani sintu, uma nikwazi ukuphuma ngemincele yamazulu nomhlaba, phumani; kepha angeke naphuma ngaphandle kwemvume.

55:34.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:35.t: Kuyothunyelwa kini bantu namajini amalangabi omlilo nethusi [elincibilisiwe] futhi angeke nikhone ukuzisiza.

55:36.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:37.t: Mhla isibhakabhaka siqhekeka, siyoba bomvu okwamafutha.

55:38.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:39.t: Ngalolosuku umuntu nejini abayikubuzwa ngezimpambuko zabo.

55:40.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:41.t: Izephula mthetho ziyobonakala ngezimpawu zabo; bese begxavulwa ngamabunzi nangezinyawo.

55:42.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:43.t: Iyona lena iJahanamu eyayiphikwa iziphula mthetho.

55:44.t: Bazolokhu bezungeza phakathi kwayo nesiphuzo esishisayo.

55:45.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:46.t: Futhi lowo osaba iNkosi yakhe uyothola izivande ezimbili.

55:47.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:49.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:51.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:52.t: Kuzo, kunamabhanqa azo zonke izinhlobo zezithelo.

55:53.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:54.t: Bayoqhiyama emibhedeni emboze ngesilika; nezithelo zezivande ziseduze.

55:55.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:56.t: Kuzo kunezintombi ezikhophozayo, ezingakaze zithintwe muntu noma ijini ngaphambi kwabo.

55:57.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:59.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:60.t: Ingabe ukhona yini omunye umvuzo wokuhle ngaphandle kokuhle.

55:61.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:62.t: Futhi ngezansi kwazo kunezinye izivande ezimbili.

55:63.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:71.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:73.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:74.t: Azikaze zithintwe muntu noma ijini ngaphambi kwabo.
