55:77.t: Ingabe-ke yizona ziphi izibusiso zeNkosi yenu [nina bantu namajini] enizoziphika na?

55:78.t: Lingcwele iGama leNkosi yakho Ehloniphekile engancishani.

56:10.t: Futhi nalabo abahamba phambili [ezintweni ezinhle] bayohamba phambili.

56:18.t: Bebalethela izinkamba namabikili nezinkomishi zewayini egelezayo.

56:46.t: Futhi babephikelela ukwenza impambuko enkulu [ukubhangqa uAllah].

56:47.t: Futhi babethi: “Kuyothi lapho sesifile saba inhlabathi namathambo, siphinde sivuswe na?”

56:56.t: Iyona lena indawo yabo ngosuku lokwahlulela.

56:59.t: Ingabe yinina enisidalayo kumbe yithina abadalile na?

56:60.t: Yithina esibeke ukufa phakathi kwenu futhi angeka sahluleka.

56:62.t: Futhi niyakwazi ukudalwa kokuqala; pho kungani ningathathi isifundo na?

56:64.t: Ingabe yinina enihlumisayo kumbe yithina abahlumisi na?

56:65.t: Uma sithanda besingakwenza kome, nisale nimangele.

56:69.t: Ingabe yinina yini eniwehlisayo emafini kumbe yithina abehlisayo na?

56:70.t: Uma sithanda besingawenza ababe; ngakhoke ake nibonge.

56:72.t: Ingabe yinina enidale isihlahla sawo kumbe yithina abadalile na?

56:73.t: Thina siwenze waba yisikhumbuzo nensiza kuzihambi.

56:74.t: Ngakhoke, dumisa ngeGama leNkosi yakho Enkulu.

56:85.t: Futhi Thina siseduze kwakhe [umufi] ukudlula nina, kepha aniboni.

56:96.t: Ngakhoke, dumisa ngeGama leNkosi yakho Enkulu.

57:1.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kudumisa u Allah; futhi unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

57:2.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokwaKhe. Uletha ukuphila nokufa; futhi akehlulwa yilutho.

57:3.t: Nguyena Owokuqala nowoGcina noNgaphezulu noNgaphakathi. Futhi wazi yonke into.

57:4.t: NguYena lona owadala amazulu nomhlaba ezinsukwini eziyisithupha wabe esenyukela kuSihlalo. Wazi okungena emhlabeni nokuphuma kuwo nalokho okwehla phezulu nokunyukela khona. Futhi unani noma ningaba kuphi; u Allah uyakubona enikwenzayo.

57:5.t: Ubukhosi basemazulwini nasemhlabeni bungobaKhe. Futhi zonke izinto ziyobuyela ku Allah.

57:6.t: Ufaka ubusuku emini, afake imini ebusuku; futhi ukwazi kahle okuqukethwe yizinhliziyo.

57:7.t: Kholelwani ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe futhi niphane ngalokho aniphe kona emuva kwabanye; ngokuba labo abakholwayo phakathi kwenu baphinde baphane, bayothola umvuzo omkhulu.

57:8.t: Kungani ningakholelwa ku Allah na?, sibe iSithunywa sinimela ekutheni nikholelwe eNkosini yenu futhi yenza isibophezelo nani, uma nikholwa.

57:9.t: NguYena lona owembulele esigqileni saKhe imibiko ecacile ukuze anikhiphe embumnyameni anise ekukhanyeni. Impela u Allah Unobubele Unesihawu ngani.

57:10.t: Futhi kungani ninganikeli endleleni ka Allah na?; futhi amazulu nomhlaba kuyosala ku Allah. Abefani labo kini abanikela ngaphambi ngokunqoba [eMakha] baphinda balwa [empini]. Labo banezigaba eziphakeme kunalabo abanikela emuva kokunqoba baphinde balwa. kepha bonke u Allah ubathembise okuhle [iJana]. Futhi u Allah unolwazi ngakho konke enikwenzayo.

57:11.t: Ngubani ongaboleka u Allah imboleko enhle na?. Uzomuphindaphindela yona aphinde athole umvuzo omuhle.

57:12.t: Ngosuku lapho uyobona abakholwayo besilisa nabesimame, ukukhanya kwabo kuhamba ngaphambi kwabo nangakwesokunene kwabo. [Kuthiwe kubo]: “Siyanihalalisela namhlanje, ngezivande okugeleza ezansi kwazo imifula, niyohlala kuzo unaphakade; leyo iyona impumelelo enkulu.

57:13.t: Ngosuku lapho abazenzisi besilisa nesifazane bayothi kulabo abakholwayo: “Simeleni, nathi sizothekela ekukhanyeni kwenu”. Kuyothiwa kubo: “Buyelani emuva [emhlabeni], niyofuna khona ukukhanya”. Kuyomiswa umthangala phakathi kwabo onomnyango; ngaphakathi unomusa kepha ngaphandle, nangaphambili kwawo ubukeka unesijeziso.

57:14.t: Bayobabiza: “Ingani besisonke”. Bayothi: “Kunjalo, kepha nina nazifaka obishini, nalokhu nilindele ninokungabaza nadukiswa izifiso kwaze kwafika umyalelo ka Allah nomdukisi wanidukisa”.

57:15.t: Namhlanje akukho nhlawulo eyothathwa kini noma laba abangakholwa. Indawo yenu isemlilweni, yiwona oyoningamela; saze sasibi isiphetho.

57:16.t: Ingabe asikafiki yini isikhathi kulabo abakholwayo ukuba izinhliziyo zabo zithobele inkumbulo ka Allah nalokho okuyiqiniso elembulelwe futhi bangabi njengalabo abanikwa iMibhalo ngaphambilini; saba side isikhathi kubo zaze zabalukhuni futhi iningi labo liyizephula mthetho.

57:17.t: Yazini ukuthi u Allah uvuselela umhlaba emuva kokufa kwawo. Impela sinicacisele imibiko ukuze niqonde.

57:18.t: Impela labo abesilisa nabesimame abakholelwa ngokweqiniso baphinde baboleke u Allah imboleko enhle, bayophindaphindelwa futhi bayothola umvuzo omuhle.

57:19.t: Futhi nalabo abakholelwa ku Allah neZithunywa zaKhe, yibona kanye abakholwa ngokweqiniso. Futhi nalabo abawe empini bayothola umvuzo wabo nokukhanya kwabo eNkosini yabo. Kuthi labo abangakholwa nabaphika imibiko yeThu; yibona kanye abayongena emlilweni.

57:20.t: Yazini ukuthi impilo yasemhlabeni iwukudlala nokuchitha isikhathi nokubukeka kahle nokuqhoshelana phakathi kwenu nokuba nomcebo nezingane eziningi. Njengemvula ozitshalo zazo zimangaza abangakholwa, bese ziyabuna uzibone zezomile ziphuzi bese ziba yimvithi. Futhi kwelizayo kunesijeziso esinzima nentethelelo evela kuAllah nenjabulo. Futhi impilo yasemhlabeni iyinto yokudukisana.

57:21.t: Ncintisanani ukuthola intethelelo evela eNkosini yenu nokuya eJana ububanzi bayo obungangobubanzi besibhakabhaka nomhlaba, ilungiselelwe labo abakholelwa ku Allah neSithunywa saKhe. Lowo umusa ka Allah, uwunika amthandayo. Futhi u Allah unomusa omkhulu.

57:22.t: Wonke umshophi owenzekayo emhlabeni noma kini uqobo, usuke ulotshiwe eNcwadini ngaphambi kokuba siwudale. Impela lokho kulula ku Allah.

57:23.t: Ukuze ningakhathazeki ngalokho okunilahlekele futhi ningazindondonyi ngalokho enikuphiwe. Futhi u Allah akamthandi wonke umuntu oziqhayisayo ozigqajayo.

57:24.t: Labo abancintshanayo baphinde bayalele abantu ngokuncintshana. Lowo ofulathelayo ashaye indiva; impela u Allah Uzimele Uyadunyiswa.

57:25.t: Sathumela iZithunywa Zethu nemibiko futhi sabembulela iNcwadi nobulungiswa ukuze abantu babe nobulungiswa. Futhi sehlisa insimbi enamandla eqinile nezinsiza kubantu. Nokuthi u Allah azi lowo omesekelayo Yena neZithunywa Zakhe ngasese. Impela u Allah Unamandla unguSomandla.

57:26.t: Futhi sathumela uNuhu no Ibhirahimu senza kwaba nobuthunywa neZincwadi kuzalo lwabo; kunalabo ababa sendleleni eqondile, kepha baningi kubo abayizephula mthetho.

57:27.t: Sabe sesilandelisa ezinyathelweni zabo ngeZithunywa Zethu, salandelanisa ngo Isa indodana ka Mariyamu, samnika I Ininjili futhi senza kwaba nesihawu nomusa ezinhlizweni zalabo ababemlandela. Ubuzindela bazisungulela bona ngokwabo befuna ukujabulisa u Allah, asizange sibanqumele bona, kepha abazange babunakekele ngendlela efanele. Sanika labo abakholwayo kubo umvuzo wabo, kepha iningi labo liyiziphula mthetho.

57:28.t: Nina enikholwayo, thobelani u Allah nikholwe nakuSithunywa saKhe; uzoninika okuphindwe kabili emseni waKhe aphinde anenzele ukuba nibe nokukhanya enizohamba kukho futhi anithethelele; belu u Allah Ungumthetheleli Onesihawu.

57:29.t: Ukuze abeMibhalo ukuthi abayikuthola lutho emseni ka Allah; nokuthi umusa useZandleni zika Allah uwunika amthandayo, futhi u Allah unomusa omkhulu.

58:1.t: Ngempela u Allah uyizwile inkulumo yalowo obebalisa ngomyeni wakhe kuwe [Muhamadi] futhi ekhala ku Allah, belu u Allah uyayizwa inkulumo yenu nobabili. Ngokuba u Allah uzwa futhi ubona konke.

58:2.t: Labo abaphimisa iDihari kubafazi babo – abasibona onina babo; onina babo yilabo ababazala kuphela. Empeleni bakhuluma ichilo [ngokufanisa umkakhe nonina] na-manga. Kepha u Allah unesihe uyathethelela.

58:3.t: Futhi labo abaphimisa iDihari kubafazi babo, kepha bazisole ngalokho abakushilo; [inhlawulo yabo] kumele bakhulule isigqila esisodwa ngaphambi kokuba bathintane. Yikho lokhu eniyalelwe kona. Futhi u Allah ukwazi konke enikwenzayo.

58:4.t: Kepha lowo ongenaso [isigqila] kumele azile izinyanga ezimbili ezilandelanayo ngaphambi kokuba bathintane. Kepha uma engakhoni makondle amahlwempu abangamashumi ayisi-thupha. Lokhu ukuze nikholwe ku Allah neSithu-nywa Sakhe. Leyo imincele ka Allah, kanti abangakholwa bayothola isijeziso esibuhlungu.

58:5.t: Ngempela labo abaphambana no Allah neSithunywa Sakhe bayohlaziswa njengalabo ababandulelayo bahlaziswa. Belu sambulela imibhalo ecacile. Futhi labo abangakholwa bayothola isijeziso esihlazayo.

58:6.t: Ngosuku lapho u Allah ayobabuthanisa bonke abazise ngezenzo zabo [emhlabeni]. Bheka ngoba u Allah uziqophile kepha bona bazikhohlwa, ngokuba u Allah uziqaphile zonke izinto.

58:7.t: Awuboni ukuthi u Allah wazi konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni na. Lapho abathathu bekhuluma ngasese, Yena ungowesine, uma bebahlanu, yena ungowesithupha, futhi noma bengaba bancane kunalokho noma bendlulele, uhlala enabo noma bengaba kuphi. Kuthi ngoSuku loKwahlulelwa abazise ngabakwenzile. Ngokuba u Allah wazi konke.

58:8.t: Awubheke laba abayalelwa ukuba bangabi nezigungu zangasese, kepha bona baphikelela ukwenza lokhu abanqatshelwe kona, ngokuba nezigungu zangasese bedingida impambuko, nokuphula umthetho kanye nokweyisa iSithunywa. Belu uma befika kuwe bakubingelela ngendlela u Allah angakubingeleli ngayo, kuthi lapho bebodwa bathi: “Kungani u Allah angasijezisi ngesikushoyo na?” IJahanamu abayobhadla kuyo iyobenela, okuyindawo embi impela.

58:9.t: Nina enikholwayo! Uma ninezigungu zangasese, ningadingidi impambuko, nokuphula umthetho kanye nokweyisa iSithunywa; kepha dingidani ngokulunga nokugcina imiyalelo, futhi nithobele u Allah Lona eniyobuthaniswa Kuye.

58:10.t: Empeleni lezigungu zangasese zivela ku Shayitani ukuze akhathaze labo abakholwayo. Kepha akasoze abalimaze ngalutho ngaphandle kwemvumo ka Allah, ngakho- ke labo abakholwayo kufanele bathembele ku Allah.

58:11.t: Nina enikholwayo! Uma niyalelwa ukuthi; ‘vulani isikhala’ uma nihlezi, anibosivula, funa u Allah anivulele nani. Futhi uma niyalelwa ukuthi: ‘sukumani’ anibosukuma; u Allah uyobaphakamisa labo abakholwayo kini nalabo abaphiwe ulwazi izigaba ngezigaba.

58:12.t: Nina enikholwayo! Uma nifuna ukukhuluma neSithunywa ngasese, nikelani ngotho ngaphambi kokuba nixoxe. Lokho kuyinto engcono nenhle kini. Kepha uma ningenalutho, u Allah Uyathethelela Unesihawu.

58:13.t: Ingabe beninqena ukunikela ngotho ngaphambi kwengxoxo yenu na? Uma nehlulekile no Allah wanithethelela, qikelelanike ukwenza iSwala nikhiphe neZaka futhi nithobele u Allah neSithunywa Sakhe. Belu ukuqaphe konke enikwenzayo.

58:14.t: Awubabonanga na, labo abazibandakanya nalabo abathukuthelelwe ngu Allah; abekho ngakini futhi abekho ngakubo, baphinde bafunge ngamanga ngamabomu.

58:15.t: U Allah ubalungisele isijeziso esinzima; ngempela kubi lokhu abakwenzayo.

58:16.t: Basebenzisa izifungo zabo [zamanga] njengesihlangu, baba yizivimba endleleni ka Allah, kanti bayothola isijeziso esihlazayo.

58:17.t: Kepha ingcebo yabo nozalo lwabo, akusoze kwabasiza ngalutho ku Allah. Yibo kanye labo abayobhadla emlilweni, bahlale kuwo unaphakade.

58:18.t: Ngosuku lapho u Allah uyobabuthanisa khona bonke, bayophinda bafunge naKuye njengoba bafunga nakini, belu bacabanga ukuthi banotho; empeleni bangabaqambi manga.

58:19.t: Baphicwe uShayitani bakhohlwa intando ka Allah; laboke iqembu lika Shayitani, bheka ngoba iqembu lika Shayitani aliphumeleli.

58:20.t: Labo abaphambana no Allah neSithunywa Sakhe, yibo kanye labo abasehlazweni.

58:21.t: Ngokuba u Allah wanquma ukuthi: “Yimina neZithunywa Zami esiyonqoba”, u Allah Unamandla unguSomandla.

58:22.t: Awusoze wathola abantu abakholwa ku Allah noSuku lokuGcina bethakasela labo abaphambana no Allah neSithunywa Sakhe, noma bengaba abazali babo noma izingane zabo noma abafowabo noma imindeni yabo. Laboke u Allah uzinzise ukholo ezinhlizweni zabo futhi wabaqinisa ngeRuhu evela Kuye. Kantike uyobabeka ezivandeni okugeleza ezansi kwazo imifula, bayohlala kuzo unaphakade. U Allah uyothokoza ngabo kanti nabo bayothokoza ngaYe. Yiboke labo abayibutho lika Allah, belu ibutho lika Allah yilona eliyophumelela.

59:1.t: Konke okusemazulwini nokusemhlabeni kudumisa u Allah, unguSomandla onoBuhlakani.

59:2.t: Nguye owakhipha labo abangakholwa kwabeMibhalo emizini yabo okokuqala ngqa; naningacabangi ukuthi bayoke baphume, nabo babecabanga ukuthi izinqaba zabo ziyobavikela ku Allah, kepha u Allah wagasela lapho ababengalindele khona. Wafaka uvalo ezinhlizweni zabo; babhidliza izindlu zabo ngezandla zabo nangezandla zabakholwayo; ngakhoke thathani isifundo nina enikhaliphile.

59:3.t: Uma nje bekungesikho ukuthi u Allah wabanqumela ukuba baxoshwe, wayezobajezisa lapha emhlabeni nakweLizayo bathole isijeziso soMlilo.

59:4.t: Lokho yingoba baphambane no Allah neSithunywa Sakhe; kanti kulowo ophambana no Allah, ngempela u Allah ujezisana kanzima.

59:5.t: Lezo zihlahla zamasundu enazigawula noma naziyeka zimile ngeziqu zazo, kuyintando ka Allah nokuthi ahlazise labo abayiziphula mthetho.

59:6.t: Lokho okwabo u Allah akunika iSithunywa Sakhe, anizange nigibele mahhashi noma amakameli, kepha u Allah opha iZithunywa Zakhe amandla phezu kwalowo afunayo; u Allah unamandla phezu kwezinto zonke.

59:7.t: Lokho kwabantu bezigodi u Allah akunika iSithunywa Sakhe, kungokuka Allah neSithunywa nezihlobo nezintandane nabampofu nezihambi, ukuze ingazungezi kulabo abacebile kuphela; futhi lokho iSithunywa esininika kona kuthatheni kuthi lokho aninqabela kona nizithibe, nithobele u Allah ngokuba u Allah ujezisana kanzima.

59:8.t: Nabantulayo kubafuduki laba abakhishwa emizini yabo nengcebo yabo belangazelele umusa ka Allah nokumthokozisa futhi bezimisele ukulekelela u Allah neSithunywa Sakhe. Yiboke labo abaneqiniso.

59:9.t: Labo ababe sebengaphambi kwabo bakhile futhi bathatha nokholo, bayabathanda labo abafudukela kubo futhi abanawo umona ezinhlizweni zabo ngalokho abanakho. Futhi bayazikhandla ekunaneleni abanye nakuba bengenakho okutheni. Kantike lowo ohlengwe emoneni womphefumulo wakhe, ngempela, ungophumeleleyo.

59:10.t: Kanti laba ababelamayo, bathi: “Nkosi yethu sithethelele thina kanye nabaFowethu abasandulelayo ngokholo futhi ungafaki inzondo ezinhlizweni zethu kulabo abakholwayo; Nkosi yethu, ngempela ungOnobubele Onesihawu.

59:11.t: Awubabonanga yini laba abangamaphixiphixi lapho bekhuluma nabanewabo beMibhalo abangakholwa, bethi: “Uma nixoshwa, siyakuphuma nani, futhi asiyukulalela muntu ngani sanhlobo; uma nilwiswa, siyakunilekelela”. U Allah Uyazi ukuthi bahubha aluhlaza amanga.

59:12.t: Uma bexoshwa abayikuphuma nabo, uma belwiswa abayikubasiza; uma kwenzeka bebasiza izithende ziyoshaya esiphundu ngakhoke abayikusizwa.

59:13.t: Empeleni nina enikholwayo, niyesabeka kubo ukwendlula u Allah uqobo; lokho yingoba bangabantu abangaqondi.

59:14.t: Abasoze balwa nani beyibutho, ngaphandle uma besezinqabeni noma bebhace ngezindonga. Uhilizwisano phakathi kwabo lukhulu. Ungacabanga ukuthi babumbene kepha izinhliziyo zabo zahlukene; lokho yingoba bengabantu abangaphusile.

59:15.t: Befana nalabo ababandulelayo kungekudala; bawuthola umvuzo wezenzo zabo futhi bamelwe isijeziso esibuhlungu.

59:16.t: Befana noShayitani lapho ethi kumuntu: “Phika ukholo” kuthi eseluphikile athi: “Mina angihlangene nawe, mina ngizesabela u Allah iNkosi yezizwe zonke”.

59:17.t: Isijeziso sabo kwaba ukuba bangene eMlilweni babhadle kuwo unaphakade. Yisoke leso isijeziso sabaphambukayo.

59:18.t: Nina enikholwayo! Thobelani u Allah, umuntu nomuntu abheke ukuthi ulilungiseleleni iKusasa; nithobele u Allah, ngokuba u Allah uyakwazi enikwenzayo.

59:19.t: Futhi ningabi njengalaba abakhohlwa u Allah, ngalokho, wabenza bazikhohlwa nabo uqobo. Yibona labo abayizamphula mthetho.

59:20.t: Abafani laba abayongena eMlilweni nalabo abayongena eJana; labo abayongena eJana yibona abaphumelele.

59:21.t: Ukube nje Sehlisela le Kurani echobeni lentaba, wawuyoyibona ithamba iqhekeka ngenxa yokwesaba u Allah. Lezo izibonelo esizethula kuSintu ukuze bajule [bacabangisise].

59:22.t: Unguyena u Allah lo okungekho okufanelwe ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe, Isazi sokungabonwa nokubonwayo, nguYena Onomusa Onesihawu.

59:23.t: Unguyena u Allah lo okungekho okufanelwe ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe, nguYena OyiNkosi Ongcwele Onokuthula OnguMhlengi Oqaphile uSomandla Oyingqungqulu Ophakeme; makangcweliswe u Allah kulokho abakubhangqayo.

59:24.t: Nguyena u Allah, uMdali uMsunguli uMbumbi; unaMagama aMahle, konke okusemaZulwini naseMhlabeni kuyamdumisa; unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

60:1.t: Nina enikholwayo! Ningenzi isitha Sami nesitha senu abangani nibakhombise ukubakhathalela; bheka ngoba baliphikile iqiniso elifike kini, baxosha iSithunywa kanye nani uqobo, ngenxa yokuba nikholwe ku Allah iNkosi yenu. Uma niphume impi endleni Yami futhi nihlose ukuzuza intokomalo yami, nibapha izimfihlo nibakhathalele, nakuba Ngazi konke enikwenza ngasese nenikwenza obala. Lowo owenza lokho kini, ngempela usephambukile endleleni eqondile.

60:2.t: Uma bona benithola bayoba izitha zenu bagadle ngokubi ngezandla zabo nemilomo yabo; futhi bafisa ukuba nibe abaphika ukholo.

60:3.t: Ubuhlobo benu nozalo lwenu aliyikunisiza ngalutho; ngoSuku loKwahlulela Uyokwahlulela phakathi kwenu, ngokuba u Allah Ungobona konke enikwenzayo.

60:4.t: Empeleni ninesibonelo esihle ku Ibhirahimu kanye nalabo ayenabo mhla bethi kubantu bakubo: “Thina asizibandakanyi nani kanye nalokho enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah; asikholwa kini; ubutha nenzondo bumile phakathi kwethu nani kuze kube nikholwa ku Allah Yena Yedwa – ngaphandle kwamazwi ka Ibhirahimu lapho ethi kuyise: ‘ngizokucelela intethelelo futhi ayikho into engingakwenzela yona ku Allah’ -; Nkosi yethu sethembele Kuwe futhi sizilahla Kuwe kanti neSiphetho siKuwe…”

60:5.t: “Nkosi yethu ungasenzi isisulu salabo abangakholwa, usithethelele Nkosi yethu, ngokuba Wena unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

60:6.t: Ngempela ninesibonelo esihle kubo, kulowo okholwa ku Allah nasoSukwini lokuGcina. Kanti lowo ophambukayo, u Allah Uzimele Uyadunyiswa.

60:7.t: Maduzane nje u Allah uzokwenza kube nokuzwana phakathi kwenu nalabo enibazondayo. Bheka ngoba u Allah Unamandla futhi u Allah Uyathethelela Unesihawu.

60:8.t: U Allah akanivimbi ukuba nibaphathe kahle futhi nenze ubulungiswa kulabo abanganilwisi ngenkolo yenu futhi bengezange banixoshe emizini yenu; ngokuba u Allah uyabathanda abenzi bobulungiswa.

60:9.t: U Allah univimbela kuphela ukuba nizibandakanye nalabo abaniliswa ngenkolo yenu futhi banixoshe emizini yenu baphinde balekelelane ekunixosheni. Labo abazibandakanya nabo, yibonake abaphambukile.

60:10.t: Nina enikholwayo! Uma kufika kini abakholwayo besimame bengabafuduki, bavivinyeni; u Allah kuphela owazi ngesimo sokholo lwabo. Uma seniqinisekisile ukuthi bangabakholwayo, ningabe nisababuyisela kubangakholwa, ngokuba bona [abakholwayo besimame] abavumelekile ukushada nabo kanti nabo [abangakholwa] abavumelekile ukushada nabo. Alikho icala uma nifuna ukubashada, uma nje senibanike amalobolo abo. Futhi ningagcini abangakholwa [besimame] emshadweni; nicele lokho enakukhipha, nabo [abangakholwa] bacele lokho abakukhipha. Lowo umthetho ka Allah wehlulela phakathi kwenu; u Allah Wazi konke Ukhaliphile.

60:11.t: Uma abafazi benu benishiya bebuyele kwabangakholwa; bese nihlabana empini, nikani labo abahanjelwe abafazi babo okulingana nalokho abakukhipha; nizithobe ku Allah, lo enikholwa Kuye.

60:12.t: Sithunywa! Uma kufika kuwe abesimame abakholwayo bezofunga ukuba abasoze babhanqa lutho no Allah noma bebe noma baphinge noma babulale izingane zabo noma baqambe amanga ngamavezandlebe noma baphambane nawe kokuhle; bafungise ubacelele nentethelelo ku Allah ngokuba u Allah Uyathethelela Unesihawu.

60:13.t: Nina enikholwayo! Ningazibandakanyi nabantu abathukuthelelwe ngu Allah; bheka ngoba abanathemba ngeLizayo, njengalokhu abangakholwa bengenathemba ngabasemathuneni.

61:1.t: Konke okusemaZulwini naseMhlabeni kudumisa u Allah, futhi nguye uSomandla Okhaliphile.

61:2.t: Nina enikholwayo kungani nikhuluma eningakwenzi na?

61:3.t: Kumuthukuthelisa kakhulu u Allah uma nikhuluma eningakwenzi.

61:4.t: U Allah uthanda labo uma belwa endleleni Yakhe bame ngemigqa kube ngathi bayisakhiwo esihlangene.

61:5.t: Khumbula lapho uMusa ethi kubantu bakhe: “Bantu bami, kungani ningihlukumeza nibe nazi kahle ukuthi ngiyiSithunywa sika Allah kini”. Kwathi uma bephambuka, u Allah waphambukisa izinhliziyo zabo.

61:6.t: Khumbula futhi lapho u-Isa ka Mariyamu ethi: “Sizwe sika Isirayeli, ngempela ngiyiSithunywa sika Allah kini, ngifakazela lokho okufike phambi kwami futhi ngethula izindaba ezinhle ngeSithunywa esiza emuva kwami ogama laso ngu Ahmadi”. Kwathi lapho ebalethela izibonakaliso bathi: “Lokhu ubuthakathi uqobo”.

61:7.t: Ingabe ubani ophambuke ukundlula lowo oqamba amanga ngo Allah ebe emenyelwa ku Isilamu; u Allah akabahlengi abantu abaphambukile.

61:8.t: Bafuna ukushabalalisa inkanyiso ka Allah; kepha u Allah uyoyiphelelisa inkanyiso yaKhe nakuba abangakholwa bengathandi.

61:9.t: Phela nguyena owathumela iSithunywa Sakhe nenkolo yeqiniso ukuze ayiphakamise phezu kwazo zonke izinkolo nakuba amaMushiriki engathandi.

61:10.t: Nina enikholwayo! Nginganikhombisa uhwebo oluzoniphephisa esijezisweni esibuhlungu na?

61:11.t: Kholwani ku Allah neSithunywa Sakhe futhi nilwe endleleni Yakhe ngengcebo yenu kanye nani uqobo; lokho yikona okuhle kini uma nje benazi.

61:12.t: Uyonithethelela izimpambuko zenu aningenise eziVandeni okugeleza imifula ngaphansi kwazo, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle eziVandeni zenhlalo engunomphela; lokho iyona kanye impumelelo enkulu.

61:13.t: Kokunye enikulangazelelayo, usizo luka Allah nokunqoba okuseduze; yethulake izindaba ezinhle kwabakholwayo.

61:14.t: Nina enikholwayo, yibani abasizi baka Allah, njenga mhla u-Isa ka Mariyamu ethi kumaHawariyina: “Obani abazoba abasizi bami ku Allah na?” Athi amaHawariyina: “Yithina abasizi baka Allah!”. Kwaba khona labo abakholwayo esizweni sika Isirayeli futhi kwaba khona labo abangakholwa; sabe-ke sesilekelela labo abakholwayo ezitheni zabo baba ngabanqobayo.

62:1.t: Konke okusemaZulwini naseMhlabeni kudumisa u Allah, onguMbusi, oNgcwele, onguSomandla oKhaliphile.

62:2.t: Nguyena owaqoka kwabangafundile iSithunywa kubo esibafundela imibiko Yakhe, sibahlanze futhi sibafundisa iNcwadi kanye neHikima; nakuba endulo babesekudukeni imbala.

62:3.t: Kanti abanye babo baseza emuvakwabo, futhi nguYena onguSomandla oKhaliphile.

62:4.t: Lokho kuwumusa ka Allah awupha amthandayo, bheka ngoba u Allah unomusa omkhulu.

62:5.t: Labo abathwesa ukulandela iTora kepha bangayilandela, bafaniswa nembongolo ethwele imiqulu yezincwadi; saze sasibi isifaniso salabo abaphika imibiko yaka Allah; kanti futhi u Allah akabaholi labo abaphambukile.

62:6.t: Yithi: “Nina eningamaJuda uma niqakambisa ukuthi ningabangani baka Allah ngale kwabanye abantu, langazelelani- ke ukufa uma ngempela niqinisile”.

62:7.t: Kepha abasoze bakulangezelela ngenxa yezenzo zabo; kantike u Allah ubazi kahle abaphambukile.

62:8.t: Yithi: “Ukufa lokhu enikubalekelayo, empeleni kuyanifica, bese nibuyiselwa kuMazi wokungabonwa nokubonwayo, abe esenazisa ngebenikwenza.

62:9.t: Nina enikholwayo! Uma sekumenyezelwa iSwala ngosuku lweJuma, phuthumelani enkumbuzweni ka Allah nishiye ukuhweba. Yikona lokho okuhle kini uma nje benazi.

62:10.t: Uma isiphothuliwe iSwala, chithekani emhlabeni nizithungathele emseni ka Allah, nikhumbule u Allah kakhulu ukuze niphumelele.

62:11.t: Uma sebebona uhwebo noma umcimbi baphuma kuwo bakushiye wena umile. Yithi: “Okuku Allah kungcono kunomcimbi nohwebo, futhi u Allah nguyena uMondli ongcono.

63:1.t: Uma abazenzisi beza kuwe bathi: “Siyafakaza ukuthi ngempela wena uyiSithunywa sika Allah”; u Allah uyazi ukuthi uyiSithunywa Sakhe kanti futhi u Allah uyafakaza ukuthi abazenzisi bangabahubhi bamanga.

63:2.t: Basebenzise izifungo zabo njengehawu; bevimba kwasani endleleni ka Allah. Ngempela yimbi lento abayenzayo.

63:3.t: Belu yingoba bakholwa babe sebeluphika futhi ukholo; izinhliziyo zabo zalukhuni ngakhoke abanakuqonda.

63:4.t: Uma ubabona, imizimba yabo iyakumangaza kanti uma bekhuluma uyayilalela inkulumo yabo, bafana nezigxobo ezigxunyekiwe. Bahlale becabanga ukuthi sonke isambulo singabo. Bayisitha uqobo, ngakhoke baqaphele. Engathi u Allah angabahlazisa, baphambukelephi.

63:5.t: Uma kuthiwa kubo: “Wozani iSithunywa sika Allah sinicelele intethelelo”, bavane bagebise amakhanda phansi futhi uyobabona sebevimba bezigqaja.

63:6.t: Kuyefana nje kubo, ubacelela intethelelo noma awubaceleli, u Allah akasoze abathethelela, ngokuba u Allah akabaholi labo abayiziphula mthetho.

63:7.t: Yibo kanye laba abathi: “Ningabasizi labo abaneSithunywa sika Allah baze bahambe”, nakuba imicebo yamazulu nomhlaba ingeka Allah, kepha abazenzisi abaqondisisi.

63:8.t: Bathi: “Uma sesibuyele eMadina, ongumhlonishwa uyokhipha ongumfokazane”, nakuba ukuhlonishwa kungokuka Alllah neSithunywa Sakhe nabakholwayo, kepha abazenzisi abazi.

63:9.t: Nina enikholwayo! Umcebo wenu nezingane zenu, mazinganilibazisi enkumbulweni ka Allah; labo abenza lokho, yibo kanye abalahlekelwe.

63:10.t: Futhi nanelane ngalokho esinabele kona ngaphambi kokuba kufike ukufa komunye wenu bese ethi: “Nkosi yami, uma nje ungangipha elinye ithuba ukuze nginikele futhi ngibe ngomunye wabalungileyo”.

63:11.t: U Allah akasoze amupha umuntu elinye ithuba uma sesifikile isikhathi sakhe; futhi u Allah ukuqaphe konke enikwenzayo.

64:1.t: Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kudumisa u Allah. Umbuso ungowaKhe nodumo lungolwaKhe, futhi unamandla okwenza noma yini.

64:2.t: Nguyena owanidala; kwaba khona abangakholwa kini kanye nabakholwayo. Belu u Allah ukubona konke enikwenzayo.

64:3.t: Udale amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso futhi wanibumba wanenza nabahle; kanti isiphetho sikuYe.

64:4.t: Wazi konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni futhi Wazi konke enikufihlile nenikuveze obala; ngokuba u Allah ukwazi konke okuthukuswe ezifubeni.

64:5.t: Aniyitholanga indaba yalabo abaphika ukholo endulo na?; bazivuna izithelo zemisebenzi yabo futhi bathola isijeziso esibuhlungu.

64:6.t: Lokho yingoba kwakuthi uma iZithunywa zabo ziletha izibonakaliso, bathi: “Singaholwa umuntu na?” Baphika ukholo bafulathela; kepha u Allah akadingi lutho, ngokuba u Allah Uzimele Uyadunyiswa.

64:7.t: Labo abangakholwa baqagula ukuthi abasoze bavuswa; yithi: “Nebala, ngiyifunge iNkosi yami, niyakuvuswa futhi naziswe ngezenzo zenu, bheka ngoba lokho kuyinto elula ku Allah”.

64:8.t: Kholwanike ku Allah neSithunywa Sakhe kanye neNkanyiso ayehlisela; u Allah ukuqaphile enikwenzayo.

64:9.t: Ngosuku lapho eyonibuthanisa ngalo, ngoSuku lokuButhana, lelo kuyakuba uSuku lokuGqama kokuLahlekelwa. Lowo okholwa ku Allah wenza okuhle Uyomesulela amacala akhe futhi amungenise ezivandeni okugeleza imifula ngaphansi kwazo, ahlale khona unaphakade; iyonake leyo impumelelo enkulu.

64:10.t: Kepha labo abaphika ukholo bachithe nezambulo Zethu ngamanga; yiboke labo abayobhadla eMlilweni unaphakade; saze sasibi isiphetho.

64:11.t: Asikho isehlakalo esehlayo ngaphandle kwemvumo ka Allah; lowo okholwa ku Allah uyakuyihola inhliziyo yakhe, ngokuba u Allah unolwazi lwakho konke.

64:12.t: Thobelani u Allah neSithunywa; kepha uma nidikila, umsebenzi weSithunywa Sethu ukwethula umlayezo ocacile.

64:13.t: U Allah, akekho omunye ofanele ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe; ngakhoke abakholwayo mababeke ithemba labo ku Allah.

64:14.t: Nina enikholwayo! Ebafazini benu nasezinganeni zenu kunesitha senu, ngakhoke baqapheleni. Kepha uma nixolela noma nidlulisa futhi nithethelele, u Allah Uyathethelela Unomusa.

64:15.t: Nebala, umcebo wenu nezingane zenu ziyisivivinyo, kepha u Allah unomvuzo omkhulu.

64:16.t: Ngakhoke, thobelani u Allah ngokusemandleni enu, nilalele nihloniphe futhi nanelane, ikona okungcono kini. Kantike lowo ohlengwe emoneni womphefumulo wakhe, ngempela, ungophumeleleyo.

64:17.t: Uma niboleka u Allah imboleko enhle, uyakuyiphindaphinda futhi anithethelele, bheka ngoba u Allah Uyazisa Unobubele.

65:1.t: Sithunywa! Uma nehlukanisa nabafazi; hlukanisani nabo ngesikhathi sabo sokuzithiba futhi nisibale kahle isikhathi sokuzithiba. Nithobele u Allah iNkosi yenu; ningabaxoshi emzini yabo futhi nabo bangaphumi, ngaphandle nje uma begila amanyala. Leyoke imiyalelo ka Allah; lowo ophula imiyalelo ka Allah impela uyazilulaza. Belu awazi mhlawumbe u Allah kukhona angakwenza emuva kalokho.

65:2.t: Uma sebephothule isikhathi sabo; buyelanani nabo noma nehlukane nabo ngokomthetho. Futhi niqoke amadoda amabili aqotho kini ukuba abe ngofakazi, ubufakazi nibenzele u Allah. Yilokho okuyalelwa ngakho lowo okholwa ku Allah noSuku lokuGcina. Lowo othobela u Allah uyakumcushisa.

65:3.t: Futhi amondle nangale ebengalindele khona. Lowo othembela ku Allah, uyomenela. Futhi u Allah uyayifeza into yaKhe. Nebala u Allah yonke into uyibekele umkhawulo.

65:4.t: Labo bafazi benu abangasakulindele ukuya esikhathini, uma ningabaza, isikhathi sabo sokuzithiba siyoba izinyanga ezintathu, kanye nakulabo abangasayi nhlobo esikhathini. Kuthi labo abazethwele, isikhathi siphela mhla bebeletha. Kantike lowo ozithoba ku Allah, uyakumenzela lula izinto zakhe.

65:5.t: Lokho kuwumthetho ka Allah awehlisele kini; lowo ozithoba ku Allah uyakumthethelela izimpambuko zakhe futhi amandisele umvuzo.

65:6.t: Hlalani nabo [abafazi enehlukanise nabo] lapho enihlala khona nibondle; ningabahlukumezi ukubathwesa ubunzima. Uma bezithwele bondleni kuze babelethe. Uma benincelisela bakhokheleni; nibonisane ngokuhle. Kepha uma ningavumelani, useyonceliselwa [uyise wengane] ngomunye.

65:7.t: Lowo ocebile makakhiphe ngokwamandla akhe, kuthi lowo ompofu akhiphe kulokho u Allah amphe kona. Bheka ngoba u Allah akemethwesi umuntu okudlula lokho amphe kona. U Allah uyekwenza kube lula emuva kobunzima.

65:8.t: Ziningi izizwe ezaphula umthetho weNkosi yazo neZithunywa zaKhe, Sabehlulela kanzima futhi sabajezisa isijeziso esinzima.

65:9.t: Bavuna izithelo zemisebenzi yabo; isiphetho sabo kwaba wukulahlekelwa.

65:10.t: U Allah ubalungiselele isijeziso esinzima; ngakhoke zithobeni ku Allah nina enikhaliphile enikholwayo, ngokuba u Allah unilethele uMkhumbuzi.

65:11.t: ISithunywa esinifundela imibiko zika Allah ezicacisayo, ukuze ahlenge labo abakholwayo futhi benze nokuhle ebumnyameni baye ekukhanyeni. Lowo okholwa ku Allah enze nokuhle, uyomngenisa ezivandeni okugeleza imifula phansi kwazo, ahlale khona unaphakade. Bheka ngoba u Allah umlungisele isondlo esihle.

65:12.t: Nguye u Allah odale amazulu ayisikhombisa kanye nokufanayo emhlabeni, imiyalelo yehla phakathi kwawo ukuze nazi ukuthi u Allah unamandla okwenza yonke into, nanokuthi u Allah wengamele yonke into ngolwazi lwaKhe.

66:1.t: Sithunywa! Kungani uzinqabela lokho u Allah akuvumele kona; ingabe ufuna ukujabulisa amakhosikazi akho na? U Allah Uyathethelela Unesihawu.

66:2.t: U Allah uninqumele ukuphula izifungo zenu, u Allah unguMhlengi wenu futhi nguYena Owazi konke Okhaliphile.

66:3.t: Khumbula lapho iSithunywa sihlebela inkosikazi yaso udaba oluthile, kepha kwathi esemtshela ngalo [omunye unkosikazi], u Allah wambonisa, okunye wakukhuluma kwathi okunye wakugodla. Kwathi esemtshelile [unkosikazi amhlebela] ngalo, wathi: “Ubani okutshele lokhu”, wathi: “Ngitshelwe Owazi konke Oqaphe konke!”.

66:4.t: Uma nicela [nina makhosikazi amabili] intethelelo ku Allah, ngokuba izinhliziyo zithemelezile kanti uma nimuhlanganyela, bheka ngoba u Allah unguMhlengi wakhe noJibhiruli nabakholwayo abaqotho, kanti futhi neZingelosi ziyamlekelela.

66:5.t: Funa iNkosi yakhe uma ehlukanisa nani amuphe abafazi abangcono kunani, angamaMusilimu akholwayo, azithobayo, acela intethelelo, akhonza-yo, azilayo, abake benda nabayizintombi nto.

66:6.t: Nina enikholwayo! Zivikeleni kanye nemindeni yenu eMlilweni ozithungelo zawo abantu namatshe; okujutshwe kuwo iZingelosi eziqatha ezingenasineke, aziphambuki no Allah kulokho aziyalele kona; zenza ngqo lokhu eziyalelwe kona.

66:7.t: Nina eningakholwa! ningabiki imbiba nebuzi naMhlanje, ngokuba niyakuthola umvuzo walokho ebenikwenza.

66:8.t: Nina enikholwayo! Zithibeni ku Allah okweqiniso; hleze iNkosi yenu inithethelele izimpambuko zenu futhi iningenise eZivandeni okugeleza phansi kwazo imifula, ngoSuku lapho u Allah angeke asiphoxe iSithunywa kanye nalabo abakholwa naso; inkazimulo yabo iyohamba phambi kwabo nangekwesokudla, bathi: “Nkosi yethu phelelisa inkazimulo yethu futhi usuthethelele ngokuba Wena unamandla okwenza konke.

66:9.t: Sithunywa! Phaka impi kulabo abangakholwa kanye nabazenzisi uqinise kubo; bhekha ngoba bayophelela eJahanamu, saze sasibi isiphetho.

66:10.t: U Allah wenzele labo abangakholwa isibonelo ngomfazi ka Nuhu nomfazi ka Luti; babengaphansi kwezinceku ezimbili zezinceku Zethu, kepha ababanga neqiniso kuzo; bheka ngoba azizange zibasize ngalutho ku Allah; kwathiwa kubo: “Ngenani eMlilweni nabangenayo!”.

66:11.t: Waphinde futhi u Allah wenzela labo abakholwayo isibonelo ngomfazi ka Firawoni mhla ethi: “Nkosi yami ngakhele umuzi kuWe eJana futhi ungitakule kuFirawoni nezenzo zakhe futhi ungitakule nakubantu abaphambukile.

66:12.t: NoMariyamu ka Imrani, lona owazithiba, sabe sesiphefumulela kuye uMoya weThu; wakholwa amaZwi eNkosi yaKhe neMibhalo yaKhe waba ngozithobileyo.

67:1.t: Ubusisekile lowo uMbuso useZandleni zaKhe futhi unamandla okwenza konke.

67:2.t: Lowo odale ukufa nokuphila ukuze anivivinye ukuthi ubabi kini ozokwenza kahle, futhi uSomandla Othethelelayo.

67:3.t: Lowo odale amazulu ayisikhombisa izigaba, awusoze wabona ukungalinga endalweni ka Allah; qalaza, ingabe lukhona uqhekeko olubonayo na?

67:4.t: Phinda futhi uqalaze kabili, amehlo azobuya edangele ekhathele.

67:5.t: Futhi sisihlobisile isibhakabhaka ngezibani, sazenza ukuba kujikijelwe ngazo amaShayatwini futhi siwalungiselele isijeziso seLangabi.

67:6.t: Labo abaphika iNkosi yabo bayothola isijeziso seJahanamu, saze sasibi isiphetho.

67:7.t: Kuyothi uma belahlelwa kuyo [iJahanamu] bezwe ibubula lapho isibila.

67:8.t: Kuthi mayiqhekeke intukuthelo; kuyothi njalo uma uquqaba luphonswa kuyo, umqhaphi wayo ababuze: “Ingabe akafikanga yini uMxwayisi kini na?”

67:9.t: Bayothi: “Nebala, wafika kiithi uMxwayisi, kepha samphika sathi: “Ayikho into u Allah ayehlisile, nisephutheni elukhulu”.

67:10.t: Bayothi: “Ukube nje salalela noma siqonde, ngabe asikho eLangabini”.

67:11.t: Bayozivuma izimpambuko zabo; baqakisiwe labo abaseLangabini.

67:12.t: Kepha labo abesaba iNKosi yabo bengayiboni, bayothola intethelelo nomvuzo omkhulu.

67:13.t: Khulumelani phansi noma phezulu, bheka ngoba Yena [u Allah] ukwazi konke okusezifubeni.

67:14.t: Angahlala kanjani engayazi okunguyena uMdali futhi Owazi yonke imininingwane Oqaphe konke na?

67:15.t: Nguyena lona onenzele umhlaba waba isendlalelo; ngakhoke guduzani emagumbini awo nizitike nganabele kona futhi niyovuselwa kuYe.

67:16.t: Ingabe nizibona niphephile kulowo Ophezulu ekutheni anigqibe ngomhlaba lapho uzamazama.

67:17.t: Ingabe nizibona niphephile kulowo Ophezulu ekutheni anithumele isiphepho; niyokwazike ukuthi sinjani isexwayiso.

67:18.t: Nalabo ababandulelayo baphika, saba njanike isijeziso Sami.

67:19.t: Ingabe abaziboni izinyoni phezu kwabo zivula zivala izimpiko na? Akhekho ozibambile [ukuba zingawi] ngaphandle koNomusa, bheka ngoba Yena Ubona konke.

67:20.t: Ingabe iliphi lelibutho eliyonisiza ngaphandle koNomusa na? Ngempela abangakholwa bakhohlisekile.

67:21.t: Ingabe ubani lona oyonipha ukudla uma [Allah] ekumisa okwaKhe na? Kepha basagxile shi ekuphuleni umthetho nasekugwemeni iqiniso.

67:22.t: Ingabe lowo ohamba ehuduka ngomuso ukhanyiseleke ukudlula lowo ohamba eqondile endleni eqondile na?

67:23.t: Yithi: “Nguyena lona owanisungula wanidalela izindlebe namehlo kanye nezinhliziyo, kepha niyincosana enibongayo.

67:24.t: Yithi: “Nguyena lona onisabalalise emhlabeni futhi niyobuthelwa kuYe”.

67:25.t: Bathi: “Kanti sinini lesi sethembiso na, uma niqinisile”.

67:26.t: Yithi: “Ulwazi liku Allah kuphela, mina nje nginguMxwayisi ocacisayo”.

67:27.t: Kepha lapho sebesibona eduzane, baswaca ebusweni, kwathiwa kubo: “Yikhoke lokhu ebenikufuna”.

67:28.t: Yithi: “Ake ningitshele, uma u Allah engithatha mina nalabo abanami noma asenzele umusa, ngubanike oyosiza abangakholwa esijezisweni esibuhlungu.

67:29.t: Yithi: “NgoNomusa, sikholwa kuYe futhi sethembele kuYe, noyokwazike maduze ukuthi ubani osephutheni uqobo.

67:30.t: Yithi: “Ake ningitshele, uma amanzi enu ezika, ingabe ubani oyonilethela amanzi agobhozayo.

68:7.t: Bheka ngoba iNkosi yakho ibazi kahle labo abadukayo endleni yaKhe kanti futhi ubazi kahle labo abasendleleni eqondile.

68:9.t: Bafisa engathi ungabathambisela ukuze nabo bakuthambisele.

68:10.t: Futhi ungamlaleli lowo othanda ukufunga ongenamandla.

68:14.t: Ngenxa yokuthi uyinjinga futhi enabantwana abaniningi.

68:15.t: Uma efundelwa imibiko yeThu, uthi: “Izinganekwane nje”.

68:17.t: Nebala sibavivinye kanjengoba savivinya abanikazi besivande mhla befunga ukuthi bayosivuna basigence entathakusa;

68:18.t: Kepha abashongo ukuthi; “uma u Allah evuma”.

68:19.t: Kwathi lapho belele, sehlelwa isehlekalo esivela eNkosini yakho.

68:22.t: Bethi: “Hambani ekuseni niye ezitshalweni zenu uma nizimisele ukuvuna.

68:25.t: Bahamba khona ekuseni bezimisele ukufeza abakuhlosile.

68:26.t: Kepha kwathi lapho besibona bathi: “Sidukile impela!”

68:28.t: Wathi lowo oqotho kubo: “Anginitshelanga na ukuthi nidumise u Allah”.

68:32.t: Mhlawumbe iNkosi yethu iyosinika okungcono kunaso [isivande] ngokuba sethembele eNkosini yethu.

68:33.t: Sinjaloke isijeziso, futhi isijeziso sakweLizayo sinzima; ukube nje bebazi.

68:34.t: Kepha labo abathobela u Allah bayothola izivande zentokomalo eNkosini yabo.

68:35.t: Singabenza kanjani abazithobayo bafane nezigilamkhuba na?

68:39.t: Kumbe ninezithembizo Nathi kuze kuyofika uSuku lokwaHlulela; ukuthi niyothola konke enikufunayo.

68:41.t: Kumbe banabalingani; mabalethe abalingani babo uma beqinisile.

68:42.t: Ngosuku lapho kuyovezwa Umbala bese bebizwa ukuba bakhothame bawe ngobuso, kepha bayohluleka.

68:43.t: Bayogqolozela phansi behaqwe ihlazo; kakade bebebizelwa ukuba bakhothame bawe ngobuso besayimiqemane.

68:44.t: Myekele kimi lowo ophika leZwi, ngiyombamba lapho enganake khona.

68:45.t: Ngizobapha isikathi, bheka ngoba isu laMi liqinile.

68:46.t: Ingabe ubakhokhisa inhlawulo, ebahlulayo ukuyikhokha na?

68:48.t: Ngakhoke bekezelela isinqumo seNkosi yakho ungafani nowagwinywa umkhome, mhla ememeza ephatheke kabi.

68:49.t: Ukube nje akawutholanga umusa weNkosi yakhe ngabe wakhafulelwa ehlane ehlazekile.

68:50.t: Kepha iNkosi yakhe yamqoka yamenza waba ngomunye wabalungileyo.

68:51.t: Nakuba labo abangakholwa bacishe bakuquzukise ngokugqoloza kwabo lapho bezwa isikhumbuzo; bathi: “uyazihlanyela lo”.

69:3.t: Uyokwazi kanjani ukuthi siyini Isikhathi seQiniso na?

69:4.t: Isizwe samaTamudi nakwa-Adi zasiphika Isikhathi Esithusayo.

69:5.t: Isizwe samaTamudi sabhujiswa sona ngomsindo onamandla.

69:6.t: Kwathi isizwe sakwa-Adi sabhujiswa sona ngesivunguvungu somoya obandanyo.

69:7.t: Wawuthumela kubo ubusuku obuyisikhombisa nezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili zilandelana; wawubona ngabantu bedindilizile okweziqu zemithi yamasundu eziwile.

69:9.t: NoFirawuni nalabo abamandulelayo kanye nalabo abasakazwa phansi beza nempambuko.

69:10.t: Beyisa Isithunywa sseNkosi yabo, bheka ngoba yabe isabajezisa kanzima.

69:11.t: Nebala kwathi lapho amanzi esegeleza ngokwendlulele Sanigibeza emkhunjini.

69:12.t: Ukuze ibe yisifundo kini futhi izwakale ezindlebeni ezilalelayo.

69:15.t: NgaloloSuku Isikhathi lapho siyokwenzeka khona iseSehlakalo.

69:16.t: NgaloloSuku isibhakabhaka siyoqhekeka bheka ngoba siyobe sesilula.

69:17.t: Izingelosi zona ziyobe zisizungezile. Futhi ngaloloSuku isiHlalo seNkosi yakho, siyobe sithwelwe eziyisishiyagalombili.

69:18.t: NgaloloSuku niyokwethulwa eNkosini yenu kungekho nencane imfihlo eyofihlakala ngani.

69:19.t: Lowo oyonikwa incwadi yakhe ngesokundla; uyokuthi: “Wozani fundani incwadi yami”

69:20.t: Bengivele ngazi ukuthi ngiyowudla umvuzo wami.

69:25.t: Kepha lowo oyonikwa incwadi yakhe ngesokunxele; uyothi: “ngifisa engathi anginikwanga incwadi yami”

69:26.t: Futhi angazi ukuthi yini umvuzo wami.

69:32.t: Bese nimfaka emaketangweni obude bawo bungagalo angamashumi ayisikhombisa.

69:33.t: Bheka ngoba ubengakholwa ku Allah Omkhulu.

69:41.t: Akusiwona amazwi embongi, ukuba ningakholwa idlanzana.

69:42.t: Futhi akusiwona amazwi esanusi, ukuba ningathathela idlanzana phezulu.

69:49.t: Kantike Siyazi ukuthi kukhona abaphika iqiniso kini.

69:52.t: Ngakhoke dumisa iGama leNkosi yakho eNkulu.

70:4.t: Izingelosi kanye noRuhu zenyukela kuYe esikhathini esiwusuku olulingana neminyaka eyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amahlanu.

70:8.t: Usuku lapho isibhakabhaka siyophenduka umdokwe oncibilikayo.

70:11.t: Bayobonana! Isigilamkhuba siyofisa ukuzihlenga esijezisweni saloloSuku ngezingane zaso.

70:17.t: Ubiza wonke lowo owadikila washaya indiva.

70:23.t: Labo abaqikelela ukwenza iSwala njalo nje.

70:28.t: Ngokuba akekho ophephile esijezisweni seNkosi yabo.

70:29.t: Labo futhi abavikela izitho zabo zangasese.

70:30.t: Ngaphandle uma kungabafazi babo noma amabibi, ngokuba abanacala.

70:31.t: Labo abalangezelela okungale kwalokho; yiziphulamthetho uqobo lezo.

70:32.t: Futhi labo abagcina izethembiso nezibophezelo zabo.

70:35.t: Yiboke labo abayongena eJana baphathwe kahle.

70:36.t: Yini ngalaba abangakholwa lokhu beshabashekela ngakuwe.

70:38.t: Ingabe bonke bafisa ukungeniswa eJana yentokomalo na?

70:39.t: Phinde! Bheka ngoba sibadale ngalokho abakwaziyo.

70:40.t: Ngifunga ngeNKosi yezimpumalanga nezintshonalanga ukuthi Siyakhona;

70:41.t: Ukuletha abanye abangcono kunabo futhi akekho oyophunyula.

70:42.t: Ngakhoke bayekele banhlanhlathe bachanase baze bafike kuloluSuku abathenjiswa lona.

70:43.t: Usuku lapho abayophuma khona emangcwabeni bephuthuma ongathi bajahele izithixo.

70:44.t: Bayokhophozela bethelwe ihlazo; yiloke loloSuku abathenjiswe lona.

71:1.t: Ngempela samuthumela uNuhu esizweni sakhe, ukuba: “Xwayisa abantu bakho bengakatholi isijeziso esibuhlungu”.

71:3.t: Khonzani u Allah nimuthobele futhi ningilalele.

71:4.t: Uzonithethelela izimpambuko zenu futhi uyonigcina kuze kube isikhathi esinqunyiwe. Bheka ngoba isikhathi esinqunywe u Allah asisoze sahlehliswa, ukube nje benazi.

71:5.t: Wathi: “Nkosi yami, ngimeme isizwe sami ubusuku nemini; ”

71:6.t: Kepha ukubamema kwami kubenze babaleka ngokudlangile.

71:7.t: Kuthi njalo uma ngibamema ukuze ubathethelele, bavame bafake iminwe ezindlebeni zabo bazimboze ngezambatho zabo futhi baphikelele bezigqaja.

71:10.t: Ngathi: “celani intethelelo eNkosini yenu ngokuba Yona iyahethelela.

71:12.t: Inandisele ingcebo nenzalo futhi anenzele izivande nemifula.

71:13.t: Yini ngani ningakhombisi inhlonipho ku Allah na?

71:15.t: Anibonanga ukuthi u Allah uwadale kanjani amazulu ayisikhombisa alakelana.

71:16.t: Wenza inyanga yaba ukukhanya kuwo, wenza ilanga isibani.

71:18.t: Futhi uyonibuyisela kuwo aphinde anikhiphe kuwo.

71:21.t: UNuhu wathi: “Nkosi yami, ngempela abangilalelanga, balandela lowo odukiswe kakhulu ingcebo yakhe nezingane zakhe;”

71:23.t: Bathi: “Ningazishiyi izikhonzwa zenu, ningabashiyi oWadu noSuwa’u noYaguta noYa’uka kanye noNasru.”

71:24.t: Empeleni baningi ababadukisile, yenzake labo abaphambukile bagxile ekudukeni.

71:25.t: Ngenxa yezimpambuko zabo, baminziswa bafakwa eMlilweni; abazange bathole abasizi ngaphandle kwa Allah.

71:26.t: UNuhu wabe esethi: “Nkosi yami, ungashiyi muntu ophilayo kulabo abangakholwa”.

71:27.t: “Ngokuba uma ubayeka bazodukisa izinceku zakho futhi bazolokho bezala eminye imigulukudu engakholwa”.

71:28.t: “Nkosi yami ngithethelele mina kanye nabazali bami nalowo ongena emzini wami ekholwa, nalabo abesilisa nabesifazane abakholwayo futhi wandisele labo abaphambukile ekulahlekelweni”.

72:1.t: Yithi: “Kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi iquqaba lamaJini belilalele, lathi: ‘Ngempela sizwe iKurani eyisimanga!’”

72:2.t: Iholela kubuqotho sakholwa kuyo futhi asisoze sabhangqa muntu no Allah.

72:3.t: Nokuthi udumo lweNkosi yethu luphakeme, akanamfazi akanangane.

72:4.t: Lowo owethu oyisiwula bekakhuluma iphutha ngo Allah.

72:5.t: Futhi besicabanga ukuthi Abantu namaJini abasoze bakhuluma amanga ngo Allah.

72:6.t: Nebala amadoda angabantu abecela ukuvikelwa amaJini, bheka ngoba abe esebathusa njalo.

72:7.t: Nabo bebecabanga njengani ukuthi u Allah akasoze avusa muntu ekufeni.

72:8.t: Kuthe lapho siya emkhathini sathola kugcwele abaqaphi kanzima namalangabi.

72:9.t: Kadeni besihlala silalele; kepha manje ozama ukulalela uhlangabezana nelangabi limlindele.

72:10.t: Empeleni nathi asazi, kumbe okubi okuhloselwe abasemhlabeni noma iNkosi yabo ibahlosele okuhle.

72:11.t: Kanti futhi kunabanye bethu abalungile kanti abanye abanjalo, sinezindlela ezahlukene.

72:12.t: Besazi ukuthi asisoze saphunyuka ku Allah emhlabeni futhi singasoze saphunyuka uma simubalekela.

72:13.t: Kuthe uma sizwa inkokhelo sakholwa kuyo, bheka ngoba lowo okholwa eNkosini yakhe akanalo ixhala lokucindezelwa no ukuthelwa ngengcabha.

72:14.t: Kantike kunalabo abangamaMusilimu kithi futhi kunalabo abaphambukile; kepha labo abazinikelayo yibo labo abziqokele ukulunga.

72:16.t: Ukube babambelela endleleni eqondile besizobapha amanzi ayinala.

72:17.t: Ukuze sibavivinye ngawo; kantike lowo ochitha imiyalo yeNkosi yakhe; iyomufaka esijezisweni esinzima.

72:18.t: AmaMasajidi angawaka Allah, ngakhoke ningakhonzi muntu no Allah.

72:19.t: Kwathi inceku ka Allah imile imkhonza bacishe balakenyana phezu kwakhe.

72:20.t: Yithi: “Ngikhonza iNkosi yami kuphela vo, futhi angiyibhanqi nalutho!”

72:21.t: Yithi: “Okubi nokuhle kini akukho ezandleni zami”

72:22.t: Yithi: “Akekho noyedwa oyongivikela ku Allah futhi akukho la engiyophephela khona ngaphandle kwaKhe!”

72:23.t: Ngiphethe nje umlayezo ovela ku Allah nemiyalelo yaKhe; loyo ongalaleli u Allah neSithunywa saKhe uthola uMlilo weJahanamu, uyobhadla kuwo unaphakade.

72:24.t: Kuyothi lapho bebona lokho abathenjiswe kona; bayokwazi kahle ukuthi ubani obengumsizi obuthaka nonebutho elidlanzana.

72:25.t: Yithi: “Angazi ukuba kuseduze na lokhu enithenjiswe kona kumbe iNkosi yami ikuhlehlisele isikhathi esithize.”

72:26.t: UnguSolwazi wokungabonwa, akambuleli muntu kokungabonwa kwaKhe.

72:27.t: Ngaphandleke kwalowo amqokile njengeSithunywa; bheka ngoba izingqaphi zikanise ngaphambili nangemuva.

72:28.t: Ukuze azi ukuthi bayendlulisile imiyalelo yeNkosi yabo futhi ingamele konke abanakho kanti futhi yazi yonke into ngononina.

73:2.t: Ima ebusuku ukhonze, ngaphandle nje okwesikhashana.

73:3.t: Isigamu sabo noma wehlise nje kancane;

73:4.t: Noma wengeze futhi ufunde iKurani ngesineke.

73:6.t: Ukukhonza ebusuku kunomthelela omkhulu nenkulumo ecacile.

73:8.t: Khumbula igama leNkosi yakho uzunikele kuYo ngokuphelele.

73:9.t: UyiNkosi yempumalanga nentshonalanga, akekho omunye ofanele ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe, ngakhoke thembela kuYe.

73:11.t: Ungishiyele labo abaphika iqiniso abacebile, ubayeke nje kancane.

73:14.t: NgoSuku lapho umhlaba nezintaba kuyozamazama, izintaba ziphenduke izintuli eziphephukayo.

73:15.t: Nebala sathumela iSithunywa kini njengofakazi, njengalokhu sathumela iSithunywa kuFironi.

73:16.t: Kepha uFironi akasilalelanga iSithunywa, ngakhoke samujezisa kanzima.

73:17.t: Nilwesaba kanjani usuku oluyokwenza izingane zibempunga njengoba ningakholwa na?

73:18.t: Ngisho isibhakabhaka imbala siyoqhekeka ngalo. Isithembiso saKhe nakanjani siyenzeka.

73:19.t: Lesi isexwayiso, othandayo makathathe indlela ebheke eNkosini yakhe.

73:20.t: Ngempela iNkosi yakho iyazi ukuthi wena neqembu lalabo abanawe niyama okuthi akusonde izigamu ezimbile kwezintathu, nesigamu kwezimbili nesigamu kwezintathu; u Allah nguYena ohlela ubusuku nemini. Ubazi ukuthi anisoze nakhona, wanithethelela; ngakhoke fundani enikukhonayo kuKurani. Ubazi ukuthi kuyoba khona kini abagulayo abanye bayasebenza bethungatha umusa ka Allah, kuthi abanye bayalwa endleleni ka Allah, ngakhoke fundani enikukhonayo kuyo; niqikelele ukwenza iSwala nikhiphe neZaka futhi niboleleke u Allah imboleko enhle. Konke enizenzela kona okuhle niyokuthola ku Allah kungcono kunomvuzo omkhulu. Nicele intethelelo ku Allah ngokuba u Allah uyaThethelela Unesihawu.

74:9.t: Lolo suku liyokuba uSuku olunzima impela.

74:11.t: Ngidedele Mina nalowo engamdala eyedwa vo.

74:20.t: Waphinde waqalekiswa ngendlela akha ngayo isu.

74:31.t: Senze abaqaphi boMlilo baba yizingelosi futhi senze nenani labo laba siyilingo kulabo abangakholwa, ukuze labo abanikwa iMibhalo babe nesiqiniseko kuthi labo abakholwayo bande ngokholo. Ukuze labo abanikwa iMibhalo nabakholwayo bangabi nokungabaza. Kepha laba abanesifo ezinhlizweni zabo nalaba abangakholwa bayothi: “Ingabe uhloseni u Allah ngalomzekelo na?” Kanjalo u Allah udukisa amthandayo futhi ahole amthandayo. Kantike akekho owazi ibutho lika Allah ngaphandle kwaKhe. Futhi (uMlilo) uyixwayiso kuSintu.

74:37.t: Kulowo kini ofuna ukuya phambili noma uhlehlela nyovana.

74:52.t: Kunalokho wonke umuntu ufuna ukunikwa incwadi evuliwe.

74:56.t: Futhi abasoze balalela ngaphandle kwentando ka Allah; nguYena ofanelwe ukuthotshelwa nokuthethelela.

75:3.t: Ingabe umuntu ucabanga ukuthi asisoze sahlanganisa amathambo (abashona) na?

75:4.t: Nebala, sikwazi ngisho ukuhlanganisa iminwe yakhe.

75:5.t: Kepha umuntu ufuna ukuqhubeka nokuphula umthetho.

75:6.t: Elokhu ebuza ukuthi lunini uSuku lokwaHlulela.

75:10.t: Ngalolo suku wonke umuntu uyothi: “ngiyobalekela kuphi na?”

75:12.t: Ngalolo suku konke kuyophelela eNkosini yakho.

75:13.t: Yingalolu suku lapho wonke umuntu eyokwaziswa ngakho konke akwenza.

75:24.t: Kanti ngalolo suku obunye ubuso buyobe buhwaqile.

75:36.t: Ingabe umuntu ucabanga ukuthi uzoyekwa nje enganakwa na?

75:37.t: Ubengelona yini ihlwili lesidoda esiphumayo na?

75:38.t: Wabe eseba isigaqa segazi, wadala wabumba.

75:39.t: Wadala ngaye ubulili obubili, indoda nomfazi.

75:40.t: Ingabeke akanawo yini Lowo (uMdali) amandla okuvusa abafileyo na?

76:1.t: Kwaba nesikhathi esithize lapho umuntu wayengelutho olwaziwayo.

76:2.t: Samdala umuntu ngesidoda esixutshiwe ukuze simvivinye, Samenza wezwa wabona.

76:3.t: Samthengisa indlela, yokuba obongayo noma ongabongi.

76:5.t: Labo abalungileyo bayophuza isiphuzo esithakwe ngeKafuri.

76:6.t: Emthonjeni okuyophuza kuwo izinceku zika Allah, ziwugelezise nokuwugelezisa.

76:7.t: Bagcina izethembiso futhi besaba usuku obubi balo buyobe busabalele.

76:8.t: Futhi bondla ngokudla labo abaswele, izintandane neziboshwa nakuba bekuthanda.

76:9.t: Sinondlela ukuthokozisa u Allah, asifune mklomelo kini noma ukunconywa.

76:10.t: Ngokuba sesaba iNkosi yethu ngoSuku lapho kuyobe kunokuswaba okunzima.

76:11.t: U Allah wabavikela ebubini balolo Suku, wabalethela intokomalo nenjabulo.

76:13.t: Kuyo (iJana) bayohlala baqiyame emibhedeni; abayikubona langa noma amakhaza ashubisa umnkantsha.

76:14.t: Amathunzi ayo (iJana) ayomengamela futhi nezithelo zayo ziyosondezelwa eduze.

76:15.t: Futhi bayophakelwa ezitsheni zesiliva nezinkomishi eziyingilasi;

76:17.t: Futhi bayophuziswa kuyo isiphuzo esithakwe ngeZanjambili.

76:19.t: Bayobe besetshenzelwa abafana abaphila unaphakade, uma ubabona uzocabanga ukuthi amaLulu achithekile.

76:20.t: Uma uqalaza lapho uzobona intokomalo nobukhosi obukhulu.

76:21.t: Bayombathiswa izembatho eziluhlaza zesilika elithambile nelihayayo. Bahlotshiswe ngamabhengela esiliva, futhi iNkosi yabo izobaphuzisa isiphuzo esihlanzekile.

76:22.t: (kuyothiwa kubo): “Ngempela lokhu kuwumvuzo wenu kanti nemisebenzi yenu iyancomeka.”

76:24.t: Ngakhoke bekezelela isinqumo seNkosi yakho futhi ungalaleli kubo (abangakholwa) lowo ophambukile noma ongenakubonga.

76:25.t: Ukhumbule igama leNkosi yakho ekuseni nantambama.

76:26.t: Nasebusuku mkhothamele (u Allah) umdumise isikhathi eside ebusuku.

76:27.t: Empeleni laba (abangakholwa) bathanda okuseduze (emhlabeni) kepha beshaya indiva uSuku Olunzima.

76:28.t: Yithina esibadalile saqinisa ukwakheka kwabo, ngakhoke uma sithanda singaletha abanye abafana nabo esikhundleni sabo.

76:29.t: Lokhu yisikhumbuzo nje, ngakhokelowo ofunayo anangayithatha indlela eya eNkosini yakhe.

76:30.t: Futhi akukho eningakufisa ngaphandle kwentando ka Allah; u Allah Wazi konke uKhaliphile.

76:31.t: Ufaka amathandayo emseni waKhe, kuthi laba abaphambukile ubalusele isijeziso esibuhlungu.

77:14.t: Uthi bewazi ukuthi luyini uSuku lokwaHlulelwa na?

77:15.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:19.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:24.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:27.t: Safaka kuwo (umhlaba) izikhonkwane (izintaba) ezinkulu futhi Sanipha amanzi amtoti.

77:28.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:31.t: Ongenakho ukuphola futhi ongasizi ngalutho elangabini.

77:34.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:37.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:40.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:41.t: Labo abathobele u Allah bayoba semthunzini nasemithonjeni.

77:43.t: Dlanini niphuze ngokunethezeka ngenxa yezenzo zenu.

77:45.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:47.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:49.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kubaphiki beqiniso ngalolo Suku.

77:50.t: Iyona yiphi inkulumo emuva kwale (iKurani) abazoyikholwa.

78:9.t: Futhi Senza ubuthongo benu kwaba ukuphumula.

78:11.t: Imini yona Sayenza isikhathi sokuphemba impilo.

78:12.t: Futhi Sakha phezu kwenu izakhiwo eziyisikhombisa (amazulu) eziqinile.

78:18.t: Usuku lapho liyoshaywa icilongo, nize ngezinqumbi.

78:25.t: Ngaphandleke nje kwamanzi abilayo noma izinsila.

78:29.t: Kantike yonke into Siyiqophe phansi ngombhalo.

78:30.t: Ngakhoke izwani, ngoba asizukunandisela ngaphandle kwesijeziso.

78:31.t: Labo abathobela u Allah bayothola impumelelo.

78:36.t: Umvuzo ovela eNkosini yakho nesipho esibaliwe.

78:37.t: INkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokungaphakathi kwawo, Onomusa; akekho onegunya lokukhuluma naYe.

78:38.t: NgoSuku lapho uRuhu nezingelosi bayoma emigqeni; akekho oyokhuluma ngaphandle kwalowo ogunyazwe Onomusa futhi akhulume okuyikona.

78:39.t: Kuyobe kuwuSuku lweQiniso lolo, ngakhoke makazilungiselele ukubuyela eNkosini yakhe lowo othandayo.

78:40.t: Nebala, Thina sinixwayisile ngesijeziso esiseduze, ngosuku lapho umuntu eyobona izenzo zakhe kuthi lowo obengakholwa athi: “Maye, ngifisa ukube ngabe ngiwuthuli.”

79:10.t: Kepha basathi: “Ingabe ngempela siyobuyiselwa esimeni sasekuqaleni (sempilo)”

79:15.t: Ingabe ifikile kuwe indaba kaMusa na?

79:16.t: Mhla iNkosi yakhe immemeza endaweni engcwele eTuwa.

79:17.t: (Yathi): “Hamba uye kuFiriwoni ngokuba ngempela uphambukile ngokwendlulele”.

79:25.t: Kepha u Allah wamujezisa isijeziso sokuqala nesokugcina.

79:27.t: Ingabe yinina okunzima ukunidala noma isibhakabhaka asidala.

79:29.t: Wagqungqisa ubusuku baso wagqamisa imini yaso.

79:31.t: Wakhiqhiza kuwo amanzi awo namandlelo awo.

79:35.t: Ngosuku lapho wonke umuntu uyokhumbula akwenza.

79:40.t: Kantike lowo owasaba mhla ezoma phambi kweNkosi yakhe, wazithiba ezinkanukwenu eziphambukile.

79:42.t: Bayakubuza ngeSikhathi ukuthi siyofika nini na?

79:46.t: Ngosuku lapho besibona (iSikhathi) kuyoba ngathi baphile isigamu sosuku noma ingxenye yaso.

80:34.t: Ngalolo Suku wonke umuntu uyobalekela umnewabo.

80:37.t: Ngokuba ngalolosuku wonke umuntu uyobe ekhungethekile.

80:40.t: Kanti obunye ubuso buyobe bumbozwe uthuli.

81:20.t: Esinamandla, esisezingeni eliphezulu kuMnini weSihlalo [u Allah].

81:23.t: Bheka ngoba wasibona [iSithunywa uJibhirili] okwalweni olubanzi.

81:27.t: Bheka ngoba iyiSikhumbuzo nje ezizweni zonke.

81:29.t: Futhi angeke nafisa ngaphandle kwentando ka Allah iNkosi yezizwe zonke.

82:5.t: Umuntu uyokwazi lokho akwenzile nobekuyinkambiso yakhe.

82:6.t: Wena muntu [ongakholwa]! Yini ekudukisile ngeNkosi yakho eHloniphekile na?

82:8.t: Nakuba abengakudala ube yinoma yiphi into ayifunayo.

82:13.t: Labo abaqotho abenza okuhle bayongena entokomalweni.

82:17.t: Uthi uyazi nje ukuthi luyini uSuku lokwaHlulela na?

82:18.t: Uthi ngempela uyazi ukuthi luyini uSuku lokwaHlulelwa na?

82:19.t: Usuku lapho umuntu engezukusiza omunye ngalutho; futhi yonke into ngaloloSuku iyobe iphethwe ngu Allah.

83:2.t: Labo uma bekala ebantwini bafuna isikali esigcwele.

83:4.t: Ingabe labo abazi yini ukuthi bayovuswa na?

83:6.t: Usuku lapho abantu bayoma phambi kweNkosi yezizwe.

83:8.t: Uthi bewazi nje ukuthi iyini iSijini na?

83:10.t: Imbubhiso iyoba kulabo abaphika iqiniso ngaloloSuku.

83:13.t: Uma efundelwa imibiko yeThu, uthi: “izinganekwane zasendulo lezi”.

83:14.t: Qhabo; empeleni izinhliziyo zabo zimbozwe uqweqwe lwezenzo zabo.

83:15.t: Qha! Bayovinjelwa ukubona iNkosi yabo ngaloloSuku.

83:19.t: Uthi bewazi nje ukuthi iyini i-iLiyini na?

83:22.t: Labo abaqotho abenza okuhle bayongena entokomalweni.

83:26.t: Esiqedelelwe ngeMisiki; yikonake lokho okumele bancintisanele kukho abancintisanayo.

83:29.t: Labo abayizephulamthetho babekade behleka labo abakholwayo.

83:31.t: Uma [abangakholwa] bebuyela emizini yabo, babuyela bethakasile.

83:36.t: Ingabe abangakholwa bawutholile yini umvuzo ofanele imisebenzi yabo na?

84:6.t: Muntu! Nebala ulibangise eNkosini yakho, nakanjani uyoyifumanisa.

84:10.t: Kepha lowo oyonikwa incwadi yakhe emuva komhlane wakhe,

84:13.t: Bheka ngoba wayekade enethezekile nomndeni wakhe.

84:23.t: Kepha u Allah ukwazi kahle lokho abakufihlayo.

84:24.t: Ngakhoke bathulele izindaba ezinhle zesijeziso esibuhlungu.

84:25.t: Ngaphandle kwalabo abakholwayo abenza okuhle, bona bayothola umvuzo ongenamkhawulo.

85:8.t: Ayikho into ababebajezisela yona ngaphandle nje kokuthi bakholwa ku Allah uSomandla oDunyiswayo.

85:9.t: Lona onguMnini wamazulu nomhlaba, futhi u Allah uzibheke zonke izinto.

85:10.t: Nebala labo abahlukumeza abakholwayo besilisa nabesifazane baphinde bangaceli intethelelo, bayothola isijeziso seJahanamu futhi bayothola isijeziso soMlilo.

85:11.t: Kepha labo abakholwayo benze okuhle, bona bayothola izivande okugeleza ngaphansi kwazo imifula; iyonake leyo impumelelo enkulu.

85:13.t: Bheka ngoba nguYena owasungala [indalo ingelutho] nobuyiselayo [indalo esimeni sayo emuva kokufa].

85:17.t: Ingabe lufikile kuwe udaba lwamabutho na?

86:2.t: Ungabe uyokwazi kanjani ukuthi siyini lesifika kuhlwa na?

86:5.t: Ngakhoke umuntu [ophika ukuvuswa] makabheke ukuthi wadalwa ngani.

86:8.t: Kepha Yena [u Allah] uyakwazi ukumbuyisela [esimeni sakuqala].

86:17.t: Ngakhoke bayeke nje abangakholwa, Nami Ngibayekile okwesikhashana.

87:7.t: Ngaphandle kwalokho u Allah afuna ukukhohlwe; ngokuba Yena wazi okusobala nokusithele.

87:9.t: Ngakhoke xwayisa lapho isexwayiso sinomthelela khona.

87:10.t: Bheka ngoba lowo onokwesaba [u Allah] uzoxwayiseka.

87:15.t: Wakhumbula iGama leNkosi yakhe wenza neSwala.

88:16.t: Kanye namacanci kakhaphethi andlalwe ndawo yonke.

88:17.t: Ingabe abaliboni ikameli ukuba lidalwe kanjani na?

88:21.t: Ngakhoke xwayisa, ngokuba ungumexwayisi nje kuphela.

89:5.t: Ingabe konke lokufunga akwemenele lowo okhaliphile na?

89:6.t: Awubonga ukuthi iNkosi yakho yasenzani isizwe sakwa Adi na?

89:8.t: Lena okungakaze kwakhiwe efana nayo emhlabeni.

89:9.t: Kanye nesakwaTamudi lesi esaqhekeza amadwala [bakha imizi] Ehlanzeni.

89:13.t: Kepha iNkosi yakho yabashaya ngoswazi lwesijeziso.

89:15.t: Uma umuntu evivinywa iNkosi yakhe ngokumupha nangokumcebisa, uthi: “iNkosi yami ingibusisile”.

89:16.t: Kuthi uma isimvivinya, ngokumswinya isondlo sakhe, athi: “iNkosi yami ingihlazile”.

89:22.t: INkosi yakho Iyokuza nezingelosi zime imigqa ngemigqa.

89:23.t: Kuthi neJahanamu ilethwe ngaloloSuku; ngaloloSuku wonke umuntu uzothoba; kambe kuyomsiza kanjani ukuthoba na?

89:25.t: NgaloloSuku, akekho noyedwa oyoba nesijeziso esifana neSakhe,

89:28.t: Buyela eNkosi yakho weneme futhi uthokozelwe.

90:5.t: Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi akekho noyedwa ongamnqoba na?

90:7.t: Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi akabonwa muntu na?

90:12.t: Uthi bewazi nje ukuthi iyini lenqinamba na?

90:17.t: Uyobeke [owenza okuhle] eseba kanye nalabo abakholwayo abalulekana ngokubekezela nangokuba nomusa.

90:19.t: Kuthi labo abangakholwa imibiko yeThu, babe ngabangakwesokunene.

91:11.t: Waliphika iqiniso uTamudi ngokuphula kwabo umthetho.

91:12.t: Mhla lowo owonakele kubo bonke ebahlohla.

91:13.t: ISithunywa sika Allah [u Swalihi] sathi kubo: “Qaphelani, ikameli lika Allah namanzi alo!”.

91:14.t: Kepha abamukholwanga, baligenca balibulala; iNkosi yabo yababhubhisa bonke kwangasala muntu ngenxa yempambuko yabo.

92:11.t: Futhi umcebo wakhe awuyikumsiza lapho esengena [eMlilweni].

92:17.t: Kepha lowo othobela u Allah uyohlengeka.

92:18.t: Lowo ophana ngomcebo wakhe ngoba ezihlanza.

92:19.t: Futhi ebe engalangezele ukunxephezelwa muntu ngokuhle akwenzayo.

92:20.t: Ngaphandle kokulangezelela Ubuso beNkosi yakhe Ephakeme.

93:4.t: Nebala eLizayo ilona elingcono kuwe kunalomhlaba.

93:5.t: Futhi iNkosi yakho izokwabela uze wencame.

93:6.t: Ayikuthola yini [iNkosi yakho] uyintandane Yakuphephisa na?

95:6.t: Ngaphandle kwalabo abakholwayo benze okuhle, ngokuba bona bayothola umvuzo ongenamkhawulo.

95:7.t: Iyona yiphi into ezokwenza uphike ukholo emuva kwalokhu na?

95:8.t: Akuyena yini u Allah oNgomehluleli ovelele na?

96:1.t: Funda eGameni leNkosi yakho okuyiyona eyadala.

96:3.t: Funda, belu iNkosi yakho iphana kakhulu.

96:12.t: Kumbeke egqugquzelela ukuzithoba ku Allah na?

96:13.t: Uke wambona lapho esephika iqiniso futhi elishaya indiva.

96:14.t: Ingabe ngempela akazi yini ukuthi u Allah Uyabona na?

96:19.t: Qha! Ungamlaleli, kepha ukhothame [ku Allah] ukhonze.

97:2.t: Ingabe uyazi ukuthi buyini uBusuku beSinqumo na?

97:4.t: Izingelosi kanye noRuhu [uJibhirili] ziyehla kubo [uBusuku] ngemvumo yeNkosi yazo ngalo lonke udaba [olunqunyiwe].

98:1.t: Labo abangakholwa kwabeMibhalo kanye namaMushrikina [ababhanqi] abasoze bayeka [ukholo lwabo] kuze kuba kufika ubufakazi.

98:2.t: ISithunywa sika Allah esibafundela Imiqulu Ehlanzekile.

98:4.t: Laba abanikwa iMibhalo, bahlakazeka emuva kokuba sekufike kubo imibiko ecacile.

98:5.t: Futhi babekade beyalelwe ukuba bakhonze u Allah ngokuzinikela okumsulwa bengambhangqi nalutho, futhi baqikelele ukwenza iSwala nokukhipha iZaka; bheka ngoba iyona leyo inkolo eqotho [i-Isilamu].

98:6.t: Nebala, labo abangakholwa kwabeMibhalo namaMushirikina bayongena eMlilwe wase Jahanamu babhadle kuwo unaphakade; yiboke kanye labo abayindalo embi.

98:7.t: Kepha labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo, yibona abayindalo enhle.

98:8.t: Umvuzo wabo oseNkosini yabo izivande zaseDeni okugeleza enzansi kwazo imifula, bayohlala kuzo unaphakade; u Allah uthokozile ngabo kanti nabo bathokozile ngo Allah. Lokho okumuntu owesaba iNkosi yakho.

99:2.t: Lapho umhlaba uyokhafula imithwalo yabo [konke okungcwatshwe kuwo].

99:3.t: Umuntu lapho uyothi: “Ingabe ungenwe yini na?”

99:4.t: Ngalolosuku uyobe ukhipha zonke izindaba zawo.

99:6.t: Ngalolosuku abantu bayophuma bathi chithisaka ukuze bakhonjiswe izenzo zabo.

99:7.t: Lowo owenze okuhle noma kukuncane kanjani, uyokubona.

99:8.t: Nalowo owenze okubi, noma kukuncane kanjani, uyokubona.

100:11.t: Impela, iNkosi yabo iyobe yazi konke ngabo ngalolosuku.

101:3.t: Futhi ingabe uyokwazi kanjani ukuthi uyini Umethusi.

101:4.t: uSuku lapho abantu bayoba njengamavemuvana athe chithisaka.

101:8.t: Kepha lowo isikali sakhe siyoba lula;

103:3.t: Ngaphandle kwalabo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo nabelulekana ngeqiniso nangokubekezela.

104:3.t: Acabange ukuthi umcebo wakhe uzohlala naye unaphakade.

104:5.t: Ingabe uyazi ukuthi iyini iHutwama na?

105:1.t: Awubonga yini ukuthi yabenzani iNkosi yakho laba abezindlovu na?

105:2.t: Akazange yini enze uzungu labo lwangaphumelela na?

106:2.t: Ukujwayela kwabo ukuthatha uhambo lwasebusika nasehlobo.

106:4.t: Lena ebondlayo lapho belambile futhi ibavikele lapho besaba.

107:5.t: Labo abangaqikeleli ukwenza iSwala yabo ngendlela.

108:2.t: Ngakhoke bhekisa iSwala nomhlatshelo eNkosini yakho.

108:3.t: Lowo okugxekayo nguyena empeleni onqanyukelwe ulibo.

109:4.t: Futhi angisoze ngakukhonza lokhu nina enikukhonzayo.

109:6.t: Nine nkolo yenu, nami nginenkolo yami.

110:1.t: Uma sekufike usizo luka Allah nokunqoba.

110:2.t: Lapho usubona abantu bengena eNkolweni ka-Allah ngobuningi,

110:3.t: Babaza udumo lweNkosi yakho uyicele nentethelelo, impela Yona iyathethelela.

111:1.t: Engathi zingabhubha izandla zika Abu-Lahabi naye futhi abhubhe.

111:2.t: Umcebo wakhe nenzuzo yakhe akumsizanga ngalutho.

111:4.t: Kanti nomfazi wakhe uzobe ethwele izinkuni.
